name: ThreadNote — メモとスレッド
description:
ThreadNoteは、思いつきとその続きを、ひとつのスレッドに残せるメモアプリです。

まずは「＋ スレッド」から、ひとこと投稿。
あとからメモを重ねて、考えたことや気づいたことをまとめられます。

勉強の問題と考え方、読書で気になった言葉、日々のアイデアなどに。
自分のペースで、書いたことを少しずつ育てていきましょう。

主な機能
・スレッドを作成し、その中にメモを追加
・メモを検索し、一致する言葉をハイライト
・元のスレッド本文を確認しながら考えを整理
・スレッド単位、または全メモをMarkdownで書き出し
・最近削除した項目から復元
・ライトモードとダークモードに対応

広告やSNSへの公開機能はありません。

name: Animal Sounds: Tuca the Toucan
description:
Moo! Beep beep! Boom, boom! In Animal Sounds, children hear 91 real sounds: 50 animals, from the farm to the forest and from the sea to the jungle, plus 41 everyday sounds such as a car, a train, a drum, a doorbell and the rain. Their guide is Tuca, a friendly toucan who cheers every discovery.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 50 animals with sounds recorded in nature: cow, horse, rooster, lion, elephant, wolf, whale, dolphin, owl, bee, frog and many more, in 7 colourful habitats.
• NEW: 6 themes from a child's day: Vehicles, Music, Around the house, Nature and weather, People sounds and Party and play. There's an ambulance, a plane, a piano, a kettle, thunder, a sneeze, clapping, fireworks and much more.
• A card for every sound, with a big illustration, the sound written out ("Moo!") and a fun fact to read together.
• A voice says the name after the sound, so children learn the word while playing.
• NEW: cheerful animations (music notes, confetti, stars) and a gentle vibration on every tap, which can be turned off in Settings.
• "Who makes this sound?" game in two modes: listen and find who makes it, or see the picture and find its sound. Easy level with 3 choices and challenge level with 4.
• Magic touch for the little ones: every tap makes an animal pop up and sing, with no menus and no ads.
• Sticker album: every sound heard becomes a sticker. Can you collect all 91?
• Favourites and search by name.
• English, Portuguese and Spanish.

MADE FOR CHILDREN AND THEIR PARENTS
• No sign-up, no in-app purchases and no collection of personal data.
• A small ad appears at the bottom of some screens. It is never personalised and always suitable for children. There are no ads in the game or in Magic touch.
• Links, rating and privacy options live in a parents' area behind a grown-up question.
• Works offline. Only the ad needs a connection.

The sounds are public-domain (CC0) recordings and the illustrations come from Google's Noto Emoji 3D project. Full credits are in the app.

name: Anointed H-Line 7 by Mr. Korg
description:
Anointed H-Line 7 by Mr. Korg puts your Line 6 Helix Floor on your iPad. Load presets, hit snapshots, switch stomps and move the pedals from one big stage screen, over USB or Bluetooth MIDI.

STAGE
- The current preset, big pads for Snapshots 1 to 8 and the 10 footswitches (FS1 to FS5 and FS7 to FS11), with your own names and LED colors.
- Three expression pedals and the toe switch.
- Previous and next preset and snapshot, Tap Tempo with BPM, Tuner, All Bypass and Footswitch Mode.

PRESETS
- All 128 presets in each of the 8 setlists, in Helix order (01A to 32D).
- Tap to load, long-press to rename, search, and import your own names by pasting a list.

CONTROLS
- Make your own knobs, toggles and buttons. Each one sends a MIDI CC that you link to any block parameter on your Helix with Controller Assign, so you can adjust gain, mix or delay time from the iPad.

LOOPER
- Record, Overdub, Play, Stop, Play Once, Undo, Reverse, Half Speed and Looper block on and off.

SETUP
- Choose the MIDI device and channel, connect Bluetooth MIDI, name your setlists, snapshots and footswitches, and watch every message sent and received in the MIDI monitor.

TWO-WAY
- When you change a preset or snapshot on the Helix itself, the app follows along. With MIDI Clock on, it shows the Helix tempo.

GOOD TO KNOW
- You need a Line 6 Helix Floor and a USB cable or a Bluetooth MIDI adapter. Without a Helix the app opens and you can look around, but there is nothing to control.
- The app sends and receives standard MIDI. It does not edit amp models or signal chains; use HX Edit on a computer for that.
- The screen stays awake while the app is open.

Made by worship musicians for worship musicians.

Anointed H-Line 7 by Mr. Korg is an independent app. It is not made, sponsored or endorsed by Line 6 or Yamaha Guitar Group. Line 6 and Helix are trademarks of Yamaha Guitar Group, Inc.

name: Aura Bookly
description:
Aura Bookly, c'est la réservation beauté pensée pour les cils, les sourcils et les ongles.

POUR TOI QUI RÉSERVES
• Cherche un salon par ville ou par nom : extensions et rehaussement de cils, sourcils, ongles, maquillage permanent.
• Découvre chaque salon : photos, prestations et tarifs, horaires, adresse et avis.
• Profite des promotions du moment, signalées directement sur les prestations.
• Choisis ta prestation, ta praticienne si tu veux, puis un créneau libre : c'est réservé.
• Si le salon demande un acompte, tu le paies par carte en toute sécurité au moment de réserver.
• Retrouve tous tes rendez-vous au même endroit, déplace-les ou annule-les en quelques secondes.
• Reçois ta confirmation et ton rappel, pour ne rien oublier.
• Offre une carte cadeau à une amie, avec la date d'envoi de ton choix.

POUR TOI QUI ES PRO DE LA BEAUTÉ
Tu as un compte pro Aura Bookly ? Connecte-toi avec ton email, avec Google ou avec Apple, et emporte ton salon partout :
• ton agenda et tes rendez-vous, et ceux de ton équipe ;
• un rendez-vous à ajouter, déplacer ou annuler, une cliente absente à noter ;
• tes fiches clientes, leur historique et leur fiche de suivi ;
• tes prestations, tes promotions, tes horaires, tes indisponibilités et tes photos ;
• une description de salon ou de prestation écrite pour toi en un appui ;
• les acomptes à la réservation et les liens de paiement par carte, si tu les as activés ;
• les rappels SMS pour tes clientes, si tu prends l'option ;
• la demande d'avis envoyée automatiquement après chaque rendez-vous ;
• la réservation en ligne à ouvrir ou mettre en pause d'un simple appui.
L'appli et ton espace pro sur aurabookly.com partagent les mêmes données : ce que tu changes d'un côté se voit aussitôt de l'autre.

SIMPLE ET RESPECTUEUSE
• Pas de publicité, pas de pistage.
• Une seule autorisation : l'accès à tes photos, seulement quand tu ajoutes des photos de ton salon.
• Tu peux supprimer ton compte à tout moment depuis l'appli.

Une question ? Écris-nous à contact@aurabookly.com.

name: BIP39 Index
description:
BIP39 Index replaces the printed word list. Type a number from 0001 to 2048 and see the word, or type a word and see its number. Everything happens on your iPhone, without an internet connection, and nothing you type is ever stored.

Made for anyone who keeps a seed phrase backup on steel, paper or a card and wants to check it calmly and reliably.

LOOK UP BOTH WAYS
• Number to word: 0001, #0001 and 1 all show “abandon”
• Word to number: the first 4 letters are always enough
• The words just before and after, so you can check you are on the right line
• Browse all 2048 words from A to Z, with a quick filter

OTHER NOTATIONS
• The first 4 letters, as used on letter plates
• The 11-bit binary code, shown as dots, for dot-punch backups
• The technical BIP39 index (0–2047) next to the familiar numbering (0001–2048)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline; the app never connects to the internet
• No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no tracking
• Nothing you type is stored and there is no history; your input is cleared as soon as you leave the app
• The clipboard is never used
• Hidden in the app switcher, with a warning during screen recording and after a screenshot

TRUSTWORTHY WORD LIST
On every launch, the built-in English word list is checked against the SHA-256 checksum of the official BIP39 list. If it does not match, the app refuses to look anything up.

ACCESSIBLE
• Full support for larger text sizes
• VoiceOver reads results digit by digit
• English and Dutch, switchable in Settings

A calm, dark design with Liquid Glass and a slow northern-lights glow, which pauses automatically to save battery. Its strength is adjustable in Settings.

IMPORTANT
BIP39 Index is a reference tool, not a wallet. It cannot create, store, import or send seed phrases, keys or funds. Look up one word at a time, and never store your full seed phrase on a phone or in the cloud.

name: BrineMark
description:
BrineMark helps you remember water softener salt refills so the brine tank does not run dry. Register each softener with a refill interval, see what is overdue or due soon, log a refill, and optionally deduct bags from local salt stock.

Open Due to review overdue and upcoming softeners at a glance. Devices holds your softener list with location, interval, and last refill date. When you add salt, mark Refilled or open Log refill to record the date and optional bags used. Stock tracks pellet or crystal salt quantities and highlights low items. History lets you search past refill logs. About explains how to use the app, includes in-app Privacy & Support, and can erase all local data after two confirmations.

What you can do:
• Due board — overdue / due soon / OK softeners with quick Refilled
• Devices — add and edit softeners (name, location, interval 7–730 days, last refill, notes)
• Log refill — save a refill and optionally deduct stock
• Stock — bags/buckets with quantity, unit, and low threshold
• History — browse and search refill logs
• About — how to use, in-app Privacy & Support, erase local library (two-step confirm)

Core features work offline on this device. No account, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Softeners, refill logs, and salt stock stay on the device.

Built for households with a water softener who forget to refill the salt bin until the water feels hard again.

name: Carillon Notes
description:
Carillon Notes is a notebook with a method. Write down what you are doing or thinking, give it a next step and file it under one of your goals. Within days your ideas are in order and you know what to do next.

A THOUGHT NEEDS A NEXT STEP
A note you never act on is clutter. In Carillon Notes each line names a task, says what happened and ends with what comes next. One page then shows every open task with its latest status and its next step.

IT TEACHES YOU AS YOU WRITE
At first start you choose your goals, such as your health, your loved ones, your career and your home. Handwritten notes then guide you line by line: name the task with TASK+, add a few words, tap NEXT and write your next step. A short demo shows the gestures. The notes step aside once you know the method and return with a tap.

BIG GOALS, SMALL STEPS
A task is one word, such as REPORT or MY_KIDS. In the summary, hold a task and drop it on its goal to make it a step of that goal. Loose notes are gathered under "To tidy", where two taps give each one a task and a next step.

GAUGES THAT SHOW YOUR PROGRESS
The Movement panel measures your practice over the last seven days: goals, statuses, next steps, subtasks, focus and tasks closed. Each gauge fills from ○ to ●, so you see what to improve.

AN OPTIONAL CERTIFICATE OF CONSISTENCY
Write on most days of the month and laurels appear. If you wish, claim a certificate of consistency online, as a reference for yourself or anyone you choose. It attests to how regularly you wrote, never to what you wrote.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your notes stay on your phone. No account, no cloud, no tracking, no ads and no notifications. The app asks for no permission. A copy of your notebook is kept in your phone's Documents folder so you can back it up, and you can export it whenever you like, for example to the AI assistant of your choice for feedback.

FREE
Carillon Notes is free. Nothing to buy, no subscription.

SEARCH, THEMES AND MORE
Find any note by word, task or #tag. Choose among ten color themes. Dictate your notes if you prefer.

AVAILABLE IN 15 LANGUAGES
English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

Carillon Notes shares its logbook with Carillon Repetition Minute, where a discreet chime every quarter-hour invites you to write.

Swandex Technology, Switzerland
swandex.com

name: Cell Jam: Body Puzzle
description:
An unblocking puzzle inside the human body! Tap the vesicles stuck in the tissue, clear the way and keep the blood flowing to the beat of the heart.

HOW TO PLAY
● Tap a vesicle: it moves toward its tip if the path is clear.
● It docks into a pore and collects the cells of the same color arriving through the artery with every heartbeat.
● Red blood cells, neutrophils, platelets, lymphocytes and macrophages: each in its place.
● Think before you tap: if the pores fill up, circulation jams!

200 LEVELS IN 8 ORGANS
● Heart, Lungs, Brain, Liver, Stomach, Intestine, Kidney and Bone marrow.
● Every organ has its own hand-drawn tissue: heart fibers, alveoli, neurons, liver lobules, stomach folds, intestinal villi, kidney tubules and marrow.
● Levels never repeat, with Hard and Very Hard stages and a boss at the end of each organ.

BODY OBSTACLES
● Clots blocking the way.
● Mucus hiding a vesicle's color.
● Blood-brain barrier: only 3 pores in the brain.
● Toxins, giant vesicles, sleeping cells and kidney stones.

LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY
● Real biology fun facts at the end of levels: "Did you know?"

BOOSTERS AND REWARDS
● Earn ATP, the energy of cells, and use boosters: Hint, Extra Pore, Anticoagulant and Enzyme.
● 7-day daily bonus and optional reminders.

PLAY YOUR WAY
● Works offline, no account, no login.
● Quick rounds, perfect for any break.

Cell Jam is free, with non-personalized ads and optional in-app purchases (including one to remove ads). Rewarded videos only if you want them. We don't track you.

name: CleanProof Job Reports
seller_name: GPT LLM ORAGLE Ltd. Liability Co.
description:
Good work deserves a clear handover. CleanProof gives independent cleaners and small cleaning businesses a simple place to document each job, from the first photo to the final checklist.

CREATE A JOB IN MOMENTS
Keep the client, property address and service date together. Start with room checklists for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, living rooms and entrances, or build your own.

CAPTURE THE DETAILS
Tick tasks as you work. Take a photo or choose one from your library, label it before or after, and add a short caption. Record existing damage, extra care and handover notes in the room where they belong.

SHARE A PROFESSIONAL REPORT
Add your business name, logo and contact details. Export a PDF with your checklist, photos and notes, then save or share it through your device. Incomplete tasks stay visibly unchecked in the report.

KEEP YOUR WORK WITH YOU
Your jobs and photos are stored on your device. Core features work offline, with no account, advertising or AI service. Export a complete backup to keep your records safe or move them to another device.

REPEAT THE GOOD WORK
Duplicate a job to reuse its room checklist for the next visit. The new copy starts with unchecked tasks and no old photos or notes.

CleanProof is a record-keeping tool. Photo labels, checklist status and notes are entered by you; reports are not independently verified certificates. Photo timestamps show when an image was added to a job. Images are resized for manageable files. Each room supports up to 12 photos. Export backups regularly: uninstalling the app or clearing its storage can remove local records. Backups support workspaces up to 64 MB.

name: Cyclan
description:
Cyclan plans bike rides the way you want to ride them: on quiet roads, on tarmac or gravel, close to nature. Free and without ads.

PLAN ROUTES
Hold your finger on the map to set the start, the finish and points in between. Cyclan calculates the route straight away and adapts it when you move a point. Three sliders decide what it looks like:
• Surface: tarmac only up to gravel
• Small roads: direct or quiet
• Nature: through forests and fields instead of towns
Cyclan always avoids main roads.

LOOPS FROM YOUR DOOR
Just set the start and the length, and Cyclan finds up to three loops in different directions. Doubled-back sections and dead ends are filtered out. Each loop can then be edited like a route.

EVERYTHING ABOUT THE ROUTE
• Elevation profile with gradients
• Share of tarmac, gravel and cycle paths
• Weather and wind along the route at your planned time
• Drinking water, supermarkets and train stations on the way
• Map, satellite or terrain, with layers for cycle paths, surface and road classes

NAVIGATION
Voice instructions for every turn, even with the screen locked. On Android the next turn also shows on the lock screen. If you leave the route, Cyclan recalculates it; without a connection an arrow leads you back to the route. Your ride is recorded with speed, moving time and climbing.

OFFLINE
Save tours with their map for areas without signal.

TOURS AND GPX
Save tours, share them by link, export them as GPX for Garmin or Wahoo and open GPX files. With a free account (Apple, Google or an email code, no password) your tours sync with the website cyclan.app. The app also works entirely without an account.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, routing by BRouter.

name: Date!
description:
Date! counts the time you two spend together.

When your phones are near each other, Oyen the cat starts counting by itself over Bluetooth, even with both phones locked in your pockets. When you part, it stops at the minute you moved apart. No buttons to press, no timer to remember.

• Your own Oyen: pick a fur and a little accessory. Your partner has theirs.
• HOME: today's time together, live, with your two Oyens side by side.
• Calendar: every day you met, and for how long, at a glance.
• Records: your month and year together, and a card to share.
• Letters: write a letter (with a photo) that opens after you part, or on a day you pick.
• Three languages: English, Bahasa Indonesia and 日本語.

Private by design: your location is used only while the app is open, to see that you two are near each other, and it is never stored. Bluetooth looks only for your partner's phone. No ads, no trackers.

You both need Date! for Oyen to count by itself. Start right away without an account, or sign in with your Oyenza account to keep your records on any phone.

name: Diagonal Fardas
description:
The official Diagonal Fardas store on your phone: workwear, safety footwear, PPE and accessories for businesses and professionals, delivered across Portugal.

WHAT YOU'LL FIND
• 400+ products: t-shirts, polo shirts, jackets, sweatshirts, trousers, vests, aprons, chef jackets, lab coats, softshell and high-visibility wear
• Work and safety footwear: shoes, boots and clogs
• PPE: gloves, eye and ear protection, masks, visors and disposables
• Uniforms by sector: hospitality, healthcare, industry and construction, beauty and spa, school and sports

EASY SHOPPING
• Search by name, brand or reference
• Pick colour and size and instantly see the price and availability of each variant
• Automatic volume discounts, up to 34% on team orders
• Secure payment with MB WAY, Multibanco, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Payshop or bank transfer

CUSTOMISATION
Embroidery and printing with your company logo. Request a quote straight from the app.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Track your orders, save products to your wishlist and reach us by phone or email in one tap.

Diagonal Fardas · Rua do Grés 60, 4445-266 Alfena, Portugal · diagonalfardas.pt

name: DMG Patient Manager
description:
DMG Patient Manager is the phone app for Delta Medical Group distributors. It is for people DMG has already set up: there is no public sign-up.

What it does:
• Shows your patients in call-next order, so shipments waiting on an address check and call-backs that are due come first.
• Opens a patient card with Call and Text, the delivery address to confirm, and the order's shipping status.
• Records a short device support note after each call, shared with others on that patient.
• Sets call-back reminders that only you see.
• Records pain ratings on follow-up calls, as numbers only.
• Sends optional alerts for a new order, a delivered package and a reminder that is due. Alerts never include patient details.

Privacy and security:
• Sign in with a one-time emailed code, then your fingerprint or face each time.
• Screenshots are blocked while you are signed in, and the app locks when you have been away.
• Notes are for device support only. The app does not store health conditions, medications or ID numbers.

Access is by invitation from DMG only and cannot be requested through the app. Anyone can tap Explore the demo on the sign-in screen to see the app with fictional patients.

name: Dodak Dodak - Clicky Keyboard
description:
Dodak Dodak is a keyboard you can feel.
Every key press plays a sound and haptic made for its material, and the keycap moves as if it were really pressed.

FIVE MATERIALS
- Thock: the low, round sound of lubed linear switches
- Click: clicky switches that click on press and release, with light spreading from the key
- Wood: the dry tap of hollowed wooden keycaps
- Jelly: squishy silicone domes that press down and bounce back
- Wax: a hard wax shell that cracks, with flying chips

A BUDDY ON YOUR KEYBOARD
Cheese the cat, Gomgom the bear, Somi the bunny, Ppiyak the chick, Bori the puppy and Mochi the rice cake.
Your buddy taps along as you type and hops with a cry when you press Return.

EVERYDAY TYPING
- English layout with numbers and symbols; add Korean (2-set) or Japanese (flick or romaji, with kanji conversion) with the globe button in the app
- Hold delete to delete repeatedly, drag the space bar to move the cursor, double-tap space for a period
- The layout and Return key adapt to search, email and number fields
- Try the keyboard inside the app without turning it on

PRIVACY
Dodak Dodak itself never stores or sends what you type; text goes only to the app you are typing in. The app and keyboard have no network features, ads or analytics. Japanese conversion runs on your device and does not learn from or keep what you type.
iOS requires Allow Full Access for a keyboard to play sounds and haptics. You can type without it.

TURN IT ON
Settings › General › Keyboard › Keyboards › Add New Keyboard › Dodak. Then tap Dodak and turn on Allow Full Access. While typing, hold the globe key and choose Dodak.

name: Domino 4 Player
description:
Domino 4 Player keeps score for your domino night, and lets you practice Cuban dominoes anytime.

KEEP SCORE
Big, clear scores for two teams. Pick your target in steps of 50, as high as you want. Add points after each round with a few taps.

LINE OF TEAMS
More than four people at the table? Add every team to the line. Winners stay, losers go to the back, and the next team steps in by itself. Add or remove teams anytime.

SIMPLE MODE
Just two teams and a score? Use Simple mode and start a new team with one tap.

RESULTS
See the longest winning streak, the fastest win and the biggest round of the night.

PRACTICE CUBAN DOMINOES
Play double-nine dominoes, Cuban style, with a computer partner against two computer rivals. Choose how good each one plays. Learn mode gives you tips while you play.

FEELS LIKE THE REAL TABLE
Tap a tile to lift it, flick it to play. Drag your tiles to arrange your hand. Zoom in on the table. Shake the tiles with one button before every round.

MADE FOR YOUR SCREEN
Works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. Light and dark mode. Play counter-clockwise, the Cuban way, or clockwise.

- No account, no ads, no tracking
- In English and Spanish

name: e-Nastava FINRA
description: e-Nastava FINRA je službena aplikacija Univerziteta FINRA Tuzla za studente i nastavnike. Sve što vam treba za studij nalazi se na jednom mjestu.

name: EduGrade - Phụ huynh
description:
EduGrade là ứng dụng dành cho phụ huynh có con học tại trung tâm dạy thêm dùng hệ thống EduGrade (Toán, Lý, Hóa, Sinh, khối 6–9). Ứng dụng giúp phụ huynh nắm việc học của con mỗi ngày mà không phải gọi điện hỏi trung tâm.

MỘT TÀI KHOẢN, NHIỀU CON
• Phụ huynh tự tạo tài khoản bằng email và tự thêm hồ sơ từng con.
• Chuyển qua lại giữa các con ngay trên màn hình chính.
• Sau khi trung tâm ghi danh, môn và lớp mới tự hiện trong ứng dụng.

LỊCH HỌC VÀ ĐIỂM DANH
• Lịch học theo tuần: giờ học, giáo viên, phòng học.
• Buổi học bù và buổi bị huỷ được ghi rõ kèm lý do.
• Lịch sử điểm danh từng buổi: có mặt, vắng, học bù, nghỉ có phép.
• Tỷ lệ đi học của từng môn.

BÀI TẬP VÀ KẾT QUẢ
• Con làm và nộp bài tập về nhà ngay trên điện thoại của phụ huynh.
• Chụp ảnh bài làm hoặc gửi tệp PDF cho giáo viên.
• Bài làm dở được lưu lại trên máy, mở lại làm tiếp.
• Xem điểm và đáp án đúng sau khi giáo viên công bố.
• Lộ trình bài học và mục tiêu của từng khóa.

HỌC PHÍ
• Xem các gói học phí, phiếu thu và biên lai đã đóng.
• Học phí đóng trực tiếp tại trung tâm, ứng dụng không thu tiền.

THÔNG BÁO
• Hộp thư thông báo trong ứng dụng: bài tập mới, điểm mới, thay đổi lịch học.

Lưu ý: EduGrade dành cho phụ huynh. Giáo viên và nhân viên trung tâm dùng EduGrade trên web.

name: FaceForYou Workspace
description:
FaceForYou Workspace brengt het dagelijkse werk rond zakelijke schoonmaak samen. Volg aanvragen op, bekijk klantdossiers, werk aan offertes en stem afspraken af vanuit één werkomgeving.

Met Workspace kun je, afhankelijk van je rol:
• aanvragen en relaties opvolgen
• offertes en contracten bekijken
• afspraken, taken en meldingen bijhouden
• informatie over locaties en de uitvoering raadplegen

Voor toegang is een actief Workspace-account van FaceForYou vereist. Aanmelden verloopt met tweestapsverificatie. Neem bij vragen over je account of toegang contact op met FaceForYou Support.

name: Filtnest
description:
Filtnest helps you remember when household filters and other periodic consumables need replacement—air filters, water cartridges, brush heads, vacuum bags, humidifier pads, and more.

What you can do:
• Rooms: add install locations such as Living Room or Kitchen so items stay organized
• Items: name, room, replacement interval (1–730 days), last replacement date, and notes
• Due board: urgency groups for overdue, due within 7 days, and later; tap Replaced to log a swap
• Log: browse all replacements or the last 30 days; history keeps name snapshots
• About: how-to, Privacy Policy, Support & help; erase all local data when needed

Core features work fully offline. No account, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Your library stays on this device.

name: Fonts in Space
description:
Fonts in Space is a flight through a world of floating letters. Real typefaces, drawn as big 3D shapes, drift towards you, and you steer your way between them.

Drag a finger across the screen to steer. A keyboard works too.

The letters and walls are made of different materials, such as paper, wood, glass and steel. Each one bounces and rings in its own way when you bump into it. A soft knock and a hard one feel and sound nothing alike.

Your shield

Every bump costs shield energy, and how much depends on the material. Collect golden letters for points, and each one tops your shield back up. When the shield is empty, the flight is over. You see your result, and you can fly again right away.

Features:
• Fly through a world of 3D letters from real typefaces
• Steer with your finger or a keyboard
• Paper, wood, glass, steel and more: every material bounces and sounds different
• A shield that every bump drains, more or less depending on the material
• Golden letters give you points and recharge the shield
• A result after every flight, then fly again
• Works on iPhone and iPad
• No ads, no purchases, no tracking, no login

Who is behind it?
Fonts in Space is experiment #7 in an album of experimental font games by Harald Geisler, a type designer. Visit haraldgeisler.com to find out more.

[Privacy Policy] https://haraldgeisler.com/apps/#privacy-policy-for-apps

name: Hearth & One: Pet Ecosystem
description:
Browse recipes made in small batches and delivered to your door. See exactly what is inside every recipe, filter by sensitivities such as beef, chicken or grain, and reorder in a few taps. Track every order from checkout to your door.

KNOW YOUR PET
Create a Pet Heritage Passport with your dog's name, breed, birth date, weight and photos. Snap a photo and the pet scanner suggests the breed. Keep consultation notes and records together, and share or save the passport as an image.

VACCINATION RECORDS
See the vaccine schedule for your pet, record each dose, check what is due next and share a vaccine card.

VET VIDEO CONSULTATIONS
Book a video consultation with a verified veterinarian from home. Find clinics near you on the map.

MEAL PLANNER AND AI FEEDING GUIDE
Build a meal plan from your dog's profile, and ask Bravo, the AI assistant, everyday feeding questions. The assistant gives general information and does not replace advice from a licensed veterinarian.

EASY SIGN-IN
Continue with Google or verify your phone number with a one-time code.

SUPPORT THAT ANSWERS
Raise a ticket from the app and follow it until it is solved.

Questions? support@hearthandone.com

OTHER FIELDS
Category: Shopping (alternative: Lifestyle)
Contact email: support@hearthandone.com
Website: https://hearthandone.com
Privacy policy: https://hearthandone.com/privacy

name: HushPush Confessions & Secrets
description:
Some stories never make it into the group chat.

The breakup you still think about. The family expectation you can't meet. The small secret that's funny until you say it out loud.

HushPush is a community for adults to read confessions, share what's on their mind, and reply through a chosen identity. Pick a name and a mask, then join the conversation without using your real name on your public profile.

READ THE PART PEOPLE LEAVE OUT
Explore confessions about love, regret, family, friendship, secrets and everyday life. Read for a different perspective, a familiar feeling, or a story that makes you pause.

PUT YOUR THOUGHTS INTO WORDS
Write a confession, choose a topic, and decide whether to allow replies. Ask for another perspective, admit something awkward, or share a feeling you've been keeping to yourself.

BE PART OF THE CONVERSATION
Reply to posts and react when a confession resonates. A thoughtful response can turn a moment of recognition into a conversation.

MAKE YOUR MASK YOURS
Choose a display name, mask symbol and aura color. Build a recognizable identity around what you share. Your sign-in information is separate from your public mask.

KEEP THE STORIES THAT STAY WITH YOU
Save confessions to revisit and follow the masks whose posts interest you. Explore Burning to see confessions receiving attention in the community.

CHOOSE HOW YOU PARTICIPATE
Control replies, block masks and report content. Share with consideration for the people behind each story.

Start with a story. Share yours when you're ready.

HushPush is for adults aged 18 and over. A chosen identity does not guarantee complete anonymity. Posts and replies can be visible to other HushPush users; avoid sharing identifying details about yourself or others. HushPush is not a counselling or emergency service.

Made by COOKOO.
Support: hello@cookoo.dev
Privacy: https://cookoo.dev/hush/privacy-policy

Before posting or replying, agree to the posting terms and confirm you have permission to share your content. Confessions require moderator approval.
Posting terms: https://cookoo.dev/hush/terms
Support: https://cookoo.dev/hush/support

name: INGEK КРД
description:
INGEK КРД — рабочие задачи, отметки и результаты команды в одном приложении.

Сотрудникам доступны назначенные задачи Todoist, история выполненных задач, дополнительная работа, начало и окончание рабочего дня, отметки посещения офиса и личные итоги за период.

Руководитель и помощник видят задачи команды, просрочки и отклонения от графика, создают поручения, назначают ответственного и соисполнителей, отправляют сообщения выбранным сотрудникам.

Рабочие отметки в приложении и Telegram-боте INGEK КРД используют общую историю. Уведомления помогают не пропускать поручения и сообщения.

Приложение предназначено для приглашённых сотрудников INGEK. Для входа требуется активный аккаунт; сотрудник получает персональный код активации от руководителя.

name: Jumply: Istanbul
description:
A one-finger game set in Istanbul.

Press and hold to build power. Let go and the simit seller jumps. How long you hold decides how far you go. Land dead centre and a streak begins.

CROSS ISTANBUL
Start in Eminönü and work your way to Galata, Boğaz and Kadıköy. Every district has its own colours, and if you get far enough the city turns to night.

EIGHT KINDS OF PLATFORM
Simit stand, taxi, dome, tea stool, tea vendor's counter, tram, ferry and fishing boat. Ferries and trams do not sit still, so timing matters.

STREET CATS
Land dead centre to wake a cat sleeping on a platform. Keep going and cats start to follow you: Tekir, Sarman, Duman, Van and more. Collect all eight.

MIND THE SEAGULL
Land dead centre where a seagull is circling, or it will snatch a simit from your tray.

DAILY COURSE
Everyone plays the same course each day. One attempt. Share your result and compare with friends.

TEA MONEY AND COSTUMES
Centre landings and waiting at the tea vendor's counter earn tea money. Spend it on the fisherman, ice cream seller, ferry captain and tram driver costumes. Tea money cannot be bought with real money.

LEADERBOARDS
Compete on Game Center with your best score and in the Daily Course.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Jumply is free and contains ads. Ads never appear while you are jumping.
• After a fall you can watch an ad to continue from where you were. This is optional.
• A one-time purchase removes the ads between rounds and the banner.
• No account needed. Your progress is stored on your device.
• English and Turkish.

name: meta Coding
description:
Learn how code changes a screen, a value or a sequence of steps.

metacoding pairs short coding exercises with visual feedback. Fill in a blank, check the result and return to the card when it is time to review.

SEE WHAT YOUR CODE CHANGES
For supported UI examples, editing a value changes the preview above the code. Compare the result with the target and see how a line affects the interface.

PRACTICE FIVE LANGUAGES
Explore UI examples in Swift, Kotlin, JavaScript and Dart. Use Python exercises to follow changing values and loops. Visualizations cover the app's supported examples; this is not a compiler or runtime for arbitrary programs.

REVIEW A LITTLE EACH DAY
Start with up to five new cards a day and revisit earlier material on a spaced review schedule. Hints help when you get stuck, while progress reflects how independently you answer.

FOLLOW YOUR PROGRESS
Track five skill tiers, from Junior to Master, separately for each language. These are in-app progress levels, not professional certifications.

NO ACCOUNT OR ADS
Core card study and review work offline, with learning progress stored on your device. Playground examples that access the internet need a network connection.

name: meta Scene
description:
Bring everyday expressions into the picture.

meta Scene pairs illustrated scenes with short language exercises. Practice English, Korean or Spanish through cards you can flip, complete, listen to and arrange.

EVERYDAY SCENES
Explore expressions for greetings, cafes, travel and daily life alongside illustrations of familiar situations.

THREE LANGUAGES TO LEARN
Choose English, Korean or Spanish for your lessons. The app interface supports English and Korean, independently of the language you are learning.

FIVE WAYS TO PRACTICE
Recall a phrase and flip the card to check it. Fill in a blank, choose an answer, listen to a phrase or arrange words into a sentence. Use hints or reveal the answer when you need help.

SHORT SESSIONS, SPACED REVIEW
Start with up to eight new cards a day. Your answers help determine when cards return for review. Check your learning progress as you go.

HEAR THE PHRASES
Listen to pronunciation using your device's speech voices. Playback requires an available voice for the language you are studying.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Start without signing up. Core card study and review work offline, with learning progress stored on your device. No separate server account is required.

name: Mi Tienda CEG
description:
Mi Tienda CEG es la app para operar tu negocio desde el iPhone. Entra con el usuario de tu compañía y trabaja la caja, el inventario, las compras y las ventas en el mismo lugar.
Qué puedes hacer
• Cobrar ventas en tienda, por WhatsApp o Mercado Libre, con descuento, IVA y el total en bolívares según la tasa del día.
• Llevar cuentas abiertas por mesa y cobrarlas cuando el cliente termine.
• Buscar productos, ver fotos y precios, ajustar el stock y compartir productos.
• Registrar compras y consultar el historial de ventas.
• Ver el resumen del mes: ventas, compras, productos y stock bajo, además de reportes por método de pago.
La app es para el personal de la tienda. Necesitas una cuenta creada por tu compañía. Al cerrar sesión, el teléfono deja de guardar tu acceso.
Requiere conexión a internet.

name: MinPin Jump
description:
MinPin Jump ist ein flotter Jump & Run mit einem kleinen Zwergpinscher in der Hauptrolle.

Springe über Kisten und Stöckchen, sammle Knochen-Leckerlis und achte auf freche Katzen. Wenn du Katzenpfötchen sammelst, wartet ein 30-Sekunden-Bonuslevel auf dich.

• Einfache Steuerung: Tippen = springen, zweimal tippen = Doppelsprung
• Alle 1000 Punkte gibt es einen Boost mit Raketenantrieb
• Wechselndes Wetter: Sonne, Gewitter, Schnee mit orangem Mäntelchen und Strand mit Gegenwind
• Katzenjagd, Frauchen-Überraschung und viele kleine Details
• Fröhliche Musik und Geräusche, ganz ohne Internet
• Dein Highscore wird gespeichert

Wie weit kommt dein Zwergpinscher?

name: Mordant Math Calc
description:
Mordant Math calc  turns a skein of yarn and a bag of madder root into exact numbers: grams of dye at your depth of shade, alum for the mordant bath, water for your liquor ratio and millilitres of stock solution to measure. Everything runs on your device, with no account and no network.
DYE BY % WOF
- Grams of dye from fibre weight at any depth of shade, from pale 1% to deep 15%
- Preset shades plus your own, with a second-bath suggestion for overdyeing
- Multi-skein batches: weigh each skein once, dye them as one pot
- Fibre profiles for wool, cotton, silk and linen with the mordant each expects
MORDANT AND WATER
- Alum at a percentage you control, with cream of tartar and tannin lines
- Liquor ratio math: 1:20 for 400 g of wool means 8 litres, shown in litres and gallons
- Cotton route: tannin bath then alum bath, each with its own percentage
- Iron and modifiers recorded as percentages so a recipe can be repeated exactly
STOCK SOLUTIONS
- Stock concentration in grams per litre, and the millilitres to measure for any batch
- Dilution calculator: enter any three of C1, V1, C2, V2 and get the fourth
- Leftover stock tracked so the next session starts from what you have
- Recipe library: save a successful pot as a one-tap formula
WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
- No account, no sign in, no cloud sync — your ledger stays on this device
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no third-party SDKs, no network requests
- No subscriptions or purchases: every feature is free, all of it offline
A LEDGER THAT LEARNS
- Batches move through mordanting, dyeing and curing with dates
- Results: colour notes, pH, temperature and time, ready for the next batch
- Dye material library with typical shade ranges and mordant hints
- Export a recipe or a batch record as plain text

name: myGenogramm
description:
myGenogramm is an editor for genograms and ecomaps. Free, no account, no ads.

Made for work with families: child and youth welfare, family support, disability services, youth welfare offices, counseling centers, psychotherapy, psychiatry, supervision, teaching and non-profit organizations.

WHAT IS A GENOGRAM?
A genogram shows a family across several generations: who belongs to whom, what the relationships are like and which events have shaped the family. It helps you see connections, form hypotheses and present a case clearly to your team.

AS EASY AS DRAWING
Drag people, relationships and institutions from a palette onto a free canvas. Drop a child on a couple's line and it belongs to that couple. Quick actions add parents, partners and children with one tap. "Arrange" tidies up the genogram automatically whenever you want. Everything works with mouse, finger and Apple Pencil, and every step can be undone.

FAMILY AND RELATIONSHIPS
• People with names, dates of birth and death, including approximate dates ("c. 1970")
• Marriage, partnership, separation, divorce, widowhood
• Biological children, adoption, foster care, guardianship, twins, pregnancies
• 30 emotional relationship types from close to conflicted, plus a simplified mode
• Custom line types from the line builder
• Households drawn as an area around their members
• Index person, photos and notes

ENVIRONMENT AND SUPPORT NETWORK
• Institutions in 11 categories, such as youth welfare office, service provider, school and day care, health, counseling, justice
• External people and pets
• Connections with quality: strong, weak, stressful, unavailable
• Flow of resources shown as an arrow

PROFESSIONAL DEPTH
• Attributes for health, social and legal matters, shown directly on the symbol
• Health catalog with 64 entries in 12 categories, extendable with your own attributes
• Timeline for the family and for individual people
• Events, annotations and hypotheses
• Layers you can show and hide
• Automatic legend that lists only what is used
• Search, filters and collapsible family branches
• Hints on inconsistencies, such as implausible ages
• Templates: nuclear family, three generations, blended family, single parent, foster family with family of origin, family with support network

DRAW AND PRESENT
• Freehand pen, eraser and lasso, ideal with Apple Pencil
• Presentation mode for case conferences, supervision and teaching

OUTPUT
• PDF in A4 and A3, portrait or landscape, also split across several pages
• PNG and SVG
• Printing
• GEDCOM import and export

PRIVACY
• Genograms are stored as files on your device or in a location you choose
• No account, no server, no analytics, no ads
• Works without an internet connection
• Encrypted saving with a password
• Pseudonymized view and pseudonymized copy for meetings and training

THE SAME FILE EVERYWHERE
myGenogramm is available for Mac, iPad and iPhone and in the browser at mygenogramm.app. One file opens and can be edited on all devices.

LANGUAGES
German and English. The language of the genogram can be chosen separately from the interface, for example work in German and print in English for the family.

NOTE
myGenogramm is a drawing tool for documentation. It does not replace professional judgment and is not a medical device.

name: MyWorth Belongings Vault
description:
MyWorth is your on-device inventory for belongings and value — by Basic Made Simple.

Capture items with photos, receipts and warranties. Track values, categories and expiring warranties. Everything stays on the device. No ads. No tracking.

BE PREPARED FOR A CLAIM
After a theft, burglary or fire you have everything at hand: the total value of all your belongings with purchase prices, receipts and serial numbers as a PDF for your insurer.

START FREE
• Up to 10 items after the trial
• Inventory, warranty reminders, offline recognition
• Backup and CSV export

5-DAY PREMIUM TRIAL
After first launch you get five days of full Premium access.

PREMIUM €4.99 ONCE — NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Unlimited items
• Document library
• Insurance PDF with total value, useful after theft or fire
• Advanced statistics

Values are informal estimates, not confirmed insurance figures and not purchase advice.

name: P+R Prague – Park and Ride
description:
See free spaces at Prague Park and Ride (P+R) car parks right on your car display. The app works in CarPlay, so you never have to pick up your phone: the nearest car parks and their free spaces are on your car screen, and one tap starts navigation.

Park and Ride is the easiest way to visit Prague by car. Leave your car at a car park on the edge of the city, right next to a metro, train or tram stop, and ride public transport to the centre. No traffic jams, no hunting for a space in the old town, and parking costs a fraction of city-centre prices.

IN YOUR CAR (CARPLAY)
• Car parks sorted by distance with free spaces, refreshed every minute.
• Your favourite car parks always on top.
• Details with arrival time, spaces usually free at that time, price and payment options.
• One-tap navigation to the car park.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN (WIDGETS)
• Favourite P+R: free spaces at your car parks on the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• One P+R: a chosen car park in a small widget or on the Lock Screen.
• Tap to open the car park details.

ON YOUR PHONE
• Live free spaces from the official Prague parking overview.
• Nearest first, with colour at a glance: green means free, orange means only a few spaces left, red means full.
• Space when you get there: your arrival time and how many spaces are usually free at that time.
• Details for each car park with capacity, price, payment options and last update time.
• Star your favourite car parks.

GREAT FOR
• Visitors and tourists coming to Prague by car who want to park safely outside the centre.
• Daily commuters who want to know whether their P+R still has space before they get there.

Free, no ads, no sign-up. Your location is only used to sort the car parks and to estimate your arrival with Apple Maps. It is not sent anywhere else.

The app speaks English, or Czech if your phone is set to Czech. Car park names stay in Czech, just like on the road signs and metro stations.

This is not an official app of the City of Prague or TSK. Data comes from the public overview at parking.praha.eu. Some car parks do not report free spaces; for those we show capacity only.

name: PaintCue
description:
PaintCue helps you keep leftover paint organized so touch-ups stay easy. Register rooms, log paint cans with brand and color code, and see what’s running low before you need it.

Open Rooms to browse paint by room, or Cans to search and filter your full library. Each can holds brand, color code, sheen (matte through gloss), fill level, storage location, and notes. Link cans to rooms or leave them unassigned. Low shows half-full, low, and empty cans at a glance.

When you use paint on a job, update the fill level and add a note. About explains how to use the app, Privacy & Support, and lets you erase all local data after two confirmations.

What you can do:
• Rooms board — see cans grouped by room; add rooms and cans
• Cans — search, filter by fill level, open details to view or edit
• Low stock — focus on half, low, and empty cans
• Paint can editor — brand, color code, sheen, level, room, location, notes
• Room list — manage room names and notes
• About — how to use, in-app Privacy & Support, erase local library (two-step confirm)

Core features work offline on this device. No account, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Your rooms and paint library stay on the device.

Built for homeowners who stash extra gallons and need the right color code when it’s time to patch a wall.

name: Pillary - Medicine Cabinet
seller_name: Shanghai Shoumeng Jiaye Technology Co., Ltd
description:
Your medicine cabinet finally, organized. Pillary is an offline-first family medication tracker: the cabinet is your stock, the plan is your rhythm, the log is your facts.

What Pillary does:
• Stock the cabinet — log meds off the box: name, form, quantity, expiry, family member.
• Build plans — daily, specific weekdays, every N days, or as-needed, each with dose and times.
• Take on time — a Today timeline with one-tap take/skip; stock deducts automatically. Local notifications plus home-screen and lock-screen widgets.
• Look back — a monthly adherence calendar shows exactly what happened.
• Restock and clean out — low-stock forecasts and expiry warnings before things run out or go bad.

Privacy by design: everything stays on your device. No account, no sign-up, no cloud sync, no analytics, no tracking. Works fully offline — airplane mode is not a problem. Your family's health data is nobody's business but yours.

Free to start: track 10 medicines across 3 family members. Pillary Pro removes the limits.

Note: Pillary is a tracker, not a doctor. No medical advice, no drug database, no photo recognition — just a calm, reliable system for the meds you already know.
Pillary Pro: unlimited medicines & members (monthly / yearly with 7-day free trial, or one-time lifetime).
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Planeta Diesel
seller_name: Planeta Diesel Comercio de Pecas e Servicos Ltda
description:
Planeta Diesel — A força da linha pesada na palma da sua mão!

Quem trabalha com caminhões e ônibus sabe: encontrar a peça certa faz toda a diferença. Com o aplicativo Planeta Diesel, você fica mais perto das peças, dos acessórios e do atendimento especializado que ajudam a manter seu veículo pronto para o trabalho.

Baixe agora e tenha a Planeta Diesel sempre à mão quando precisar!

PEÇAS E ACESSÓRIOS PARA QUEM MOVE O BRASIL

Do pequeno conector ao farol, cada detalhe importa. Trabalhamos com uma ampla variedade de produtos para manutenção e reparação de caminhões e ônibus:

• Conectores, terminais e selos de vedação.
• Chicotes elétricos e componentes de conexão.
• Faróis, lanternas, setas e acessórios de iluminação.
• Sensores, interruptores e componentes elétricos.
• Servos e cilindros de embreagem.
• Componentes para sistemas ARLA.
• Peças e acessórios para cabine e outras aplicações da linha pesada.

São opções para veículos Mercedes-Benz, Volvo, Scania, Volkswagen, MAN, Iveco e Ford, além de aplicações em motores Cummins. Consulte a disponibilidade e a compatibilidade de cada peça com nossa equipe.

MAIS PRATICIDADE NA SUA ROTINA

Na estrada, na oficina ou na gestão da frota, tenha o aplicativo Planeta Diesel como um aliado na busca por peças e acessórios. Deixe nossa marca a um toque de distância e ganhe praticidade para lembrar de quem pode ajudar quando surgir uma necessidade.

ATENDIMENTO DE QUEM ENTENDE DO ASSUNTO

Está em dúvida sobre qual peça escolher? Nosso time está pronto para ajudar você a conferir códigos e aplicações, com atenção às necessidades do seu veículo.

Para agilizar seu atendimento, informe o código da peça, o modelo do caminhão ou ônibus e, quando necessário, o número do chassi.

ENVIO PARA TODO O BRASIL

Esteja onde estiver, conte com a Planeta Diesel. Consulte as opções de entrega, os prazos e as condições disponíveis para sua região.

SUA PRÓXIMA PEÇA COMEÇA COM UMA BOA ESCOLHA

Tenha por perto uma empresa que valoriza seu trabalho e entende a importância de manter seu veículo em movimento.

Baixe o aplicativo Planeta Diesel e conte com nossa parceria no próximo pedido!

Planeta Diesel — Peças, confiança e parceria para seguir viagem.

name: PolymarketX
description:
PolymarketX is a watch-only portfolio manager for people who want a clear record of wallets, assets, and market research without sending funds anywhere.

Add public wallet addresses, enter the holdings you want to follow, and record buys, sells, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, fees, and adjustments. Portfolio value, cost basis, unrealized profit or loss, and realized profit or loss are calculated from those entries with decimal precision. Performance charts use snapshots saved on your device when the portfolio changes. The app does not invent a past balance and does not treat a pasted address as proof of ownership.

The market explorer loads publicly available event data for research. You can search, filter, sort, and save a watchlist. When live data cannot be reached, PolymarketX says so and can show the last saved public response or a clearly labeled demo. Demo figures are never presented as your funds or as live prices.

Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode. Export a backup, import one without overwriting existing records, or export the ledger as CSV.

PolymarketX does not ask for private keys or recovery phrases. It does not place bets, trades, deposits, withdrawals, or swaps. It is an independent utility and is not affiliated with Polymarket or Polymarkex.

Portfolio values are estimates based on prices you enter and on public market data when you choose to load it. They are not investment, tax, or legal advice.

name: Relay by AgentsPro
description:
Started a task on your Mac? Open it on your iPhone to read your agent’s reply, inspect a code snippet, or answer a question so work can continue.

Start a conversation in Dot or open a task from the project drawer. Send a request to your connected Mac or a cloud Relay Runner. Messages, questions, and permission requests appear together in the conversation.

Requires a Relay account and a connected execution environment. Available in English and Russian.

name: SafeLabNote
description:
SafeLabNote is a free reagent manager for school science labs, made to give science teachers a hand.

- Snap the label: take a photo of a bottle and the app reads the name, CAS number, size, maker and expiry date on your device. Shoot many bottles in a row and add them all at once.
- Find: search by name, formula or CAS number and the shelf lights up on a picture of your cabinets.
- Used it: one tap lowers the remaining amount. Bottles that are running low go to the shopping list.
- Class prep: pick one of 63 experiments from the Korean 2022 national curriculum and get the bottles you need in cabinet order. Put everything back in one tap after class.
- Safety: warnings when a bottle goes on an incompatible shelf, GHS pictograms, and a safety summary (hazards, protective gear, first aid, storage, disposal) for 89 school reagents.
- Your school only: data stays on your device. Share it with colleagues as a file locked with your school password.
- Floor plan: arrange the cabinets the way they stand in your real lab.
- Waste containers, term inventory checks and a purchase list are built in. Choose from 10 designs.

Available in 10 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Vietnamese and Indonesian. Long safety texts are shown in Korean or English.

The safety information is a reference summary. Always check the supplier's SDS and your local regulations before an experiment.

name: Şarj Fiyatları
description:
Şarj etmeden önce fiyatları karşılaştır.

Şarj Fiyatları, elektrikli aracınız için yakınınızdaki şarj istasyonlarını keşfetmenize ve AC / DC şarj fiyatlarını karşılaştırmanıza yardımcı olur. Haritadan istasyonları inceleyin, ihtiyacınıza uygun seçeneği bulun ve yol tarifini açın.

YAKININIZDAKİ SEÇENEKLERİ GÖRÜN
Bulunduğunuz konumun çevresindeki istasyonları haritada ve listede görüntüleyin. Arama yarıçapını değiştirin; istasyonları fiyata veya mesafeye göre sıralayın. Seçtiğiniz bölgede, listelenen verilere göre en uygun fiyatlı seçeneği kolayca fark edin.

AC VE DC FİYATLARINI KARŞILAŞTIRIN
AC ve DC hızlı şarj seçenekleri arasında geçiş yapın. Operatörlerin kWh başına liste fiyatlarını harita üzerindeki etiketlerde görün. İstasyon ayrıntılarından bildirilen güç, soket sayısı ve şarj tipi bilgilerini inceleyin.

YOLDAKİ İSTASYONLARI KEŞFEDİN
Yolda modu, konumunuz ve gidiş yönünüz bilindiğinde önünüzdeki şarj seçeneklerini gösterir. Yaklaşan istasyonları ve ileride daha uygun fiyatlı bir seçenek bulunup bulunmadığını inceleyin. Sürüş sırasında uygulamayla etkileşim kurmak için güvenli bir yerde durun.

BAŞKA BİR ŞEHİRDE ARAYIN

name: Valqeviaprt
description:

Stop wondering what weight to load. Valqeviaprt keeps a record of every set you lift and uses your own results to work out the next session's target, so each workout builds on the last one.

SMART LOAD PROGRESSION
After each session Valqeviaprt looks at what you actually did and suggests the next load:
- Linear: add weight whenever every set hits its target, ideal for 5 x 5 style lifts
- Double progression: earn extra reps across a range, then step up the load
- Deload: after two missed sessions in a row the weight drops by roughly ten percent
- Pick the rule and the jump size for each exercise
- The Next load card explains the reason and shows the plates to put on each side of the bar

FAST SET LOGGING
- Large weight and rep steppers that work mid-workout
- Rows arrive pre-filled at the suggested load; tick each set as you finish it
- Rate any set with RPE if you like
- A rest clock starts on every ticked set, with +30 and Skip
- Add or remove sets, rename a session or delete it later

TRAINING PLANS
- Build a plan from days, lifts, target sets and rep ranges, and reorder as you go
- The Lift screen shows each plan's upcoming day, ready to start
- Load the two starter plans in one tap and adapt them, or begin an empty session

RECORDS AND PROGRESS
- A board of your lifts ranked by estimated one-rep max
- Charts for estimated max, volume and top set for each lift
- Every earlier session one tap away in the Logbook
- A NEW PR moment the instant you beat a best

YOUR EXERCISE LIBRARY
More than sixty barbell, dumbbell, machine, cable and bodyweight movements are built in. Create your own lifts with a muscle group, equipment, rep range and progression rule, or tune a built-in one.

KILOGRAMS OR POUNDS
Switch units in the Locker and every load, stepper and plate breakdown follows along.

ACCOUNT OPTIONS
Sign up with email and password, or tap "Lift as guest" to train immediately. A guest can attach an email later in Locker > Save my lifts and keep every set. Data syncs to your private account and keeps working with no signal.

NO ADS, NO TRACKING
There are no ads, no tracking and no analytics. Your training history is visible only to you, and Locker > Delete account removes every session, set, plan and custom lift together with the account.

Valqeviaprt is a logbook, not medical or coaching advice. Train within your limits and always use safeties.

name: chronowave
description:
chronowave is an oscilloscope, a tuner and an analyzer for iPhone and iPad, as an Audio Unit (AUv3) effect and as a standalone app on the microphone.

A WAVEFORM THAT STANDS STILL
chronowave finds the repeat of your signal by itself — no trigger level, no note to enter, no clock. The picture stays put while the pitch glides or wobbles and while the timbre moves (filter sweeps, pulse width): the shape changes, it does not scroll. Silence keeps the last picture; noise scrolls freely; drum hits are caught on their attack.

SCOPE
• Auto, Wave, Hit, Free and Beat modes
• 1 to 8 cycles on screen
• Beat mode locks slow signals (envelopes, LFOs, loops) to the host tempo, from 1/16 to 16 beats
• Automatic or fixed scale, Freeze, Persistence

TUNER
• Needle, Strobe and Digits displays
• Fast or Slow response, adjustable reference (A4) and tolerance
• Range 25 Hz to 4 kHz (A0 to B7)

ANALYZER
• Levels per channel: peak, RMS, peak hold, crest factor, DC offset, clipping
• Log spectrum with averaging and peak hold
• Harmonics H1 to H16 with THD
• Pitch history

MADE FOR YOUR SETUP
• Passes your audio through bit-for-bit unchanged
• MIDI-controlled effect: it works without any note; a note, when you send one, is only a hint (expected pitch, Hit trigger)
• Ten parameters exposed to the host for automation; everything is saved with your project
• Layouts for every window size, from a thin strip to full-screen iPad
• Mono to 8 channels, 8 kHz to 192 kHz
• Light on the CPU: analysis runs off the audio thread, at screen rate

PRIVATE
No account, no tracking, no data collected. The microphone is used only on your device, only in the standalone app, and nothing is recorded.

chronowave is part of the CHRONO family of instruments by MONOLAG.
