name: 心yeの便箋
description:
心yeの便箋——彼女の話を聞き終え、時令に合わせて一封の花の手紙を封じます。

あなたは傍観の編集者ではありません。匣主「桃箋」がこの一封を正しく書き、封じられるよう手伝う人です。どの便箋も、はじめに「信題の対話」へ。誰に届けるのか、なぜ書くのかを聞き終えてから、花材の引き出しを開きます。

【本当にやる三つのこと】
・花期の対応：手作りの花束を時令に合わせる。季節を間違えると紅線が入り、この便箋は通せません。
・詞と花：短文から、花材のタグと噛み合う一句を選ぶ。合わなければ封じられません。
・封緘の手触り：折る → 印を押す → 蝋が冷める窓のあいだに滴す。手順を飛ばすと無効。時間切れだと印面がにじみます。

できあがるのは一枚の花の信帖。箋面、花枝の影、短文、封蝋の拓し。信帖匣に収めたり、近くのポストへ投じて花箋を返してもらえます。

【こんな方に】
・着せ替え採点ではなく、ゆっくりした時令の手触りが好き
・まず心事を聞いてから、花と文言を合わせたい
・折り・印・封蝋という儀式感を楽しみたい

【ひとこと】
本編はオフラインで最後まで遊べます。近くへの投函や印のスキャンはおまけで、本封の完成を邪魔しません。

広告の壁も、課金で止まる関門もありません。この季節の花の手紙を、きちんと匣へ。

name: 365UI Interpretation Audio
description:
365UI Interpretation Audio turns an iPhone or iPad into the audio feed for 365UI Live Interpretation, an AI interpretation service for conferences and meetings.

It is for the venue helper, not the audience. The organizer's event page shows an audio QR code for each room; scan it with this app, choose a microphone, and the room's sound goes to the interpretation service. The audience listens and reads captions in a web browser on their own phones and needs no app.

WHAT IT DOES
• Uses a microphone or wireless receiver plugged into the iPhone or iPad (for example a lavalier set's receiver), or the device's own microphone.
• Sends only the input you chose. If that input is unplugged, the app sends silence and says so, rather than switching to another microphone.
• Keeps sending with the screen locked or another app in front.
• Tells you when something else takes the microphone (a phone conversation, Camera in video mode) and picks up again by itself afterwards.
• Reconnects by itself when the network drops.
• Lets you pause for a break, so private talk is not interpreted or recorded.
• "Try a microphone first" checks an input on the device itself, offline, with nothing sent.

WHAT YOU NEED
An event booked with 365UI Live Interpretation (listen.365ui.com). Without an event's audio link the app can only try a microphone offline.

The app has no accounts, no purchases and no advertising.

name: 5CRM
description:
5CRM is the mobile app for employees of companies that work in the 5CRM system.

Features:
• Leads and sales pipelines: customer card, stages, responsible person
• Today's and overdue tasks
• Customer chats (Telegram, Instagram) and internal team chat
• 5TEL: calls through your company's IP telephony right from the app
• Call history and reports on your own work
• Notifications about new leads and messages
• Check-in and check-out at work
• Sign in to the desktop by QR code, Face ID app lock

You need an employee account created by your company administrator in 5CRM. There is no sign-up inside the app.

Support: https://5crm.uz

name: A Life, Noticed: Mood Journal
description:
There’s more to a day than you think.

A song you played twice. A place you keep returning to. A book you couldn’t put down. A Life, Noticed is a quiet place to keep these small things, and to see the shape they make over time.

NOTICE
Choose what you’d like to notice, and begin with one:
• How I Feel: the feelings you name, set down where they sit.
• Places I Go: the places you visit, mapped around home.
• Read Log: your reading sessions, how long and how absorbed.
• Songs I Discover: songs that found you, and how often you play them.
Each entry takes a moment and settles into its collection as a seed. No streaks, no pressure.

SEE THE SHAPE OF IT
Pick a week, a month, a season or any dates, and your entries become an artwork: Pebbles, Atlas, Meadow or Echo. Every mark comes from something you recorded, and each artwork carries a small key so you can read it. Keep them in your Archive, where they follow your entries if you edit them.

SHARE, IF YOU LIKE
Turn an artwork into a story-sized image in three styles, with or without names and the key.

YOURS, ON YOUR IPHONE
No account. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. The app never connects to the internet: everything stays on your iPhone, included in your own iCloud backup. Export your data whenever you like, or delete it all in one step.

name: A1 Sprint: German Boot Camp
description:
This is not the relaxed way to learn German. It is a boot camp.

You set the deadline. A1 Sprint puts today's new words, today's reviews and today's questions in front of you, and they stay there until you finish. One goal: the A1 exam.

VOCABULARY: YOUR DEADLINE, NO MERCY
• Nearly 800 A1 words on a plan you choose, from 7 to 90 days. The shorter the plan, the harder each day
• Cards show only the German first, so you have to think before you flip
• Memory tips for every word: compounds, prefixes, word families, false friends

REVIEW: MISSED WORDS KEEP COMING BACK
• Spaced review: known words move further apart, missed words return the next day
• More than five question types: multiple choice, fill in the example, matching, articles, typing and dictation
• Guessing a multiple-choice answer does not count. Next time you must type it
• Daily challenge: hundreds of mixed questions a day. Missed ones go to the back of the queue until you get them right
• Endless practice in more than eight modes, including weak words only, typing only, dictation, plurals and verb forms

LISTEN & SPEAK LESSONS BUILT FOR THE A1 EXAM
• 30 lessons of about 30 minutes covering the situations the A1 speaking and listening parts test
• Hear a prompt, say it in German yourself, then hear the answer and repeat. Every sentence makes you speak
• Sentences you learned come back later, and long ones are built up piece by piece
• More to listen to: today's review words, speaking patterns for the oral exam, number listening (prices, times, phone numbers) and graded readings read aloud
• Hands-free on your commute, in the car (CarPlay supported) or while doing chores. Keeps playing on the lock screen

GRAMMAR COURSE: LEARN IT, THEN GET TESTED
• More than 15 lessons, from nouns and articles to the perfect tense
• Over 150 exercises with explanations. Missed questions come back first next time

READING, WRITING, MOCK EXAMS
• More than 10 graded readings that unlock as your vocabulary grows
• Writing lessons, sentence reordering and form-filling tasks in the A1 format
• Timed mock exams for listening and reading

ANALYTICS: NOWHERE FOR WEAK SPOTS TO HIDE
• A1 readiness score with your next step
• Accuracy by skill, your own memory curve, and what kind of mistakes you make
• Words you recognise but cannot write, and words that take you longest
• Streaks, lock-screen widgets and a countdown

NO DISTRACTIONS
• Works offline without an account. No ads, no tracking
• Optional Sign in with Apple or Google to back up your progress

Note: lesson prompts are available in English, but grammar explanations, reading translations and exam explanations are in Traditional Chinese only.

HONESTLY
This app cannot correct your pronunciation or mark your writing. To get your speaking and writing up to exam level, you will still need a German teacher to check them.

Feedback, feature requests or anything that could be better: ctgithuber@gmail.com. Thank you!

Note: A1 Sprint currently covers the A1 exam only. If you are preparing for A2 or higher, try it first and see whether this way of studying works for you. We would love to support higher levels in the app. If you need one, email us at ctgithuber@gmail.com and we will look into it and prioritise it.

name: ABN Signal: ABN & GST Lookup
description:
ABN Signal makes it quick to check who you're dealing with. Look up any Australian Business Number (ABN) or business name, confirm GST registration, and keep an eye on the businesses that matter to you.

Built for sole traders, bookkeepers, accountants and accounts payable teams who check suppliers, clients and contractors every week.

ABN AND GST LOOKUP
• Search by ABN or business name
• See ABN status, GST registration, entity type, state and postcode
• View business and trading names, ASIC number and deductible gift recipient (DGR) status
• Read a plain-English summary of what the record shows, plus its recent change history
• Recent lookups stay on your phone, so you can reopen them offline

SCAN AN ABN FROM AN INVOICE
Point your camera at an invoice or quote and ABN Signal finds the ABN for you. Text is read on your phone – images are never stored or uploaded.

BULK ABN CHECK
Paste a list or open a CSV file and check up to 500 ABNs at once. Cancelled ABNs, missing GST and invalid numbers are listed first, so you know what needs attention. Export the results to CSV.

WATCHLIST
• Watch the suppliers, clients and contractors you deal with
• Add your own labels and notes – they stay on your phone
• Export your watchlist to CSV

ALERTS
• Changes detected for watched businesses – ABN status, GST status and name – appear in your Alerts inbox, showing the old and new value
• Save up to 10 new-registration alerts by keyword, state or entity type, and see how many new businesses match after each weekly refresh

CHANGES AND NEW REGISTRATIONS
Browse the ABN, GST and name changes detected in the last seven days, plus the latest new registrations. Filter by state and entity type.

LEARN
Short guides and a glossary explain ABN status, GST, entity types and what each part of an ABN record means.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no ads
• Your watchlist, labels and notes live on your phone
• Delete all your data from within the app at any time

ABOUT THE DATA
ABN Signal uses the Australian Business Register (ABR) public bulk extract, refreshed weekly. Changes are detected after each weekly refresh, not in real time. Always confirm critical decisions with the official ABN Lookup service.

ABN Signal is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, the Australian Business Register, the Australian Taxation Office or any government agency.

name: AcademicOS - Projects
description:
AcademicOS organizes academic projects and assignments: document intake, rubrics, project history, an evidence studio and a viva simulator, with workspaces that adapt to iPad and Mac.

Try the demo workspace without an account.

name: Academy by Collab Media
description:
Academy is the training app for teams that work with Collab Media. Your company's courses, in your company's colors, on every phone.

SHORT VIDEO LESSONS
Watch with chapters, captions and speed control. Keep watching in a small player while you browse, or switch to Listen and keep going with the screen off.

READ AT YOUR OWN PACE
Every lesson also comes as text, with a text size you can adjust.

COURSE CHECKS
A few questions at the end of each course, with an explanation after every answer. Your best score is saved.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Your progress is saved to your account, and videos resume where you stopped.

FOR MANAGERS
See how your team is progressing, course by course.

ENGLISH AND SPANISH
Every screen in both languages. Switch any time.

Academy needs an account from your company or from Collab Media. Want to look around first? Tap Try the demo to explore a sample coffee company with lessons, videos and quizzes, no account needed.

name: Access ZON36O
description:
¡Gestionar tus reservas es así de simple!
Desde la app ZON36O Access puedes comprobar si una reserva es válida, revisar sus detalles y registrar el ingreso de forma eficaz.
Si se trata de un paquete de clases, la sesión también se registra automáticamente.
Todo lo necesario para controlar el acceso, sin tener que buscar la reserva entre mensajes o confirmar datos manualmente.
Descarga ZON36O Access y haz más sencillo el proceso de  ingreso de tus clientes.
*Uso exclusivo para personal autorizado de comercios aliados.

name: Acquirely: AI Sales Outreach
description:
Acquirely on your iPhone: your cold email, replies and leads, wherever you are.

Answer the moment a lead replies
- Every reply from every inbox in one place, sorted by interest.
- Read the thread, reply, label it, or approve the AI's draft, without opening a laptop.

See how every campaign is doing
- Sent, replies, positive replies and bounces today, and over 7, 30 or 90 days.
- Launch, pause and resume campaigns, and see each one's leads and sends.

Keep your inboxes healthy
- Warm-up and ramp-up for every sending account, with its inbox rate and today's limits.
- Pause, resume or extend any account's ramp-up.

Find and add leads
- Search leads by title, company, industry and country, and add them to a list or campaign.

Built for teams
- Switch between workspaces, or see them all at once.
- Dark by default, fast, and made for one hand.

Acquirely is for businesses with an Acquirely account. Sign in with your work email.

name: Acrewalk: Land Area Measure
description:
Acrewalk measures land. Tap the corners on a satellite map, or walk the edge with your iPhone, and get the area and the distance around in seconds. Then turn the measurement into a shopping list.

MEASURE ON THE MAP
• Search an address, zoom in on the satellite picture and tap each corner
• Drag corners to fine-tune, add corners in the middle of a side, undo any step
• Acres, square feet, square yards, hectares and square meters, all at once
• Perimeter and the length of every side
• Cut out the pond, the house or the driveway
• Type or paste GPS coordinates if you already have them

WALK THE EDGE WITH GPS
• Tap Start, walk around the boundary, come back to where you began
• Lock the phone and put it in your pocket; the walk keeps recording
• Live GPS accuracy while you walk, and bad readings are thrown out
• The result comes with an honest ± range, so you know how far to trust it
• A call or a dead battery does not lose your walk; it is saved as you go

KNOW WHAT TO BUY
• Fence: posts, sections, rails, pickets or rolls of wire, gates, and concrete for the post holes
• Sod: rolls and pallets
• Seed and fertilizer: pounds and bags at the rate on the label
• Gravel, mulch, topsoil and sand: cubic yards, tons and bags for any depth
• Concrete slab: ready-mix yards or premixed bags
• Land value: price per acre and total, either way round
• Everything is rounded up to whole bags, rolls and pallets, with extra for cuts and waste

SAVE AND SHARE
• Save every job with a name, a folder and notes
• PDF report with the map, the area in every unit, side lengths and corner coordinates
• Export KML (opens in Google Earth), GPX, GeoJSON and CSV
• Import KML, GPX, GeoJSON and CSV outlines

BUILT TO BE RIGHT
• Areas are worked out on the WGS84 ellipsoid, the same model of the Earth that GPS uses, not a flat-map shortcut
• Checked against the reference geodesic library on thousands of shapes, from back yards to whole counties
• Feet and acres or meters and hectares

PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your places and your location stay on your iPhone

For farmers and ranchers, fence and landscape contractors, real-estate agents, and anyone with a yard project.

Acrewalk gives estimates for planning. It is not a legal survey and does not show legal property lines.

name: Adventthrum
description:
Adventthrum is an Advent calendar for primary school children and their families. From December 1 to 24 a new door opens every day with a short game. Finish it and a little reindeer video appears as a surprise.

HOW THE CALENDAR WORKS
• The numbers 1 to 24 are mixed up: the door of the day has to be found first.
• One game is added each day. All open doors stay playable through December 30.
• Every completed door earns a star. Next Advent the collection starts again.
• After the daily task children can keep playing at their own pace.

24 GAMES IN EIGHT GAME TYPES
Finding pairs, building Christmas words, connecting paths, laying shapes, clearing bricks, sliding puzzles, arithmetic and spatial thinking take turns. Each game type appears three times, each time with a new task.

24 REINDEER VIDEOS
An eight-second video waits behind every completed door: the reindeer in a blue bobble hat and red scarf on a sleigh ride, baking cookies, building a snowman or on Christmas Eve. All earned videos stay in the video album. Grown-ups can pass a video on or save it through the share sheet.

BY THE FIREPLACE
The special feature of this calendar: a fireplace to watch and listen to. Nine scenes, from a Christmas living room to quiet embers, with crackling and Christmas music that can be switched on and off. The fireplace is open all year.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• German and English, switchable in the app
• Everything works offline; games and videos are included in the app
• No account, no ads, no purchases, no data collection
• Outside links and sharing open only after an arithmetic question for grown-ups
• A test mode for grown-ups opens all doors for trying things out; it is normally switched off
• Light and dark appearance, large text, reduced motion on request

Adventthrum is dedicated to the First Austrian Dyslexia Association (EÖDL).

name: AeroSentinel
description:
AeroSentinel es la app de operaciones de AeroSentinel S.A.C., empresa peruana de vigilancia con drones para municipalidades e instituciones.

La usan tres tipos de cuenta, que entrega la empresa:

PILOTOS Y OBSERVADORES
• Turno de hoy: horario, zonas que cubres y dron asignado.
• Marcar entrada y salida con la ubicación del celular, dentro de la zona.
• Checklist de seguridad antes de cada vuelo.
• Plan de vuelo en el mapa: puntos calientes, puntos de paso y zonas prohibidas.
• Reportes con foto o video: la IA redacta el informe y avisa a la central.
• Botón de ayuda (SOS) que envía tu ubicación a la central.
• Avisos dentro de la app: turnos, reemplazos, alertas de búsqueda y emergencias.
• Examen semanal de conocimientos.

CENTRAL DE OPERACIONES
• Operación del día: turnos, alertas y pilotos en vuelo.
• Asignar turnos y reemplazos.
• Revisar y aprobar los reportes automáticos antes de enviarlos.

MUNICIPALIDADES E INSTITUCIONES
• En vivo: incidentes abiertos, prioridad y tiempo de respuesta.
• Derivar casos al serenazgo, la policía o los bomberos.
• Fotos y videos de cada incidente.
• Informe mensual del convenio en PDF.

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta entregada por AeroSentinel o por tu institución. No hay registro abierto.

name: Afar
description:
Afar 让 iPad 成为没接显示器的 Mac mini（或其他 Mac）的屏幕。打开 App，点一下卡片，iPad 就通过苹果自带的「随航」显示 Mac 桌面，手指和 Apple Pencil 都能用。

· 一点就连：自动找到局域网里的 Mac，点卡片连接随航；随航中途断开，回到 Afar 会自动连回。
· 远程解锁：Mac 重启后停在登录界面时，在 iPad 上确认一下（可用面容 ID）就能进桌面。
· 显示大小三档：更大文字 / 默认 / 更多空间，按你的 iPad 屏幕计算，清晰不留黑边。
· 蓝牙键盘交接：用随航时把蓝牙键盘交给 Mac，断开后交回 iPad。
· 在 iPad 上重启 Mac、查看断电恢复设置。

使用前需要：
· 在 Mac 上安装免费开源的 Afar Mac 端（github.com/dm-mdz/afar）
· Mac 和 iPad 登录同一个 Apple 账户、连同一个局域网，并且支持随航
· iPadOS 27 及以上，macOS 27 及以上

隐私：Afar 不收集任何数据，只在你的局域网里和你自己的 Mac 通信。

name: Agent Share
description:
Agent Share sends what is on your iPhone straight to the coding agents you work with. The agents can send answers, files and questions back to the phone.

Share from any app
Tap Share in Photos, Safari, Files, Mail or any other app and choose Agent Share. Pick the agent that should get it, add a note if you like, and send. You can send screenshots, photos, video, PDFs, other files, links and text. Uploads continue in the background, even after you close the app.

Send to My inbox
The "Send til Min indbakke" action in the share sheet drops something into your own inbox with one tap, so you can deal with it later.

Replies from the agent
When an agent finishes, has a question or sends you a file, you get a notification. The reply sits in the thread next to what you sent, and you can answer right there.

Shortcuts and Siri
On iOS 17 or later you can send files from Shortcuts, Spotlight, Siri and the Action button.

For people who work with coding agents
Agent Share needs an agentics.dk sign-in. Agents are connected to your inbox on your computer, with the agent-share command-line tool or over MCP. Without a connected agent you can still use your own inbox.

Privacy
No ads and no tracking. The app only sees the photos and files you pick or share. You can lock the app with Face ID. You can delete your account in the app.

The app's interface is in Danish.

Agent Share is made by Poul Kjeldager Sørensen in Denmark.

name: AGRO+ FITOSANITARIO
description: AGRO+ Fitosanitario es la app para los usuarios del módulo Fitosanitario de AGRO+ que permitirá a los usuarios registrar las evaluaciones de sus plantas para plagas y estdios de forma fácil y rápida.

name: AguamielCue
description:
AguamielCue ayuda a productores de maguey pulquero en Hidalgo y Tlaxcala a organizar el ciclo completo: desde la madurez de la planta hasta el aguamiel diario y la fermentación del pulque.

Con esta app puedes responder con claridad: ¿cuántas plantas puedo cosechar este año?, ¿cuántos litros recolectaré al día?, ¿cuántos tinacales necesito? y ¿cuánto gano por planta?

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES

• Ciclo de plantas
Registra variedad, año de siembra, región y fecha de madurez. Calcula cuántos magueyes estarán listos para capar y extraer aguamiel.

• Predicción de cosecha
Estima litros diarios y del ciclo completo según número de plantas, variedad y rendimiento real.

• Plan de rasurado
Organiza turnos, rasurados por día, horas de trabajo, trabajadores y capacidad de cubetas.

• Lotes de fermentación
Dimensiona tinacales, capacidad y fechas de arranque para convertir el aguamiel en pulque.

• Beneficio por planta
Calcula litros del ciclo, costo de mano de obra, ingreso bruto y utilidad neta.

• Ingresos y consejos
Consulta el margen global y recibe recomendaciones prácticas para mejorar la eficiencia de recolección y aumentar tus ingresos.

Diseñada para el trabajo real del campo: simple, clara y pensada para el oficio tradicional del pulque.

name: AI CEO
description:
AI CEO 是你自己那支 AI 团队的手机端。CEO 和 AI 员工都在你家里的 Mac mini 上干活；出门在外，用 iPhone 就能放任务、看进展、批准、验收，和 CEO 直接说话。

工作
按项目看每件任务：谁在负责、做到哪一步。点开任务能看到正在做什么、时间线、交出来的文档和成果，可以回复负责的员工、验收、退回或重新打开。一周内做完的事和交出来的东西也在这里。

今天
等你处理的事放在最前面：要你批准、验收、回话的，和 Mac mini 上要你动手的。下面是正在做的、24 小时内做完的、出了问题的，和接下来到点的例行任务。

和 CEO 说话
底部一直有一栏 CEO：派活、追问进度、改主意，一句话就行。

任务箱
一次写好几件事，每行一件；选排队做还是同时开始，再归到某个项目。

团队与自动化
看每位员工正在做什么，给他们换模型；例行任务和流程一键开关。

Mac mini
体检、后台服务、连通、磁盘和屏幕状态都在设置里，必要时重启某一项服务。

配对
在 Mac 上的 AI CEO 里打开「设置 → 手机 → 添加手机」，用 iPhone 相机扫一下二维码。配对码 10 分钟内有效、只能用一次；在 Mac 上随时可以移除这台手机。

没有 Mac mini？
第一次打开时点「先看看示例」，用一支编好的示例团队把所有功能试一遍，不连任何服务器。

隐私
App 不收集任何数据，没有广告、没有追踪，也不用注册账号。任务、对话和文件都留在你自己的 Mac mini 上，iPhone 只通过加密连接查看和操作。

name: AI Cố Vấn
description:
AI Cố Vấn giúp cá nhân, hộ kinh doanh và doanh nghiệp nhỏ nắm việc pháp lý của mình mỗi ngày.

CHÂN DUNG PHÁP LÝ
Chọn vai trò (doanh nhân, hộ kinh doanh, người lao động, cán bộ xã, người nước ngoài, gia đình). Hệ thống lập bản đồ nghĩa vụ và tự đặt lịch nhắc hạn.

TRỢ LÝ AI
Hỏi bằng lời thường, trả lời theo pháp luật Việt Nam hiện hành và theo chân dung của bạn, có dẫn điều luật để bạn tự đối chiếu.

HỒ SƠ VỤ VIỆC
Mỗi việc một hồ sơ: mô tả, giấy tờ (chụp ảnh — AI đọc chữ), mốc thời gian, trao đổi.

LUẬT SƯ
Phân tích hồ sơ theo khung của đội ngũ luật sư đối tác; khi cần, gọi video trực tiếp với luật sư ngay trong app, có chuông báo cuộc gọi đến.

THƯ VIỆN
Tra cứu văn bản pháp luật và từ điển thuật ngữ.

Lưu ý: phân tích tự động bằng AI không phải ý kiến pháp lý chính thức của luật sư.

Tài khoản có thể xoá ngay trong app (Tài khoản → Xoá tài khoản).

name: AI Huyền Học
description:
AI Huyền Học là nơi tìm hiểu văn hoá và học thuật cổ phương Đông bằng tiếng Việt, tính theo âm lịch Việt Nam.

TƯ VẤN VIDEO 1:1 VỚI THẦY THẬT
• Chọn thầy, đặt lịch và gọi video ngay trong app — không cần cài Zoom hay Meet.
• Khi thầy gọi, điện thoại đổ chuông như cuộc gọi thường, kể cả lúc khoá màn hình.
• Thầy là người thật, có hồ sơ và lĩnh vực rõ ràng: tử vi, phong thủy nhà ở, chọn ngày, Kinh Dịch.

CÔNG CỤ TRA CỨU
• Lập lá số tử vi Đẩu Số đủ 14 chính tinh, đại vận, lưu niên.
• Lịch âm, xem ngày, đổi ngày âm dương, hướng nhà, thước Lỗ Ban, hợp tuổi, sao hạn, bát tự, gieo quẻ Mai Hoa.
• Hỏi AI Huyền Học bằng lời thường; mọi câu trả lời có dẫn sách cổ để bạn tự đối chiếu.

THƯ VIỆN
Hơn 1.500 bài viết tay về Sơn, Y, Mệnh, Tướng, Bốc — viết dễ hiểu, có nguồn.

name: AI Translator: Photo & Talk
description:
Text, photos, files and speech, translated in one app.

PHOTOS
Take a picture of a menu, a sign or a manual and the translation appears right on top of the original words. Tell the app about an allergy or something you don't eat, and dishes that may matter are marked.

FILES
Pick a PDF, a Word file or a few photos and read the original and the translation paragraph by paragraph. Scanned pages work too. Then ask questions like "Which clauses work against me?" and get answers that point to the page.

CONVERSATIONS
Take turns speaking into your phone. Each line is translated and read out loud. Show the other person their words in big type with one tap. Useful for directions, ordering food, seeing a doctor or sorting things out at a counter.

TEXT
Type, paste or just speak. You get a few ways to say it, more formal or more casual, and slang is explained. Got a message in another language? Have the app write your reply.

HISTORY
Everything you translate stays on your phone, searchable, with favorites.

32 languages, including Chinese (Simplified, Traditional, Cantonese), English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Russian and Arabic. No sign-up needed.

Translations and explanations are written by AI and can be wrong. For contracts, medical care, medicine or allergies, check with someone who knows.

 LƯU Ý CHO BA MẸ
 • Kết quả chấm và lời giải thích được tạo bởi AI nên đôi khi có thể chưa chính xác. Ba mẹ nên cùng bé xem lại khi cần.

name: Ala Mukth: Quran & Fatwas
description:
Ala Mukth («على مكث», "with deliberation", Quran 17:106) is a calm listening app for the Holy Quran and the lectures of trusted scholars. It always remembers your place.

Completely free. No ads, no accounts, no tracking — no data collected.

■ QURAN
• 240+ reciters in several riwayat, plus live Quran radios.
• "My reciters": pick your favorites once, then tap any surah to start in their voice.
• Repeat a surah a set number of times, stay within a juz, A-B loop for memorisation.
• A khatma per reciter with an optional daily goal and reminder.

■ MEMORIZE THE QURAN («الحفظ»)
• A very simple daily plan: new portion, near and far review, and extra practice for the pages you stumbled on.
• The pages exactly as in the printed Madinah mushaf, with optional tajweed colours.
• "Recite with your voice": recite from memory and each word appears in its place on the page — recognition runs on your device only.
• The full mushaf: all 604 pages with surah, juz and quarter indexes.

■ PRAYER TIMES
• Umm al-Qura times, optional adhan alerts, and playback pauses at the adhan.

■ SHEIKH MUHAMMAD IBN SALIH AL-UTHAYMEEN
• The complete «Noor ala al-Darb» fatwa series in the correct order — tape after tape, non-stop.
• «Liqa' al-Bab al-Maftuh», the monthly meetings and his explanations: Riyad as-Salihin, al-Usul ath-Thalatha, Kitab at-Tawhid, the Forty Hadith, Bulugh al-Maram, al-Wasitiyya, Zad al-Mustaqni', tafsir.
• Written fatwa text when available; search across all fatwas.

■ «NOOR ALA AL-DARB» BY SENIOR SCHOLARS
• Sheikh Abdulaziz Ibn Baz: ~950 episodes and 12,000+ fatwas with their texts.
• Sheikh Salih al-Fawzan: 877 episodes.

■ 40+ SCHOLARS IN ONE PLACE
• Lessons, fatwas and lectures from the scholars' official websites and trusted sources: Sheikh Abdulaziz Al ash-Sheikh, al-Fawzan, Ibn Humaid, al-Khudair, al-Shinqiti, al-Badr, al-Abbad and more.
• Classic texts and their explanations: every sheikh's sharh of the same book on one page.
• The written fatwa alongside the recording when available.

■ VIDEOS
• Scholars' video lessons from YouTube inside the app — without Shorts.

■ ACHIEVEMENTS
• Medals for listening streaks, hours, surahs, fatwas and lessons — encouragement to keep going.

■ MADE FOR THE ROAD AND THE GYM
• Steering-wheel and headphone buttons: next, previous, play, pause.
• Optional auto-play when your car's Bluetooth connects.
• Clear artwork on car displays and the lock screen: series name and tape / episode number.
• Voice boost for quiet recordings, playback speed, a sleep timer that fades out.
• Downloads for offline listening.

■ NEVER LOSE YOUR PLACE
• Your position is saved every few seconds and whenever you pause or leave.
• Continue listening from Home, widgets and Control Center.
• Goals per series and progress like "120 of 6,901".

■ WIDGETS & SHORTCUTS
• Continue Listening, Continue Your Series and Streak widgets with real play buttons.
• Control Center / Action button controls and Siri Shortcuts.

■ PRIVACY
Everything stays on your device and is included in your device's iCloud backup. No sign-in, no analytics.

■ SOURCES
Content comes from public sources: mp3quran.net, the audio library of binothaimeen.net, binbaz.org.sa, an Internet Archive mirror of al-Fawzan's fatwas, af.org.sa (Dawah Charitable Foundation), rabee.net, shankeety.net, IslamHouse.com and the Internet Archive. Ala Mukth is an independent app and is not affiliated with any of them.

The interface is in Arabic.

name: AlbumPlayer Classic
description:
AlbumPlayer is a music player for your own files — with a click wheel.

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR FILES
Import audio and video files you already own, and AlbumPlayer turns them into albums on a clean shelf. Cover art is found automatically through Apple Music (with your permission). Three original demo songs are included so you can press play right away — delete them any time.

A CLICK WHEEL, BACK AGAIN
Browse and play with the classic click wheel: spin to move, tap to play or pause, skip back and forth. Playback continues in the background and picks up where you left off.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add the AlbumPlayer widget to see what's playing — and control playback right from your Home Screen, without opening the app.

TUNE IT YOUR WAY
A 10-band equalizer (31 Hz–16 kHz) with presets — Pop, Hip-Hop, Rock, Electronic, Classical and more — plus your own custom presets.

TURN IT SIDEWAY
Rotate your phone and the player becomes a fullscreen visual show: 18 animated effects, from 3D particles and aurora to a disco ball, all moving with your music.

IMPORT AND EXPORT, FREELY
Bring music in from the Files app, and export your songs back out — one, a batch, or all of them. Your files stay yours.

No account. No ads. No tracking. Your library stays on your device.

name: Alerta Guate: Noticias
description:
Alerta Guate reúne las noticias y alertas comunitarias de Guatemala, ordenadas por departamento y municipio, para que sepas qué pasa cerca de ti.

• Elige tu departamento y municipio y mira primero lo que ocurre en tu zona.
• Publica alertas y noticias de tu comunidad con fotos o videos, al instante.
• Comenta, reacciona y guarda las noticias que te interesan.
• Sigue a periodistas y vecinos, y recibe avisos de lo que te importa.
• Consulta el clima de tu municipio.
• Reporta contenido o bloquea usuarios desde el menú de cada publicación. El equipo atiende los reportes en un máximo de 24 horas.

Las publicaciones y los comentarios pasan por una revisión automática con inteligencia artificial, y lo que parece incumplir las normas se oculta hasta que lo revisa una persona del equipo.

Alerta Guate es para personas de 18 años o más. Puedes eliminar tu cuenta desde Mi perfil o en alertaguate.com/p/eliminar-cuenta.

name: ALinkgram
description:
ALinkgram is a third-party client for Telegram, built on Telegram's open TDLib library. Sign in with your Telegram account; your chats stay in sync with other Telegram apps.

CHAT — private chats, groups, channels, topics and comments; photos, videos, files, voice and video messages, stickers and GIF search; end-to-end encrypted voice and video calls and group voice chats; bots, mini apps and inline bots.

ORGANIZE — two-level folders for saved messages, synced across devices; pinned chat order, archive and chat folders.

STORE — save files straight to your own NAS (WebDAV / SMB), with built-in Tailscale to reach it from anywhere.

FOCUS — ad and keyword filters with your own rules; keyword alerts.

SECURE — app lock, per-chat lock with Face ID, secret chats.

ALinkgram is not an official Telegram app and is not affiliated with Telegram FZ-LLC.

name: All-in-One TV Remote
description:
Works with Roku TVs and players (TCL, Hisense, onn and more), Samsung Smart TVs (2016+), LG Smart TVs, Google TV and Android TV (Sony, TCL, Hisense), and Vizio SmartCast TVs.

Lost the remote? Batteries dead? TV Remote turns your iPhone into the remote your TV should have come with. Open the app, tap your TV, and every button just works - no account, no sign-up, nothing to set up first.

It finds your TV on your Wi-Fi and reconnects on its own every time you open the app. Type searches and passwords with your phone keyboard instead of hunting letter by letter. Swipe the touchpad or use the buttons - your choice. Launch your apps in one tap. Save every TV in the house with its own name and switch between them instantly.

EVERYTHING INCLUDED:
• Full remote: power, direction pad with OK, Back, Home, Menu, volume, channel, mute, play, pause, rewind, and fast forward
• Automatic finding and reconnecting - connect once, then forget about it
• Phone keyboard for search and sign-ins
• Touchpad and button navigation in one tap
• One-tap app shortcuts, plus every app on your TV where your TV shares its list
• Every TV in the house, saved with your own names
• A plain-words connection check that helps you fix it when your TV cannot be found
• No account, no ads, nothing locked

Everything happens between your phone and your TV, right on your Wi-Fi. Nothing is uploaded, tracked, or sold. Data Not Collected.

SUPPORTED TVs:
• Roku TVs and players - TCL, Hisense, onn, Philips, Sharp, Westinghouse, RCA, JVC, and Roku-branded TVs and players
• Samsung Smart TVs (2016 and later)
• LG Smart TVs (2014 and later)
• Google TV and Android TV - Sony, TCL, Hisense, Philips, Xiaomi TVs, Chromecast with Google TV, Google TV Streamer, NVIDIA Shield, and onn streaming boxes
• Vizio SmartCast TVs (2016 and later)

Your iPhone and your TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network. To wake a TV that is off, turn on your TV's setting that lets mobile apps wake it.

TV Remote is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Roku, Samsung, LG, Google, Vizio, TCL, Hisense, Sony, Philips, Xiaomi, NVIDIA, or onn. All brand and product names are trademarks of their respective owners.

WHY FREE?
Apps like this are wildly popular because they're genuinely useful, and people pay for them. So why not make them completely free? I don't need ads and I don't need to charge a subscription, because I don't need the money. And maybe someday they become popular enough to lead to bigger opportunities. But I'll never charge for these. That's all. Plain and simple.

Other TV remote apps charge $4.99 to $10.99 a WEEK for this. TV Remote charges nothing.

name: Amiyola
description:
You are expected.

Amiyola is a private circle for people who like to go out, and would rather arrive at a table where someone is waiting for them.

HOW IT WORKS
- Open the app and see the plans of the week in your city: a dinner, a coffee, a padel game, a walk, a night out.
- Each plan has a host and a small number of seats. Take one in a tap.
- Walk in. The table knows you are coming.

WHY IT FEELS DIFFERENT
- By invitation. Every member was invited by someone, so every table starts with trust.
- Small tables. Seats are few on purpose, so people actually talk.
- Hosts, not algorithms. A real person opens each plan and welcomes you.
- Balanced tables, and plans for women only, hosted by women.
- Your location is read only when you tap Near me, to show what is around you.
- You can report or block anyone, and a person reads every report.

YOUR CIRCLE
- Invite the people you would want at your own table. Invitations are limited every month.
- Host your own plan in a minute: place, hour, seats.
- Talk with your table before you meet, in text or voice.

GETTING IN
Amiyola opens by invitation. If you have one, open it and your seat is ready. If you do not, ask for a seat at amiyola.com and a host will answer.

You can delete your account and your data at any time from the app (Me, Questions and help). Amiyola is for adults, 18 and over.

name: AMT One
description:
Ora — Koha e punës është një aplikacion në shqip për organizimin dhe evidentimin e kohës së punës. Ai bashkon regjistrimin e hyrje-daljeve, pushimet, historikun, planifikimin e turneve dhe raportet javore në një vend.

I krijuar duke pasur parasysh nevojat e një ekipi të vogël në zyrë, Ora ndihmon në mbajtjen e një pasqyre më të qartë të orëve të regjistruara dhe të organizimit të punës.

REGJISTRO HYRJEN DHE DALJEN
Fillo turnin kur nis punën dhe mbylle kur përfundon ditën. Shiko kohëzgjatjen e turnit në vazhdim dhe totalin e regjistruar gjatë ditës.

EVIDENTO PUSHIMET VEÇMAS
Regjistro fillimin dhe mbarimin e pushimeve. Ora dallon pushimin ligjor të paguar, i cili përfshihet në orët e punës, nga koha e shënuar si dalje ose pushim i papaguar, e cila zbritet nga totali.

KONTROLLO HISTORIKUN
Shiko regjistrimet sipas ditëve, orët e fillimit dhe përfundimit, kohëzgjatjen e pushimeve dhe totalet. Shto një regjistrim të harruar ose korrigjo një regjistrim ekzistues me një shënim shpjegues.

ORGANIZO EKIPIN
Mbaj profilet e punonjësve me emrin, pozicionin dhe departamentin. Kërko punonjësit dhe shiko gjendjen e tyre sipas regjistrimeve: në punë, në pushim ose jashtë turnit.

PLANIFIKO TURNET
Cakto turne për punonjësit dhe organizo përsëritjen javore të tyre pa i shtuar një nga një. Shiko turnet e ardhshme dhe historikun e planifikimit.

ADMINISTRO KËRKESAT PËR LEJE
Regjistro kërkesa për leje dhe shqyrto statusin e tyre. Pamja e menaxhimit mundëson miratimin ose refuzimin me shënim. Lejet e miratuara paraqiten veçmas nga orët e regjistruara të punës.

SHIKO RAPORTET JAVORE
Kontrollo totalet individuale dhe të ekipit, pushimet e paguara, kohën e papaguar dhe orët mbi objektivin javor. Kalo ndërmjet javëve për të parë ecurinë e regjistrimeve.

PËRSHTAT CILËSIMET E KOMPANISË
Përcakto emrin e kompanisë, orarin bazë dhe objektivin javor. Konfigurimi fillestar për AMT-në është e hënë–e premte, 08:00–16:00, me objektiv 40 orë në javë.

INFORMACION PËR KËTË VERSION
Ky version është një hapësirë demonstrimi me ruajtje lokale. Të dhënat ruhen në pajisjen ku përdoret aplikacioni dhe nuk sinkronizohen ndërmjet pajisjeve. Profilet demonstrative dhe historiku shembull janë të shënuara si të tilla. Pamjet e punonjësit dhe menaxherit nuk përbëjnë ende llogari të veçanta me autorizim.

Ora evidenton veprimet e regjistruara nga përdoruesi; nuk verifikon praninë fizike përmes GPS-it, QR-së ose biometrisë. Raportet janë për evidencë dhe organizim dhe nuk zëvendësojnë përllogaritjen zyrtare të pagave apo këshillimin ligjor.

name: Anvil & Moon: Clock Dials
description:
Two crafted clock dials for Apple Watch, with useful controls on your iPhone.

THE METAL DIAL
Hammer-shaped hands and markers, a battery gauge and five forge palettes. Turn the Digital Crown to choose a finish, or pick one from the larger iPhone preview. Palette edits travel between your paired devices.

THE MOON CHRONOGRAPH
Swipe to a second dial with a moon-phase window and working start, stop and reset controls. Its chronograph state is saved locally for the Watch and its Chrono complication. Siri and Shortcuts can open a dial and control the chronograph.

COMPLICATIONS
Add hammer, moon-phase or chronograph complications to supported slots on your existing Watch face. watchOS controls their refresh timing.

ON YOUR IPHONE
Preview palettes, use the phone's independent stopwatch and view estimated moon phase and next full/new moon dates. Choose Automatic, Light or Dark appearance. Automatic follows your device.

Anvil & Moon is a foreground clock app with complications. watchOS Return to Clock and Always On settings govern how it stays visible. Moon dates use an average-cycle estimate that can differ by about 18 hours. A date may be a day early or late.

No app account, ads or tracking.

name: App Sales Overview
description:
App Sales Overview shows every app of your App Store Connect account on one screen again: downloads, proceeds, how often your apps are seen in the App Store, what's waiting for review, and new reviews.

OVERVIEW
• Yesterday, the last 7, 30 or 90 days, over all apps and per app, compared with the period before
• Downloads per day as a chart, and the countries they come from
• Proceeds in one currency, converted with the European Central Bank's daily rates
• Refunds, the last 12 months, Apple's payouts and your subscriptions

EXPLORE
• Build your own chart: downloads, proceeds, updates, refunds, impressions or page views
• Split by app, country, device or where people found your app
• The average day per weekday, and what a download brings in per country

STORE
• Impressions, product page views, downloads and conversion from Apple's App Store analytics
• Where people found your app: search, browsing, other apps, websites
• Every version waiting at Apple: in review, waiting, approved, rejected
• The newest reviews of all your apps in one list

EXPORT
• Everything as CSV, ready for Numbers and Excel: daily figures, countries, every sales line, store analytics
• A monthly statement as PDF and CSV, for your books

NOTIFICATIONS AND WIDGETS
• When a version goes into review, is approved or rejected; new reviews; yesterday's numbers; download milestones
• Yesterday's downloads and the last 7 days on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, updated on their own

YOUR KEY STAYS WITH YOU
App Sales Overview has no server. You connect your own App Store Connect API key once; it's stored in your iPhone's Keychain, on this device only, and sent nowhere but to Apple. No account, no tracking, no analytics. The app is open source, so you can check every line.

One purchase, no subscription.

Requires an App Store Connect API key (Admin role for store analytics, Finance for sales).

name: Arabic Class
description:
Arabic Class accompagne les élèves d'un cours d'arabe dans leurs révisions, à la maison comme avant un contrôle.

GRAMMAIRE
• Les leçons du cours, avec la traduction
• Une fiche de révision par leçon, à l'écran et en PDF
• I‘râb : la méthode pas à pas, puis des phrases à analyser, du plus simple au plus difficile

TEXTES ET VOCABULAIRE
• Les textes étudiés en classe, avec leur traduction
• Le vocabulaire de chaque texte, avec des quiz

CORAN
• Tajwid : cours, fiches de révision et contrôles
• Hifz : aide à la mémorisation des sourates
• Tilâwa : écoute et récitation

TARBIYA
• Les leçons et ce qu'il faut savoir par cœur

QUIZ ET CONTRÔLES
• Quiz en ligne, une question à la fois, corrigés tout de suite
• Contrôles à imprimer en PDF, avec ou sans corrigé

Gratuit, sans publicité, sans compte. Aucune donnée n'est collectée : ta progression reste sur ton appareil.

name: Archii - Smart Certificate
description:
Smart Certificate gives the things you value a digital certificate of authenticity, linked to a secure NFC tag on the item itself. Anyone can hold an iPhone near the tag and see straight away whether it's genuine, along with the item's details and how many owners it has had.

Made for artists, makers, galleries, collectors and anyone who wants proof that an item is the original.

TAP TO VERIFY
Certificate tags use NTAG 424 DNA chips, which create a new secure code every time they're tapped. The tag can't be copied, so when the screen shows "Genuine" with the certificate number, you know you're holding the real thing.

YOUR ITEMS IN ONE PLACE
Add an item in a few steps: choose its type, add a title, artist or maker, year, medium, dimensions, edition and up to three photos. Each item gets its own certificate number.

TRANSFER OWNERSHIP SAFELY
Selling or gifting an item? Create a one-time transfer code and give it to the new owner. They enter the code and tap the item's certificate tag to finish, so ownership only changes hands when the item does. Every change is recorded in the item's ownership history.

PRINTED CERTIFICATE
Download a printable A4 Certificate of Authenticity with a QR code that links to the live status of the certificate.

INFORMATION TAGS
Add ordinary NFC tags to share an item's details on labels, packaging or display cards. Information tags show details only and never show "Genuine", so there's no confusion with the secure certificate tag.

REPORT STOLEN
If an item goes missing, report it stolen. Anyone who taps its tag will see the warning.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Owner details are never shown to people who check an item, and they're never printed on the certificate.

Smart Certificate is made by Archii, a design-led software studio in Hove, UK.

An iPhone with NFC is needed to tap tags.

name: ArchNotePro
description:
ArchNote är ett verktyg för att dokumentera och jämföra tandstatus. Tandschemat visar över- och underkäken från behandlarens perspektiv. Växla mellan permanenta tänder och mjölktänder. Tryck på en tand för att markera exempelvis en krona, ett implantat, ett brostöd eller en saknad tand. Appen sammanför intilliggande brostöd och mellanled till en bro.

Registrera fickdjup i millimeter på upp till sex ställen per tand och lägg till en anteckning. Du kan även ange mobilitet och, där det är tillämpligt, furkationsgrad. Värden från 4 mm markeras visuellt. Det är en gräns för visningen av registrerade värden.

Tandbågarna visas direkt i FDI- eller Palmernotation. Spara undersökningen och välj en tidigare registrering som utgångspunkt för jämförelser. Då kan du se ändrad tandstatus och skillnader i fickdjup. Jämförelsen utelämnar ställen där ett värde saknas. I referensdelen finns guider och en ordlista med källhänvisningar.

Registreringarna sparas på enheten. Appen fungerar utan nätanslutning och konto. Gränssnittet finns på engelska och förenklad kinesiska.

Appen är avsedd för dokumentation och undervisning och ger inga diagnoser eller behandlingsråd.

name: Arclet Sound
description:
Most earbud apps stop at a few presets and sliders. Arclet opens up the equalizer built into your earbuds, and the result is stored on the earbuds, so it follows them to every phone, laptop and app.

WHY ARCLET
- Parametric EQ: move each band's frequency and width, not just its level*
- Fit to target: one tap tunes your earbuds toward a balanced baseline made for your model*
- Personal Sound: a 2-minute listening test adjusts that baseline to your ears and taste*
- Up to ±12 dB per band, more than many makers' apps allow*
- Save up to 16 of your own curves and see the response as you tune
- No account, no sign-in, no data collected
- One app for all your supported earbuds

* Depends on the model, see below.

SUPPORTED EARBUDS
- Moondrop Golden Ages 2: parametric EQ, fit to target, Personal Sound, ±12 dB
- SOUNDPEATS Air5 Pro+: parametric EQ, fit to target, Personal Sound, ±12 dB, start from any preset
- Nothing Ear: parametric EQ, fit to target, Personal Sound, ±12 dB
- Nothing Ear (3): parametric EQ, fit to target, Personal Sound
- CMF Buds 2 Plus: parametric EQ, fit to target, Personal Sound, ±12 dB
- Cambridge Audio Melomania A100: fit to target, Personal Sound, ±12 dB, start from any preset
- CMF Buds Pro 2: presets and custom EQ
- Shokz OpenDots 2 and OpenDots ONE: presets and custom EQ

EVERYTHING ELSE, TOO
Battery for each bud and the case, noise control, gestures, multipoint, codec choice, ring a lost bud and device options, on the models that support them. Each model is studied before it's supported, so you only see controls your earbuds actually have.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Arclet talks to your earbuds over Bluetooth and nothing else. No account, no tracking, no data collected.

Arclet is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Shokz, Cambridge Audio, SOUNDPEATS, Nothing or Moondrop. All product names and trademarks belong to their respective owners and are used only to show which hardware Arclet works with.

name: Art of Words
description:
Learn the words worth knowing.

Art of Words brings a little more intention to learning English. Instead of a crowded dashboard, you get one focused word card: a definition, pronunciation, an example, and a place to decide what comes next.

START WITH WORDS THAT MATTER
Browse a ranked feed of more than 16,000 English words. Each word has a global rank and learning-value indicator. Choose different lists without losing a consistent ordering.

MAKE THE FEED YOURS
Explore GRE, IELTS, SAT, and TOEFL vocabulary lists, or combine several lists into one feed. Selected lists are combined without duplicate words. Additional regional lists appear where supported.

KEEP USEFUL WORDS CLOSE
Favorite a word to return to it later. Already know it? Archive it from your active feeds. Archived words remain available to browse and restore.

GO BEYOND A QUICK DEFINITION
Open Word details for full meanings, examples, phrases, related expressions, and six word dimensions. Search your current feed by word or global rank and jump directly to a card.

LEARN IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Choose English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, Portuguese, or German for the interface and definitions. English examples remain visible alongside available translations.

LISTEN AND STAY FOCUSED
Tap to hear English pronunciation using available device voices, with US and UK preferences. Choose a warm light appearance or a quiet dark one.

OFFLINE BY DESIGN
Vocabulary is included in the app. No account, advertising, analytics, in-app purchases, or subscriptions. Buy once and learn at your own pace.

Your favorites, archive, and settings are saved locally. Export and import progress through Files when you want a separate backup or a manual transfer. There is no automatic iCloud sync; deleting the app can remove local progress, so keep an exported copy somewhere safe.

Art of Words is an independent learning app, not an official exam product or a guarantee of exam results.

name: Âsâr
description:
Âsâr, hadis ve âsâr kütüphanesini günlük zikir sayacıyla bir araya getiren sade bir uygulamadır.

KÜTÜPHANE
• Musannef, Müsned, Sahîh-i Buhârî, Sahîh-i Müslim, Sünen-i Ebî Dâvûd ve Selef’in diğer eserlerinden on binlerce rivayet
• Her rivayette Arapça aslı ve Türkçe çevirisi
• Râvi zinciri: her râvinin bir öncekinden hangi lafızla aldığı, râvi sayfaları ve kaynak gösterimli râvi bilgileri
• Âlim, kitap ve bab düzeninde gezinme; kitapları çevrimdışı okumak için indirme
• Bütün kütüphanede Türkçe ve Arapça arama

ZİKİR
• Genel, sabah ve akşam zikirleri; Peygamber (s.a.v.) duaları
• Dokunarak sayma, odak modu, günlük sayaçlar ve son 7 gün
• Hedef değil, kaç kez okuduğunuzu sayar; tamamladığınızı siz işaretlersiniz

AKIŞ VE ANASAYFA
• Bütün kütüphaneden her gün yeni rivayetler
• Beğendiklerinizi kaydedin, koleksiyonlara ayırın, kitapta açın, görsel olarak paylaşın

PROFİL
• Okuma hedefi, okumaya devam ettikleriniz, son 30 günün özeti
• Verileriniz hesabınızda saklanır, cihaz değiştirince kaybolmaz

Reklam yok, takip yok. Verileriniz satılmaz, paylaşılmaz.

name: Astra: Legacy of Karanth
description:
Leave your shattered home behind and set out in search of Karanth's legacy.

Astra: Legacy of Karanth is a single-player space action game built around exploration, dangerous sorties, and the journey home. Hold your device upright to cruise through space and gather cargo and resources. Turn it sideways to face enemy fire with manual aiming and weapon skills.

A new angle on combat
Automatic fire lets you focus on movement. In landscape combat, aim your shots and unleash your weapon's skill. Push deeper into danger or protect what you have collected and head back to the mothership. Every return is a chance to prepare for the next sortie.

Build your ship between missions
Combine weapons, hulls, sensors, and support modules. Visit the hangar's shop, research, and storage to prepare your equipment. The shop uses only currency and materials earned by playing.

Find a way through the stars
Explore asteroid fields, dark nebulae, and ancestral tombs. Secure return points, face each region's threats, and escort convoys through the Varkon blockade as you open the route ahead.

Play offline, in your language
Free to play, with no ads, in-app purchases, or subscriptions. No account or sign-in is required. Progress is saved on your device.

Available in English, Korean, Japanese, German, Spanish, French, Italian, and Portuguese. The game automatically follows your device language and uses English when that language is unsupported. English is the default language. You can also choose a language manually in settings.

name: Augmentify
description:
Augmentify brings print, products and places to life with augmented reality.

SCAN AND SEE IT COME ALIVE
Point your camera at an Augmentify code, a poster, a flyer or a product. Videos, 3D models, buttons and messages appear right on top of it. No code? The camera also recognises the pictures businesses have set up.

PLACE IT IN YOUR ROOM
See a sofa on your floor, a painting on your wall or a lamp hanging from your ceiling, at real size, before you buy. Clear steps guide you: point, move slowly, tap Place here.

SHOP AND FIND COUPONS
Buy what you see straight from the AR and pay with Uni5Pay+, bank transfer or cash. Hunt for hidden coupons at real places in town.

DISCOVER
See which shops and places use Augmentify near you, with directions, opening hours and a direct line to the business.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
No account needed. The camera picture never leaves your phone. Sign in with just your email, only if you want your orders and coupons on every phone.

Available in English, Dutch, French, Spanish and Portuguese.

Augmentify is a service of Technovate N.V., Suriname.

name: Auriva OS POS
description:
For the counter tablets used by your café staff. Auriva OS POS is the shared till that stays on the counter — staff sign in with their own PIN. (Owners follow sales and reports on their own phone with the separate Auriva Owner app.)

• Take dine-in, takeaway and counter orders in a few taps.
• Print KOTs to the kitchen and GST bills on Bluetooth or network receipt printers.
• Take cash, UPI QR and card payments, split bills and settle tables.
• Works offline: orders keep flowing and sync when the connection is back.
• One sign-in per shift with staff PINs and manager approvals for voids and discounts.
• Day start and day close with cash counts, shift handover and reports.

Auriva OS POS needs an Auriva OS café account. Register your café at aurivaworld.com.

name: Aurora Narrows
description:
Let a promising shadow pass, or risk a little more of your line for the creature below.

In Quiet Water, drag to choose your depth beneath the ice. Each bite shows a landing chance and the wear a lift will cause, so you can commit or let go. Your equipment changes the decision, and successful outings provide Frostglass for the Outfitter. Sixteen northern species fill the Winter Album across four waters.

Underice Passage replaces the landing roll with a route you control. Steer through frozen gates, hold Draw In to rise, then ease off when a current pulls the line taut. Eighteen handcrafted passages combine offset openings, changing currents and surges without a clock.

The ice mouth is close. The current has other plans.

name: AwoSign: QR Business Card
description:
AwoSign is an offline-first Digital QR Business Card, Company Invoice & Multi-Currency IBAN Wallet, and Staff ID Badge Studio built for professionals, executives, field teams, and international trade-fair exhibitors.

No sign-up, cloud account, or internet connection is required. Every profile, scanned counterparty card, tax record, and IBAN stays strictly on your iPhone.

KEY FEATURES

1. 10-Language Digital QR Business Cards & vCard 3.0
• Design cards in English, Turkish, Chinese, Arabic (RTL), German, Russian, Spanish, French, Japanese, and Korean.
• Bilingual card support (e.g., English + Chinese or English + Arabic) for international meetings and expos.
• Instant Fullscreen QR Pass that works reliably even in Airplane Mode.
• Built-in QR Business Card Scanner (Camera & Photo Library) with 1-tap export to iOS Contacts.

2. 100% On-Device OCR (Powered by Apple Vision)
• Extract contact details, company names, tax IDs, and IBAN numbers from paper business cards, tax certificates, and bank slips.
• Zero server uploads: all optical character recognition runs locally on your device.
• Strict MOD-97 IBAN checksum validation and a mandatory draft review stage before saving.

3. Corporate Invoice & Multi-Currency IBAN Wallet
• Organize company billing details alongside TRY, EUR, USD, GBP, CNY, AED, SAR, CHF, RUB, and JPY bank accounts.
• Share a single IBAN, invoice details, or VCF/PNG cards via the native iOS Share Sheet, AirDrop, WhatsApp, or Save to Files.

4. Native AirPrint & Print-Ready Exports
• Print 85×55 mm business cards (10-up A4 sheets), CR80 vertical staff ID badges, and A4 company IBAN sheets directly via AirPrint, or export crisp PNG, VCF, CSV, and JSON backups.

5. Privacy by Design
• No account registration required.
• Zero third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking SDKs.
• Local device storage with portable JSON backup and snapshot restore.

name: Axe Your Photos
description:
Your camera roll is full of blurry shots, old screenshots and videos you'll never watch again. Axe Your Photos makes cleaning it up quick, and kind of fun.

SWIPE THROUGH YOUR LIBRARY ONE CARD AT A TIME:
• Swipe right to keep. It won't show up again.
• Swipe left to axe. It's queued for deletion.
• Swipe up to file it into an album, or create a new one.
• Swipe down to skip it and decide later.

FREE UP THE MOST SPACE FIRST
Sort by largest files to find the space hogs, or shuffle for a random mix. Filter to just photos, screenshots or videos. Each card shows its file size, so you know what you're saving.

NOTHING IS DELETED BY ACCIDENT
Axed items wait in a review queue until you're ready. Rescue anything with a tap, undo your last swipe, and confirm before anything is removed. Deleted items go to Recently Deleted, where iOS keeps them for 30 days.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking and no uploads. The app makes no network requests at all. Your photos stay on your iPhone.

Zoom in on photos, scrub through videos, and get your library under control, one Axe at a time.

name: Azkar Tracker: Zikr & Tasbih
description:
Azkar Tracker is a complete, customizable zikr counter for Muslims who want to build a consistent practice of remembrance.

Whether you're completing your daily tasbih, reciting your morning and evening adhkar, or counting an unlimited dhikr, Azkar Tracker keeps everything organised, beautiful, and effortless.

A BUILT-IN LIBRARY — READY TO USE
Start immediately with a curated collection of essential adhkar: daily, morning & evening, weekly, monthly, and unlimited — plus Tasbeeh Fatima after each prayer and a Duas section.

FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE
Add any zikr or dua you need — set a name, Arabic text, category, goal count, and reminder time. Built-in adhkar can be deleted or have their target count changed to suit your personal practice.

SMART REMINDERS & PRAYER-TIME ALERTS
Schedule reminders at a fixed time or link them directly to prayer times (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) with a custom offset before or after the adhan. The prayer-time calculator works fully offline — no internet required.

STREAKS, STATISTICS & ACHIEVEMENTS
See your per-zikr streak in the right unit — days for daily adhkar, weeks for weekly, months for monthly — plus an app-wide daily streak. Miss a period and the streak resets honestly. Track your progress with a 14-day chart and activity heatmap, and unlock achievements as your practice grows.

AUTO-RESET, NEVER MISS A PERIOD
Counts reset automatically at the right boundary — midnight for daily, your chosen weekday for weekly, and the 1st for monthly.

HOME-SCREEN WIDGET
Glance at your streak and today's count without opening the app.

THOUGHTFULLY DESIGNED
• Large, readable counter with smooth tap animation and haptics
• Progress ring that turns green when you reach your goal
• Light and dark mode, with a choice of accent colours
• All data stored privately on your device — nothing is ever uploaded or shared

Azkar Tracker is made by a Muslim, for Muslims, with care for the practice it supports.

name: BA Bus: Buenos Aires Live Map
description:
BA Bus shows the buses of the City of Buenos Aires live on the map. Open it and see where your colectivo actually is.

LIVE BUSES
• Every bus in the city's open feed, moving along the streets between position updates
• Tap a bus to see its line, its operator and its route with the stops along it
• Follow a bus as it moves

YOUR LINES
• Choose which lines the map shows, by number or by barrio
• Your picked lines are remembered the next time you open the app

BY BIKE
• Ecobici stations with the bikes and free docks available now
• Ciclovías and bike racks on the map
• Bike routes to an address or a dropped pin: the fastest, or the most protected when it differs

MADE FOR THE CITY
• English, Spanish, Italian, German and Portuguese
• No account and no sign-up
• Your location is used only to show where you are on the map

Bus positions come from the City of Buenos Aires open transport data and can be delayed when the city's feed is. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Bike lanes, racks and Ecobici stations: Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, CC BY 2.5 AR.

name: BAGE Monitör
description:
BAGE Monitör is an internal operations companion app for BAGE Studio staff to monitor the bage.studio service on the go.

• Overview: service status, request and error rates, worker health
• Alerts: open alerts with severity and details
• Errors and events: error groups and recent events
• Security: attack summary and edge protection
• Costs: external service usage costs
• Push notifications: critical alerts reach your phone

Accounts are created by BAGE Studio administrators; there is no public sign-up. Sessions are device-bound and signed; no ads, no tracking.

name: Bahaa Delivery
description:
Bahaa Delivery - fast, simple deliveries, no hassle.

• Order a courier - need to send something across town? Pick a pickup and drop-off address, see the price upfront, and a courier is on the way.

• Order from local businesses - shops and restaurants nearby, with menus and photos. Add to cart and order in a few taps.

• Live tracking - from the moment the courier picks up your order, see them on the map and know when they'll arrive.

• Easy payment - cash, Bit or PayPal. A receipt for every order.

• Points and credit - earn points on orders and get rewards.

• Notifications - updates at every step of your order.

• Real support - chat directly with our team inside the app.

• 5 languages - Hebrew, Arabic, English, Russian and Ukrainian.

Quick sign-in with Apple, Google or email. You can delete your account at any time from inside the app.

name: Baiveriyaa
description:
Baiveriyaa is the Maldives' marriage-focused matchmaking app: a private, respectful place to meet someone who is also looking for marriage.

MEET SERIOUS PEOPLE
• Every member is 18 or older and confirms who they are with their ID card, so the people you meet are real.
• Browse marriage posts by atoll and island, age and what each person is looking for.
• AI Matchmaking suggests people who fit what you want.

SHOW YOURSELF YOUR WAY
• Create a marriage post with a beautiful poster in minutes.
• Add a portfolio about you, your family and your plans.
• Keep your photos private until you choose to share them.

TALK SAFELY
• Send an interest. When it is accepted, you can chat.
• Send photos, voice notes, stickers and photos that can be seen only once.
• Voice and video calls inside the app, without sharing your phone number.
• Block or report anyone, at any time.

MADE FOR THE MALDIVES
• In Dhivehi and English.
• Community: short videos from members across the islands.
• Premium is free for women.

Baiveriyaa is run by VIXERIA PRIVATE LIMITED.
Terms: https://baiveriyaa.com/terms
Privacy: https://baiveriyaa.com/privacy

name: Bandstead
description:
Bandstead is the home base for musicians who play in more than one band.

Keep every show, rehearsal, setlist, lyric, task and dollar in one place, and share it with everyone in the band. Switch between your bands in a tap, or see all of them at once.

SHOWS • Load-in, soundcheck, doors and set times in the venue's time zone • A day sheet with the times and setlist, ready to share • Invite the band and see who's in for each show • Settle up: guarantee, merch and costs for the night

REHEARSALS AND MEETINGS • Set the time and place, pick who's coming, repeat it weekly • Everyone answers Going, Maybe or Can't make it • Practise a show's setlist or build one for the room

SONGS AND LYRICS • Every song with its key, tempo and writers • Lyrics laid out by verse and chorus, with a big-text view for the stage • Folders and track order for each release

TASKS • Share a task between bandmates, with a due date and time • Plan a release or a tour from a ready-made checklist • Get a notification when someone assigns you a task or adds you to a rehearsal

RELEASES AND PROJECTS • Release plans from final masters to release day • Projects for marketing, music videos, tours and gigs

MONEY • Income, expenses and expected payments for each band • Budgets for each part of a release • Only the people you choose can see the money

YOUR WHOLE BAND JOINS FREE Only the person who runs the band space needs a plan. Bandmates, crew and managers join free, with the access you choose.

Try everything free for 14 days with no card. Plans are managed at bandstead.app.

name: Barrio Brisa
description:
Tu casa. Tus personajes. Una ciudad llena de pequeñas historias.

Barrio Brisa transforma una casa de muñecas en un mundo que puedes tocar. Aquí no avanzas por una lista de menús: juegas directamente en el escenario. Toca el suelo para caminar, mueve objetos, cambia de ropa y descubre qué ocurre cuando cada detalle queda en su sitio.

Conoce a Nico y Lola, prepara meriendas, crea un ramo y organiza una fiesta de bienvenida. Tres aventuras de cuatro pasos mezclan pistas, decisiones y pequeñas sorpresas. Si te equivocas, puedes volver a intentarlo sin perder nada.

Lo que hace especial a tu barrio:

• Crea tu estilo con tres conjuntos originales.
• Camina y explora la casa, la plaza, la panadería y el taller.
• Toca y arrastra objetos para decorar y resolver retos.
• Vive tres miniaventuras con decisiones y finales propios.
• Prepara recetas, entrega regalos y fortalece amistades.
• Reúne a tus vecinos, coloca la mesa y crea una foto para tu álbum.
• Juega sin conexión y conserva el progreso en tu dispositivo.
• Disfruta a tu ritmo: sin cuentas, esperas obligatorias ni castigos por probar.

Cada acción deja una huella visible: una flor junto a la ventana, un amigo en la sala o una nueva foto en tus recuerdos. En Barrio Brisa, la historia no solo se cuenta; la construyes jugando.

¿Qué historia crearás hoy

name: Baseline: Stay on it.
description:
Baseline shows how your nights respond to your days.

Your Apple Watch measures your resting heart rate and wrist temperature while you sleep. Baseline learns what's normal for you, then shows each night as on or off your own baseline. A late dinner, a few drinks, a big night out, stress or a cold can all push those numbers up. Baseline doesn't judge. It shows the numbers, so you can see the pattern for yourself.

NIGHTS ON BASELINE
Your current streak, your best runs, and how often your nights stay on baseline over a week, a month or a year.

LOG A ROUND
Log what you drank in a couple of taps and see it next to the night that followed.

YOUR NUMBERS, YOUR BASELINE
Resting heart rate and wrist temperature, night by night, against your own average and threshold. Every chart shows which device or app its data came from.

SICK? MARK IT
Mark a night as sick and it's left out of your baseline and your stats.

CYCLE-AWARE, IF YOU WANT IT
If you track your period in Apple Health, turn on cycle data and Baseline compares each night with the same phase of your cycle, so the usual rise in temperature after ovulation isn't counted as off baseline. It's off by default, and Baseline doesn't ask for cycle data unless you turn it on.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Baseline reads from Apple Health and never writes to it. Everything stays on your iPhone: no account, no servers, no analytics, no ads.

TRY IT WITH SAMPLE DATA
No nights yet? Turn on sample data in Settings to see how everything works.

WHAT YOU NEED
Resting heart rate comes from Apple Watch. Wrist temperature needs Apple Watch Series 8 or later, or any Apple Watch Ultra, worn to sleep.

Baseline is not a medical device and doesn't diagnose or treat anything. It shows trends in your own data.

name: BatchTrace
description: Track production batches and genealogy offline.

name: BBABAM Building
description:
Turn a favorite photo into a room full of things you love.
Lounge at a manga café, spend time with friends, and enjoy the rooftop night view in this cozy everyday-life game.
Drop into BBABAM Building for a moment—and stay a little longer.

• Your photos, your own collection room
Use photos or drawings to decorate in-game frames, posters, acrylic standees, keychains, cushions, and bedding. Create several rooms, each with its own style. Loved ones, pets, or your own artwork—make room for what matters to you.

• Create virtual goods and style your avatar
Make decorations from photos or drawings in the workshop. Choose hairstyles, clothes, and sizes for cute chibi plush dolls. Keep your creations in your bag or display them in your room. Customize your avatar's clothes, accessories, and face, too.

• Find your next favorite manga
Browse descriptions and keywords, share recommendations, and leave a short bookmark note. Can't remember a title? Post the clues you remember and look for it together. Where available, follow a link to the official reading platform.

• Relax alone or hang out with friends
Meet friends in the same channel, explore the café, and settle into a comfy spot with virtual snacks. Try a café shift and chat with the NPCs you meet around the building.

• Make a memory at the photo booth
Take a four-photo strip with your avatar. In the photo companion mode, remove the background from a selected picture and pose alongside it.

• Take the scenic route on the rooftop
Ride the Ferris wheel, carousel, swinging ship, and roller coaster, or enjoy the night view from the Starlight Train. In the mood for a little mystery? Look for the hidden basement manga room.

Rooms and creations are saved on your device. Optional device linking lets you continue with your rooms, photos, workshop creations, and keepsakes on a linked device.

Virtual goods are in-game decorations. No physical products are made or shipped.
Manga and webtoon chapters are read on linked official external sites. Availability, sign-in, and payment requirements vary by site.
An internet connection is required. Photo features use pictures you choose.

Music in the store video: Bossa Antigua — Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Source: https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/index.html?isrc=USUAN1700069
Edited for this video.

name: BCCloud
description:
BCCloud is your personal cloud for files, photos and the projects that fill your life, with an assistant that helps you keep it all in order.

YOUR FILES, EVERYWHERE
• Upload photos, videos and documents from your iPhone, or take a photo or video right in the app
• Organize everything in folders, filter by tag and star your favorites
• Preview documents, photos, video and audio
• Recently deleted items stay recoverable for 30 days

SHARE WITH THE PEOPLE YOU CHOOSE
• Share files and folders with other BCCloud members, who see them view-only
• Create share links with an expiry date, a password or a download limit
• Ask someone to send you files with a file request
• An Inbox shows new shares, files sent to you and mentions

KITS FOR LIFE'S PROJECTS
• Keep the steps, files and dates for a project together, such as buying a home or onboarding a client
• Track progress step by step and invite others to work on a kit with you
• Comment on steps and keep everyone up to date

CALENDAR AND REMINDERS
• See every dated thing in one place: kit steps, reminders and more
• Add reminders for any day and get notified when they're due

AN ASSISTANT FOR YOUR CLOUD
• Ask in plain words: "Find my tax return", "What's due this week?", "Remind me to call the bank tomorrow at 10am"
• Speak your request; speech is turned into text on your iPhone
• Changes the assistant proposes are always shown for your confirmation first

MORE
• Separate workspaces, each with its own files and look
• Search file names and folders, plus the text of documents you choose to index
• Lock the app with Face ID
• Sign in with email, Google or Apple

The assistant uses a third-party AI service and asks for your permission before it sends anything.

Terms of Use: https://officialbccloud.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://officialbccloud.com/privacy.html

name: BDM Мэдээллийн сан
description: BDM нь орон нутгийн мэдээллийн сан юм. Аймаг, бүс, сумын эрх бүхий хэрэглэгчид өөрийн нэвтрэх эрхээр орж, харьяа нэгжийнхээ статистик үзүүлэлт, мэдээллийг харах, удирдах боломжтой.

name: Bellbound
description:
Tiny gifts. Grand adventures.

Meet a little blue penguin with a red scarf, a golden bell and a very important winter job. In Bellbound, every parcel carries a smile—and every floating ice island is a new way home.

TILT THE ICE, DELIVER THE JOY
Drag the tilt pad to guide your penguin's slide. Pick up a wrapped gift, follow its address and hold the Bell Brake for a gentle landing. Deliver all three parcels, then return to the Post Bell to finish your crossing.

A WORLD WITH A LITTLE WOBBLE
Explore six postal regions, from welcoming Snowglobe Bay to the breezy Windward Shelf and the busy Bellworks. Learn to drift over slick ice, line up narrow bridges, lean into crosswinds and ring open special bell gates.

FRESH POST EVERY TIME
Each dispatch creates a new connected island layout. There is no countdown and no life limit. If you slide off the ice, a soft snow rescue brings you back with your parcel safe.

YOUR OWN WINTER COLLECTION
Earn postal ranks, collect 18 illustrated stamps and unlock four cozy courier outfits through deliveries. Careful crossings earn Steady Flippers ribbons; three gentle landings with no rescues earn a Golden Bell.

MADE FOR QUIET MOMENTS
Enjoy a real 3D snow world, an orbitable camera, original bell music and soft haptic feedback on supported devices. A skippable practice crossing teaches by doing. Adjust sounds, music, motion, tilt sensitivity, route guidance and edge assistance to make the journey comfortable.
A little tilt goes a long way.

name: BellowsLab: Fold Synth
description:
BellowsLab turns iPhone Duo into a pocket synthesizer studio. The scope and tape reels sit above the fold, multi-touch pads below it, and the hinge becomes an expression pedal.

PLAY
• 8-voice analog-style synth with two band-limited oscillators, sub and noise
• Resonant zero-delay-feedback filter, two envelopes and an LFO
• 8 hand-made presets: Bellows Organ, Glass Keys, Reed Lead, Tape Strings, Sub Bass, Dust Pad, Pluck Box, Wah Clav
• Isometric pad grid with Scale Lock, so every note is in key. 9 scales, any root
• Arpeggiator: up, down, up & down, random, 1–3 octaves, synced to tempo

THE HINGE IS YOUR PEDAL
• Gently tilt the top half a few degrees to sweep the filter, a wah or tape pitch
• Calibrate your resting angle with one tap
• The hinge is only ever read between 85° and 165°. No need to push it flat or snap it shut
• On other iPhones and iPads, tilting the whole device does the same job, and a touch strip always works

FOUR REELS
• 4-track reel-to-reel looper with overdub, mute, level and ½× / 2× tape speed
• Wow and flutter you can dial in
• 120 Hz phosphor oscilloscope

POCKET TAPE DECK
• Close iPhone Duo and the cover screen becomes a cassette deck. Your loops keep playing, even with the screen locked
• Step through your saved sessions, mute tracks, export

EXPORT
• Render loops to WAV (24-bit) or M4A (AAC) and share them anywhere

RESPECTS YOU
• One purchase. No subscription, no account, no ads, no tracking, no network access
• Fully localized in English, Turkish and German
• VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion support

Optimized for iPhone Duo. Works great on every iPhone and iPad running iOS 27.1 or later.

name: BFPOS Chat
description:
BFPOS Chat ist der interne Messenger der BF POS GmbH für die Kommunikation im Team.

Die App ist ausschliesslich für Mitarbeitende und Partner bestimmt, die von einem Administrator ein Konto erhalten haben. Eine Registrierung in der App gibt es nicht.

FUNKTIONEN
• Einzelchats und Gruppen, Gruppen mit Einladung
• Fotos, Dokumente (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) und Sprachnachrichten
• Antworten auf einzelne Nachrichten, Weiterleiten und Löschen
• Suche in jeder Unterhaltung
• Push-Mitteilungen bei neuen Nachrichten
• Online-Status und Anzeige, wenn jemand schreibt
• Helles und dunkles Design, passend zur Einstellung des iPhones
• Deutsch, Englisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Spanisch und Kroatisch

SICHERHEIT
• Konten werden nur von Administratoren erstellt
• Jedes neue Gerät muss von einem Administrator freigegeben werden
• Nachrichten und Dateien liegen auf dem Server der Firma in der Schweiz
• Die Übertragung ist verschlüsselt, Dateien werden verschlüsselt gespeichert

REGELN UND MODERATION
• Jede Nachricht kann gemeldet, jede Person blockiert werden
• Administratoren prüfen Meldungen und können Nachrichten entfernen und Konten deaktivieren

name: BibleSpan
description:
Bible Span is a calm, distraction-free Bible reader crafted for spanning across translations, deep side-by-side verse comparison, and quiet daily reflection on iPhone and iPad.

Designed like a fine print edition rather than a noisy social feed, Bible Span removes accounts, pop-ups, ads, and algorithmic clutter so you can focus entirely on the enduring word.

EVERYDAY CONTEMPLATIVE READING (CORE FEATURES)
• Complete 66-Book Offline Bible: Read every chapter and verse of the Old and New Testaments (1,189 chapters, 31,103 verses) completely offline with zero loading lag.
• Instant Book, Chapter & Line Selection: Jump directly to any Testament, Book, Chapter, or individual Line (Verse) number from the top bar or inline quick-selector strip—and share or return to exact verse deep links.
• Three Distinct Reading Atmospheres: Switch effortlessly between Pure Bright White Daylight for crisp daytime contrast, Warm Parchment Sepia for gentle afternoon reading, and Midnight Dark for restful nighttime reflection.
• Custom Editorial Typography: Tailor your reading space with Editorial Serif or Clean Sans typefaces, adjustable font sizing (15px–28px), and one-tap switching between Verse-by-Verse study layout and Continuous Paragraph Flow.
• Instant Search Across 31,103 Verses: Search keywords or type any reference (such as "John 3:16", "Psalm 23:2", or "living water") to jump directly to the exact verse with highlighted matches and testament filters.
• Visual 66-Book Progress Tracker: Mark chapters read and follow your completion percentage across the entire Bible, Old Testament, New Testament, and every individual book.

SPECIAL STUDY & DEVOTIONAL FEATURES
• 10 Complete Offline Bible Translations Built In: Switch translations on the fly while looking at any passage—all 10 complete Bibles are bundled 100% offline:
  1. WEB — World English Bible (Modern contemporary English)
