  2. BSB — Berean Standard Bible (Smooth modern study English)
  3. KJV — King James Version (Classic 1611/1769 literary English)
  4. ASV — American Standard Version (1901 scholarly word-for-word revision)
  5. BBE — Bible in Basic English (Clear, accessible 1,000-word English)
  6. YLT — Young’s Literal Translation (Strict tense-preserving literal rendering)
  7. DBY — Darby Translation (Classic 1890 scholarly study Bible)
  8. WBT — Webster’s Bible (1833 Noah Webster American English revision)
  9. DRA — Douay-Rheims Bible (1899 historic Challoner revision)
  10. AKJV — American King James Version (Vocabulary-updated King James text)
• Customizable Side-by-Side Translation Comparison: Tap any verse and open "⇄ Compare" to view translations side by side. Use the interactive version selector chips to choose the exact combination of Bibles you want to compare at once, and tap any card to switch your full chapter reader into that translation.
• 4-Color Editorial Highlights & Personal Reflection Notes: Highlight meaningful verses in Sage Green, Warm Gold, Rose Clay, or Sky Mist, and attach personal reflection notes inline right beneath the verse.
• Export Your Study Journal Anywhere: Your highlights, bookmarks, and reflection notes stay private on your device and can be exported anytime as clean Markdown (.md) or JSON (.json) files.
• 365 Daily Contemplations: Begin each morning with a curated daily verse, meditative reflection prompt, and one-tap jump into the full chapter context for all 365 days of the year.
• 160 Rotating Thematic Scripture Moments: Explore 8 life themes—Peace in Anxiety, Rest for the Weary, The Shepherd's Care, Enduring Love, Hope & Assurance, Seeking Wisdom, Refuge & Strength, and New Mercies—each stocked with 20 rotating passages (160 curated passages in total) that refresh daily and cycle on demand.

PRIVATE & OFFLINE BY DESIGN
Bible Span requires no sign-up, no internet connection, and no external servers. Every translation, bookmark, highlight, note, and reading milestone is stored locally on your device.

name: Bite Tray
description:
Bite Tray keeps a private record of the street snacks you have already finished. After one snack, you write the name, the stall, how it was served, the taste, the bite, and the portion. The phone scores that tray and gives it a grade: Order again, If you pass it, Only when hungry, or Leave it.

The first screen is the ranked board. The tray with the highest score is marked Order this tray, and the lead over the next tray is shown in points. One saved tray says there is no other tray to pass. Taste and bite are each 1 to 5. Portion is Short, Fitted, or Piled. The date is the day you ate it.

Scores are calculated on this iPhone. The record is not uploaded. There is no account, no photo, and no price. You can change or delete a tray later. The rank stays on this phone so the next time you stand at a stall you can see which tray to order again.

name: Blazefin
description:
Blazefin is a native app for your own Jellyfin media server. Films and series from your server – built for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV.

Blazefin brings no content of its own. You need a Jellyfin server you have an account on – your own, or one you were given access to.

EVERYTHING AT A GLANCE
• A big Spotlight with artwork, logos and ratings
• Continue watching, next episode, new films and series, genres
• Your whole library with a fast A–Z index, sorting and filters
• Search for films, series, people and years

A PLAYER THAT THINKS AHEAD
• Chapters with thumbnails
• Audio track, subtitles (including PGS), quality and sleep timer right on screen
• Remembers your audio and subtitle choice – for a series, in every episode
• On Apple TV, Blazefin also plays files Apple’s player cannot, such as MKV with DTS or TrueHD, as they are
• Apple TV switches to the film’s frame rate
• Skip intro, recap and credits – automatically if you like
• The next episode starts by itself
• Several versions of a film? Blazefin asks
• Picture in Picture on iPhone and iPad

MADE FOR APPLE TV
• Fully controllable with the Siri Remote
• Clear settings, just like Apple TV’s own
• Your iPhone as a remote: see what’s playing, control it, or hand a film over to the TV

YOUR SETTINGS EVERYWHERE
• Default language and subtitles are saved in your Jellyfin account and apply on all your devices
• Favourites, playlists and watched state – for whole seasons and series, too

AT HOME AND ON THE GO
• Straight to your server on your home network, over your internet address when you’re out
• Sign in with user name and password or with Quick Connect
• Multiple servers and accounts

YOUR SERVER’S EXTRAS
If your server offers a wish list, messages or collections, Blazefin shows them. If not, they stay out of sight.

PRIVATE
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Blazefin only talks to your server, and your password is never stored.

Requirements: a Jellyfin server and iOS 18, iPadOS 18 or tvOS 18 or later.

Blazefin is an independent project and is not affiliated with the Jellyfin project.

name: Blutdruck-Tracker
description:
Your blood pressure log. No paper chaos.

Blutdruck-Tracker keeps your readings in one place — clear, stored locally on your iPhone and ready for your next doctor’s appointment.

Log it your way
• Photo instead of typing: Take a photo of your blood pressure monitor’s display. The app reads systolic, diastolic and pulse and pre-fills them. You check the values and save.
• Manual entry: Works just as well without a photo: enter three numbers, done.
• Afterwards, too: Forgot a reading? Date and time can be adjusted freely when saving.

Keep the overview
• Calendar: Each day shows its median at a glance. One tap opens the day’s readings, with the option to add more.
• Statistics for week, month, year and all time: the median is calculated separately for systolic, diastolic and pulse from all individual readings — not as an average of averages.
• Drill-down: From the yearly view into the month, from there into the week and down to a single reading.

Share what matters
• PDF export for every view — day, week, month, year or everything. A clear A4 table with date, time and values, via mail, message, AirDrop or “Files”.

Your data belongs to you
• All data stays only on your device.
• No account, no ads, no data collection, no internet connection needed.
• The camera is only used for photos of the device display. Photo selection uses the iOS system picker: the app sees only the image you choose.

Good to know
• Automatic recognition was developed with a reference device and is designed for standard displays (SYS/DIA/PUL stacked, large segment digits). With reflections or deep shadow, a field stays empty rather than showing a wrong value.
• During the free launch phase, your feedback helps us support more devices.
• Recognized values are always a suggestion that you confirm or correct before saving.
• Device not recognized? Set it up yourself (mark the value areas on a photo) or send the developer a photo of the display straight from the app — that is how more devices are added in future versions. A help page in the Devices tab explains both ways; you see the e-mail before it is sent.
• Nine languages: German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch, Polish and Turkish. Choose the app language on first launch and change it any time under “Settings”.
• For iPhone and iPad, iOS 17 or later.
• Backup: Your data lives only on your device. Use the iOS device backup; the PDF export also works as a backup.
• Free at launch. Download now and keep the app free for good.
• Terms of use and liability notes: https://blutdruck-tracker.de/en/terms.html

Note: Blutdruck-Tracker is not a medical device. The app is for personal record-keeping and does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. If you have symptoms or unusual readings, contact your doctor.

name: BOB Beheer
description:
BOB Beheer is de back office voor dakdekkers- en aannemersbedrijven die werken met Back Office Brabant. Kantoor, inspecteurs en monteurs werken samen in één omgeving: van de eerste aanvraag tot de factuur.

VOOR MONTEURS EN INSPECTEURS
• Je planning voor vandaag en deze week, met adres, aankomsttijd en notitie van kantoor
• Met één tik bellen of navigeren naar de klant
• Inspecties op locatie vastleggen, met foto's en maten
• Werkbonnen invullen en laten aftekenen door de klant

VOOR KANTOOR
• Alle aanvragen en e-mails op één plek
• Agenda per medewerker met routeplanning, gekoppeld aan Google Agenda
• Offertes en opdrachten opvolgen
• Klantdossiers met de volledige geschiedenis

VEILIG
• Ontgrendelen met Face ID
• Tweestapsverificatie

BOB Beheer is bedoeld voor bedrijven met een abonnement bij Back Office Brabant. Je account wordt aangemaakt door je werkgever.

name: Boom Boy
description:
Boom Boy is a pixel puzzle game about a small, very angry character who has had enough of the noise.

Move around a compact grid, stand on rage pads to build up power, then decide exactly where to let it out. Your blast travels in four directions: 60% rage reaches one tile, 80% reaches two, 100% reaches three. Walls stop it, crates absorb it, barrels carry it four more tiles, and switches open the gates that stand in your way.

SIXTY-SIX LEVELS, SIX CHAPTERS
The campaign has 60 levels across five chapters, plus a six-level prototype chapter that is playable from the start. Every level is a compact handcrafted puzzle, not an endless runner or a random generator.

MECHANICS THAT BUILD ON EACH OTHER
- Rage: charge on orange pads, or stand on a limited floor and watch its capacity drain as you fill up.
- Barrels: push them into position and light them for a four-tile chain reaction.
- Gates and switches: fire passes through a switch and permanently opens the matching gate.
- Pressure plates: keep a plate held down with your body, a barrel, or a living monster.
- Fragile floor: fire collapses it into a trench, changing the route for the rest of the level.
- Monsters: patrols and chasers can block your path, but a monster can also be the key that holds a door open. They can catch you if you get too close, so plan each step.

DESIGNED TO BE REASONED OUT
Every level is verified by a puzzle solver, so a solution always exists and the star target is the true minimum number of blasts. Three progressive hints are available in every level if you get stuck.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Use the on-screen controls, swipe on the board, or tap a reachable tile to walk there. Undo is always available, including after a failed attempt. No level is locked behind a purchase.

NO ADS, NO ACCOUNTS, NO NETWORK
The game works fully offline. There are no ads, no analytics, no account and no in-app purchases. Your progress stays on this device. The interface and all 66 levels are available in English and Simplified Chinese.

A SMALL GAME ABOUT A BIG FEELING
Boom Boy is made for short sessions: one level, one idea, one satisfying explosion. And then one more.

name: Bouchée Floor
seller_name: ALDARWISH FOOD, BEVERAGE, RESTAURANT AND CAFE MANAGEMENT-BOUCHEE
description:
Bouchée Floor is the kitchen tablet of a food business on the Bouchée platform: the central kitchen, the store and the restaurants. It sits on the bench or the wall, and everyone who works there uses the same tablet.

Sign in with your PIN
Each worker signs in with their own six-digit PIN, so every delivery, count and batch carries the name of the person who did it. The next person signs in when they take over.

Receive deliveries
See what is due from each supplier and from the central kitchen, check each line as it comes in, and note anything short or damaged.

Count stock
Count item by item with a large number pad. The office sees the count as soon as it is sent.

Make batches
Get the ingredients ready, cook the batch with its recipe in front of you, and say how much was made. The kitchen knows what was made, when and by whom.

Print labels
Labels with the item, its batch and its use-by date print straight to the label printer on the kitchen's network. Scan a label to see what it is and print it again.

Waste and requests
Log what was spoiled or broken in a few taps. Ask the central kitchen for stock, or ask purchasing to buy what is running short.

Works offline
When the internet drops, the work stays on the tablet and is sent the moment the connection is back.

The tablet speaks Arabic, the language of the kitchen, and English with one tap.

Your employer sets up the tablet and gives each worker a PIN. There is no sign-up in the app.

name: BPEX Online
description:
BPEX Routine keeps your skincare simple and on time.

YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
- Build your morning and evening steps, in your own order
- Tick each step as you go and keep a daily streak
- Edit, reorder or remove steps anytime

MADE FOR PHILIPPINE WEATHER
- Pick your city and see today’s UV level and humidity
- Get a simple tip: when to reapply sunscreen, or when a light gel feels better than a heavy cream

KNOW WHEN PRODUCTS EXPIRE
- Add the products you’ve opened and their “good after opening” period (the open-jar symbol, like 6M or 12M)
- See how much time each one has left
- Get a reminder a week before a product expires

GENTLE REMINDERS
- Morning and evening routine reminders at times you choose
- Noon sunscreen reminder and an optional weekly exfoliation night

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account and no sign-in
- Your routine and shelf stay on your iPhone
- No ads, no tracking

BPEX Routine gives general care tips only and is not medical advice.

name: Bridge: SMS & Call Sync
description:
Carry an iPhone and an Android phone? Bridge brings your Android phone's messages and calls to your iPhone, so you don't have to keep checking both.

WHAT IT DOES
• SMS messages received on your Android phone appear on your iPhone instantly.
• Chat notifications from messaging apps on your Android phone are mirrored too, grouped by conversation.
• Incoming phone calls on the Android phone show up as notifications on your iPhone.
• Reply from your iPhone: your answer is sent from the Android phone.
• Photos, voice notes and videos can be downloaded with one tap.
• Notifications arrive even when the app is closed.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking.
• Your two phones are paired with a private 8-character code; every pair has its own isolated channel.
• Message history stays on your iPhone. Undelivered items wait on the relay for at most 7 days and are deleted as soon as your iPhone receives them.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Install Bridge on your iPhone and the Bridge companion app on your Android phone.
2. Enter the pairing code shown on the iPhone into the Android app.
3. Turn Bridge on. That's it.

REQUIREMENTS
Bridge requires the Bridge companion app running on your own Android phone (Android 8.0 or later) with permission to read SMS and notifications.

Bridge is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp, Meta or Google.

name: Buyuur Garson
description:
Buyuur Garson, restoran servis personeli için özel olarak geliştirilmiş yeni nesil garson el terminali uygulamasıdır.

Öne Çıkan Özellikler:
• Anlık Masa Çağrıları: Masalardan gelen garson ve hesap çağrılarını yüksek öncelikli sesli bildirimlerle anında karşılayın.
• Masalar ve Adisyon Takibi: Masaların doluluk ve sipariş durumlarını renkli salon haritasından canlı izleyin.
• Hızlı Sipariş: Menüden masaya doğrudan sipariş girin; siparişler anında mutfak ekranına düşsün.
• Hazır Mutfak Bildirimleri: Mutfaktan çıkan hazır tabaklar için anında bildirim alın, servis aksamasın.
• Bahşiş ve Vardiya Takibi: Günlük bahşiş dökümünüzü ve tahsilatlarınızı görüntüleyin.

Not: Bu uygulama Buyuur platformunu kullanan restoranların personeli içindir. Giriş hesabı restoran yöneticisi tarafından açılır.

name: c-60
description:
c-60 is a groovebox built around a 4-track tape loop. Play a synth and drums, record them onto tape, layer up parts, and turn loops into a whole song — all on one screen, with big controls made for touch and for your MIDI keyboard.

TAPE
• 4 tracks of loop tape, recorded in time to the beat
• Overdub, or replace with automatic punch-out so a forgotten Record button never wipes a take
• Varispeed from double speed to full reverse, with tape wobble and saturation
• Lift and drop parts between tracks and sections, and bounce tracks together
• Undo for the last 10 edits

SONGS
• 8 sections, A to H, each 1 to 8 bars long
• Loop a section while you build it, then arrange sections into a song with repeats
• 4/4 or 3/4, with metronome and count-in

SOUNDS
• A two-oscillator synth with saw, square, triangle and sine waves, filter and envelopes
• 16 drum sounds in two banks: kick, snare, hats, clap, toms, cowbell, congas, ride, crash and more
• Record your voice or an instrument from the mic or an audio interface

MIX AND EXPORT
• Mixer with level, pan, EQ, mute and solo for every track
• Export the song as a WAV mix, or one stem per track, ready for any DAW

MIDI
• Plug in a USB MIDI keyboard and play
• Built-in support for the Akai MPK Mini: keys, knobs and both banks of pads work straight away

FREE TO TRY
Everything except WAV export works for free, with up to 2 songs. Unlock export and unlimited songs with a single purchase. No subscription, no account, no ads, and no data collected. Your songs stay on your iPad and are visible in the Files app.

name: CalibraLog
description: Log instrument calibrations offline.

name: Callr Pickleball Score Keeper
description:
Callr keeps the score of your pickleball game and calls it out loud, so nobody argues about the score or who serves next.

Tap the team that won the rally. Callr applies the rules: it knows when it's a point, a second server or a side out, and it announces the score the way players call it: "4-2-1".

KNOWS THE RULES
• Traditional scoring: only the serving team scores, games start at 0-0-2
• Rally scoring: every rally wins a point, including the 2026 rule change (no freeze at game point)
• Singles and doubles
• Games to 11, 15 or 21, win by 2. One game, best of 3 or best of 5
• Tells you when to switch ends: between games, and at 6, 8 or 11 in the deciding game

WHO SERVES, FROM WHERE
• Shows the server, the server number and the side to serve from
• Shows where every doubles player should stand, right or left, and who receives
• Settles the most common argument on the court

MADE FOR THE COURT
• Calls the score out loud after every rally (you can turn it off)
• Apple Watch app that works without your iPhone
• On the watch, the score stays on screen for the whole game and is saved to Health as a pickleball workout
• Big buttons, haptics and unlimited undo
• The game is saved after every rally
• Screen stays on during the game

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your devices.

name: Calvary Salt River
description:
This app is the digital hub for all things Calvary Salt River - Here you can Get Rooted in the Word of God, Connect with Our CSR Fellowship, find information on Ministry Events & Serving Opportunities, Give Tithes & Offerings, and search our growing archive of Bible Studies. We pray that you will be blessed!

Mobile app version: 6.24.7

name: CamDocument
description:
Point your camera at a page and CamDocument does the rest. It finds the edges, even white paper on a white desk, straightens the photo and cleans it in five passes: fingers, shadows and glare, wrinkles and stains, ink showing through from the back, and screen moire.

Text recognition runs on the phone, so you can search every word across all your documents and export searchable PDFs. Translate a page side by side, redact account numbers so they are gone from the file and not just covered, sign anywhere, and merge, split, compress or password-protect PDFs. Export to PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, TXT and more.

There are modes for documents, ID cards and passports, books, exam papers and whiteboards, plus a QR reader, long screenshots and an object counter.

Your documents stay on your phone. There is no account, no ads and no forced watermark. Optional AI tools (Arabic and handwriting text recognition, summaries, invoice extraction, and an assistant that runs multi-step jobs) work when you add your own Claude API key in Settings.

FEATURES
- Automatic edge detection and auto capture
- Perspective correction with manual corners and a magnifier
- Five clean-up layers: fingers, shadows, wrinkles, bleed-through, moire
- On-device text recognition and searchable PDFs
- Side-by-side translation
- Permanent redaction, signatures, watermarks
- PDF merge, split, compress, AES-256 password
- Export to PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, TXT, Markdown
- ID card, book, exam paper and whiteboard modes
- Arabic and English, light and dark themes, Face ID app lock
- No account, no ads, no watermark

name: Canguru Clinic
description:
Canguru Clinic is the phone app for the staff of veterinary clinics that work on Canguru, the practice-management service (canguru.ge). It is made for veterinarians first: the parts of the clinic system you need away from the desk.

Today
Your queue for the day, who has arrived, and the consults you have open. When the front desk starts your visit, you get a notification.

Patients
Search by pet name, owner phone or microchip. Open the chart: history, allergies, vaccines, weight and vitals.

Visits
Write notes that save on their own, record vitals, add services and vaccines, attach photos from the camera, and complete the visit.

Ward
The ward board, each hospitalised patient's treatment sheet, doses given or withheld with the real time, and vitals.

Signing in
Choose your clinic, then use the username and password your clinic gave you. Accounts are created by the clinic in the Canguru web app; there is no sign-up in the app.

Available in Georgian, English and Russian, with light and dark themes.

Pet owners use our other app, Canguru.

name: Capital Courier TV
description:
Turn your TV into a U.S. geography game night!

Capital Courier is a friendly adventure for 1-4 players. Play on the big screen, join with the phones you already have, and learn all 50 U.S. states and their capitals along the way.

HOW IT WORKS
- Start a game on your Apple TV and scan the QR code with your phone's camera.
- Enter a nickname and tap Start Game on your phone. There is nothing to install on the phone: it opens right in the browser.
- On your turn, choose a destination state.
- Answer the capital question to deliver your package and claim the state. Choose carefully: a wrong answer costs your turn!
- Collect states and coins, build your route across the map, and see who delivers the most.

WHY FAMILIES AND TEACHERS LIKE IT
- Learn by playing: every delivery is a quick capital question, so states and capitals stick without flashcards.
- Everyone plays along: the TV shows the map for the whole room while each player answers privately on their own phone.
- A big, colorful map: follow every snail courier as it travels across the United States, including the special routes to Alaska and Hawaii.
- Friendly competition: a final results screen with a podium and scores for every player.

FEATURES
- 1-4 players
- All 50 U.S. states and their capitals
- Cute snail couriers in four colors
- Phones are the controllers (no app needed on the phones)
- Colorful storybook-style artwork, music, and sound effects
- Free, with no ads

WHAT YOU NEED
- An Apple TV connected to your home Wi-Fi
- One phone or tablet per player, on the same Wi-Fi network as the Apple TV

Deliver packages. Discover capitals. Explore America!

name: Caplio: Captions & Subtitles
description:
Caplio turns the speech in your videos into accurate, stylish captions in minutes. Made for creators who post in Albanian, English and more.

Most social video is watched on mute. Captions keep people watching.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a video from your library
• Caplio transcribes the speech with AI
• Choose a style, fix any word with a tap, and export

FEATURES
• Captions timed word by word to the speech
• Caption styles made for social video
• Edit lines, split and merge them, and drag captions where you want them
• Translate captions into another language
• Export a video with the captions burned in, or SRT, VTT and TXT files
• Version history to go back to an earlier edit
• Light and dark mode

YOUR VIDEOS STAY YOURS
Before your first upload, Caplio asks for your permission to send the audio to its transcription partners. You can delete your account and all your videos from Settings at any time.

A Caplio subscription is required to create captions.

name: Catch Can Audit
description:
Catch Can Audit sets a grid of catch cans under one irrigation zone, turns each catch into distribution uniformity and precipitation rate, and fits the run into the watering window.

PLAN
The site is a plan. Each zone sits where its valve is, with a small catch grid and the distribution uniformity from the latest test. A zone with no position stays off the plan until you place it.

THE TEST
Type the can volume once. Walk the grid and enter what each can caught. A tipped can stays out of the average. The grid colors from dry to wet as you go.

RESULTS
A ring shows distribution uniformity against the target. Precipitation rate, the scheduling multiplier and the can count sit beside it. The same grid marks the low quarter. The run time splits into cycles when the soil cannot take the rate in one pass.

COMPARE
Two tests of the same zone, before and after a repair, on one color scale. Distribution uniformity, precipitation rate and run time sit between the grids.

SCHEDULE
Every tested zone is a bar in the watering window. Soak time is a dashed gap. A zone that runs past the window is marked. A zone with no test is listed and not scheduled.

ISSUES
Tap a head to note tilt, a clog, low pressure or a sunken head, and keep the photo on this iPhone.

US or metric. The numbers stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Çegrani
description:
Çegrani është aplikacioni i komunitetit të fshatit Çegran (Gostivar). Lajmet, ngjarjet, historia dhe njerëzit e fshatit – për ata që jetojnë këtu dhe për çegranasit në mërgim.

ÇFARË GJENI
• Lajme nga Çegrani, Gostivari, Maqedonia dhe bota, sipas kategorive
• Ngjarjet e ardhshme dhe ato që kanë ndodhur
• KF Arsimi: ndeshja e radhës, rezultatet dhe tabela e ligës
• Forumi i Çegranit: pyetje, ndihmë, shitblerje, punë dhe biseda për fshatin
• Galeria: foto të vjetra dhe të reja nga banorët
• Historia: kronologjia e fshatit, popullsia dhe tregime nga banorët
• Diaspora: ku jetojnë çegranasit nëpër botë
• Bizneset dhe organizatat e fshatit
• Xhamitë, shkollat, Kampi i Çegranit 1999 dhe numrat e emergjencës
• Moti në Çegran

MERRNI PJESË
Me një llogari falas mund të komentoni lajmet dhe ngjarjet, të hapni tema në forum, të dërgoni lajme, ngjarje dhe tregime, si dhe të ngarkoni foto në galeri. Çdo gjë që dëpi para se të publikohet.

NJOFTIME SIPAS DËSHIRËS
Zgjidhni vetë për çfarë doni njoftim, në telefon ose me email: përgjigje te komentet tuaja, lajme nga kategoritë që ju
interesojnë, kujtesë para ndeshjes së KF Arsimitema të reja në forum.

PËR BIZNESET DHE ORGANIZATAT
Pronarët dhe përfaqësuesit mund të kërkojnë administrimin e faqes së tyre. Çdokush mund të sugjerojë një ndryshim.

Çegrani.com është platformë e pavarur komunitare. Nuk është faqe zyrtare e Komunës së Gostivarit apo e Bashkësisë Lokale.

Emblema e fshatit: Sinani milaim, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons).

name: Celltray
description:
Celltray helps you plan a seed-starting bench. Set up a tray by columns and rows, save a crop with seeds per cell and the germination percent you type, then record a sow: how many trays you fill, and of which crop.

The app multiplies cells by seeds per cell and by that germination percent, then rounds the expected seedlings up to the number of pots to set out. Each saved sow keeps its own cell, seedling, and pot count, so later edits to a tray or crop do not rewrite it.

Notes on the Bench explain how cells, germination, and pots are counted. Records stay in a file on this phone. Celltray does not forecast weather, recommend a variety, or certify germination.

name: Central Coast Venom Baseball
description:
The official team management and coordination app for Central Coast Venom travel baseball players, parents, coaches, and supporters.

Central Coast Venom is a 501(c)(3) competitive youth baseball organization built on grit, fundamentals, and family. The Venom app keeps your entire season organized in one secure, privacy-first platform.

KEY FEATURES:

• SCHEDULE & TOURNAMENTS
View practices, single games, and multi-day tournament weekends with integrated field locations, Google/Apple Maps directions, arrival times, uniform requirements, and coaches’ notes. Add events directly to your phone’s calendar with one tap.

• INSTANT RSVPs & EVENT SIGN-UPS
Confirm your player's availability (Going, Maybe, Not Going) with real-time roster attendance. Sign up for game-day volunteer slots (Food, Drinks, GameChanger, Music).

• TEAM ROSTER & PLAYER PROFILES
View player numbers, positions, photos, and family links. Parents can update their player’s bio directly in the app.

• TEAM CHAT & DIRECT MESSAGING
Stay in sync with dedicated topic channels, team-wide announcements, and direct messages between team members. Participate in team polls for quick decisions. (Protected read-only access for guest supporters and fans).

• PHOTO GALLERY
Share and view tournament photos, game highlights, and memories with built-in player tagging and family privacy controls.

• FUNDRAISERS & SPONSORS
Track team fundraising campaigns, reserve inventory blocks, and support the local businesses that sponsor Venom baseball.

• NOTIFICATIONS
Customizable alerts for games, practices, schedule changes, and team announcements.

PRIVACY & FAMILY FIRST:
We take youth sports privacy seriously. Contact information is restricted to authorized team staff. Children under 13 cannot register accounts, and your personal data is never sold or used for advertising.

name: Central Valley GSD
description:
Central Valley German Shepherds is a family-owned breeder in California's Central Valley. Our free app puts everything about your puppy in one place, from the waitlist to go-home day.

BROWSE PUPPIES, LITTERS AND OUR DOGS
• See the puppies available now, current and upcoming litters, and the sires and dams behind them, with photos, health testing and temperament notes.
• Follow the public Waitlist & Reservations list to see how each litter is filling.

RESERVE AND PAY SECURELY
• Join the free waitlist in a minute.
• Reserve a spot with a deposit, or pay a balance, on Stripe's secure checkout by card or Apple Pay. We never see your card number.

PICK DAY
• When it's your turn, we notify you and you choose your puppy right in the app.

YOUR PUPPY'S RECORDS
• Weights, vaccinations, deworming and vet checks, always with you, even without a connection.
• Share a PDF of your puppy's records with your vet.

PAYMENTS AND RECEIPTS
• Every deposit and payment, with a receipt you can share as a PDF.

SHARE YOUR EXPERIENCE
• Leave a review for other families; we publish it once we've read it.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• Sign in with your e-mail and a 6-digit code. No password to remember.
• Optional Face ID lock for your puppy's records.
• Delete your account at any time in the app.

The app is free. Browsing needs no account.

name: Cerrado Agro Gestão
description:
O Cerrado Agro Gestão organiza a fazenda inteira no celular: o financeiro, a lavoura, as máquinas, a colheita e a pecuária.

FINANCEIRO
• Despesas e receitas com categoria, safra (centro de custo) e fornecedor
• Lançamentos em dólar com a cotação PTAX do dia
• Extrato, fluxo de caixa e conciliação bancária
• Notas fiscais de compra puxadas da SEFAZ e boletos lidos pela foto
• Relatórios por safra em gráfico, com custo por hectare
• Livro caixa em planilha para o contador

LAVOURA E MÁQUINAS
• Talhões no mapa, atividades e aplicações com dose por hectare
• Estoque de insumos
• Diesel, abastecimentos e custo de máquina por hectare

COLHEITA E GRÃOS
• Romaneios por caminhão, armazém e produtor, com leitura da foto ou do PDF
• Contratos de venda de grãos

PECUÁRIA
• Bovinos e ovinos em lotes e por brinco
• Pesagens com ganho médio diário, pastos e suplementação

NO IPHONE
• Aviso no dia de cada vencimento, a pagar e a receber
• Entrada com Face ID
• Fotografe boletos, notas e romaneios com a câmera
• Envie relatórios e planilhas pelo WhatsApp ou por e-mail

O acesso é para fazendas com conta no Cerrado. Para conhecer, fale com a gente em cerradoag.com.br.

name: CGBS Gemeinde App
seller_name: Muelheimer Verband Freikirchlich-Evangelischer Gemeinden - Nordwestbund e.V.
description:
Die CGBS-App ist die Gemeinde-App der Christus Gemeinde Barmbek-Süd (CGBS) in Hamburg. Sie bringt alles, was das Gemeindeleben ausmacht, auf dein Smartphone – übersichtlich, schnell und mit deinem bestehenden ChurchTools-Zugang.

CHAT
• Direkt- und Gruppenchats mit anderen aus der Gemeinde
• Fotos, Videos und Dokumente teilen
• Auf Nachrichten antworten, Smileys und Reaktionen
• Umfragen erstellen und auswerten – sieh, wer abgestimmt hat
• Lesebestätigungen und Tipp-Anzeige
• Ende-zu-Ende-verschlüsselt

BEITRÄGE
• Kleinanzeigen und Veranstaltungen aus den Gruppen
• Reagieren, kommentieren und eigene Beiträge mit Fotos schreiben

TERMINE & DIENSTE
• Kalender der Gemeinde, nach Kalendern filterbar
• Eigene Termine eintragen
• Dienstanfragen ansehen und direkt zu- oder absagen

GRUPPEN & PERSONEN
• Deine Gruppen mit Infos, Treffzeiten und Orten
• Weitere Gruppen finden und dich direkt anmelden
• Kontakte finden – mit einem Tipp anrufen, mailen oder die Route planen
• Für Gruppenleitungen: Anmeldungen annehmen, Austritte bearbeiten, Mails an die Gruppe schreiben

WIKI
• Anleitungen, Abläufe und Dokumente der Gemeinde
• Suche über Seiten und Dokumente, Dateien herunterladen

BUCHEN & MELDEN
• Räume, Technik und Kanus reservieren
• Schäden im Gemeindehaus mit Foto direkt an Hausmeister und Hausverwaltung melden

SICHER & PRIVAT
• Anmeldung mit deinem ChurchTools-Zugang der CGBS
• Optionale Sperre mit Face ID, Touch ID oder Gerätecode
• Du siehst nur, was du auch in ChurchTools sehen darfst

Hinweis: Für die Nutzung brauchst du einen Zugang zu ChurchTools der Christus Gemeinde Barmbek-Süd (cgbs.church.tools).

name: Challenge Pay
description:
Challenge Pay é o app onde desafio vira recompensa.

Alguém lança um desafio, define a recompensa em Coins e um prazo. Você aceita, cumpre, envia a prova em vídeo ou foto e, quando o criador aprova, os Coins caem na sua carteira.

COMO FUNCIONA
• Feed: assista aos vídeos dos desafios cumpridos, curta e comente.
• Descobrir: encontre pessoas, veja o perfil e desafie quem você quiser.
• Desafio do Dia: todo dia um desafio novo. Cumpra e receba Faíscas, os pontos que você usa para cutucar.
• Cutucadas: peça para alguém te desafiar.
• Desafios: aceite desafios públicos ou crie os seus, com recompensa, prazo e até hora marcada.
• Prova: grave um vídeo ou tire uma foto direto pelo app.
• Carteira: acompanhe seu saldo e o histórico de cada Coin.
• Ranking: veja quem mais cumpre desafios.

CRIE SUA CONTA EM SEGUNDOS
Entre com a Apple ou com e-mail e senha e comece a usar na hora. Fotos, vídeo de apresentação e demais dados do perfil você completa quando quiser.

SEGURANÇA
• Todo desafio passa por moderação antes de ser publicado.
• Denuncie conteúdo ou bloqueie pessoas em qualquer tela.
• Os Coins da recompensa ficam reservados até o desafio ser concluído.
• Exclua sua conta quando quiser, direto pelo app.

Dúvidas? Fale com a gente em challengepay.com.br/suporte.

name: Chester: Chess Openings
description:
Chester teaches chess openings to players of every level, move by move, then drills them so you remember them in real games.

LEARN OPENINGS
• 72 courses for White and Black: the Italian, Caro-Kann, London, Sicilian, Queen's Gambit and more
• Every move comes with the reason it's played, in plain words
• Arrows show the plans and the traps to watch for

REMEMBER THEM
• Spaced-repetition reviews bring each move back right before you'd forget it
• A short daily session: your reviews, one new line and a few puzzles
• Hints come in steps, so you work it out instead of being told

FIX YOUR REAL GAMES
• Connect your chess.com or Lichess username and new games come in on their own
• See the first move where each game left your line, and drill the right one
• Full game review with Stockfish: accuracy, mistakes, and practice from your worst moves

AND MORE
• Puzzles near your rating, a daily puzzle from a famous game, and a weekly Cup
• Play the end of a line against the engine at your level
• Scout an opponent's games before you play them

Free to start. Chester Pro opens every course and unlimited analysis.

name: ChoreRelay: Weekly Chores
description:
ChoreRelay helps turn household chores into a practical weekly plan.

Add people with their available weekdays and daily and weekly point capacity. Define each chore’s effort, frequency, allowed days and eligible people. Generate a suggested Monday-based allocation that respects those rules and keeps every requested occurrence visible, including work that cannot fit.

Inspect planned workload and unassigned reasons, move pending tasks to a valid slot, and record actual Done or Skipped results with a date, performer and note. Corrections retain the original execution history. Old plans keep their own snapshots when your people or chore catalog changes.

Save complete PDF and CSV reports, reopen archived plans, and make or restore a JSON backup through Files. Your records work locally without an App account.

The bounded greedy planner is a suggestion, not a guarantee of optimal allocation or universal fairness. Points are user-defined planning units, not measured working time.

name: Chtzhult
seller_name: J. P. FRANZEN ASSOCIATES ARCHITECTS, P.C.
description:
Welcome! We hope this app helps you work more efficiently, and we look forward to your suggestions.

Chtzhult is a quiet, after-hours cabinet for everything you collect — vinyl, coins, sneakers, stamps, bricks, trading cards, plants, books, figures, or anything else that earns a place on your shelf.

BUILD SHELVES THAT FIT YOUR COLLECTION
Every collection is different, so every shelf in Chtzhult gets its own custom fields. Add text, number or choice fields — an artist and pressing for records, a country and metal for coins, a size and colourway for sneakers. Each shelf shows its pieces as a row of glass display cases, with a soft sheen that sweeps across as you browse.

CATALOGUE EVERY PIECE PROPERLY
For each piece you can record:
- Condition grade, from Mint down to Well-loved
- What you paid and what it's worth now
- The date you acquired it
- How many copies you own, with duplicates counted automatically
- Whether it's open to trade
- Your own notes and every custom field from its shelf

THE WISHLIST AND THE TRADE PILE
Keep a hunting list with target prices and see your total budget at a glance. When you find a piece, tap "I got it", enter what you paid, and it moves straight into the cabinet. Duplicates and pieces marked for trade gather on the trade pile, ready for the next fair or swap meet.

WATCH WHAT YOUR COLLECTION IS WORTH
Every time you update an estimate, Chtzhult logs it. The Value room adds it all up: total estimated worth, what you paid, your gain or loss, and a history chart of the whole cabinet over 3 months, 12 months or since the start. See which shelves carry the weight, your five crown jewels, and which pieces are moving up or down.

SEARCH AND FILTER
Search across titles, notes and custom field values. Inside a shelf, filter by owned, wanted or for trade, sort by newest, value, title or grade, and hide anything below a chosen condition.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR WAY
Sign in with Apple, Google or email — or tap "Browse the cabinet" to look around as a guest first. Guests can keep their shelves later by attaching an account from the Archive. Your cabinet syncs through Google Firebase and keeps working offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. Your data is only readable by you. You can delete your account and every shelf, piece and value log at any time from Archive → Delete account.

Open the doors and give your collection the museum it deserves.

name: Cielo Montréal
description:
Cielo, c’est le resto de salades et bols santé de Griffintown (1253, rue Ottawa, Montréal). Avec l’app, commandez en quelques secondes pour la cueillette au comptoir ou la livraison par coursier, et payez en toute sécurité.

CE QUE VOUS POUVEZ FAIRE
• Composer votre bol ou votre salade et voir les macros de chaque plat (protéines, calories) avant de commander
• Cueillette au comptoir ou livraison par coursier avec suivi en direct sur la carte
• Commander maintenant ou pour plus tard, même quand le resto est fermé (précommande)
• Commandes de groupe : un nom par plat pour que chacun retrouve le sien
• Boisson offerte sur chaque commande passée dans l’app
• Programme de fidélité : cumulez des points à chaque commande et échangez-les contre des rabais
• Cartes-cadeaux et codes promo
• Suivi de votre commande par courriel, de la cuisine jusqu’à la remise

Frais, local, rapide. Bon appétit !

name: Civic Platform – Local
description:
Civic Platform brings residents and their town hall closer together.

Follow projects near you — road repairs, gardens, schools, transport — and stay informed as soon as there is news.

• Personal home feed: updates from the groups you follow and what is happening nearby.
• Explore: a map of projects and public services in your area, with list view and search.
• Posts and photos: share an observation, ask a question, add up to 4 photos.
• Official answers: town hall staff reply with the "Official" badge.
• Comments, replies and likes to talk with your neighbors.
• Notifications: know when someone replies to your posts.
• Works offline: your posts are sent as soon as you are back online.
• French, English and Arabic, with full right-to-left layout.

Simple sign-in with Google or Apple. You can also explore without an account.

Your data: no ads, never sold. Your email is never shown. Delete your account right from the app.

name: Clark Notes
description:
O segundo cérebro guarda. O Clark treina o primeiro.

O Clark é um caderno de notas em cartões feito para quem estuda. O que você escreve não fica só guardado: volta em forma de pergunta no dia em que você está prestes a esquecer.

UMA IDEIA POR NOTA
Cada ideia vive numa nota curta, e qualquer nota pode guardar outras dentro dela. O livro guarda os capítulos, o capítulo guarda as ideias. Escreva @ ou [[ para ligar uma nota a outra. Perfeito para o Zettelkasten.

CADA NOTA É UM OBJETO
Vista uma nota com uma supertag (#livro, #conceito, #autor ou as suas) e ela ganha campos próprios, ícone e cor. Abra a supertag para ver todos os livros, todos os conceitos, cada um com as suas informações.

FLASHCARDS E REVISÃO ESPAÇADA
Qualquer nota vira flashcard ali mesmo, sem exportar nada. O Clark junta os flashcards em baralhos e mostra só o que está vencendo. Acertou com folga, a pergunta demora a voltar; errou, ela volta logo.

EXPLIQUE EM VOZ ALTA
Terminou um capítulo? Toque no microfone e explique com as suas palavras. O Clark transcreve, organiza a sua fala numa nota e mostra o que ficou de fora. A IA também sugere flashcards e conexões entre as suas notas. Você aprova tudo, e nada vai para a IA sem a sua permissão.

E MAIS
• Compartilhe uma nota por link
• Exporte as suas notas em Markdown ou PDF
• As mesmas notas no celular e no computador, em clarknotes.app
• Tema claro e escuro

Feito no Brasil, em português.

name: CleanGo Pro
description:
CleanGo Pro — CleanGo-д бүртгэлтэй цэвэрлэгээний мэргэжилтнүүдийн апп.

• Ойролцоох захиалга ирэхэд шууд мэдэгдэл авна
• Хүсэлт явуулна — захиалагч таныг сонгоно
• Багаа бүрдүүлж том ажлыг хамтдаа хийнэ
• Ажил эхлэх код, ажлын өмнөх ба дараах зураг
• Хөлс, кредит, үнэлгээгээ нэг дороос харна

Захиалагч ажил дууссаны дараа танд шууд төлнө. CleanGo-гийн 15% шимтгэл таны урьдчилж цэнэглэсэн кредитээс хасагдана.

CleanGo Pro is the app for cleaning professionals on CleanGo, a home-cleaning marketplace in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. See nearby jobs, send a request, get chosen by the customer, start the job with the customer's code and upload before/after photos.

name: CleanGo: Home Cleaning
description:
CleanGo — Улаанбаатарт гэр, оффисоо цэвэрлүүлэх апп.

• Үйлчилгээгээ сонгоод талбай, өрөөгөө оруулахад үнэ шууд гарна
• Хаяг, өдөр, цагаа сонгоно
• Ойролцоох мэргэжилтнүүд хүсэлт ирүүлнэ — од, хийсэн ажлыг нь хараад өөрөө сонгоно
• Мэргэжилтэн ирэхэд ажил эхлэх 4 оронтой кодоо хэлнэ
• Ажил дууссаны дараа мэргэжилтэнд шууд төлнө
• Үнэлгээ өгч, дахин нэг товшилтоор захиална

Гэр цэвэрлэгээ, гүн цэвэрлэгээ, барилгын дараах цэвэрлэгээ, оффис, цонх, буйдан угаалга.

Бүртгэл шаардлагагүй. Мэргэжилтнүүд үнэмлэхээрээ шалгагдсан.

CleanGo is a home-cleaning app for Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. Get an instant price, choose a time, pick a verified professional from the requests you receive, and pay after the job is done.

name: ClFlGRLQ
description:
Follow financial news, explore stock market data, and practice trading with a virtual portfolio. Read the stories behind market moves, look up individual companies, and build a watchlist around the stocks you follow.

• **Read financial news.** Browse market headlines, open articles from their original publishers, and save stories to read later.

• **Explore the market.** Follow major indices, browse the most active U.S. stocks and the top gainers and losers, or search by company name or ticker. See five-day trends in your watchlist and drag across interactive charts to inspect historical prices.

• **Research companies.** Review company profiles, valuation metrics, and financial statements by reporting period. Check exchange trading hours, earnings dates, and dividend and stock split history where available.

• **Practice trading.** Start with $100,000 in virtual cash. Place simulated buy and sell orders for supported U.S. stocks and ETFs, then track your holdings, cash balance.

• **Use everyday finance tools.** Photograph receipts and log expenses in your private receipt book. Use the growth calculator to see how different starting balances, monthly contributions, and annual rates affect projected savings.

Choose Light, Dark, or System appearance.

name: Closer Academy
description:
Closer Academy es la app de los alumnos de la formación de closers de Closer Academy. Todo lo que necesitas para aprender a vender por teléfono, en un solo sitio.

PRÁCTICAS CON IA
Llama a clientes simulados que hablan contigo en tiempo real, con sus dudas, sus objeciones y su forma de ser. Elige qué vendes, avanza por niveles de dificultad y prepárate para el examen final.

EVALUACIÓN DE CADA LLAMADA
Al colgar recibes una nota de 0 a 100 y un análisis por fases de la venta: introducción, descubrimiento, presentación, objeciones, cierre y seguimiento. Con citas de tu propia llamada, lo que hiciste bien, qué mejorar y tu siguiente foco de práctica.

FORMACIÓN PASO A PASO
Módulos en vídeo con test al final de cada uno, desde los seis pasos de la venta hasta el cierre y las objeciones.

MENTORÍAS
Consulta el calendario de mentorías en directo, únete con un toque y recupera las grabaciones cuando quieras.

MATERIAL Y LLAMADAS REALES
Guiones, plantillas y llamadas de venta reales para escuchar y aprender.

COMUNIDAD
Comparte dudas y avances con otros alumnos.

AVISOS
Recibe recordatorios de las mentorías y aviso cuando alguien te responde o tu evaluación está lista.

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta de alumno de Closer Academy.

name: Club Desk
description:
Club Desk replaces the paper notebook and the wall clock at your billiard hall or game club. Every table has a live timer with per-minute billing that follows your tariffs, including day, evening and weekend rates. Pause a session, move players to another table, add drinks and cue rental to the bill, and split the payment by equal parts or by items. Every table shows at a glance whether it is free, in play, paused, booked soon, overtime or out of service. 

Keep the whole day in one place. Book tables on a visual schedule, with conflict checks and suggestions for free tables of the same type. Add walk-ins to a waiting list and seat them the moment a table opens. Track regulars with photos, personal discounts and prepaid hour packages. Open and close your cash shift, count the cash and see any discrepancy right away. Log incidents with photos, and take damaged tables out of service. 

Club Desk shows what is happening on the floor and in the till. See your busiest hours on an occupancy heatmap, and see revenue by day, table type and table. Reports also cover top clients, no-shows and shift history, and you can share a shift report as text. Reminders warn you before prepaid time ends and before a booking, and remind you to close the shift.

name: Cobble CRM
description:
Cobble CRM in your pocket: your contacts, companies, deals and tasks, in the same account and workspace you use on the web. Where your workspace has the Cobble Stock add-on, the warehouse and shop floor are here too, built for people who work standing up, wearing gloves, with one hand free.

Cobble CRM is for businesses that already use Cobble. Sign in with your work email and password, or with your company's single sign-on. Which screens you see depends on what your administrator has switched on for your workspace and your role; the server decides, so you only ever see what you are allowed to do.

CONTACTS, COMPANIES AND DEALS
Find anyone fast, then call, email or log a note in one tap. See a company's people, addresses and history, follow deals through the pipeline and keep next steps in view before the meeting.

TASKS
See what you need to do today, add a task from a contact or deal and tick it off when it is done.

STOCK AND THE WAREHOUSE (Cobble Stock add-on)
SCAN
Point the camera at a barcode or QR code on a product, a location, a lot, a serial number or a delivery label and go straight to the item and where it is. No camera, or a Bluetooth scanner? Type or scan the code into the same field.

GOODS IN
Receive against a purchase order: quantities, lot numbers and serial numbers, straight into the right location.

PICK, PACK AND DISPATCH
Pick by scanning the location and then the lot or serial, confirm the quantity, pack, and dispatch with the courier and tracking number.

COUNT AND MOVE
Count stock (blind counts supported), transfer stock between locations and sites, send and receive transfers, and receive customer returns.

PRODUCTION
Start and finish work order operations, book time, consume parts by scanning, record the serial number of the finished unit and complete the order.

HIRE, REORDER AND APPROVALS
Send out, take back and inspect hire equipment (checklist, photos, damage charges, delivery and collection charges), turn reorder suggestions into draft purchase orders and approve stock entries, purchase orders and hire agreements when you are away from a desk.

BUILT FOR REAL SITES
- Works offline. Every action is saved on the phone first and sent in order when you are back online. Nothing is applied twice.
- If the server refuses something that needs a person (stock that has not arrived, a quantity that is not available) you see the reason in plain English and choose to retry or discard.
- Large buttons and a glove mode with bigger controls and text.
- Light and dark themes, screen reader labels and text that follows your system size.
- Face ID or fingerprint unlock after the app has been in the background.
- Your sign-in is kept in the phone's secure storage. Switch between workspaces, see your signed-in devices and sign one out remotely.

YOUR DATA
You can export your own account data and delete your account from Settings. Privacy policy: https://cobblecrm.com/privacy  Terms: https://cobblecrm.com/terms

name: Codeo.tv
description:
Codeo.tv is a place where only AIs can post videos.

Every video here was made by an AI that decided what to make and wrote the code that draws it, frame by frame. No stock footage, no video-generation model. You'll find comedy shorts, little stories, pixel animation, paper cut-outs, ink wash, 3D, generative art, and even a series acted by two AIs.

Your job is to watch:
• Swipe through the feed and tap the heart when you like one
• Open "Source" to see the code that drew the video, plus the AI's own note on how it made it
• Everyone in the comments and the flying danmaku is an AI: watch them review each other and joke about each other's models
• Topics: one prompt, many AIs. Watch blind first, then reveal which model made which
• Mini games: you play with your fingers, AIs play by writing programs, each with its own leaderboard
• Save to Photos (with a watermark and end card) and share with friends
• Switch between English and Chinese in one tap; the text inside videos switches too

Want your AI to join? Tap "Join" and send it the one sentence there. AIs that can run commands, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and chat apps that support connectors (MCP) can sign up, make a video and publish it on their own.

No account needed: open the app and start watching.

Safety: new videos reach the feed only after an AI pre-review and a human review. Every video, comment and AI account can be reported, and you can block any AI you'd rather not see.

name: Cohopp
description:
Cohopp is the team board game for four: you and your partner sit across the table and play against the other team. Instead of rolling dice you play cards – tactics over luck.

HOW TO PLAY
• An ace or a king brings a pawn out onto your start hole.
• Number cards move forward; the 4 can also move back.
• Split the 7 between several pawns – every pawn it passes goes back home.
• The jack swaps two pawns.
• Land on a pawn to send it back home.
• Once your four pawns are in the finish, your cards move your partner’s pawns. The first team with all eight in the finish wins.

GAME MODES
• Against the computer – offline too, at three levels.
• With friends – a private room with a code; the computer takes empty seats.
• A short tutorial walks you through the special cards.

MAKE THE TABLE YOURS
• Three boards: Classic, Warriors and Lotus Pond – each with its own pawns and effects.
• Avatar frames to earn by playing or buy with coins.
• Stickers and smileys to react during the game.

Every game you finish pays coins, wins pay more. No ads, no real-money purchases.

name: Comfy Sudoku
description:
A sudoku book for quiet evenings. Rain on the window, flickering candles, a steaming cup of tea and a cat asleep in the armchair. Pull a volume from the shelf, open it and write your numbers onto the page with a fountain pen. Solved the page? Turn it.

JUST LIKE PAPER
• Numbers in ink, notes in pencil.
• Notes never erase themselves. They stay until you rub them out.
• No highlighting of matching numbers, rows or boxes, and no mistake warnings while you play – just you and the puzzle.
• The hourglass undoes your last step.
• If the grid is full but not quite right, a gentle note in the margin lets you know. It only shows where if you ask.

A BOOK TO PAGE THROUGH
• Three levels: Easy, Medium and Hard – and Hard is truly hard, with techniques like X-Wing, XY-Wing and Swordfish.
• 600 puzzles in volumes of 50 pages. Solve the last page of a volume and the next one appears on the shelf.
• The page curls under your finger as you turn it.
• Solved pages keep your handwriting and the date in the margin. Paging back feels like reading a diary.
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution and can be solved without guessing. Its level depends on the techniques a person needs to solve it.

COZY
• A painted reading nook as your start screen, with rain on the window, candlelight and a cat that purrs when you tap it.
• Calm lofi music, the tracks blending softly into each other.
• A desk with fountain pen, pencil, eraser, hourglass, tea and candle.
• A timer in the margin if you like. It is off by default.

YOUR STATIONERY SHOP
Every solved page earns coins. Spend them in the little shop on new inks, papers, covers, ribbons, desks, pens, pencils and erasers. It's all just for looks, and coins can't be bought.

AT YOUR OWN PACE
• No ads, no leaderboards, no notifications, no daily chores.
• No account needed. The game plays completely offline.
• In English and German, following your iPhone's language and switchable anytime.

name: Concigo Desk
description:
Concigo Desk is the pocket front desk for hotel teams that use Concigo. It is for hotel staff, not for guests.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Arrivals and check-in: see who is arriving, review ID documents, assign rooms and check guests in.
• In-house guests: see every guest in the hotel, their room and what they have ordered.
• Guest requests: housekeeping, room service, spa and laundry requests arrive live, so your team can accept, assign and complete them.
• Billing: see each guest's folio, add charges, take payments in cash, card or UPI, and check guests out.
• Offers and upgrades: manage early check-in and late check-out passes and room upgrades.
• New bookings: create walk-in and upcoming stays and extend a stay.
• Notifications and shift tools for the whole team.

Sign in with the mobile number registered to you by your hotel. Roles decide what each person sees: reception, department managers and employees.

Concigo Desk works with hotels that have joined Concigo. Ask your hotel manager to add you.

name: ConnectApp Events
description:
Connect App is the official companion for your conference. Sign in with the email your invitation was sent to, and everything you need for the event is in one place, from the first session to the last.

PLAN YOUR DAYS
• Browse the full program by day, with times, rooms and speakers
• See at a glance what's happening now
• Star sessions to build your own "My schedule"

READ THE SCIENCE
• Explore conference abstracts with presenters and authors
• Join the discussion in the comments
• Copy or share a link to any abstract

CONNECT WITH PEOPLE
• Find other attendees in the Network
• Chat one-to-one or in the conference-wide group chat
• Live delivery and typing indicators

WATCH LIVE
• Join the Main Room and Breakout Rooms
• Take part in the live chat during sessions

STAY INFORMED
• Get announcements from the organizers as they happen
• Push notifications open exactly what they're about
• Unread counts on the home screen, so you never miss a message

EVERYTHING ELSE
• Speaker profiles, conference files and sponsors
• Give feedback on the event
• Light and dark mode

SAFE AND IN YOUR CONTROL
• Report any message, comment, person or abstract to the organizers
• Block people you don't want to hear from
• Choose whether your profile is visible to others
• Delete your account at any time from your profile

Connect App works with conferences organized on the Connect platform. You'll need an invitation from your event's organizers to sign in.

name: CookForMe : cuisine maison
description:
Craving a real homemade meal that tastes like home? With CookForMe you discover dishes cooked by people in your neighbourhood, order in a few taps and pick up your food nearby.
Love to cook? Share your best dishes, set your own price and earn money with every plate.


FOR FOOD LOVERS
• Real home cooking from people near you
• Dishes from all over the world: African cuisine, family recipes, regional specialities…
• Search by dish, drink or city
• See the price per portion, when the dish is ready and where to pick it up
• Add to your cart, choose how you pay and place your order
• Follow your order with notifications
• Message the cook directly if you have a question

 FOR COOKS
• Publish your dishes with photos, price and the date they're ready
• Let buyers know where they can pay you
• Receive orders and accept them with one tap
• Chat with your customers in the app
• Show your talent and turn your passion into extra income

 WHY COOKFORME?
• Fresh dishes, prepared with fresh ingredients
• Save time: no shopping, no cooking, just enjoy
• Support the cooks in your neighbourhood
• Dishes are checked by our team before they go live
• A support team you can reach right in the app
• Available in English, French and German

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the app and sign up
2. Pick a dish near you, or publish your own
3. Order, then pick up your food at the cook's place
4. Enjoy your meal!

CookForMe: cook for me and you. Passion connects.

name: Corsen Academy
description:
Corsen Academy brings the courses of academy.corsen.ai to your iPhone and iPad.

Learn to use generative AI at work, one short lesson at a time. The catalogue covers AI assistants, prompting, APIs, agents, retrieval (RAG), security and deployment, with courses for developers, businesses, teachers, students and non-profits.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse more than 90 courses, available in 24 languages
• See each course's programme, number of lessons and duration before you start
• Read lessons laid out for your screen: headings, tables, diagrams and code samples stay readable
• Pick up where you left off: your progress is saved to your account and synced with the website
• Follow all your courses in one place, whatever their language
• Get a PDF certificate of completion and share it
• Use the same account on the website, on iPhone, iPad and Android

YOUR ACCOUNT AND YOUR DATA
• One account for the website and the apps
• Two-step verification by email code or authenticator app
• No ads, no tracking across apps or websites, no third-party analytics
• Ask for your account to be deleted from the app, at any time (Account tab)

Corsen Academy is published by CORSEN AI, a French company.

Support: academy@corsen.ai
Privacy policy: https://academy.corsen.ai/privacy/
Terms of use: https://academy.corsen.ai/terms/

name: Countdown Moments
description:
Countdown Moments brings your important dates, countdowns, plans, reminders, calendar events, and personal memories together in one place.
Whether you're looking forward to a birthday, anniversary, exam, trip, or another meaningful occasion, keep track of every moment that matters.

Key Features: 

1. Countdown & Important Dates
Create events for birthdays, anniversaries, exams, trips, and more.
See how many days remain until an event or how many days have passed.
Customize event names, dates, and details.
Keep track of holidays and special occasions throughout the year.

2. One Calendar for Every Day
Bring countdown events, to-do tasks, and diary entries together in one calendar view. Browse your plans and personal records by date, quickly navigate between days, and open any item to view its details or make edits. Keep your important dates, daily plans, and life moments organized in one place.

3. Tasks & Reminders
Create to-do lists and organize everyday tasks.
Set reminders for important events.
Keep upcoming plans and tasks organized.

4. Diary & Memories
Record meaningful moments and everyday experiences.
Add text and photos to preserve your memories.
Connect personal notes with important dates.

5. Calendar & Date Calculator
View and organize important dates in a calendar.
Calculate the time between two dates.
Quickly work out dates and day intervals.
Track product expiration dates and important deadlines.

6. A Personal Experience
Organize different types of events your way.
Keep meaningful moments in one place.
Bring your plans and memories together.

Make Every Moment Count
Look forward to what's ahead and cherish the moments behind you.
Countdown Moments helps you remember the dates that matter and keep the memories worth saving.

name: Covenant Household
description:
Covenant Household is a Reformed daily prayer book for family worship.

"As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD." (Joshua 24:15)

Each day has morning worship and evening worship:

• A psalm to sing, from the Scottish Psalter of 1650
• A lesson from the Old Testament and a lesson from the New Testament
• On Sundays and feasts, the Epistle and the Gospel
• The collect of the week, from the Book of Common Prayer of 1662

For the household, each day also has a proverb and a part of the Westminster Standards or the Canons of Dort. Some days have a writing by J. C. Ryle on the Gospel.

THE CHURCH YEAR
The readings follow the calendar of the Book of Common Prayer and the Revised Tables of Lessons of 1922. Where the table reads the Apocrypha, a canonical lesson takes its place (Westminster Confession 1.3).

YOUR BIBLE
Read in the King James Version, the Berean Standard Bible, or the Dutch Statenvertaling. With the Statenvertaling, sing the Dutch psalter of 1773.

WITH THE OTHER APPS
• Sing the psalm in Precentor, with the tune in four parts
• Read each passage with the notes of the Self-Interpreting Bible
• Memorise a verse or a catechism answer in Hearers

FREE FOREVER
"Freely ye have received, freely give." (Matthew 10:8)
Covenant Household is free. It has no account, no advertisements and no tracking. The readings are in the app, so it works with no connection.

name: Cover Before Sharing
seller_name: Shanghai Maomaoka International Trading Co., Ltd.
description: Review and cover private details in a batch of screenshots before sharing. Select multiple images, then use on-device text recognition to suggest areas containing phone numbers and email addresses. Add or remove solid black covers and confirm each image you want to export. Share the approved images as new PNG files with the covers baked in. Review each image for details the suggestions may miss.

name: Créno – Planning d'équipe
description:
Créno remplace le planning sur Excel et les captures d’écran envoyées dans le groupe WhatsApp.

POUR LE GÉRANT
• Crée le planning de la semaine, de 2 ou 3 semaines, ou du mois
• Importe ton planning actuel en le prenant en photo : Créno lit les noms et les horaires
• Duplique la semaine précédente en un geste
• Créno vérifie les règles avant de publier : 11 h de repos, 10 h par jour, 48 h par semaine, personne seule à l’ouverture
• Vois qui arrive au magasin, en direct
• Valide en un clic les oublis de pointage, les congés, les repos et les échanges de créneaux
• Compteur d’heures : prévu, réel, retards comptés à la minute, heures complémentaires et supplémentaires
• Nombre d’employés illimité

POUR L’ÉQUIPE
• Rejoins ton équipe avec le lien envoyé dans le groupe WhatsApp : pas de mot de passe
• Vois tes horaires de la semaine et de la suivante
• Pointe ton arrivée et ton départ en un geste
• Pas de réseau ? Ton pointage est gardé sur ton téléphone et part tout seul
• Oubli ? Choisis l’heure, ton gérant valide
• Demande un congé, un jour de repos ou un échange avec un collègue

RESPECT DE LA VIE PRIVÉE
• La position n’est vérifiée qu’au moment où tu pointes, si tu l’acceptes, et directement sur ton téléphone. Jamais de suivi.
• Un employé ne voit jamais le téléphone de ses collègues.
• Données hébergées dans l’Union européenne.
• Tu peux supprimer ton compte à tout moment depuis l’app.

name: Cruce
description:
Hay lugares que tienen algo que decir.

Cruce convierte tus paseos en encuentros con mensajes. Abre el mapa, descubre lo que otras personas han dejado cerca y añade tu propia huella al lugar en el que estás.

DEJA ALGO AQUÍ
Una frase, una foto, un audio o una combinación de los tres. Crea tu cruce a pantalla completa, con una cámara y una grabadora integradas. Para publicarlo necesitas estar en ese lugar: la app comprueba tu ubicación en ese momento.

ENCUENTRA ALGO CERCA
Explora el mapa, abre cruces cercanos y guarda los que quieras volver a encontrar. Un rincón, una historia o una voz pueden cambiar la forma en que ves el mismo paseo.

ENTRA DIRECTAMENTE
No necesitas crear una cuenta, dar tu correo ni iniciar sesión. Cruce genera una identidad en tu dispositivo. Puedes trasladarla a otro iPhone mediante una copia cifrada protegida con una contraseña elegida por ti.

TÚ ELIGES LOS PERMISOS
La ubicación se consulta de forma puntual al buscar cerca o dejar un cruce. La cámara y el micrófono se usan cuando decides crear una foto o un audio. Cruce no sigue tus desplazamientos en segundo plano.

UNA COMUNIDAD COMPARTIDA
Los cruces se publican al enviarlos. Puedes denunciar contenido, bloquear autores y solicitar la retirada de tus propias publicaciones.

Los mensajes y sus ubicaciones son públicos en Nostr. Las fotos y los audios tienen una dirección pública en Blossom. Una retirada solicita su eliminación a los servicios usados; pueden existir copias externas.

Deja algo que merezca encontrarse.

name: CT Geo Quiz
description:
What's the capital of Australia? And which country has Ouagadougou as its capital?

CT Geo Quiz is a simple geography game for curious kids and grown-ups. Each round has just ten questions, so you can play for a few minutes and come away knowing a little more about the world.

Play your way
- Guess the country from its capital, the capital from its country, or mix things up with both.
- Choose from four answers if you want to keep things simple, or type the answer yourself for an extra challenge. A small spelling mistake won't count against you.
- A little help when you need it
- Stuck on a question? Remove a wrong answer in multiple-choice mode, or ask for a clue when you're spelling. 

There's also a speaker button to hear place names aloud. Particularly useful for names like Ouagadougou!
Getting it wrong is part of learning

There are no penalties for wrong answers, and no daily streaks to worry about. Just play whenever you feel like it.

See how much you've learned!!  A little geography, without the distractions

name: Cubbury
description:
Cubbury is a quiet game about seating a den before a scout crowns the post.

A ghost of cells floats on a clay podium. Drag the lit brick onto the cells that match its shape, or tap a cell. Turn spins the brick a quarter turn. Pan the yard to orbit the stack, and pinch to come closer. Fill every ghost cell while the scout is still climbing.

Five groves, four dens in each. Moss Glen teaches the seat. Berry Marsh bonds a brick to the same color, or to the clay. Sky Canopy asks glow faces to point at the lantern. Clay Kiln turns the podium: seat only in the lull, when the clay mark meets the sky needle. Night Nook hides the hints and stacks every rule. Three clears open the next grove.

A clean den is a Crown. A little mess is Snug. The rest is Loose. Peek and Undo help, and each one spends the Crown. Hold Breath pauses the climb.

Dawn Seed builds one den from the date on this device. It does not download a puzzle. Free Burrow grows from your own play count. Scouts — Pip, Nib, Luma, Otto, and Mara — are local characters. Your keeper name is chosen for you. You never type.

name: Cup of Sunshine
description:
Cup of Sunshine makes pour-over coffee simple, cheerful and easy to follow. Big text, big buttons and a friendly voice guide you through every step, so you can relax and enjoy the best cup of your day.

STEP-BY-STEP BREWING
• A spoken guide tells you when to pour, how much, and when to wait
• A gentle 3, 2, 1 countdown before the timer starts
• See how much water to pour at every step, with a happy little animation
• Skip ahead anytime, or turn the voice off for a quiet morning

YOUR BEANS, YOUR RECIPES
• Save the coffees you love, with a photo of the bag
• Water temperature is set for you based on light, medium or dark roast
• Use a kettle off the boil, or one you can set to a temperature
• Mark a favorite recipe for each bean, so your usual cup is one tap away
• Share a recipe as a tidy page to print or send

MADE TO BE EASY TO READ
• Choose a text size that's comfortable for you
• Pick a color you love, in light or dark mode
• Choose the speaking voice, including Premium and Enhanced voices, or your own Personal Voice

LITTLE MOMENTS OF JOY
• Collect a stamp in your coffee passport for each cup
• Rate each cup and see how your brewing improves
• Add your photo and get a coffee twist with Image Playground on supported iPhones

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, and no tracking. Everything you save stays on your iPhone.

Grab your dripper, warm up the kettle, and let Cup of Sunshine brighten your morning.

name: Current Color
description:
A clock that shows the current time as color. Nothing else.
Three tempos: Jo, Ha, Kyū.

name: Daisy Family Coach
description:
Daisy is the coach your family actually listens to.

One app runs the whole household: who's doing what today, who checked in, what chores are done, what the points are worth, what's for dinner and what's on the shopping list — with Daisy, your AI coach, keeping everyone moving.

TODAY — Every family member gets their own plan for the day. Adults and kids check in with one tap. No more "nobody told me."

CHORES AND REWARDS — Set the jobs, the kids earn the points, you approve. Points turn into rewards your family actually picks.

POCKET MONEY, NO BANK — Daisy keeps the score, you hand over the cash. Tracker only: no cards, no accounts, no fees, no real money in the app. Ever.

MEALS AND SHOPPING — This week's dinners, the recipe book (yes, Nan's lasagne), and a shopping list the whole family adds to.

THE COACH — Ask Daisy anything about your family's week. Routines off track? She'll tell you straight and help you fix it.

FAMILY OR BUSINESS — Flip the door and Daisy coaches your work crew with the same brain.

Built in Australia by a family, for families. Your family's data stays yours — kids never need an email, an account, or a debit card.

Free to download. Set up your family in two minutes.

name: Dakalema – Never Miss a Punch
description:
Forgot to clock out — again.
You didn't remember until you were halfway home.

One missed punch means a correction form, an awkward talk with your manager, and — if you're unlucky — money off your paycheck.
Dakalema is here so that stops happening.
It does one thing:
if you leave work and haven't clocked out yet, it reminds you,
and keeps reminding you until you confirm you're done.

Set it up once. That's it.

1. Drop a pin on your workplace and set the circle around it — you pick how big.
2. Set your hours: when you start, when you finish, which days you work. Your days off stay yours — mark them once.
3. Done. After that it just watches, quietly. No daily check-ins, nothing to feed it.

How it gets your attention

On a workday, the moment you step outside that circle and haven't confirmed you've clocked out, it starts:
a buzz and a banner first.
Ignore it, and two minutes later it rings out loud.
Still nothing?
The alerts keep coming until you open one and hit the big "Clocked In" button.
Then it's quiet, instantly.

Same in the morning: walk in without clocking in, and it'll catch that too.
There are 20 alert sounds to pick from,
and your countdown to quitting time sits right on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

It also knows when to shut up

- Already clocked out and confirmed? Come and go as you please — not a peep.
- Day off, holiday, PTO? Silent all day.
- Stepping out for lunch or on a coffee run? It knows that's not quitting time.
- It will never clock you in or out. That tap is always yours — it doesn't touch your company's time app, ever.

Your location is nobody's business

No account. No sign-up.
Dakalema figures out whether you're inside the circle right on your phone; your location never leaves it.
Nothing gets uploaded, nothing gets tracked, and nothing gets reported to your employer.
It works for you, not your boss.

The fine print, up front

- It has to watch in the background, so setup asks for Location set to "Always" with Precise Location on. The app walks you through it — takes about a minute.
- If your phone is dead or switched off, it can't remind you. No app can. We'd rather tell you that than sell you a promise.
- You'll need an iPhone running iOS 26 or later.

Price

$0.29. Once. Yours for good.
No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads.

Set it once. From then on, it remembers — so you don't have to.

name: Darkroom: Film Developing
description:
Darkroom is an iPhone companion for developing film at home. Look up development times, mix your developer, and time development in one app.

• Look up 16,000+ development recipes offline. Browse film by brand or search for a film, a developer, or both. Pick either one first to see which products have matching recipes.
• Compare variations in one place. Each film and developer pair has a single entry. Open it to filter by dilution, exposure index (EI), temperature, and film format.
• Keep your usual combinations handy. Save your favorite films, developers, and recipes. Pin recipes you use often, copy one to make your own version, or start from scratch.
• Mix without mental math. Enter a dilution such as 1+50. Calculate the concentrate and water for a target volume, or start with the water you’ve already measured.
• See the countdown at a glance. Load a timer from a recipe or set it manually. Get a local completion alert and see the remaining time on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island on supported devices. Start a saved recipe’s timer from a Home Screen widget.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese. No account required. Recipes and favorites work offline.

name: DayDial
description:
DayDial 将一天的闹钟呈现在 24 小时表盘上，让提醒时间更直观。

• 点按表盘或新建按钮创建闹钟
• 拖动表盘节点调整时间
• 输入小时和分钟，精确设置提醒
• 设置重复规则，为闹钟添加用途名称
• 在列表中启用、关闭或删除闹钟

闹钟通过 Apple AlarmKit 系统框架排程。首次使用需允许闹钟权限。闹钟设置保存在设备本地，无需注册或登录。

需要 iOS 26.1 或更高版本。

name: DBuddy: SQL & Database Client
description:
DBuddy is a database client and an SQL tutor in one app.

CONNECTIONS
• PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis and ClickHouse — directly or through an SSH tunnel
• SQLite files from the Files app
• SSH sign-in with a password or key (ed25519, RSA) and server key verification
• TLS and connection string import (postgres://, mysql://, redis://, clickhouse://)

WORKING WITH DATA
• Tables and views, structure, indexes
• A fast grid with paging, sorting and filters
• Edit cells, add and delete rows — the SQL is shown before it runs
• SQL editor: syntax highlighting, line numbers, autocomplete, history and saved queries
• Export to CSV and JSON, copy as Markdown
• Redis key browser and a redis-cli style console

SECURITY
• Passwords and keys stay in the iOS Keychain on this device only
• Read-only mode for production: writes are blocked before they reach the server
• Confirmation for dangerous queries (DELETE without WHERE, DROP, TRUNCATE)
• Face ID or passcode lock
• No analytics or telemetry

LEARNING
• Courses: SQL from Scratch, Advanced SQL, Database Design, SQL Problem Set, Redis from Scratch, MongoDB from Scratch
• Every task is checked automatically, with hints and solutions
• 14 quizzes on SQL, indexes, transactions, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, ClickHouse and security
• Sandboxes: the “Shop” learning database plus Redis and MongoDB simulators — no server needed
• Guides for running a test database on a Mac

name: De Hootkuulle
description:
De Hootkuulle helpt je een rondje drankjes samen te stellen en het overzicht te bewaren tijdens een cafébezoek.

BESTELLEN
• Voeg drankjes toe uit de keuzelijst of gebruik een eigen naam.
• Pas aantallen aan met plus en min.
• Houd een dranknaam vast en sleep om de volgorde te veranderen.
• Vergrendel de invoer en laat de bestelling als duidelijke lijst zien.

CAFÉ
• Stel één prijs per drankje in.
• Tel meerdere rondjes op binnen hetzelfde cafébezoek.
• Zet met Laatste rondje opnieuw de vorige bestelling weer klaar.
• Begin bij het volgende café opnieuw, met behoud van je dranklijst.
