Je gegevens blijven op je iPhone. Geen account, advertenties of tracking. Een internetverbinding is voor het gebruik niet nodig.

De app houdt alleen aantallen en bedragen bij. Je plaatst of betaalt hiermee geen bestelling bij een café.

name: DefIntotheWild
description:
Your DefIntoTheWild roadbooks on the road: GPS track, offline trail map and detailed sheets, waypoint after waypoint.

DefIntoTheWild is the reader app for DefIntoTheWild 4x4 and overland roadbooks: Italy, France, Spain, Morocco. Sign in to your account and find the roadbooks you already own.

ON THE TRAIL
• GPS track: follow your roadbook’s route on a map made for off-road travel, with trails graded by difficulty, relief and contour lines.
• Dashboard: your live position, speed, altitude and a compass, with the map north up or facing your direction of travel.
• Offline: save the map along the track before you leave, then everything works without a signal, in the mountains or in the desert.

THE ROADBOOK IN YOUR POCKET
• Detailed sheets: the complete roadbook, with wild camps, fuel stations and points of caution.
• Map and roadbook linked: tap a waypoint on the map to open its sheet, tap the sheet to go back to the map.
• Drive there: Google Maps guides you to the start of the track or to a waypoint.

ALWAYS UP TO DATE
• Reports: trail closed or washed out? Send a photo and your position, and the team updates the roadbook.
• App in 13 languages, light or dark theme, on phone and tablet.

The app is not a store: it gives access to the roadbooks you already own. A DefIntoTheWild account is required; you can delete it from the app.

Enjoy the road with DefIntoTheWild!

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Relief: Copernicus.

name: Dela.bg – деловодна система
description:
Dela.bg е деловодната система на българската адвокатска кантора. Приложението Ви дава достъп до работата на кантората навсякъде – с профила, с който влизате и в уеб приложението.

КАКВО МОЖЕТЕ ДА ПРАВИТЕ
• Начало – заседанията, събитията и сроковете за следващите 7 дни и последните активности по делата от ЕПЕП и ПРБ.
• Дела – търсене, вкл. по номер на дело; по всяко дело: страни, отговорници, активности от съда, заседания, документи, бележки, задачи и отработено време, връзка към ЕПЕП.
• Документи – отваряте, споделяте и четете текста им; качвате нови – снимка с камерата, от снимките или файл.
• Отработено време – таймер, който продължава и при затворено приложение, и записи за работа по дела.
• Задачи – седмичното табло на кантората: бързо добавяне, завършване, преместване по дни и с влачене, запис за работа, тип, отговорник, продължителност; списък с просрочените.
• Календар – заседания, събития и срокове в един списък по дни, с добавяне в календара на телефона.
• Контакти – създаване и редакция, обаждане, съобщение, имейл и карта с едно докосване, запис в контактите на телефона.
• Известия – новите документи и актове от ЕПЕП, както в уеб приложението.
• Без връзка – последно заредените данни остават достъпни.

Приложението е за екипа на кантората. Вход – с имейл и парола от Dela.bg; двустепенната защита се поддържа. Фактурите, финансите, ЕПЕП настройките и AI асистентът са в уеб приложението на Dela.bg.

IN ENGLISH
Dela.bg is the case management system for Bulgarian law firms. The app gives the firm's team access to their work on the go, with the same account they use on the web: cases with their parties, hearings, court activity and documents; uploading documents from the camera, photos or files; the firm's task board; a calendar of hearings, events and deadlines; contacts; time tracking with a timer; notifications about new court documents. The last loaded data stays available offline. The interface is in Bulgarian.

name: DemirSoft BarProBulut
description:
**DemirSoft BarProBulut – Cloud-Based Barcode Point-of-Sale (POS) System**

DemirSoft BarProBulut is a modern, cloud-based barcode point-of-sale and business management application designed to help businesses easily manage their sales, inventory, cash register, and daily operations.

Whether you are in your store or away from your business, you can manage your sales and operational tasks from your phone or tablet via an internet connection.

**KEY FEATURES**

**Barcode-Based Sales**
- Quick product selection via barcode
- Creating and tracking sales
- Recording cash and card payments

**Product and Inventory Management**
- Adding and editing products
- Tracking stock levels
- Managing product prices

**Cash Register Management**
- Viewing daily sales and cash register activity
- Tracking cash inflows and outflows
- Reviewing payment records

**Reporting and Analysis**
- Viewing daily sales reports
- Monitoring sales performance
- Analyzing business data

**Cloud-Based Access**
- Accessing data via an internet connection
- Interface compatible with iPhone and iPad
- Notification screen for internet connection interruptions
- Automatic retry once the connection is restored

**WHO IS IT FOR?**

Grocery stores, retail shops, points of sale, and any business that utilizes a barcode-based sales system.

Manage your business’s sales and inventory processes more systematically, quickly, and efficiently with DemirSoft BarProBulut.

**DemirSoft Software**
Modern software solutions for your business.

name: Denki KY – KY危険予知
description:
Denki KY は、電気工事の現場で使うKY（危険予知）活動表を、話すだけで作れるアプリです。

■ 話すだけでKY活動表
マイクをタップして「2階天井裏で脚立を使ってVVF配線」のように今日の作業を話すと、約10秒で次の内容ができあがります。
・作業内容
・危険のポイント（「〜ので、〜して〜になる」の形で3つ）
・それぞれの対策
・本日の行動目標
・指差呼称（「開き止め ヨシ！」など）

■ 外国人スタッフにも伝わる
すべての文にふりがなとポルトガル語訳が付きます。ポルトガル語で話しても、日本語のKY活動表ができます。

■ チームですぐ共有
できたKY活動表はコピーやLINE・メールでそのまま共有。履歴にも保存されます。

■ Apple Watch対応
文字盤のコンプリケーションをタップして話すだけ。電気工事のちょっとした疑問にも短く答えます。KY活動表はiPhoneの履歴に送られます。

■ プライバシー
音声も質問も、当社サーバーには保存しません。ログイン不要。履歴はお使いの端末の中だけに保存されます。

■ ご注意
KY活動表と回答はAIによる提案です。必ずKYミーティングでチームと確認し、法令・社内ルールに従って現場で確認してください。
無料版は1日20回までご利用いただけます。

開発：衛藤電設株式会社

name: DePokerface
description:
DePokerface is a free imposter party game for 3 to 10 friends on one phone, with a twist: the phone plays too.

Pass the phone around. Everyone holds a thumb down to peek at the secret word, except the imposter, who has to bluff. Say one word each, point on three, and find the liar.

Then the Detective makes its call. While you peeked, the front camera watched for tells: a smile, a raised brow, a pressed lip, a glance away. The Detective accuses whoever reacted most differently from the group and plays the evidence in slow motion. Sometimes it's spooky. Sometimes it's hilariously wrong. Keep a poker face and beat it.

• One phone, no account, no setup: add names and play in seconds
• New players learn inside the first round, one line at a time
• 12 word packs, about 1,400 words, plus seasonal packs
• Our words: your group's inside jokes as a private pack
• Unlock new modes by playing: Two imposters, Blind imposter, Detective's revenge
• A 6-second replay clip of the Detective's call, saved only if everyone in it says OK
• Own phones mode: each player peeks on their own phone, on the same Wi-Fi or nearby
• English, Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese, each with its own word lists
• Play without the camera any time

Our promise
• Free. No ads, no paywall, no subscription, ever.
• No account and no sign-in.
• No analytics, ad or tracking SDKs.
• Works offline.
• Camera frames are analysed live on your phone and thrown away. No face templates, no identity matching, nothing kept after the round.

The Detective is entertainment only: it is guessing, not detecting lies.

name: Dictaphone AI Decode
description:
Dictaphone AI Decode connects to your Bluetooth voice recorder, downloads your recordings and turns them into text, entirely on your iPhone.

• 100% offline: no internet needed, nothing is uploaded.
• Private by design: your audio and text never leave your phone.
• On-device AI speech recognition in Russian and English.
• For your security, a recording is deleted from the dictaphone once it has been transcribed; the text stays on your phone.
• Share transcripts anywhere.

Free. No accounts. No tracking. No ads.

WHICH DICTAPHONES ARE SUPPORTED

The app works only with certain types of dictaphones, and the list of supported devices is limited.

It is built for Bluetooth "AI card" voice recorders that use the FAMMIX AI Card protocol. It has been verified with a device that appears over Bluetooth as "FAMMIX AI Card" (firmware 0.1.2.0).

These recorders are sold under many different names, but often share the same hardware and protocol. In that case the app will work.

PLEASE READ BEFORE INSTALLING

Manufacturers of such devices change firmware and the protocol without notice or documentation. Therefore:

• the app may not work with your particular unit, even if it looks identical;
• compatibility depends on the production batch and firmware version;
• some firmware versions may work only partially (for example, the list of recordings is visible but audio cannot be downloaded).

If the app cannot find your recorder or download recordings, email mail@univerum.com with the model, the seller and the firmware version, and we will try to add support.

GOOD TO KNOW

• The minimum recording length is 10 seconds.
• While the dictaphone is recording, it does not share its recordings. Stop the recording first.
• Keep the app open while a recording is being transcribed.

REQUIREMENTS

• iPhone with iOS 16.4 or later
• about 1.5 GB of free space (the speech model is included in the app)
• a recent iPhone is recommended (iPhone 14 or newer, or a Pro model from iPhone 12 Pro): recognition runs entirely on the phone
• recognition languages: Russian and English

This app is not affiliated with the manufacturers or sellers of the recorders. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

name: Digital Workforce
description:
Digital Workforce puts your organisation's Digital Employees on your phone. They are the AI staff who run the front desk, the gate, the building office and more. Talk to them by voice or by chat, any time.

TALK TO YOUR DIGITAL EMPLOYEES
• Speak naturally, or type if you prefer. Each employee answers in their own voice.
• Ask anything: which facilities you can book and when, the status of a service request, the latest notices.

NEVER MISS THE GATE
• When a visitor arrives, your phone rings with an alert, even when the app is closed.
• See who is there and why, then let them in or turn them away with one tap.
• Requests that need your decision arrive as simple cards with clear buttons.

A PERSONAL ASSISTANT THAT LIVES ON YOUR PHONE
Everyone gets a Personal workplace, with no sign-in needed. Its assistant runs entirely on your iPhone, so it works with no internet and keeps what you say on the device.
• To-do lists: "Add milk, eggs and bread to groceries". Create, tick off and rename lists by talking.
• Reminders: "Remind me to call mom at 6".
• Calendar: "Lunch with Priya on Friday at 1" goes straight into your calendar.
• Email: it writes the email and opens your mail app, and you tap Send.
• Music and videos: it opens the song or video you ask for.
• Quick web answers when you are online.

ONE APP FOR EVERY WORKPLACE
• Join a workplace by scanning the QR code your administrator gives you.
• Sign in once with your email and password to restore every workplace you belong to.
• Switch between your apartment, your office and your Personal workplace in a tap.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS
• Invite people with a QR code, and disable or remove them.
• Set up lobby kiosks and the ads they show between visitors.

• The Personal Assistant is provided which runs on your phone, and its conversations never leave it.
• Workplace conversations are handled by your organisation's Digital Workforce server.
• You can delete your account from inside the app at any time.

The Digital Employees are available to people whose organisation uses Digital Workforce by DheeYantra. The Personal Assistant works for everyone. It needs a one-time download of about 530 MB, best done on Wi-Fi.

name: DineHarbor
description:
DineHarbor is a simple way to order from restaurants near you.

Open the app, choose your address or let it find where you are, and see the restaurants that deliver to you or that you can collect from. Every menu is the restaurant's own, with its real prices.

What it does
• Finds restaurants that deliver to your address or are close by, with the reason each one is shown
• Shows the restaurant's own menu with photos, sizes, extras and allergy information
• Order for delivery or collection, now or for later
• Follow your order live from accepted to delivered
• Save favourite restaurants and reorder in a few taps
• Sign in with an email code or a password, or order as a guest
• Tell us about a restaurant you want to see on DineHarbor

Your location is used only when you tap Use my location, to show restaurants near you. You can type an address instead.

Available in English, Arabic, Spanish and French.

Restaurants can join at dineharbor.com.

name: DivaKids: Детская одежда
description:
DivaKids — магазин детской одежды, которому родители доверяют с 2009 года. Нарядные платья, костюмы, футболки и комбинезоны теперь всегда под рукой: выбирайте, заказывайте и платите при получении.              

ПОКУПАТЬ ЛЕГКО
• Каталог с поиском, фильтрами и сортировкой
• Размеры с наличием: сразу видно, сколько осталось
• Избранное — сохраняйте понравившиеся вещи
• Отзывы и оценки других покупателей

ЗАКАЗ ЗА ПАРУ МИНУТ
• Оплата наличными при получении, без предоплаты
• Доставка по Узбекистану
• Адрес можно выбрать на карте и сохранить
• Менеджер позвонит и подтвердит заказ

ВСЁ ПОД КОНТРОЛЕМ
• Статус и история заказов в профиле
• Вход через Apple, Google или Telegram — без паролей
• Приложение на русском, узбекском и английском

Ждём вас и в наших магазинах в Ташкенте. Вопросы? Звоните или пишите в Telegram — мы на связи каждый день с 10:00 до 22:00.

name: Don't Wake the Boss
description:
It is 4:58 PM. The boss had a very big lunch and he is fast asleep at his desk. Your mission: tiptoe to the exit without waking him up.

Hold anywhere to sneak. Let go to freeze. If he looks up while you are moving, you are caught.

• 35 days across 5 offices: Head Office, Glass Tower, Startup Loft, The Majlis and Work From Home
• Every day brings something new: a robot vacuum, Hala from HR, a security camera, a karak spill, a falcon, a sandstorm, Uncle Saeed and his coffee, a cat called Mishmish, and a boss who fell asleep on a video call
• Grab salary coins, find hidden leave days, and get promoted from Intern all the way to CEO
• Weekly performance reviews from the boss himself
• The Office Shop: silent socks, karak to go, a decoy phone, caps, shades and more
• Endless Overtime mode: how many rooms can you escape?
• No ads. No accounts. Plays offline.

One tap to play. Hard to put down. Never wake the boss.

name: Donut Painting
description:
The Donut Painting app is the work app for Donut Painting's crew and office.

CREW TIME CLOCK
• Pick your job and clock in, with your location noted at clock-in and clock-out to confirm the jobsite
• Take a lunch or a break: the first 30 minutes of lunch are paid, then it switches to unpaid
• Change jobs during the day without clocking out
• See today's hours and your pay period's total
• Forgot to clock in or out, or spent part of the day at another job? Request a change and a crew lead or admin approves it
• A reminder if you're still clocked in late in the day

FOR CREW LEADS
• See who's on the clock right now, everyone's hours by pay period, and each job's crew schedule
• Approve or deny the crew's change requests

FOR THE OFFICE
• Bid sheets for exteriors, interiors, decks and fences
• Estimates, materials, crew schedules and work orders with Sherwin-Williams colors
• Each job's actual hours and labor cost against the estimate

The app is for Donut Painting staff; accounts are set up by the company.

name: DORI: Wedding Invites
description:
DORI is the wedding invitation that lives on your guests' phones.

For guests
• Open your family's personal invitation with the code from your WhatsApp message.
• Swipe a card for each function: Mehendi, Sangeet, Haldi, the Wedding and more, with the date, timing, venue and what to wear.
• Tap Directions to open the venue in Google Maps or Apple Maps.
• Stamp how many of you are coming to each function. Change it any time.
• See the photographers' albums in HD after each function, and save or share any photo.
• Add your own photos from your phone to the wedding albums.

For the couple and their families
• Add every family to the guest list, pick them from Contacts, and send each one a personal invite on WhatsApp.
• Watch replies come in as an exact headcount for every function.
• Separate links for the bride's side and the groom's side, so each family invites their own.
• Update a function's time or venue and every guest sees it straight away.
• Hide any guest photo from the albums.

Private by design
• Every wedding is private. Nothing opens without a personal invite code or the hosts' link.
• No ads, no tracking and no accounts.
• Photos are kept for 30 days after the last function, then deleted. The couple can ask to keep them longer.

Made for Indian weddings, in six regional styles: Gujarati, Marwadi, Punjabi, Maharashtrian, South Indian and Christian.

Your wedding is set up by the DORI team. Write to contact@dashovia.app to bring DORI to yours. Try a sample wedding with the code AARAV-VANYA.

name: DoTask: AI Teaching Assistant
description:
DoTask is an AI assistant for teachers and adult learners. It drafts grades and feedback for you to review, tutors you by voice, and helps you write. It uses Google Gemini with your own API key, which you can get free from Google AI Studio. There is no DoTask account, no subscription and no DoTask server.

TEACH
Works with Canvas LMS. Sign in to your school's Canvas through your browser, or explore the fictional Demo School with sample data first.
• Grading drafts: DoTask suggests rubric scores and feedback for a submission, following your rubric and your notes.
• You stay in charge: you review and edit each draft, then post it yourself, one student at a time. Nothing posts until you press the button with that student's name.
• Per-student history: each student's grades and comments are kept on your device and are never mixed between students.
• Grading prompts leave out student names.
• Drafts replies to submission comments, Inbox messages and discussions, and drafts announcements for your courses.

STUDY
• Take a photo of a page, upload a file (PDF, Word, text or images) or paste text.
• Ask for an explanation, a summary, a quiz, flashcards or a study plan.
• Live voice tutor: talk naturally, the way you would with a person. Turn on "Show my camera" and the tutor can see what your camera shows.
• The tutor explains and quizzes you so you learn the material yourself. It does not complete graded quizzes or exams for you.

WRITE
• Draft replies in any tone and any language.
• Translate and polish your own writing.
• Copy it, share it, or save it as a Word document.

YOUR KEY, YOUR DATA
• Uses Google Gemini with your own API key. A free key from Google AI Studio is enough to start. You can also connect an OpenAI-compatible provider you choose.
• Settings shows your usage and an estimated cost.
• Your settings, student history and drafts are stored only on your device. Your API key and Canvas sign-in are kept in the Keychain.
• DoTask asks your permission before it sends anything to the AI. Content is sent only when you use a feature, straight from your device to Google (or the provider you set up) and to your school's Canvas, over encrypted connections.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking. The developer receives none of your data.
• Back up through the share sheet, or delete your data in Settings.

GOOD TO KNOW
• On a free-tier Gemini key, Google may use what you send to improve its products, and people may review it. For student records, use a paid-tier key with billing turned on; a whole class usually costs a few cents. In the EEA, the UK and Switzerland, Google's terms require a paid-tier key.
• Use DoTask as your school's policies allow, including FERPA and other student-privacy rules.
• AI output is always a draft. Check it before you post or share it.
• DoTask is for adults 18 and over.
• Connecting a real Canvas needs a developer key that your school's Canvas administrator creates once. Our support page has the settings to send them.
• The microphone and camera are used only after you tap to start the voice tutor or take a photo. Everything else works without them.

DoTask is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Instructure (Canvas) or Google.

name: DREAMERS ATLAS: Set Prep
description:
DREAMERS ATLAS: SET PREP is the pocket side of DREAMERS ATLAS, the DJ library and performance platform from DREAMERS BY CLOVER.

YOUR MUSIC, ANALYSED ON YOUR IPHONE
Add WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3 or AAC files from Files, iCloud Drive or any storage app. ATLAS works out each track's BPM, musical key in Camelot notation, energy from 1 to 10 and a three-band waveform. It uses the same analysis maths as DREAMERS ATLAS on the computer, and it all runs on the phone. Nothing is uploaded.

SET PREP
Build sets and let ATLAS order them: a warm-up-to-peak journey, energy up, the smoothest harmonic chain, the key wheel or BPM. Between every two tracks you see the key move, the pitch change and the energy step, so you can spot a clash before you're in the booth.

MIXES WELL NEXT
Pick a track and ATLAS ranks what to play after it. Choose SMOOTH, LIFT or COOL DOWN and it scores key, tempo (half and double time too) and energy.

TWO DECKS
Two players like a pair of CDJs: spinning platters you can nudge, a scrolling waveform with the beat grid, CUE and PLAY, a tempo fader with key lock, SYNC that matches the tempo and lines up the beats, and a 3-band EQ, filter and fader on each channel with an equal-power crossfader. Turn the phone for the decks side by side with the mixer in the middle. Swipe a track in a set to load it and the next one, and AUTO MIX plays the transition: the next track starts on the bar and fades in over 8 to 64 bars.

TAKE IT TO THE COMPUTER
Export a set as an M3U playlist or as a DREAMERS ATLAS folder with the audio. The full app on the computer opens it with the order, BPM, key and energy.

THE FULL PLATFORM
4 and 6 decks, stems, Automix, recording, controller mapping and CDJ USB export are in DREAMERS ATLAS for Mac and Windows.

No account. No ads. No tracking. Copy-protected Apple Music songs can't be analysed.

name: Drillframe
description:
Slow it down. Loop the hard part. Mirror it. Nail it.

Drillframe is a practice player for anyone learning with video or music: dancers, musicians, athletes, singers and speakers. Record yourself or bring in a clip, then take it apart one section at a time until it's in your body.

RECORD OR IMPORT
• Record a practice clip with the camera, with sound.
• Import videos you choose from Photos, or videos and songs from Files.
• A demo drill is included so you can try every control straight away.

SLOW IT DOWN
Play at 0.25×, 0.5×, 0.75×, 1×, 1.25× or 1.5×. Music keeps its natural pitch when slowed.

LOOP THE HARD PART
Tap Set A at the start of a tricky section and Set B at the end. Drillframe repeats it until you stop. Turn any mark into a loop that runs to the next mark.

MIRROR AND STEP
• Mirror the picture to follow a teacher as if you were facing a studio mirror.
• Step frame by frame to check a landing, a grip or a bow stroke.
• Jump back or forward 5 seconds, or drag the timeline.

MARK AND NOTE
Drop named marks on key moments and jump straight back to them. Keep coach notes on every clip, and sort clips by Dance, Music, Sport, Speech or Other.

WATCH ON A TV
Send your clip to an Apple TV or AirPlay-ready TV from the player. Speed, loop and marks keep working from your iPhone.

PRACTICE WITH THE SCREEN OFF
Sound keeps playing when you lock your iPhone or switch apps. Pause, play and skip 5 seconds from the lock screen or Control Center.

COUNT-IN
An optional 3-2-1 countdown before playback gives you time to get in position.

SHARE AND SAVE
Share a clip, just the looped section, a single frame or your practice notes. Save a frame or a loop to Photos.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Practice time counts only while a clip is actually playing. See your last 7 and 30 days, your daily streak, a ten-week practice calendar, time by discipline and your most-practiced clips.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Drillframe has no servers: your clips, marks, notes and practice history stay on your iPhone.

name: Dure: Dualar ve Sureler
description:
Dure; günlük duaları, Kur'an-ı Kerim'i ve zikirmatiği tek bir sade uygulamada toplar. Her dua Arapça aslı, Türkçe okunuşu ve anlamıyla birlikte verilir.

TAMAMEN ÜCRETSİZ
• Dure Allah rızası için hazırlandı ve tamamen ücretsizdir
• Reklam, üyelik ve uygulama içi satın alma yoktur
• Hesap gerekmez, hiçbir veri toplanmaz

DUALAR
• 20 konuda 350'den fazla dua: sabah ve akşam, namaz, Kur'an'dan dualar, peygamber duaları, özel dualar, günlük hayat, uyku, yolculuk, şifa, sıkıntı ve kaygı, rızık, aile, tövbe, şükür, Ramazan ve hac, vefat ve tâziye ve daha fazlası
• Özel dualar: nazar, hacet ve hatim duası, Salât-ı Tefriciye ve Salât-ı Münciye; kaynağı ve hükmüyle
• Âyetü'l-Kürsî, Fâtiha, İhlâs, Felak ve Nâs gibi sık okunan sûreler
• Namaz duaları: Sübhâneke, Ettehiyyâtü, Salli–Bârik, Rabbenâ, Kunut ve namaz tesbihatı
• Her duada kaynak: Kur'an dualarında sûre ve âyet numarası, hadis dualarında eserin adı

KUR'AN-I KERİM
• 114 sûrenin tamamı: Arapça metin, Türkçe okunuş ve Diyanet Vakfı meali
• Âyet âyet kıraat (Mişârî Râşid el-Afâsî) ve Türkçe sesli meal; okunan âyet vurgulanır, ekran onu takip eder
• Sûreleri indirip internetsiz dinleme
• Kaldığınız sûre ve âyetten devam
• Arapça metin Tanzil mushaf metninden alınmış, Quran.com metniyle âyet âyet doğrulanmıştır

OKUMA
• Harekeli, büyük ve okunaklı Arapça; dört yazı tipi ve ayarlanabilir boyut
• Odak modu: yalnız Arapça ve anlam kalır
• Ezber modu: metni gizleyip ezberden okuyun, dokunup kontrol edin, ezberlediklerinizi işaretleyin
• Kur'an dualarında âyetin kıraatini ve mealini dinleme
• Belirli sayıda okunan dualar için dokunmalı tekrar sayacı
• Açık ve koyu görünüm, dört tema rengi

ZİKİRMATİK
• Büyük dokunma alanlı tesbih sayacı; ses ve titreşimle
• Namaz tesbihatı: 33 Sübhânallâh, 33 Elhamdülillâh, 33 Allâhü ekber adım adım
• Hazır zikirler: Lâ ilâhe illallâh, Estağfirullâh, Salavat, Lâ havle ve serbest sayım
• Hedef seçimi: 33, 99, 100 ya da serbest
• İstatistik: günlük hedef, seri, haftalık grafik ve hangi zikirden kaç tane çektiğiniz

SİZE ÖZEL
• Dua defterim: kendi dualarınızı yazın ve saklayın
• Listeler: "Sabah rutinim" gibi sıralı listeler oluşturun, baştan sona okuyun
• Kaydedilenler ve kaldığınız yerden devam
• Günün duası, sabah–akşam ve Cuma hatırlatmaları

HER YERDE
• Ana ekran ve kilit ekranı widget'ları: günün duası ve dokunmalı zikir sayacı
• Apple Watch'ta zikir sayacı
• iPad için üç sütunlu düzen
• Duayı desenli bir görsel olarak paylaşın: kare ya da hikâye boyutu, beş tema
• iCloud yedekleme: kaydedilenler, listeler, dua defteri, ezberler, zikir geçmişi ve ayarlar Apple hesabınızla eşitlenir; uygulamayı silip yeniden yükleseniz de geri gelir

GİZLİLİK
Dualar, Kur'an metni ve dua sesleri internetsiz çalışır; bir sûrenin sesi ilk dinlendiğinde bir kez iner, sonra o da internetsiz çalışır.

Kur'an metni ve Kur'an kaynaklı duaların Arapça metinleri Tanzil mushaf metninden alınmış ve doğrulanmıştır.

name: dusk bot
description:
dusk bot is your own team of AI bots, and this app puts them in your pocket.

Your bots run on your computer or server, where they do real work: read and answer email, book things, keep an eye on
your site, run your routines. This app is how you stay in touch with them when you are away from your desk.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Text any bot like a teammate and read its reply the moment it lands
- Put a few bots in one room and let them split the work
- Say yes or no when a bot asks before it does something that matters
- Get a notification when a bot finishes or needs you
- See your routines and switch them on or off
- Keep writing with no signal: messages wait and send once you are back
- Start a new bot from your phone

HOW IT WORKS
Pair the app once by scanning the code dusk bot shows on your computer, or sign in to your dusk bot account. From then on
your phone talks to your bots directly, or through an end-to-end encrypted link when you are away.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics
- Your chats stay with your bots, not on our servers
- Your pairing is kept in the iPhone Keychain

You choose which AI your bots use, on your computer. Before anything you write goes to an AI provider, the app tells you
who receives it and asks you first.

name: Dynasty Sports & Framing
description:
The Dynasty Sports & Framing app puts our shop on your iPhone. Shop authentic signed memorabilia, get Experience tickets to meet athletes in person, and turn on alerts for the teams you follow.

DYNASTY ATHLETE EXPERIENCES
Meet the athletes in person. See upcoming Experiences, choose your Experience ticket, and pick add-ons like inscriptions. Sign in before you check out, and your order and ticket pickup details show up right in the app.

SIGNED MEMORABILIA
• Shop signed jerseys, photos, helmets, balls and framed pieces from football, baseball, hockey, basketball and more
• Search by player, team or item, then sort and filter to find the right piece
• Your teams sit on the Home screen, one tap from their gear

YOUR TEAMS, YOUR ALERTS
• Pick the teams you follow, from local favorites to any team in the store
• Turn on alerts and get a heads up when an Experience, drop or restock lands for your teams
• Store-wide drops go to everyone with alerts on
• Turn alerts off anytime in the app

YOUR ORDERS
• Sign in to see your orders, including the ones you placed on our website
• Track your packages and see ticket pickup details right in your order

NO PASSWORD TO REMEMBER
Sign in with your email and a one-time code. It is the same account you use on our website.

SECURE CHECKOUT
Checkout is handled by Shopify, the same secure checkout as our website. Apple Pay and Shop Pay accepted.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
You can delete your account from the Account tab at any time.

VISIT US
Find us at Oxford Valley Mall in Langhorne, PA, Willow Grove Park Mall in Willow Grove, PA, and Northshore Mall in Peabody, MA. We also do custom framing, for everything from jerseys and sports photos to wedding dresses and diplomas.

Questions? Email us at info@shopdynastysports.com.

name: EFC Green Valley
seller_name: Evangelical Free Church of Green Valley Inc.
description:
This app will help you stay connected with the day-to-day life of EFC Green Valley. With this app, you can watch or listen to past sermons, stay updated with push notifications, read the Bible from anywhere, view our calendar of upcoming events, give securely, and more.

Mobile app version: 6.24.7

name: Elfventory
description:
Make Christmas magical with Elfventory, your personal Christmas gift planning and tracking companion!

From the first gift idea to the last wrapped present, Elfventory helps you organize your holiday shopping while keeping the fun and excitement of Christmas alive.

YOUR CHRISTMAS WORKSHOP

Watch your Christmas room come to life with wrapped presents beneath the tree, stockings by the fireplace, and a countdown to Christmas Day.

KEEP EVERY GIFT ORGANIZED

Create gift lists for family and friends. Track each present from Idea to Planned, Purchased, Wrapped, and Given. Add photos, prices, shopping links, and notes to keep everything together.

MANAGE CHRISTMAS BUDGETS

Set an overall Christmas budget and individual budgets for the people on your list. Track spending and see how much you have available.

SANTA'S GOOD LIST

Organize recipients, save their sizes and preferences, mark favorites, and celebrate completed Christmas shopping with festive badges.

REMEMBER WHERE YOU HID IT

Save hiding spots so you can remember where you tucked away those Christmas surprises.

CHRISTMAS MEMORIES, YEAR AFTER YEAR

Keep your previous Christmas gift records organized by year, making it easy to look back at gifts you've given.

YOUR CHRISTMAS PLANS, TOGETHER

Use Elfventory on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with automatic synchronization through your Apple iCloud account.

Keep your Christmas surprises organized, your budget under control, and the holiday spirit alive with Elfventory!

name: Elisa's Albanian School
description:
Elisa's Albanian School, in your pocket.

This is the app for members of Elisa's Albanian School: Elisa's A1 course, her weekly activities and the whole Library, made for iPhone and iPad.

LEARN WITH ELISA
• Short video lessons with live captions, then homework that corrects itself as you go
• A clear path, week by week, from your first word to real conversations
• Shadowing, real-life situations, culture films and Gheg & Tosk dialogues
• Zana helps you with any word, day or night

WATCH OFFLINE
• Save a lesson, a whole week or a film, like on Netflix
• No internet? The School still opens with everything you saved
• Do your homework on the plane: it's sent to the School when you're back online

STAY ON TRACK, CALMLY
• Gentle reminders when a new week opens and before activities with Elisa
• Never more than 2 a day, never at night, with soft sounds: a little bell, mountain, sea, flower, star and dawn

MADE FOR YOU
• Widgets for your home screen and lock screen
• Face ID, light and dark mode, 6 app icons
• Shqipëria: explore Albania and Kosovo, place by place
• Built for iPad too, with a sidebar and a full week view
• Book 1:1 lessons with Elisa right from the app

You need an active School membership to log in.

name: ELSA Moldova
description:
ELSA Moldova este aplicația oficială a Asociației Europene a Studenților la Drept din Moldova. Tot ce ține de viața ta în ELSA, într-un singur loc.

Pentru membri
• Legitimația de membru digitală, cu cod QR verificabil
• Portofel cu biletele, certificatele și pașaportul tău ELSA
• Înscrieri la evenimente, bilete cu QR și check-in la intrare
• Notificări despre evenimente, termene și decizii care te privesc
• Calendarul activităților și exportul în calendarul telefonului

Pentru studenți
• Evenimente, conferințe, concursuri și școli de vară
• Oportunități: stagii, burse, voluntariat
• Biblioteca juridică și documentele publice ale organizației
• Departamentele, facultățile și echipele ELSA Moldova
• Formularul de înscriere în ELSA

Verificare publică
• Verifică autenticitatea unui certificat, a unei legitimații sau a unui Board ID scanând codul QR

Pentru echipa de conducere
• Secțiune de administrare, după drepturile contului: evenimente, check-in, cereri, formulare, finanțe

Aplicația este disponibilă în română, engleză, rusă și franceză.

name: EMA7
description:
EMA7 is a global digital home for encountering Jesus, finding healing, growing in faith, connecting through prayer, and becoming part of the mission.

Created by Işık Abla Ministries, EMA7 brings biblical teaching, discipleship, prayer, encouragement, livestreams, testimonies, and opportunities to make a difference together in one place.

Whether you are discovering Jesus for the first time, beginning your walk with Christ, seeking healing and freedom, growing deeper in Scripture, or looking for ways to serve and reach others, EMA7 is designed to help you take your next step.

With EMA7, you can:
• Watch live broadcasts and biblical teaching
• Receive daily encouragement and devotionals
• Explore messages organized around what you need today
• Grow through discipleship resources and Bible-based teaching
• Submit prayer requests and connect with a praying community
• Hear powerful testimonies of lives transformed by Jesus
• Find resources for healing, freedom, identity, and spiritual growth
• Follow ministry updates and stories from around the world
• Partner with global Gospel outreach
• Access growing resources for multiple languages and nations

At the heart of EMA7 is a simple journey:
Encounter. Heal. Grow. Send.
Encounter Jesus.
Receive healing and restoration.
Grow as a disciple of Christ.
Then carry His hope to others.

Social media may introduce you to a message. EMA7 gives you a place to remain, grow, belong, pray, and become part of what God is doing around the world.

Welcome to EMA7.

Mobile app version: 6.24.7

name: Ember Beads
description:
Ember Beads is a workshop tool for makers who craft stone bracelets, especially lava stone bracelets scented with essential oil. Keep a stock of beads, cord, oils and packaging, with a weighted average price per piece that updates as you buy. Low-stock items turn red and go straight onto an automatic restock list, grouped by supplier. 

Design bracelets on a visual ring editor that sizes to any wrist from 13 to 22 cm. The app counts the beads, shows the length deviation and works out the cord you need. It calculates the true cost of each bracelet, including your time, and suggests a price. You also see the margin on every sales channel after commissions and fixed fees. For any design and size, it shows how many bracelets your stock can make and which material is the bottleneck. You can plan a batch and add any shortfall to your shopping list in one tap. 

Run the business side from the same place. Track custom orders with size, wishes, a reference photo and a deadline. Record sales across marketplaces, fairs, direct and social channels. At a fair, use the quick till to ring up sales with a tap. Insights show revenue, profit, top designs, popular sizes and how each fair paid off after costs. Your data stays on your device.

name: EnderPanel Remote
description:
EnderPanel runs Minecraft servers on your own computer, for free. This app is its remote control: everything you can do at the computer, you can now do from your phone.

Link once, by scanning a code
Open EnderPanel on your computer, go to Settings, then Devices, and pick A phone. Point this app's camera at the code on the screen. That's it. No account, no sign-up, no password.

See everything at a glance
Which servers are on, who is playing, and how the computer is doing.

Start and stop with one tap
Turn a server on before your friends get home, or off when everyone's done.

Watch and talk to your server
Read the console as it happens and send commands. Kick or ban a player who's causing trouble.

Get told when something happens
Turn on notifications to hear when a server stops, crashes, or someone joins. The words are locked on your computer and only your phone can unlock them.

Look after your worlds
Make a backup, change settings, add mods and plugins, and manage the files, all from your phone.

Works from anywhere
At home or away, your phone talks straight to your computer, end to end encrypted. Nothing about your servers is stored by us.

What you need
- A Mac, Windows or Linux computer running the free EnderPanel app from enderpanel.app.
- The computer has to be on for the app to reach it.

Free, with no ads, no accounts and no tracking.

EnderPanel is not an official Minecraft product. It is not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

name: EnerjiSən Partner
description:
EnerjiSən Partner is the checkout app for businesses that partner with the EnerjiSən employee benefits programme of Bahar Energy Operating Company (BEOC).

HOW IT WORKS
A BEOC employee shows their personal EnerjiSən QR code at your checkout. Scan it with EnerjiSən Partner, enter the purchase amount and select the discount — it is verified and recorded instantly. Each QR code is valid for a short time and can be used only once.

FEATURES
• Fast QR scanning with the device camera
• Automatic verification of the employee and the discount
• Purchase amount, discount and savings shown before confirming
• Activity with daily, weekly and monthly totals
• Store details, Azerbaijani and English, dark theme

WHO CAN USE IT
EnerjiSən Partner is for cashiers of BEOC partner businesses. Cashier accounts are created by BEOC; there is no public sign-up.

name: EsaRuta
description:
EsaRuta responde "¿qué bus me lleva allá?" en el Área Metropolitana de Barranquilla.

Marca tu origen y tu destino y mira qué rutas de bus pasan cerca de los dos puntos, cuánto cuesta el pasaje y por dónde va cada recorrido en el mapa. Cubre Barranquilla, Soledad, Malambo y Galapa.

• Busca por dirección o por el nombre de un lugar conocido: universidades, centros comerciales, terminales.
• Consulta rutas de bus colectivo (TPC), Transmetro e intermunicipales.
• Ve el valor del pasaje, en día ordinario y en domingos y festivos.
• Mira el trazado de cada ruta y la caminata hasta y desde el bus.
• En Transmetro, consulta las estaciones de cada ruta y los transbordos.

No tiene horarios ni promete tiempos de viaje u hora de llegada. Los recorridos pueden tener margen de error y se corrigen contra la fuente oficial.

Gratis.

name: Escudo: Ad & Pop-up Blocker
description:
Escudo keeps Safari calm. Ads, pop-ups, pop-unders and trackers stop before they load, and the page you came for stays put.

WHAT IT STOPS
• Ad servers and trackers, from EasyList and EasyPrivacy plus our own list
• Pop-ups and pop-unders that open without a real tap
• Invisible full-page layers that open an ad on your first tap
• Tabs that pop open onto ad networks
• Common ad boxes, hidden from the page
• New ads no list knows yet, spotted by how they look and act
• Scam pages: fake virus alerts, calendar spam and fake profile installs get a clear warning first

MADE FOR REAL LIFE
• Pause on any site that doesn't work with a blocker
• Report an ad: tap it, and it's gone from that site at once
• Control Center: a switch for every part, and a check that shows what's running on the page
• An AirPlay button on web videos, to send them to your TV
• Video controls on web videos: speed, skip 10 seconds, Picture in Picture and a sleep timer
• A video tools menu: a lag view, colours, and where the controls sit

PRIVATE
No account. No ads. No tracking. Escudo works inside Safari on your iPhone and never sends the pages you visit anywhere.

TURN IT ON
Settings → Apps → Safari → Extensions → Escudo. Turn it on and set All Websites to Allow.

Escudo works in Safari. It doesn't block ads inside other apps, or video ads that come from the same servers as the video.

Block lists include EasyList and EasyPrivacy by The EasyList authors (CC BY-SA 3.0).

name: Eternal Holy Bible: Offline
description:
Eternal Holy Bible is a daily reading companion: calm, beautiful and simple, made for reading and listening to the Word anywhere — even without internet.

THE COMPLETE BIBLE, OFFLINE
• The complete World English Bible (Old and New Testament)
• Works without a connection: reading, search, favorites and verse of the day
• Also available in Portuguese, Spanish, French and German

A VERSE FOR EVERY DAY
• A new verse every day, the same in the app and in the widgets
• Widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy
• Tap the verse to open the chapter

CALM READING
• Comfortable serif typography, light and dark mode
• Adjust text size and line spacing
• Distraction-free mode
• The app remembers where you stopped

KEEP WHAT TOUCHES YOUR HEART
• Favorite verses, highlight in colors and write notes
• Reading history
• Everything is saved only on your device

FIND ANY PASSAGE
• Search by word
• Or jump straight to a reference, like John 3:16 or Ps 23

LISTEN TO THE WORD
• Listen to chapters with your iPhone's own voice (synthesized voice)
• Speed control and sleep timer
• Keeps playing with the screen locked

PRIVACY
No account, no sign-up and no tracking. Your favorites, notes and highlights stay only on your iPhone.

Credits: World English Bible, Reina-Valera 1909, Louis Segond 1910 and Luther 1912 (public domain); Bíblia Livre (CC BY 4.0). Full credits in Settings › About the app and credits.

name: Evenyo Officials
description:
Evenyo Officials is de app voor baancommissarissen, technische controle en wedstrijdleiding op de racedag. Je logt in met je telefoonnummer, kiest je rol en je post, en de app staat klaar voor jouw taak van vandaag.

SCANNEN
Scan de QR-code op banden, zegels en licenties. Je ziet direct of het item bij deze rijder en dit evenement hoort, en wat er nog open staat: slicks, regenbanden, chassis en zegel in één overzicht per rijder.

MELDEN
Meld een incident in een paar tikken vanaf je post: contact, spin, vlag genegeerd of een vrije melding. Voeg een foto toe en kies de betrokken rijders uit de startlijst van de lopende sessie.

BEOORDELEN
Als wedstrijdleider zie je alle meldingen van de posten binnenkomen, met de standaardstraf uit het reglement klaar. Beoordeel, pas aan of wijs af. Besluiten komen direct in de uitslag van Evenyo terecht.

OOK ZONDER BEREIK
Geen netwerk op de baan? Scans en meldingen gaan in een wachtrij en worden verstuurd zodra je weer verbinding hebt.

VOOR WIE
Evenyo Officials is bedoeld voor officials die door een organisatie zijn toegevoegd aan een evenement in Evenyo. Je hebt geen apart account nodig: de organisatie voegt je telefoonnummer toe en je logt in met een sms-code.

name: EverNoise
description:
Open the app. Find your sound. Lock your screen and get some rest.

Adjust Low, Mid, and High independently with three simple symbol pickers. Keep the original deep brown sound or add more mids and highs. A small hollow circle turns a band off; four growing dots select its intensity. Each active level uses an equal decibel step for smooth control of quieter sounds.

Red represents lows, green mids, and blue highs. A small infinity mark combines your sound's color, with a gentle flowing mist during playback. The screen stays black. Pause the sound and the controls become grayscale, with the infinity mark still.

• Three independent frequency controls, each with Off and four intensities
• Smooth changes without restarting playback
• Remembers all three settings
• Starts automatically when you open the app
• Keeps playing in the background and with the screen locked
• Generates sound on your device, without looping a recording
• Works completely offline, with no timer or time limit
• Large play/pause button; use your device’s volume buttons
• Lock-screen and Control Center playback controls
• Respects Reduce Motion
• Free, with no accounts, ads, subscriptions, or tracking

Choose the largest Low dot with Mid and High off for the original Brown sound. Setting all three bands to Off produces silence and mutes the colors.

Playback continues until you pause or force-quit the app. iOS can still interrupt audio for calls, Siri, or system events; the app resumes when iOS permits.

name: Exotic Marine Wholesale
description:
Exotic Marine Wholesale supplies marine fish, corals, and invertebrates to the trade from Gardena, California.

This app is the wholesale livestock catalog for approved retailer accounts. It shows the same in-stock livestock list and stock counts as exoticmarinewholesale.com. Only items that are currently in stock appear in the app — including Home, Shop, category lists, New Arrivals, search, product pages, and the bag. Guests can browse the catalog; prices are hidden until you sign in.

If you already have a website account, sign in with the same email or username and password. There is no separate app account. Wholesale prices are shown after a successful sign-in. New accounts apply on the website and are approved after the printed application and business license are received.

Approved, signed-in accounts can add livestock to the bag and place an order through the website checkout. The app does not collect a credit card number, expiration date, or CVV. Payment follows the store’s existing methods (such as bank transfer, check, or cash on delivery). The app does not mark an order paid.

You can delete your own customer account from Me → Delete Account. That request removes only the signed-in customer’s website account. Staff and administrator accounts cannot be deleted this way.

Facility: 13609 Alma Ave., Gardena, CA 90249. Contact the shop from the app’s Contact screen: email support@exoticmarinewholesale.com; call or text the office at (310) 329-1372; or reach Emma at (310) 890-5386, Ruben at (323) 685-9388, or Gilbert at (818) 231-7338. Hours, as published: Sun–Thurs 8:30 AM–4:30 PM; Fri–Sat closed (the source does not name a time zone).

This description does not add a live-arrival guarantee, a discount, or a same-day shipping promise for every order. Shipping and dead-on-arrival terms remain the website FAQ and the credit-card authorization PDF.

name: EYCamPlan
description:
EYCamPlan is a field planning tool for CCTV installers and integrators.

• Camera calculator: enter sensor, resolution and lens to see Detection, Observation, Recognition and Identification distances per IEC EN 62676-4 DORI, horizontal and vertical field of view, and a side-view diagram. Varifocal lenses show both extremes and the current setting.
• Floor plan: start from a photo, a file (image or PDF) or a blank grid. Calibrate the scale with a known length, place and rotate cameras and see their coverage cones. Undo, redo, snapping, multi-select and layer lock included.
• Cable routing: draw routes on the plan; horizontal runs, vertical drop, service loops and slack give totals per camera, plan and project.
• PDF report: cover, plan with cones, camera table, cable table, bill of materials (cable boxes, PoE load, optional storage estimate) and notes. Attach it to a quote, with your company name and logo on the cover.
• Backup: export a project as a single file and import it on another device.

No account, no ads, no tracking, no network. All data stays on your device. Results are planning estimates based on a distortion-free (rectilinear) lens model; verify on site. Sensor presets are approximate and editable.

name: EZ Content Organizer
description:
EZ Content Organizer moves the photos and videos you plan to post out of your camera roll and into one organized place, sorted by place and date.

• Pick photos and videos in the app. They move into an entry for that outing, and the originals leave your Photos library.
• Name the place from nearby suggestions based on where the photos were taken, or type it in.
• The date comes from the photos. Add a note if you like.
• Entries live in your own iCloud Drive, in an EZ Content folder you can open on your Mac.
• Mark entries as posted when you are done, and clear them in one step.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: F-16 Guide
description:
F-16 Guide is a study companion for flight-simulator pilots flying the F-16C Block 50. Learn the jet on your iPhone or iPad, away from the PC: the cockpit, the procedures, the displays, the weapons and the maneuvers, all in one place and all working offline.

COCKPIT
• The whole cockpit, from the left console to the right, in one picture you can zoom from the full view down to a single switch
• Tap any of 380 controls to see what it does and every position it has, with a picture of where it sits

FLOWS
• 51 procedures: normal, non-normal and combat
• Play a flow on the cockpit: it takes you from control to control, in order, lighting the one to act on
• Or tick it off as a checklist

DISPLAYS
• The HUD in 8 modes: NAV, landing, AIM-120, AIM-9, dogfight, CCIP, CCRP and strafe
• MFD pages (FCR, HSD, TGP, SMS and the menu) and the DED pages
• Tap any symbol, label or button for its meaning

SYSTEMS IN 3D
• A see-through F-16, system by system
• Rotate it, zoom in, tap a component for its description

ORDNANCE
• 36 stores with detailed 3D models: air-to-air missiles, bombs, guided weapons, rockets, pods and tanks
• Details, the procedure to employ each one, the release modes and the settings available

MANEUVERS
• 22 flight profiles in 3D: patterns, aerobatics, offensive and defensive BFM, BVR and attacks
• Watch from above or follow the jet, stop at each key point and read how to fly it

CALCULATOR
• Takeoff, landing, range and combat radius estimates for your loadout

Made for iPhone and iPad. No account, no ads, no data collected.

For flight simulation only: not for real-world flight. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any aircraft manufacturer, air force or simulator developer.

name: Fantasy Coach Live
description:
Fantasy football that doesn't end at kickoff.

Every other fantasy app locks your lineup when the games start and leaves you watching. Fantasy Coach Live keeps you coaching all the way to the final whistle.

COACH IT LIVE
Your starter is cold in the second quarter. Sub him out, right then, for a player who hasn't kicked off yet. Your sub is scored from the real game clock, on his own game, never retroactively. One live sub per position per week, so every call counts.

CALL A TIMEOUT
Forty-five seconds. Every live slot graded, every legal replacement on the table, and a straight read on whether to make the switch or hold the line. Three timeouts a week. Use them well.

THROW THE FLAG
Challenge the ruling on the field. The referee decides, not you.

A COACH ON THE HEADSET
Pick your coach: the aggressive one, the analyst, the salty one, the nervous one, the oracle. He watches the games with you, tells you when a starter is behind pace, and answers whatever you ask him, with your live lineup, scores, projections and injuries in front of him. Same facts, different philosophy. His calls go on his record, and yours go on yours.

WEEKLY DRAFT LEAGUES
No season commitment. Two to six coaches draft a brand-new team before the week's first kickoff, snake or straight order, live or auto-pick, most points wins. Play one week or make it a standing game with the same group every week.

EVERYTHING A LEAGUE NEEDS
Live scoring, a win chance that moves with the games, weekly projections and player news, waivers with claims, trades with league review, a full draft room, standings and playoffs.

THE WEEK ENDS WITH A SHOW
A recap the next time you open the app: the key players, who struggled, a note from the other head coach, confetti when you won, and a card to share.

COLLECT THE SEASON
Achievement cards with holographic foil for the moments that mattered: your first W, the clutch sub, the heartbreaker, the champion.

Notes between head coaches are private, one to one, with report and block. Delete your account any time from inside the app.

name: Fantatitano
description:
Fantatitano è il fantacalcio del Campionato Sammarinese. Sedici squadre vere, i giocatori veri, e una lega fra amici che dura tutta la stagione.

IL VOTO LO SCRIVE LA PARTITA
Niente pagelle e niente opinioni. Il voto di ogni giocatore parte da 6,0 e si muove con quello che c'è nel referto della gara: gol, assist, porta inviolata, cartellini, rigori, l'esito della squadra. Il conto resta in chiaro, riga per riga, e puoi vedere da dove nasce ogni decimo.

UNA GIORNATA A SETTIMANA
Schieri 11 titolari e 7 in panchina, ordinati: al posto di un titolare senza voto entra il primo panchinaro dello stesso ruolo. Le formazioni si chiudono 10 minuti prima della prima gara, e chi non consegna perde 0-3 a tavolino. A fine giornata arrivano i punteggi e il risultato dello scontro diretto.

SE UN DATO È SBAGLIATO, SI CONTESTA
Hai tempo fino al martedì per segnalare un evento che non torna. Alle 20:00 la giornata si congela e non si tocca più: da quel momento la classifica è definitiva, per tutti.

DENTRO L'APP
• Asta iniziale a crediti, e il mercato degli svincolati a stagione aperta
• Scambi fra fantallenatori, con proposta e risposta
• Calendario, classifica, record e storico giornata per giornata
• La scheda di ogni giocatore: voti, gol, assist, minuti, giornata per giornata
• Confronto diretto fra due giocatori, numeri alla mano
• Gli highlights delle partite dal canale della Federazione
• Il promemoria della formazione con le notifiche, se lo vuoi
• Lo shop: il top Fantatitano, con ritiro allo stadio o spedizione

SENZA PUBBLICITÀ CHE TI INSEGUE
Nessuna profilazione, nessun tracciatore di terze parti, nessun cookie di marketing. In home può comparire uno spazio sponsor, dichiarato come tale e uguale per tutti: non viene scelto in base a chi sei.

Fantatitano non è affiliato alla Federazione Sammarinese Giuoco Calcio né alle società del campionato, e non ne rappresenta le posizioni. Calendario, risultati e tabellini arrivano dai referti pubblici della Federazione.

Il gioco è gratis e non ha acquisti in-app. Nello shop si può ordinare merch Fantatitano. Serve un account con e-mail e nome: si cancella da dentro l'app (Profilo, poi «Elimina account»).

name: Felora
description:
Το Felora είναι προπονητής βιντεοπόκερ με ελληνική διεπαφή και οκτώ πίνακες βαθμών.

Στο σαλόνι διαλέγεις παραλλαγή — Βαλές και πάνω, Δεκάρια και πάνω, Μπόνους, Τρελά δυάρια, Τζόκερ πόκερ και άλλα — και μοιράζεις πέντε φύλλα. Κρατάς ό,τι θέλεις, τραβάς τα υπόλοιπα και μαζεύεις βαθμούς εξάσκησης. Σε 3, 5 ή 10 γραμμές τα κρατήματα μένουν ίδια και κάθε γραμμή ολοκληρώνει το χέρι του.

Υπάρχει πρόταση κράτησης (οδηγός, όχι τέλεια στρατηγική), ημερήσιος στόχος, σερί με μικρό μπόνους, ιστορικό χεριών με σύγκριση κρατήματος, άσκηση αναγνώρισης σχήματος χεριού και στούντιο με ήχο, δόνηση, χρώμα τσόχας και κανόνες.

Δωρεάν εφαρμογή για iPhone, κατακόρυφη διεπαφή. Οι βαθμοί είναι σκορ προπονητικής, όχι χρήματα.

name: Field App: Pest & Cleaning
description:
Field App shows how a pest control or cleaning company can run its whole day from one phone. Open it, tap Try the demo, and walk through a worked example company with sample data. Nothing to sign up for.

Four views, one app:
Owner: jobs today, who is waiting, who is on site, vans, team and reports on one screen.
Office: calendar, leads, quotes, service reports and contracts.
Technician: one job at a time, GPS check-in, report a problem, works in basements and car parks.
Client: the technician is on the way, a before-arrival checklist, warranty and booking.

Also inside: van stock and fuel, chemical records and compliance, team attendance, a route map, reminders and English and Arabic with right-to-left layout.

Add your company name, colour and language on the start screen and the whole app carries it. Remove everything the app stored with one tap in More.

All people, jobs and amounts in the app are examples. The app takes no payment and has no account.

name: FieldYield
description:
FieldYield puts roadway material calculations in your pocket. Enter your dimensions and material quantities to check yield, estimate placement distance, or calculate a turnout area.

Built for contractors, inspectors, and field personnel working with asphalt, concrete, limerock, and soil.

CHECK MATERIAL YIELD
• Compare calculated quantities with the material actually placed.
• See theoretical and actual asphalt spread rates.
• Enter one material total or add individual truck tickets for asphalt, concrete, and limerock.
• Deduct returned, unused, or diverted quantities from ticket totals.
• Handle constant-width sections or multiple segments with changing widths and depths.

ESTIMATE DISTANCE
• Find how far an available material quantity will go.
• Calculate the estimated ending station from a starting station, width, and depth.
• Work with asphalt tons, concrete cubic yards, Proctor-based limerock tons, or compacted soil cubic yards.

CALCULATE TURNOUTS
• Measure areas for perpendicular connections with circular radius returns, straight flares, or rectangular edges.
• See a plan-view sketch and calculated roadway opening width.
• Calculate material quantities from the selected geometry.

USE IT IN THE FIELD
• Calculations work offline without an account.
• Enter stations without typing the plus sign.
• Share text reports, copy results, or create and share a PDF.
• One-time purchase. No subscription or ads.

FieldYield uses feet, inches, cubic yards, and U.S. tons. Asphalt calculations support a project-specified spread rate or the thickness/Gmm method. Limerock calculations use Proctor maximum dry density, estimated compaction, and optional delivered moisture. Soil quantities are compacted volumes.

Results depend on the dimensions, material data, and assumptions entered. Verify that the selected method applies to your project. FieldYield does not determine contract acceptance or payment quantities.

name: FindADink
description:
FindADink is the free pickleball companion for people who travel to play, and for everyone looking for a hit close to home.

Find courts, club nights and open sessions in one place. See what’s on in a town, save a session to your calendar, and turn on alerts for the places you care about. If you let the app use your location, your exact position stays on this phone. We only save your nearest town, so we can show what’s nearby.

The first release starts in New Zealand. Listings for Australia, Indonesia and Việt Nam are on the way, so you can keep the same app when you travel.

FindADink is free for players. Some clubs let you book a session in the app. Those bookings are for a real-world game, paid to the club, not an in-app purchase.

Sign in with Apple, Google or your email. You need to be 18 or over to create an account. You can delete your account in Settings, or email privacy@findadink.co.nz.

We also ask whether you’ll allow tracking, so we can measure whether our Facebook and Instagram ads help people find pickleball near them. If you choose Ask App Not to Track, you can still use the app.

name: Fingerstyle & Strumming Guitar
description:
Chord shapes for the six-string guitar, worked out from your tuning, and the picking and strumming patterns to play over them. Standard, drop D, DADGAD, open G, open D or your own, with a capo up to the 9th fret.

HEAR THE PATTERN OVER ANY CHORD
Pick a chord, press Loop, and a steel-string guitar sound plays the pattern over it. Change the chord, the pattern or the tempo while it loops and it changes on the next note. Loop it over a key's progressions, or build your own from the key's chords, and take it to any key.

SEVENTEEN PICKING PATTERNS
Travis picking six ways: thumb only, basic, ring on top, with a pinch, the Travis roll and the four-string bass. The p-i-m-i, p-i-m-a, p-a-m-i and p-i-m-a-m-i arpeggios. A waltz, a waltz arpeggio, Travis in 3/4, a Rising Sun 6/8 and a 6/8 alternating bass. Boom-chick and the Carter scratch. The thumb's strings follow the chord: 6 and 4 under G, 5 and 4 under C, 4 and 3 under D.

THIRTY STRUMMING PATTERNS
Down and up strokes that sound different, the down from the bass, the up lighter across the top strings. The misses are drawn too, so your hand keeps moving. Chucks, palm mute, accents and swing; eighths, sixteenths, 3/4 and 6/8. Old faithful, the island strum, boom-chicka, the bluegrass boom-chuck, the train beat, the off-beat chop and the blues shuffle.

THE THUMB'S BASS, AND SLASH CHORDS
On a guitar the thumb plays the lowest note, so a shape with another chord note in the bass is named for it: C/G, G/B, D/F#. The progressions use them, so the walkdown G, D/F#, Em, C steps the thumb down string 6.

SHAPES A PLAYER REACHES FOR
Every chord has its own page: the open shape in the chord books first (C is x32010), then the moveable E and A shapes up the neck, each with its fingers and notes. Only shapes a real hand can hold make the list. Tap a box to hear it.

THE CHORDS OF ANY KEY
Pick a key in major, mixolydian, dorian or minor, or fifteen more modes, pentatonics and blues among them. See its chords as guitar shapes and its common progressions, from I IV V to Freight Train's ragtime turn. A key with no open home chord shows where the capo goes.

CHORD FINDER AND TUNER
Both in the Tools menu. Tap a fret on each string and the finder names the chord, slash chords included. The tuner hears which string of your tuning you're playing and how far off it is. Sound is analysed on your phone and never recorded.

MADE FOR YOUR HANDS
Left-handed mirrors every box and the neck. Five colour schemes, or your own. Save the chords and keys you use; recent ones are on the first screen. Sound plays with the silent switch on.

IN YOUR CASE
Free, with no ads and no purchases. Works offline, with no account. When you're online it sends anonymous usage statistics and screen recordings of how the app is used, never what you type; one switch in Settings turns them off.

name: Fireplaice: Voice to Text
seller_name: Renato Ferreira Lima e Correa Pereira
description:
Fireplaice records your voice, transcribes it and hands you text you can use, on iPhone and iPad.

Tap record and talk. When you stop, the recording transcribes itself, gets a title and lands on your clipboard, ready to paste. Recording never waits for a network, a key or an account: the audio is saved first and the rest catches up.

TRANSCRIBE ON YOUR DEVICE
In Simple mode, transcription runs entirely on your iPhone or iPad. Use the built-in Apple engine or download a model: a light one of about 77 MB or a premium one of about 600 MB. No key and no connection needed.

DO SOMETHING WITH WHAT YOU SAID
In Complete mode, each note gets a summary and suggested next steps: turn it into an email or a message, write meeting notes, pull out action items, translate it or fix a misheard word. Each suggestion opens a chat that already carries the transcript.

LISTEN TO YOUR DOCUMENTS
In Complete mode, drop in a PDF, a Markdown or text file, or paste some text, and Fireplaice reads it to you. The words are highlighted as they are spoken. Skip 15 seconds, change the speed and listen again offline.

YOUR WORDS, SPELLED RIGHT
Add names and jargon to your vocabulary so the Apple engine and your AI provider spell them right. Search all your notes, and transcribe a recording again with another engine when you want a second pass.

FITS IN WITH YOUR OTHER APPS
Share audio and documents to Fireplaice from other apps, open files in it, or start a recording with Siri and Shortcuts.

BRING YOUR OWN AI
Complete mode uses the AI provider you choose, with your own API key, stored in the Keychain. Fireplaice sends requests only to the services you set up.

BUILT TO BE SIMPLE
• No account with us
• No ads and no third-party analytics
• Your notes are stored on your device
• English and Portuguese

REQUIREMENTS
iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. The downloadable engines need free space: about 77 MB or 600 MB. The premium engine is recommended on devices with 6 GB of memory or more. Complete mode needs an API key from a supported provider and an internet connection.

name: Firmenfunk
description:
Firmenfunk is your company's employee app. You read what is going on at work, even without a company e-mail address and without a desk.

Your company decides what you find in the app. For example:

• News and short updates from your workplace
• Events and dates
• Documents such as notices, schedules and instructions
• Notice board, polls and ideas
• Chat with colleagues
• Notifications when something important comes up

You sign in with the access your company gives you, for example with e-mail and password or with a sign-in QR code. After that the app can show your company's logo and colours.

Good to know: you cannot sign in without access from a company. Accounts are issued and managed by the company, and the content comes from it. If you want to get to know Firmenfunk first, open the demo in the app.

More about Firmenfunk: https://firmenfunk.de

name: Fishbreak
description:
Your AI works. You fish.

Fishbreak puts the status of the AI coding assistants on your computer (Claude Code, Codex) in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen of your iPhone. Working, waiting for your OK, or done: you can tell at a glance, without sitting at your desk.

TASKS IN THE DYNAMIC ISLAND
• Up to 4 running tasks at once: name, elapsed time, status
• When your AI needs a confirmation, your phone tells you, and you tap Allow or Deny right in the Dynamic Island
• Updates by itself. No need to open the app

FISH WHILE YOU WAIT
• A rod is cast the moment your AI starts working. The longer it works, the likelier a bite
• Then you reel it in: the fish runs, pulls line out, and you bring it back round by round
• Over 500 real species, from a guppy a few centimeters long to whales over 20 meters, all with real-world sizes
• Six rarity tiers and six size grades. All odds are published and never changed in secret
• Every fish has a fact card: scientific name, where it lives, and things you probably didn't know

A BOTTLE THAT SLOSHES
• Your catches live in a corked glass bottle
• Shake your phone and the water, the sand and the fish all move: waves rise and sand flows
• Drag the zoom bar to go from tiny tetras all the way to whales

ONE SENTENCE TO CONNECT
Nothing to install on your computer. Copy one sentence in the app, paste it to Claude Code or Codex, and it sets itself up. You can also watch a demo on your phone before connecting anything.

PRIVACY
Fishbreak does not store your code, file contents or conversations. It only uses the session name and one short line to show status. No account needed.

Fishbreak is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic or OpenAI. Claude Code and Codex are trademarks of their respective owners and are named only to describe compatibility.

name: Fjordwatch
description:
The shield-maiden Sigrun holds the longhall of Hrafnvik. Raiders are coming up the fjord.

BUILD BY DAY
Walk Sigrun onto a glowing stone to raise a defence: archer towers, rune stones, catapults, longhouses, farms and palisades. Upgrade them as the gold comes in.

FIGHT BY NIGHT
Sound the horn and the raiders come down the road. Sigrun fights on her own; you choose when to Dash, call Arrow Rain on a crowd, or unleash the Raven Storm.

A SAGA OF THE NORTH
Five chapters, from Hrafnvik Bay to the Roots of Yggdrasil, each with its own foe and its own lord. Survive a night and the gods offer a gift that lasts the whole saga. Then face Ragnarök, the endless mode.

• One-thumb controls: drag anywhere to move
• Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases
• No account, plays fully offline
• Your progress stays on your iPhone

name: Flatfolio: Lease & Renewal
description:
Flatfolio is a private folio for the lease you actually live in: rent, the deposit still held, water–power–gas meters, the broker fee, the notice date, the clauses you care about, the landlord and the super. File each home with its term, amount and intent, then see the floor still lit and the dates that matter on one horizon.

DATES • A month grid and a 12-month year spine: rent due, meter readings, deposit and broker lines, notice and lease end — not holidays — each as a coloured mark • Tap a day or a month to list what lands there; tap a mark to open the floor • Home shows days left, the notice window, and whether this month’s rent is posted

FLOORS • Homes listed as current, upcoming or archived; one current floor on Home, the rest in All homes • Lease: term, notice days, rent ledger against months elapsed, and the clauses you typed • Deposit: agreed versus held, then marked refunded at move-out • Broker fee: kept on its own floor and not folded into monthly burden; shown as months of rent and a daily spread • Meters: water, power and gas with a move-in baseline, usage, billed amount and an implied rate • Cabinet for file titles, landlord and broker cards, a move-in walkthrough list, and search across the folio

COSTS • True monthly burden: rent plus utilities averaged over billed months, with rent per square foot and a daily figure • Compare two homes: A against B on rent, burden, deposit held, broker paid and area, with a plain verdict on which is lighter after utilities • Utility estimate: usage times implied rates, or public tariffs if you have no pair yet — an order of magnitude, not a bill • Twelve-month ledger: rent, utilities and what you posted, month by month • Export: copy a plain-text summary of one home or the whole folio and paste it into Notes

REMINDERS • Optional in-app flags for renewal, notice and rent due — day before, week before, or both • Optional Monday review on Dates: unposted rent, open walkthrough items, and notice coming due • Quiet folio leaves the calendar marked and Home calm; there is no system push until you add one yourself

PRIVATE BY DESIGN Flatfolio works fully offline. There is no account, no sign-in, no cloud, no analytics, no ads and no in-app purchases. Everything you enter stays on this device. Uninstalling clears it. Export only copies the text you tap.

Burden and estimates assume the numbers you typed and the readings you logged; a landlord’s ledger or a utility bill may differ. Flatfolio does not offer, recommend or broker housing, and it is not legal or financial advice.

name: Flight Advisor: Connections
description:
Two cheaper flights on separate tickets can save you a lot, as long as you make your connection. Flight Advisor is built for exactly that.

FIND A CHEAPER ROUTE
• Real flights combined on separate tickets, ranked by price, total time and risk
• Choose what matters: cheapest, fastest or safest
• Booking links for each flight, clearly marked as partner links

NEVER MISS YOUR CONNECTION
• Your real safety margin at the layover: bag drop, security, terminal change and passport control are all counted
• A clear risk level before you book, and while you travel
• Transit visa reminders based on your nationality

ONE STEP AT A TIME
• Your journey becomes a simple path: get ready, airport, flight, layover, next flight, arrival
• Check off each step and see where you are
• An overview whenever you want the full picture

EVERY FLIGHT, LIVE
• Status, terminal and gate for both flights
• Both flights and your layover on a map, with a globe view
• Airport photos to find your way

NOTHING FORGOTTEN
• A ready-made checklist: passport, check-in for each ticket, visa, eSIM, travel insurance
• Boarding passes read from their barcode and shown full screen, even offline

A PRIVATE ASSISTANT
• Ask questions about your trip to an AI assistant that runs entirely on your iPhone
• Your trips stay on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Flight data by AeroDataBox. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Flint: Wake Your Mac
description:
Flint lets your Mac sleep while you're away, and wakes it when you ask from your iPhone.

Your Mac checks in every 15 minutes (5 to 120, your choice), for a few seconds each time. Tap Wake Mac, pick 1 to 24 hours, and it wakes at its next check-in and stays awake until the time you chose, ready for you or your assistant. Then it goes back to sleep.

Flint needs its free companion app for Mac, from smallbench.studio/flint (macOS 26 or later, Apple Silicon). Pair your iPhone once by scanning the code your Mac shows.

ONE TRUTH AT A TIME
• The phone shows what's really happening: asleep, wake sent, awake until 5:30 PM.
• If a network blocks Flint, it says "Wake not sent yet" and sends the Wake by itself when it can get through. It never says "sent" when it wasn't.
• A Live Activity on the Lock Screen counts down to the next check-in. Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen, and "Wake my Mac with Flint" in Siri and Shortcuts.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your phone can wake your Mac, put it to sleep, see its battery and change a few bounded settings. It can't run commands, open files, see the screen or unlock anything. No such message exists.
• Messages are end-to-end encrypted. The relay in between holds sealed messages for up to 12 hours and can't read them. You can run your own relay.
• Each phone gets its own key, paired in person by a code shown only on your Mac. The code works once and expires in minutes.
• No account, no analytics, no ads.
• Optional Face ID before the app opens or a Wake goes out.

KIND TO YOUR MAC
• Asleep between check-ins. Off the charger it sleeps at 10% and turns down wakes until plugged in. It sleeps to cool down when hot, and never sleeps a Mac someone is using.
• Undo all changes, on the Mac, puts every setting back.

WORKS WITH ANY ASSISTANT
An assistant can only work on your Mac while it's awake. Flint wakes it; your assistant connects through its own app.

Free. No subscription.

Flint by Small Bench.

name: Floodlit – Lineup Scores
description:
Floodlit puts your Sorare Football lineups on your Apple Watch, so you can follow your game week at a glance: in the stands, on the move, or anywhere getting your phone out isn't ideal.

ON YOUR WATCH
• This week at a glance: the rewards you're on track for, added up across every lineup
• A countdown to the lineup deadline before each game week
• Your 5 and 7 card lineups, with captains, substitutes and a live score under each card
• Kick-off times for players still to play
• Tap any card to see it close up with its match and status, then turn the Digital Crown to go through the lineup
• Swipe for your total, rank, projected finish and the points you need for the next reward

TRY IT FIRST
Not signed in yet? Tap "Try the demo" on your watch to see Floodlit with sample lineups.

SIGNS IN THE SAFE WAY
Sign in once on your iPhone with Log in with Sorare, on Sorare's own page. Floodlit never sees your Sorare password, keeps your sign-in in your devices' secure Keychain, and only reads your lineups and scores. No ads, no tracking, no analytics.

Works with Sorare Football Pro lineups. Arcade isn't supported.

Screenshots show demo mode with sample players. Once you sign in, Floodlit shows your own cards with their real Sorare card images.

Needs an iPhone with iOS 26 or later, an Apple Watch with watchOS 26 or later, and a Sorare account.

Floodlit is an independent app. It isn't made, endorsed or sponsored by Sorare.

name: FLUX Photography
description:
FLUX is an open, chronological photography publishing system. Your photographs, in the order you made them, become printed zines — on any office printer, folded and stapled at home. Everything runs on your iPhone; your photographs stay on it.

FLUX STUDIO
Make a zine from your photographs — Mini, Saddle Stitch, Landscape or Magazine. FLUX lays out every page, or you shape each one by hand. Print on US Letter or A4, or make a flip-through video of the finished book.

GENERATORS
Automatic. Choose a format, add your photographs, and FLUX lays out the whole issue in the order they were taken — cover, captions, contact sheet and index — as a print-ready PDF.

CAMERA
Shoot in FLUX black and white, with film looks. Load a roll of 24 or 36 exposures — no looking back until it's finished — then make the zine from the roll in one tap.

LIBRARY
Every photograph you make with FLUX, by roll. Your whole archive by year, month and day, on the map, with selects and sets. Develop any photograph in black and white as a new copy — your originals are never changed.

CONTACT SHEETS & FREEFORM
Print your photographs 6, 12 or 36 to a page to mark and select. Lay them out on a free table to find the edit and the sequence.

GALLERY
Zines by the FLUX community, free to read. Made one? Submit it to FLUX — every zine is reviewed by hand before it appears.

THE DECISIVE MOMENT
A free retro street-photography game set in Philadelphia.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Nothing leaves your phone unless you submit a zine.

name: FolioMargin
description:
FolioMargin turns your iPhone Duo, iPad, and iPhone into an archival study desk built around one simple discipline: keep the paper intact on one leaf and bind your handwritten proof sketches, equations, and margin critiques on the other.

Designed specifically for dual-leaf reading and annotation:
