• Two-Leaf Book Spread — On iPhone Duo and iPad, read PDFs in a warm cream archival folio inside a calm dark workspace while sketching linked PencilKit diagrams opposite the page, keeping every tool safely clear of the 40 pt fold crease.
• Elastic Ink Bridges — Highlight any sentence and bind it to a dated margin pin. Tap a highlight pill or margin pin to pulse its color-coded ink curve across the binding gutter without losing your reading position.
• On-Device Vision OCR Search — Search across PDF body text, quoted passage links, and your offline handwritten ink notes with local Vision text recognition across English, Turkish, and German.
• Ergonomic Left-Handed & Palm Clearance — One tap swaps the Paper and Margin leaves cleanly and shifts an outer palm-rest bezel + 160 pt bottom canvas overscroll away from the system vertical bar edge.
• Cover Flashcards on the 5.4" Screen — Gently close iPhone Duo (or switch to Flashcards on iPhone) to review linked highlights alongside sketch thumbnails, grade retention (Again, Good, Mastered), and arm a one-tap jump back to the exact PDF page upon unfolding.
• 2-Up Academic PDF Export — Share or save to Files either a landscape 2-up folio spread (highlighted page alongside your vector ink diagram) or portrait annotated sheets.

Pure one-time purchase: 100% offline with zero accounts, zero analytics, and zero subscriptions.

name: Foodsta Restaurant
description:
Foodsta Restaurants helps restaurants showcase their businesses, connect with food lovers, and promote their offerings to people discovering dining options.
Create your restaurant presence on Foodsta and share your business, food, and special offers with potential customers.

name: FORELO GOLF
description:
FORELO brings your golf life together in one place.

Track rounds, follow your performance, connect with golfers, join Crews, discover events, and share the game with a community built around golf.

PLAY
• Record 9-hole and 18-hole rounds
• Track scores and recent performance
• Follow live rounds and leaderboards
• Keep your golf history organized

COMMUNITY
• Share posts, photos, stories, and comments
• Follow golfers and interact with the community
• Join public or private Crews
• Send direct messages
• Report inappropriate content and block users

EVENTS
• Discover golf events and meetups
• RSVP and keep upcoming events easy to find

PROFILE
• Build your golfer profile
• Show your golf bag and activity
• Review rounds, scores, and achievements

FORELO includes community safety tools, in-app account deletion, and privacy controls. Handicap-related figures shown in the app are unofficial estimates and are not a GHIN or WHS Handicap Index.

name: ForestPawTrail
description:
ForestPawTrail kutsuu lapset innokkaiksi metsän tutkijoiksi.

Tutki hiekkaan jääneitä tassunjälkiä, vertaile eläinten jälkiä ja selvitä, kuka on kulkenut metsäpolulla. Aluksi jäljet erottuvat selkeästi toisistaan, mutta myöhemmillä reiteillä vastaan tulee samankaltaisia jälkiä, eri suuntiin kulkevia polkuja ja useista osista koostuvia vihjeitä.

Monipuoliset oppimisosiot, kuten Eläinopas, Vertailulaboratorio, Havaintopäiväkirja ja Tuntomerkkiharjoitukset, kehittävät havainnointikykyä ja jälkien tunnistamista.

Ystävällinen etenemistahti tekee jokaisesta metsäseikkailusta selkeän, rauhallisen ja palkitsevan.

name: Forma360 Inspections & audits
description:
Forma360 for iPhone is the field companion to your organisation's Forma360 workspace. Inspectors carry out checks where the work happens, including basements, plant rooms and remote sites with no signal, and everything they record is sent to the workspace as soon as there is a connection again.

Sign in with the account your organisation set up at forma360.io, or tap "Create an account" to start your own workspace in the app.

INSPECTIONS THAT KEEP WORKING OFFLINE
• Start an inspection from any template your organisation has published, continue one in progress, and submit it.
• Start a scheduled check straight from My work.
• Answer multiple-choice, text, number, date and time, checkbox, slider, site, asset and location questions.
• Add photos from the camera or the photo picker, record a video, or attach a PDF where a question asks for one. Files are kept on the device and uploaded with the inspection.
• Notes and evidence that an answer requires, follow-up questions, conditional questions and required-question checks work as they do on the web.
• Sign signature slots on the screen, including after the inspection has been submitted.
• See the inspection's score, sign off when it is your turn, and approve or send back an inspection with a reason.
• Changes are saved on the device first and queued. A sync screen shows what is waiting and why anything was refused.

MORE OF YOUR WORKSPACE, ON YOUR PHONE
• My work: actions, briefings, scheduled checks, sign-offs and approvals waiting for you, each opening where you can act on it.
• Actions: create them offline with a type, assignee, site, due date and photos or files; move your own actions on and comment.
• Observations: report one offline with its category questions, your location and photos; comment and raise an action from it.
• Filter lists by assigned to me, open or overdue, and search the server for older records.
• Assets: see details and recent readings, record a reading, start an inspection for the asset and scan its QR label.
• Briefings: read, acknowledge and sign them.
• Documents: open them and keep them for reading offline.
• Contractors: see their compliance and check visitors in and out at the gate.
• Notifications open the record they are about.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The app is available in English, Italian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Japanese and Chinese. It follows your phone's language, or choose one in Settings.
• Sign-in is with email and password. Accounts that use email codes or two-factor sign-in should sign in on the web.
• Building templates and managing users and settings are done on the web.
• Location is read only when you tap to add it and allow it. The app contains no advertising.

Privacy policy: https://forma360.io/en/privacy

name: FractionLab
description: FractionLab teaches fractions with visual lessons and quizzes. Offline education app with no account.

name: Frame Studio by Frame Story
description:
Frame Studio is the iPad studio for photographers: write long-form photo stories and develop your photos, side by side.

STORIES
Write the way your story will be read. The editor shows the page exactly as it will be published on Frame Story: a full-screen cover, photos in sequence, galleries, quotes and your words.
• Drag photos from the side panel straight into the story.
• Reorder blocks in the navigator; edit each block in the inspector.
• Real bold, italic and links as you type, in the story's own typeface.
• Preview the story at phone, tablet and desktop width.
• Public, private or password-protected stories, with automatic saving.

LIGHTBOX
Bring in photos from the Files app, an SD card or a camera on USB-C (RAW, JPEG, HEIC and TIFF), from your iPad's photo library, or from your Frame Story library, including photos sent from Frame Cam on iPhone.
Albums, stars and flags keep the good ones close.

DEVELOP
A non-destructive darkroom built for the large screen: calibrated looks with physically modeled grain, light, color, curves, masks, detail and presets, with a histogram and a filmstrip. Change the look, the recipe or the crop at any time.

FRAME STORY
Stories are published on Frame Story (theframe.cc), with a page of your own. No ads, no likes, no public numbers. A free account is needed for stories; the Lightbox and Develop work without one.

name: Freasure Club SunWin
description:
Freasure Club SunWin mang đến bốn hoạt động giải trí trong không gian tím và vàng: Tài Xỉu, Xóc Đĩa, Bầu Cua và Roulette châu Âu.

Quan sát kết quả hoặc chọn một dự đoán tùy thích. Không đặt cược, không ví, không tiền hay xu ảo; không mua lượt chơi hoặc đổi thưởng. Các kết quả độc lập, không thay đổi theo lịch sử hay lựa chọn của bạn.

Tìm hiểu cách đếm các kết quả có thể xảy ra trong phần Hướng dẫn. Mở Nhật ký để xem lại kết quả và dự đoán đã lưu, đánh dấu lượt muốn giữ trong danh sách yêu thích, hoặc xem thống kê theo từng game. Huy hiệu chỉ dùng trang trí.

Chơi trên thiết bị với tài nguyên và luật có sẵn, không cần đăng nhập. Ứng dụng không có quảng cáo, mua hàng trong app hoặc thuê bao. Kết quả và cài đặt được lưu local; có thể xóa dữ liệu trong Cài Đặt → Giới thiệu. Cơ chế backup của hệ điều hành được quản lý riêng.

Giao diện ưu tiên dọc và có bố cục ngang riêng. Mỗi bàn có nút quay về Trang Chủ. Âm thanh, nhạc nền và rung mặc định tắt; bạn có thể bật trong Cài Đặt.

Trò chơi chỉ dành cho giải trí. Dự đoán không phải cá cược; không có tài sản, phần thưởng có giá trị hoặc khả năng quy đổi ra ngoài app. Nhật ký không dự báo kết quả tiếp theo.

**Key Features**​
- Tài Xỉu với 3 xúc xắc; bộ ba giống nhau được ghi riêng.
- Xóc Đĩa với 4 quân Đỏ/Trắng.
- Bầu Cua với 3 viên, lựa chọn tối đa 3 hình là tùy chọn.
- Roulette châu Âu 37 ô từ 0 đến 36; chọn Đỏ, Đen hoặc số.
- Giải thích xác suất từ toàn bộ không gian kết quả.
- Nhật ký tối đa 200 lượt mỗi game, đánh dấu tối đa 40 lượt.
- Thống kê và huy hiệu từ các lượt còn được lưu.
- Không tài khoản, quảng cáo, thanh toán hay subscription.

name: Frederick: Rich in Peace
description:
Frederick means “mighty in peace”. The name goes back to Old High German fridu, “peace”, and rīhhi, “mighty, ruler” – and the ending is the same old word as rich. This little app is about the name, and about getting rich in peace.

TODAY
• A countdown to the name day, with confetti when it comes
• Today’s Frederick: a famous namesake every day
• Friday is Fred-day

THE NAME
• Where the name comes from
• Frederick in 22 languages, from Friðrik to Bedřich
• Related names like Sigfrid and Henrik, and the feminine form Frederica
• Kings and emperors who bore the name
• Places named after the name, like Fredericksburg and Fredericton
• Famous Fredericks, from Frederick Douglass to Fred Astaire
• Frederick in books, music, film and TV – from Fred Flintstone to Freddie Mercury
• Nicknames

PEACE
Press the button and breathe with the circle for one, three or five minutes – with the word for peace in a new language at every breath. Every full minute makes you one peace richer, and over time you earn new titles – from Friend of peace to Frederick the Great.

GAMES
• A quiz with ten questions about the name and everyone who has it
• The timeline: put films, songs and famous Fredericks in the right order
• Crowns in peace: a logic puzzle with a new board every day

MORE
• Your own Frederick certificate to share
• Reminders on your name day and every Friday

No account, no ads and no tracking. Nothing you do in the app leaves your phone.

name: Freefall: Skydive
description:
Stand in your own room and reach for the bar. The moment you grab it, a transport plane grows out from your hand: the cargo hold, the red night lights, the open ramp, and beyond it the sky at 18,000 feet. Wait for the green light, let go, and you're falling.

Freefall is a first-person skydive for Apple Vision Pro, played with your own hands.

FALL
Accelerate to terminal velocity and drop through a raining cloud deck: mist rushing up past you, raindrops streaking by, your gloves and sleeves getting wet. Come out of the cloud base into the rain, and then into clear sky.

PULL
The altimeter is on your wrist. When it alarms at 3,500 feet, reach across with your other hand, grab the red handle on your forearm and pull. The pilot chute drags the canopy out, the lines snap tight and the cells inflate one by one above you. Pull too late and there won't be enough sky left.

FLY
Under canopy you steer by turning your head and body, and the canopy follows you. Grab the toggles to brake, or push them forward to dive. Tap the watch to bring up a helmet HUD with your altitude, heading and the landing spot. Land on the red-and-white circle to win; hit the yellow bullseye for a perfect landing.

SEVEN WORLDS
• Atoll – a white sandbar in a turquoise lagoon. Land short and you're swimming.
• Grassland – patchwork fields, a winding river and woods between you and the target.
• Alpine – a U-shaped valley whose walls rise above you as your canopy opens.
• Snow Peaks – thin air, so you fall faster and need to pull earlier.
• Island – open over the sea, fly in over the reef, and stay out of the rainforest.
• Volcano – an erupting cone, lava flows and an ash plume to steer clear of.
• Sky City – an abandoned stone city on floating islands above a sea of clouds.

Every jump has its own wind, so no two approaches are the same.

EARN YOUR GEAR
Every world has its own canopy, and its own gloves and sleeves, patterned after that world. Land on a world's target to unlock its canopy; hit the bullseye to unlock its gloves and sleeves.

PRACTICE AND REVIEW
Once you've landed safely in a world, start a jump at 5,000 feet to practice the canopy flight. After every jump, the route map shows your whole flight from above and whether you landed long or short, left or right.

COMFORTABLE BY DESIGN
• Best played seated, with headphones.
• By default you steer by turning your head and body, so the world never spins around you. Toggle steering is available as an option, with a motion-comfort warning.
• Automatic flare near the ground, or switch to manual and flare yourself.
• A jump takes about four minutes. Hold the watch for two seconds to quit at any time.

MADE IN REAL TIME
Apart from the gloves, everything you see and hear is generated as you play: the plane, the canopy, the clouds, the sea and the mountains. No accounts, no ads, no data collected, and it works offline. Available in ten languages.

Requires hand tracking.

Sound effects "wind 2", "parachute 2" and "nylon flapping 1" by Huggy13ear (freesound.org), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

name: Fresa AI
description:
Fresa AI es el espacio operativo para coordinar el trabajo de tu empresa desde un solo lugar.

Organiza workspaces, espacios, listas y tareas con responsables, fechas, prioridades y estados. Mantén las conversaciones del equipo conectadas con el trabajo mediante canales y mensajes directos. Consulta documentos, calendario, reuniones y notificaciones sin perder el contexto.

Funciones principales:
• Tareas y proyectos organizados por workspace, espacio y lista.
• Chat de equipo mediante canales y mensajes directos.
• Documentos, calendario y reuniones conectados con el trabajo.
• Automatizaciones y asistencia de IA cuando el usuario las solicita.
• Notificaciones para mensajes, tareas y eventos relevantes.
• Compatibilidad con tema claro, oscuro y el tema del sistema.
• Cámara, fotos y micrófono únicamente cuando eliges adjuntar contenido, enviar una nota de voz, hablar con el asistente o participar en una reunión.

Fresa AI requiere una cuenta y acceso autorizado a un workspace. Tus datos y permisos permanecen sujetos a los controles de acceso de tu organización.

name: Friendship Shell
description:
A magical necklace. An island mystery. A friendship waiting to happen.

Naomi’s necklace lets her become a mermaid—and suddenly, the ocean is hers to explore. But there’s more waiting beyond the waves. A mermaid needs help, a turtle lost his parents, a boat needs fixing, a mysterious island needs help, and a new friend named Luke is ready to share the adventure.

Where will your curiosity take you?

SET SAIL WITH NAOMI AND LUKE
Help get the boat ready, sail to the island, and follow the clues into a shell-shaped cave. Solve picture puzzles, uncover the island’s missing Guardian, and discover what two friends can accomplish together. With spoken conversations and a story you help move forward, every little discovery brings you closer to the next big moment.

BUILD YOUR OWN UNDERWATER WORLD
Feel like wandering? Choose Explore and swim through colorful reefs, drifting schools of fish, and glowing ocean hideaways. Look high, swim low, and see what’s around the next bend. Earn pearls through play, then choose fish and decorations to make your own corner of the ocean feel like home.

COME FACE TO FIN WITH SOMETHING AMAZING
Step inside Papa’s aquarium for an underwater tour full of wonder. Watch manta rays glide overhead, peer into tiny sea creatures’ habitats, and tap picture signs to hear Papa explain the animals you discover. You can even help Luke feed the fish! Short, friendly explanations turn “What’s that?” into a chance to learn.

MAKE TIME FOR A LITTLE CATAPULT FUN
Discover Krabby Catapult beneath the sea and try your aim in a playful arcade challenge. Once you’ve found and tried it, Naomi’s bedroom tablet gives you a shortcut back for another round.

A WORLD TO SHARE, A JOURNEY TO MAKE YOUR OWN
Play together and talk through a puzzle, or let a curious explorer lead the way. Spoken guidance, picture-based interactions, and simple tap-or-click controls help children take part without pages of instructions to read. Friendship, helping others, and caring for the ocean are woven into the fun.

ONE PURCHASE OPENS THE WHOLE WORLD
The story adventure, ocean exploration and building, educational aquarium, and Krabby Catapult are all included. No ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Pearls are earned through play. Play offline, with no account required; progress is saved on your device.

The boat is waiting. Let’s see where the friendship takes you.

name: FRS Control de Obra
description:
FRS Control de Obra es la herramienta interna de FREDOS RENOVATION SERVICES LLC (Phoenix, AZ) para llevar sus obras con su equipo de subcontratistas.

PARA SUBCONTRATISTAS
• Entra con el código que te da el administrador — sin correo ni contraseña.
• Ve solo las obras que te asignan y el cronograma por semana.
• Marca el avance de tus tareas.
• Sube fotos de avance y escribe la bitácora del día.
• Registra compras y recibos.
• Sube tus documentos: EIN, W-9 firmado, aseguranza y workers' comp.

PARA EL ADMINISTRADOR
• Obras con cronograma, avance y fechas de entrega.
• Pagos de cada contrato (solo los ve el administrador).
• Estimados a clientes en PDF con el logo de la empresa.
• Estimados y órdenes de cambio.
• Equipo: invita subcontratistas con un código y asígnalos a cada obra.
• Revisa documentos y vencimientos de aseguranza.

La app es para el uso interno de FREDOS y sus subcontratistas invitados. Necesitas un código del administrador para entrar.

name: Frutífera
description:
Tem jabuticaba na calçada, manga na praça e caqui na esquina, e quase ninguém repara. A Frutífera é o mapa das árvores frutíferas da sua cidade, feito por quem anda a pé: você marca o pé que encontrou, o vizinho confirma, e todo mundo descobre onde tem fruta perto de casa.

POR QUE USAR
• Descubra árvores frutíferas no seu bairro: jabuticabeira, mangueira, pitangueira, amoreira, caquizeiro, aceroleira e mais 20 espécies.
• Saiba o que está na safra agora e qual pé fica mais perto de você.
• Transforme a caminhada em passeio: seu andarilho em pixel vai junto pelo mapa.
• Conheça cada fruta: nome científico, os nomes que ela ganha em cada região e o calendário de safra.
• Ajude sua cidade a enxergar o pomar que ela já tem.

COMO FUNCIONA
1. Ande. Monte seu andarilho e toque no mapa: ele vai até lá, passo a passo.
2. Ache e marque. Na frente da árvore, escolha a espécie, diga se ela fica na calçada ou num terreno particular e, se quiser, tire uma foto.
3. Dê pé. Passou por um pé que outra pessoa marcou? Confirme que ele continua lá. Só confirma quem está perto da árvore, e é isso que deixa o mapa confiável.
4. Siga a safra. A aba Safra mostra o que está dando neste mês e onde.

26 ESPÉCIES, DE A A Z
Abacate, acerola, amora, araçá, banana, caju, cambuci, caqui, carambola, coquinho-jerivá, figo, goiaba, grumixama, ingá, jabuticaba, jaca, jambo, jambolão, limão-cravo, mamão, manga, nêspera, pitanga, romã, tamarindo e uvaia. Conhece a fruta por outro nome? Sugira.

QUATRO JEITOS DE VER O MAPA
Pixel, Ao pé da letra (cada fruta vira uma letra), Safra (só o que está dando) e Rua, com os nomes das ruas por cima quando você quiser.

FEITO PARA A RUA
• Entrar é simples: seu e-mail e um código de 6 números, sem senha para decorar.
• A localização só é usada quando você toca em GPS. A câmera, só quando você anexa uma foto.
• Dá para denunciar marcação errada, bloquear quem abusa e excluir a conta dentro do app.
• O app não mostra anúncios e não vende seus dados.

COLHA COM CUIDADO
Terreno particular é só para olhar: peça ao dono. Na calçada e na praça, colha pouco, com a mão, sem quebrar galho, e deixe fruta para os outros e para os passarinhos. Lave bem antes de comer.

O mapa começa por São Paulo e cresce com quem usa, em qualquer cidade. As safras são aproximadas e mudam de um lugar para outro.

Dados do mapa: © colaboradores do OpenStreetMap, via OpenFreeMap.
Dúvidas e sugestões: frutiferapp@gmail.com

name: Fullback: your work day
description:
Fullback is the daily work app for teams whose company runs on a Talent Alliance Hub system.

Open it and you see your day: the next step first, then the rest of your tasks. Tick a task when it is done. Talk to your team in the chat and attach a photo or a file from your phone.

WHAT YOU GET
- Today: your next step and your task list on one screen.
- Works with no signal: the app opens from your phone and sends what you did when the connection is back.
- Team chat with photos and files.
- Notifications that open the exact task or message.
- Face ID lock to keep work private.

ACCOUNTS
Your account is given to you by your company. There is no sign-up in the app. If you do not have an account, ask your company administrator.

You can ask for your account and data to be removed at any time in Settings.

name: G.Academy
seller_name: AHMED MOHAMED ADEL EZZAT EL SHAMY
description:
G.Academy brings your children's school, nursery and institute into one app.

Sign in with your mobile number and the app finds every school, nursery or institute your number belongs to. In several? Just choose.

For parents:
• Follow each child's attendance and teacher evaluations
• School news, events and photos
• Class chat with the teachers
• Fees, installments and due dates, a statement for each child, and receipts
• Online lessons, quizzes and live sessions when the school offers them

For students:
• Your lessons, quizzes, classes and school news

For teachers and school staff:
• Attendance and evaluations from the phone
• Publish news and run classes
• Collect fees and print receipts

Children's privacy first: each parent sees only their own children, and the app blocks screenshots on Android.

G.Academy by AcademyHost — GeoTech.

name: Garbo Solo
description:
Keep Every Card Alone.

Garbo is a two-player game by David Parlett, the card-game historian and inventor. You and your opponent build a 4 by 4 square of face-up cards, and every card wants to be alone: place one in line with another of its suit or rank, and your opponent scores.

- Level one: place cards next to the square, one at a time, until 16 make a 4 by 4.
- In line means anywhere along it: the same row, column or either diagonal, however far.
- Every match scores its value: spades 1 up to diamonds 4, Jack 5, King 6, 7 to 10 their number, Ace 11, Queen 12.
- Level two: the last 16 cards go on top. Cover a card of the same suit or rank and your opponent scores ten times its value.

In the app:

- A new opponent every game, at three levels: Normal, Hard and Elite.
- At Normal, each place shows what it would give away before you choose.
- One game, or a match of three.
- A Practice Round: watch a game with a guide, then play one with a hint on every turn.
- Quick Rules and a searchable Glossary, any time, even mid-game.
- Stats for each level, kept on your device.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no data collected. Plays offline.

Garbo is David Parlett's game, made with his kind permission. His rules and many more of his games are at parlettgames.uk.

name: Ghost Producer Tracks
description:
Explore Ghost Producer Tracks from your iPhone.

Browse the catalog, listen to watermarked previews and save your favorite tracks. Sign in to access your account, purchases and available downloads, or contact our team through live support.

For buyers:
• Discover music productions.
• Listen to previews before purchasing.
• Save tracks to your favorites.
• Purchase through the integrated website checkout.
• Access your purchases and available downloads.

For existing sellers:
• View your tracks and performance statistics.
• Check sales and earnings.
• Submit withdrawal requests.
• Contact support.

An internet connection is required. Account features require sign-in. Purchases are charged separately from the free app download.

name: Glance Kids – How Many?
description:
Glance Kids helps children aged 5–7 see how many things there are at a glance, without counting one by one. This skill, called subitizing, is an important building block for early maths.

HOW IT WORKS
A group of objects pops up – apples, rockets, puppies, balloons and more. Your child looks, then taps how many there are. Every answer is timed, so they can watch themselves get faster and faster.

12 LEVELS ON A COLOURFUL PATH
Start with 1–3 objects and work up to 18–24. Get every answer in a round right to unlock the next level. Answer quickly to earn up to 3 stars.

ADAPTS AS THEY IMPROVE
Fast, correct answers bring bigger groups; misses bring them back down, so every child plays at the right level.

REWARDS KIDS LOVE
• Stars, stickers and a daily streak
• Fun celebrations when a new level unlocks
• 78 kinds of objects so it never feels the same
• Pick your own animal face

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Up to 10 children, each with their own progress
• Parent page showing accuracy and answer speed over time
• Settings and parent areas protected by a press-and-hold gate
• Designed for iPad, with big, easy-to-see objects

SAFE AND PRIVATE
One-time purchase. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no account and no internet needed. Nothing leaves your device.

name: Golden Casino Golf Booking
description:
Golden Golf helps you keep track of your rounds and organize your golf plans in one place.
 Create a 9- or 18-hole round for two or more players. Record strokes hole by hole, resume an unfinished round, and review completed results.
 View a local leaderboard based on your saved rounds, including wins, games played, and average strokes per hole. 
 Browse course and golf cart listings, save favorites, and keep your preferred dates and equipment choices on your device.
Browse dishes and drinks, prepare a selection, and save it locally for reference.
 Import membership details from a compatible QR code or paste its contents manually. Imported details are stored on your device; membership is not verified with a club.
 Read practical guides and open external articles and video lessons in your browser. Explore the included venue and event information.
 No account is required. Your scores, plans, and imported card details are saved locally on your device.
 Reservations and food selections are personal records only. They are not sent to a club or kitchen and do not confirm availability or service. Contact the venue directly to arrange bookings, orders, and payment. Event tickets cannot be purchased in the app.
 External learning resources require an internet connection.

name: GolfedIn Club
description:
Better networking starts on the course.

GolfedIn is LinkedIn for golfers. Host or join a round, play with people who fit your goals, and keep the connection long after the 18th hole. Golf is the sport of business, and this is the tool built for it.

HOW IT WORKS
• Host or join a round. Post a tee time or join one that fits your schedule. You choose who can play with you by interests, goals, age and distance.
• Meet people who fit your goals. Looking for a mentor, a job, a hire, a partner or new friends? GolfedIn matches mentors with mentees and hiring managers with talent.
• Confirm the round together. A round counts once everyone in the group completes a quick survey, so every round on your profile is real.
• Share one lesson. Skip the scorecard. After each round, share one thing you learned, with an optional selfie, and your connections see it.
• Connect and message. Stay in touch with the people you've actually played with.
• Climb the leaderboards. Compete by week, month and year, and earn badges as you play.

BUILD A PROFILE THAT MATTERS
Show your work experience, education, goals and interests, plus your rating and verified rounds, so people know who they're meeting before the first tee.

YOU'RE IN CONTROL
Decline any request, leave any round, and block anyone at any time. Blocking is private.

INVITE YOUR PEOPLE
Every member gets a personal invite code. Bring the people you want to play with.

Whether you're a founder, an investor, a mentor, a recruiter, a new hire or just someone who plays better with good company, GolfedIn puts the right people on the same fairway.

Download GolfedIn and book your first round.

name: GPF Logica
description:
GPF Logica è un gioco di ragionamento con cinque tipi di quesito: serie numeriche, matrici di figure, intrusi, rotazioni e analogie numeriche.

Ogni partita è composta da venti quesiti, quattro per ciascuno dei cinque livelli di difficoltà, con i diversi tipi alternati. Si parte da regole semplici e si arriva a quesiti più insidiosi. Per ogni quesito scegli una risposta tra cinque opzioni.

I quesiti
• Serie numeriche: trova il numero che completa la serie.
• Matrici: una griglia 3×3 di figure segue regole su forma, riempimento e numero; trova la figura mancante.
• Intruso: tra cinque figure, quale non c'entra con le altre?
• Rotazioni: quale figura è quella di partenza solo ruotata, e non specchiata?
• Analogie: dalle coppie d'esempio ricava la regola e applicala a un nuovo numero.

Come funziona
• I quesiti non sono presi da libri o test esistenti: nascono da regole e sono generati dall'app.
• Ogni quesito ha una sola risposta corretta rispetto alle regole che l'app conosce.
• Alla fine vedi quante risposte hai dato giuste, il tempo impiegato e un punteggio da 0 a 100.

Pensato per te
• Salvataggio automatico: puoi chiudere l'app in qualsiasi momento e riprendere la partita dal punto in cui eri.
• Sincronizzazione con iCloud, che puoi attivare o spegnere dalle Impostazioni: se è accesa, la partita in corso, l'ultimo risultato e il tuo nome ti seguono sui tuoi dispositivi; spenta, o senza iCloud, si gioca in locale. Da spenta puoi anche cancellare i dati da iCloud.
• Impostazioni di aspetto: alto contrasto, dimensione del testo, sfondo uniforme e un cronometro facoltativo per ogni quesito.
• Inserisci il tuo nome una volta sola.
• Una schermata Informazioni spiega come funziona il gioco, i limiti dichiarati e i dati salvati.
• Aspetto in bianco e nero, con caratteri a stampa, sobrio e leggibile.
• Etichette pensate per VoiceOver.

Importante
GPF Logica è un gioco di logica a scopo di intrattenimento. Non è un test psicologico o di intelligenza e non produce un QI: il punteggio da 0 a 100 è la quota di difficoltà dei quesiti risolti, con pesi ipotizzati, e non è confrontabile con altri giocatori.

name: Grade Hippo: Grades Tracker
description:
GradeHippo turns your school's gradebook into something you actually want to open.

Sign in with the same student ID and password for your school's grading system and GradeHippo shows your grades, schedule and attendance in a cleaner, faster app.

EVERY CLASS AT A GLANCE
• Letter grade and percent for every class, with new grades marked since you last looked
• Your GPA, unweighted and weighted, with honors and AP classes you can adjust

SEE WHAT MOVED YOUR GRADE
• Category weights, broken down the way your teacher's gradebook counts them
• Every assignment with its score and percent

WHAT DO I NEED?
• Pick the grade you want and GradeHippo works out the score you need on your next assignment
• What-if mode: change a score or add an assignment that doesn't exist yet and watch your grade update. Nothing is sent to your school

YOUR SCHOOL DAY
• Today's bell schedule with rooms and teachers, and which class is up next
• Attendance by day and by class: absences, tardies and what's excused
• Hall passes, if your school uses them, with a heads-up when your pass changes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking

Find your district by zip code or your location, sign in, and you're done. Not sure yet? Tap "Try the demo" to look around with made-up grades.

GradeHippo is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Edupoint Educational Systems or any school district. StudentVUE is a trademark of Edupoint Educational Systems, LLC. GPA, what-if and "what do I need" figures are estimates; your school's records are official.

name: Grid Sweep Field
description:
Grid Sweep Field is the searcher's app for a Grid Sweep missing-person search. The command post runs the search from one live map; this app puts your part of it on your phone.

JOIN IN SECONDS
No account needed. Scan the QR code at the command post or on the missing-person flyer, sign in with your name, emergency contact and skills, read the briefing, and you're on the search.

YOUR GRID, ON YOUR PHONE
See the subject's photo and description, the last known position, and the grid you've been assigned. Directions take you to your grid; the map shows your own track so you know what ground you've actually covered.

CLUES, MESSAGES AND SOS
Drop a pin and a photo when you find something; command triages it. Get messages sent to you, your team or everyone in the field. Hold to send an SOS with your position when you need help.

ROLL CALL
When command asks everyone to check in, one slide confirms you're OK.

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
Your position, clues and messages wait on the phone when you lose coverage and send the moment you reconnect. Command sees where every searcher has been, grid by grid, so cleared ground is never searched twice.

FOR THE COMMAND POST
Command runs the search in a browser or on the iPad app at wayfound.smallbatch.solutions: open the incident, grid the map, check volunteers in, watch live positions and coverage, take roll calls, track weather, and print the flyer and after-action report.

Grid Sweep Field shares your location with the command post for the duration of a search you have joined, including in the background, so command can see where every searcher is and how much of each grid has been covered. Location sharing ends when you leave the search.

Grid Sweep is a proof of concept. It is not connected to CAD or CJIS systems; all information is entered manually by the command post. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Gridleaf: Step-by-Step Algebra
description:
Gridleaf works maths problems out on your iPhone and shows how, one line at a time, the way you would write them on squared paper. Then it gives you a new problem of the same kind to try yourself.

Type a problem on the built-in maths keyboard, or photograph a printed worksheet or textbook page and pick the problem Gridleaf found. A line under what you type shows how it has been read, before you solve.

It solves:
- arithmetic with brackets and powers, worked one operation at a time, plus fractions, mixed numbers, decimals and percentages
- linear equations and linear inequalities in one unknown, including brackets and fractions (and it tells you when an inequality flips)
- quadratic equations, three ways: factoring (with the AC method), the quadratic formula and completing the square
- systems of two or three linear equations, by elimination
- exponent rules, simplifying square roots, and expanding and collecting polynomials
- derivatives with the power, product, quotient and chain rules, including sin, cos, tan, e^x, ln and log

Every answer is checked: Gridleaf substitutes it back into the original problem, or for a derivative compares it with the measured slope of the curve. Equations and derivatives come with a graph.

After any solution, "Try a similar one" writes a fresh problem of the same type for you. Type your answer and Gridleaf checks it, telling you if one of two roots is missing or an inequality points the wrong way. Stuck? Hints open one step at a time, and you choose when to see the working. The Practice tab lets you pick a topic directly, and the Notebook keeps your solved problems and shows which topics you have practised and how often you got them right.

What it doesn't do: it reads printed text, not handwriting. It doesn't solve equations of degree three or more, trigonometric or exponential equations, quadratic inequalities, integrals or word problems. Exponent and radical rules assume the variables are positive.

Gridleaf does all of its maths on the device with its own algebra engine, so it works without an internet connection. There is no account, no ads, no in-app purchases and no analytics, and your notebook stays on your iPhone.

name: GRJ Office
description:
GRJ Office is a complete workforce management app for construction and site teams. Manage attendance, location check-ins, salary payouts, KYC, purchases, leaves, and daily site operations — all from one place.

ATTENDANCE & LOCATION
• Punch in / punch out with live GPS verification
• Background location tracking during active work shifts
• Site-based presence checks for accurate attendance

SALARY & PAYOUTS
• Monthly salary sheets with Basic, HRA, PF and ESI
• Auto calculation based on payable days and attendance
• Generate and share professional payslips

STAFF & KYC
• Employee profiles, roles and site assignments
• KYC requests and document workflow
• Leave allocation and leave management

PURCHASES & OPERATIONS
• Record and track purchases with photos
• Inward / outward and store management
• Day-end activity reports for site work

TEAM COMMUNICATION
• In-app chat for quick coordination
• Camera and media support for work updates
• Push notifications for important alerts

Built for field staff, supervisors and office teams who need reliable site operations every day.

Download GRJ Office and run your workforce smoother.

name: Groovefy
description:
Stop listening to the same 50 songs on repeat.

Groovefy is your AI music companion for discovering new music you'll actually love. Just describe the moment — "late-night drive", "focus for a final exam", "Sunday morning coffee" — and Groovefy builds a playlist in seconds and saves it straight to your Apple Music library.

DISCOVER, DON'T REPEAT
Most apps recommend what you already know. Groovefy goes the other way: it uses your taste as a compass and finds artists close to what you love — but that you probably haven't heard yet. Every playlist is a chance to meet your next favorite artist.

MADE FOR YOUR TASTE
Tell us your favorite genres, artists and the moments you listen to music, and every recommendation gets smarter and more personal.

PLAYLISTS FOR ANY MOMENT
Studying, working out, driving, getting ready, chilling with friends — describe it in your own words and let Groovefy set the mood.

YOUR MUSIC, AT A GLANCE
• For This Moment: Week Favorites, Groove Match, Global Hits and Recently Played, one tap away
• Charts: your top songs, artists and albums across different time ranges
• Share cards: turn your tops into beautiful images ready for your stories

SEAMLESS WITH APPLE MUSIC
Sign in with Apple Music, and every playlist you create is saved to your library, ready to play anywhere. Your profile syncs with iCloud, so it's there whenever you come back.

Groovefy requires an Apple Music subscription to play music.

Your next favorite song is waiting. Start grooving.

name: GualiBot
description:
GualiBot gives you a team of Gualis: AI assistants that do tasks on the web for you. Each Guali has its own computer in the cloud, so it keeps working after you close the app.

Ask the way you would ask a person:
• Compare flights or insurance and pick the best price
• Book a table or an appointment
• Fill in a long form
• Find suppliers and list their contacts
• Write a report with what it finds

IT MESSAGES YOU WHEN IT NEEDS YOU
When it finishes something or needs your OK, you get a notification with its face. Tap it and you're in its chat, with buttons to approve or decline.

WATCH IT WORK
Open a Guali's screen and follow each step live. If a site asks for a code or a captcha, take over, solve it, and the Guali carries on.

A TEAM, NOT A CHAT
Make a Guali for each job and group them in projects. A team lead hands out the work and tells you what each one is doing.

YOUR LOGINS, IN THE VAULT
Save the usernames and passwords you want your Gualis to use. They only use the logins you save.

ALSO
• Voice notes and photos from your iPhone
• Files that stay on your cloud computer
• Images made by your Gualis

You need a GualiBot account to use the app. If you don't have one yet, ask for access at gualibot.com.

What you send to your Gualis is processed by third-party AI models so they can answer and act. More at gualibot.com/privacy.

name: Habitech: Todo & Habit Tracker
description:
Habitech is a habit and task tracker built around one idea: habits stick when you do them with someone.

Start a chain with a close friend or a group of up to 10. Quit smoking together, read more together, drop a bad habit and build a good one. When everyone does their part that day, the chain grows. If someone slips, the others can cheer them on, and you can take a break or use a rescue together.

TOGETHER
• Invite friends with a simple link, or pick them from your friends list
• Edit the invite message however you like; the link is added automatically
• Group board: see who's done today and everyone's week at a glance
• Cheer on friends with a quick preset message (limited, so it never turns into spam)
• Nudges, breaks, rescues and a weekly "our week" summary
• Add a "Pledge": a friendly agreement between two people, outside the app. No money moves in the app

YOUR OWN TRACKER
• Tasks and habits: today, upcoming; timed, counted and percentage tasks
• Streaks, weekly goals and reminders
• Calendar with a weekly summary and monthly rings
• Focus timer for timed tasks
• Stats: success rate, golden hour, heat map
• An icon and colour for every task, plus steps, notes and photos

PRIVACY
Your tasks stay on your phone. An account is only needed for Shared Chain, and you can delete it any time inside the app. Habitech is not a medical app and does not give medical advice.

Available in English, Turkish and 9 more languages.

Privacy: https://awaitlabs.io/products/habitech/privacy
Terms: https://awaitlabs.io/products/habitech/terms

name: Halvex
description: Halvex is an offline notebook for a straight fretboard. A fret place uses the twelfth root of two, and fret 12 lands at half the scale. The space between two frets is the difference of those places. String spacing takes one edge off each side of the nut and divides by the gaps. One compensation is added to the scale for the saddle. A tuner wrap is added to each string.

MISSIONS AND FAME
• Survive a horde of Divas charging right at you
• Stand up to the chip gang
• Stop the inmates who broke out of the asylum
• Track down the wanted criminal
Complete missions to earn cash and fame and unlock new missions.

THE CITY IS YOURS
• A living city, by day and by night
• Cars, a helicopter, planes, boats and jet skis
• Tune your car in the garage, change your style at the barber
• Jobs on the map: courier, taxi, races and more

EASY CONTROLS
Touch controls made for touchscreens: a joystick on foot; in the car, steer on the left, gas and brake on the right.

Ready to turn the city upside down?

name: Haq Jol — Radar navigator
description:
Haq Jol — радар-навигатор для водителей Каракалпакстана. Вместе с Мийрибеком Джуматовым.

НАВИГАТОР
• Радары, камеры, «Стрелка», участки средней скорости и посты ДПС — понятные значки на карте, лимит скорости прямо на значке.
• Голосовые предупреждения на каракалпакском, узбекском и русском. Звук идёт из колонок автомобиля, даже когда играет музыка по Bluetooth; навигатор продолжает работать при выключенном экране.
• Найдите адрес или отметьте точку на карте — маршрут, расстояние и время, следующий манёвр, пробки. При построении маршрута видно, сколько радаров на пути.
• Если в зоне радара скорость была выше лимита, приложение запишет это в журнал и пришлёт уведомление.
• Переносные радары («треноги») и посты ДПС отмечают сами водители — кнопка «Radar bar».

МЕТАН
• Очереди на метановых заправках Нукуса и Ходжейли — отмечают водители, видят все.
• Оценки заправок и чат водителей.

МАРКЕТ
• Автострахование, Европротокол, аксессуары, автосервис, шины — объявления в одном месте. Разместите своё объявление.

ПДД
• Правила дорожного движения, 283 знака, штрафы и AI-помощник.

Вход — имя, номер телефона и номер автомобиля, по SMS-коду. Без пароля. Аккаунт можно удалить в приложении: Jáne → «Akkauntty óshiriw».

Важно: Haq Jol не является официальным приложением государственного органа. База радаров носит справочный характер; на дороге всегда руководствуйтесь знаками.

Использование GPS в фоновом режиме может сокращать время работы аккумулятора.

name: Harora
description: Harora is an offline notebook for moving batter between two pans. A rectangle is width times length. A round pan is π times the radius twice. The new batter is the old grams times the new area, divided by the old area, using the full areas. Depth times area is cubic inches. Cups use 16 divided by 231, because one US gallon is 231 cubic inches and 16 cups.

name: HealthPro Academy
description:
HealthPro Academy is the study app for students of thehealthproacademy.com. Sign in with your existing account and take your courses anywhere.

PREPARE FOR YOUR LICENSING EXAM
HealthPro Academy courses help nurses, pharmacists, technicians and allied health professionals prepare for Gulf licensing exams, such as DHA, DOH and MOH exams delivered by Prometric or Pearson VUE.

• Continue where you left off: your home screen shows your courses and progress.
• Watch video lessons, with resume where you stopped.

• Practise with question banks and see the right answer and explanation after each question.

name: Hearers
description:
Hearers helps you and your family learn the confessions of the church by heart.

"Be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only." (James 1:22)

WHAT YOU CAN LEARN
• The Westminster Shorter and Larger Catechisms and the Westminster Confession
• The Heidelberg Catechism, the Belgic Confession and the Canons of Dort
• Luther's Small and Large Catechisms
• The Apostles', Nicene, Athanasian and Chalcedonian creeds
• The Ten Commandments
• Any passage of Scripture, in the King James Version

HOW IT WORKS
Hearers asks for an answer one clause at a time. Then it shows the answer, and you say how well you knew it. Spaced repetition (FSRS) brings each answer back just before you would forget it, so a few minutes each day is enough.

• Every proof text opens in the King James Version
• "Listen" reads each answer aloud
• Daily reminders on your device
• Back up your progress to a file, or sync with your own Hearers server

PRIVATE
Hearers has no account, no advertisements and no tracking. Your answers and your progress stay on your device. The readings are in the app, so it works with no connection.

FREE
Hearers is free, and its code is open source.

name: Hearken: Emotions in Scripture
description:
Navigating Emotions with the Church Fathers and Mothers.

Hearken is a quiet companion for Coptic Orthodox life, made for the moments when a feeling needs a holy word. Open the app to "Today I am feeling," choose how you feel (angry, anxious, alone, sad, in despair, afraid, ashamed, grateful, joyful, or blessed), and receive three things that belong together:

- A verse of Scripture
- A saying of the Church Fathers or the Church Mothers
- A related prayer, psali, or liturgical text of the Coptic Church

A new reading every day. Each feeling has its own cycle of three to four weeks of readings, so you meet a different verse, saying, and prayer each day. Tap "Another" any time for more, and "Back to today" to return to the day's reading. Every saying and prayer shows its source.

The Church Fathers and Mothers. Hear St. Athanasius, St. Cyril of Alexandria, St. Anthony the Great, and St. John Chrysostom, along with the desert mothers Amma Syncletica and Amma Sarah. The Mothers' sayings are quoted word for word from historic English editions (Budge's Paradise of the Holy Fathers, Butler's and Baring-Gould's Lives of the Saints), and the Fathers' sayings come from classic translations, some in lightly modernized wording. The prayers come from the Coptic Agpeya, the Divine Liturgy, and the psalis of the daily office, in the classic translations of Bute and O'Leary.

Journal. Keep one entry a day, beginning with the same "Today I am feeling" prompt. Choose one or more feelings and write freely.

Growth. Keep a simple rule of life: the daily Agpeya (with a check for each hour), daily Scripture reading, weekly Liturgy and Communion, confession (with an optional monthly reminder), almsgiving, and works of service. See your streaks and recent days and weeks at a glance.

Make it yours. Choose a color palette (Maroon & White by default, plus Navy & Ice Blue, Forest, Sepia, Slate, and High Contrast) or a custom accent color, and adjust the reading text size, bold, and italic. Highlight a verse, a saying, or a prayer, and the mark stays with it.

Everything stays on your device. Hearken has no accounts, no ads, no analytics, and no tracking. All readings are built into the app and work offline. Your journal, Growth checkmarks, highlights, and settings never leave your phone.

Works on iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode, with Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support.

Scripture quotations are from the American Standard Version (1901), with Sir Lancelot C. L. Brenton's English Septuagint (1851) for the deuterocanonical books. Both are in the public domain.

name: Heli Combat - 1967
description:
Heli Combat 1967 is a top-down helicopter rescue game. Somewhere on every island, eight downed pilots are waiting for you. Fly in, find them, hover low enough for them to climb the rope ladder and bring them home to the H. Everything else on the island wants you gone.

SEARCH, DESTROY, RESCUE
• Pilots wait in the open or are locked inside fenced huts. Bomb the hut open, then pick them up.
• Up to eight pilots fit on board. Land on the H to drop them off.
• Fuel is the clock. Run dry and the mission is over, so plan your route.
• Guns and bombs are limited. Land on the H to refuel, repair and re-arm, paid for with points.

SIX HAND-MADE ISLANDS
• Delta Dawn, Iron Road, Dragon Spine, Lagoon Ring, Fortress Harbour and Jungle Airfield.
• Jungle, rice paddies, beaches, railways and harbours, each island with its own layout.
• Islands unlock in order. Your best score for each one is saved.
• Your armour carries over: only half of it is repaired between missions.

EVERYTHING SHOOTS BACK
• Anti-aircraft guns, rocket launchers, bunkers and factories.
• Tanks, trucks and armoured trains on the move.
• Gunboats and heavy warships off the coast.
• Enemy choppers, and from the second island jet fighters that fire heat-seeking rockets.
• Shot-down aircraft crash into whatever is below them. Use that.
• Wipe out every target on an island for a destruction bonus.

EASY TO FLY
• Floating stick on the left: the Cobra turns and flies where you push.
• Hold GUN for auto-fire, tap BOMB to drop. A sight shows where the bombs land.
• Minimap of the whole island, folds away with a tap.
• Portrait or landscape on iPhone and iPad.

NO NONSENSE
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no tracking. Works offline.
• Sound effects can be switched off in Settings, and the game respects the silent switch.

Art by chabull from OpenGameArt (CC-BY 3.0), modified.

name: Helik Konobar

• Brzo kucanje narudžbi po kategorijama i artiklima, sa slikama artikala
• Prilozi i izmjene stavki prije slanja
• Narudžbe odmah stižu na šank, u kuhinju i na kasu
• Prijava PIN-om, odvojeno za svakog konobara

• Upozorenje pri zatvaranju smjene
• Više tema izgleda, svijetle i tamne

Aplikacija radi uz Helik sistem objekta. Uređaj se aktivira jednokratnim kodom ili QR kodom koji dobijate od administratora objekta.

name: Helik Owner
description:
Helik Owner donosi stanje vašeg ugostiteljskog objekta na telefon.

• Promet izabranog dana i poređenje s jučerašnjim
• Promet po satima, terminalima, konobarima i grupama artikala
• Preglednik računa i narudžbi, s detaljima stavki i storna

• Obavještenja o storniranim računima, otkazanim narudžbama, popustima, zatvaranju dana i smjene, ulazu robe i minimalnim zalihama
• Tihi sati i pragovi za obavještenja

Aplikacija je namijenjena vlasnicima objekata koji koriste Helik sistem. Aktivira se jednokratnim kodom, a prijava ide korisnikom iz Helik backoffice-a.

name: HelpMe Logistics

HelpMe Logistics brings delivery and ride operations together in one app for riders and logistics teams.

For riders

View and manage delivery and ride jobs.
Navigate to pickup and drop-off locations.
Update job progress and share your location while working.
Review job history, earnings and payout details.

Manage courier or vehicle-hire operations.

name: hey gefma
description:
Frag die gefma-Richtlinien – und sieh, worauf sie beruhen.

Stell deine Frage in Alltagssprache, tippe sie ein oder sprich sie einfach ins Handy. hey gefma antwortet auf Basis der Richtlinien und zeigt dir, auf welche Gesetze, Verordnungen, Normen und technischen Regeln sie sich stützen.

Das ganze Facility Management, nicht nur der Betrieb
• Grundlagen und Begriffe des FM, Leistungsspektrum und Prozesse
• Betreiberverantwortung, Dokumentation und FM-Recht
• Kosten, Lebenszykluskosten, Kennzahlen und Benchmarking
• Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Verträge, auch für internationale FM-Projekte
