• Qualitätsmanagement, kritische Infrastrukturen sowie Aus- und Weiterbildung

Was hey gefma für dich tut
• Beantwortet beliebige Fragen zu den gefma-Richtlinien, geschrieben oder gesprochen
• Zeigt dir zu jeder Antwort die Fundstelle in der Richtlinie und deren regulatorische Grundlage
• Führt dich mit wenigen Tippern von der Richtlinie bis zur einschlägigen Passage oder zum Paragraphen im Gesetz oder in der Norm
• Macht Zusammenhänge sichtbar, die sonst über viele Dokumente verstreut sind

Für wen:
Für Betreiber, FM-Verantwortliche, Objekt- und Gebäudemanager, Dienstleister, Einkäufer, Berater und alle, die mit den gefma-Richtlinien arbeiten.
Voraussetzung
Für die Nutzung braucht man eine gültige Lizenz. gefma-Mitglieder loggen sich mit ihrem gefma-Account ein. Mehr dazu unter info@gefma.de
Hinweis: hey gefma unterstützt dich bei der Recherche, ersetzt aber keine Rechtsberatung. Maßgeblich bleibt der Wortlaut der jeweiligen Vorschrift.

name: Higati: Navigation & Traffic
description:
Higati is a navigation app made in Israel for drivers who want to know what is ahead.

DRIVE SMARTER
• Turn-by-turn voice navigation with clear arrows, lanes and real road signs
• Guidance keeps going with the screen off or another app open
• Live traffic: jams on the map, an arrival time that counts them, and a faster route when one appears
• Several routes side by side with time, distance and fuel cost
• Car, bike or walking

ON THE ROAD
• Police, speed cameras, crashes, roadworks and hazards reported by drivers
• Speed limit on screen and a warning when you go over it
• Report what you see in one tap

AROUND YOU
• Gas stations, EV chargers, parking, food and urgent care nearby, with opening hours
• AI Higati: ask for a place in your own words, in Hebrew, English, Russian and more
• Voice search: tap the microphone and say where you want to go
• Weather on your way

YOUR CAR
• The car's big screen: open Higati in your car's web browser and link it to your phone

TOGETHER
• See friends on the map and meet on the way

Higati works without an account. An account (free) adds your profile, friends and syncing your saved places between devices; you can delete it in the app at any time.

Higati works in Hebrew, English, Russian, Arabic and many more languages.

Your location is used only to navigate, show traffic and send the reports you choose to share. No ads, no tracking.

Privacy policy: https://higati.com/privacy/
Terms of use: https://higati.com/terms/
Support: support@higati.com

name: Hivebound : Find Your Crew
description:
Hivebound keeps your group findable in crowds.

At festivals, concerts, theme parks and other busy events, phone networks get jammed and maps stop loading. Hivebound is built for that. Its main screen is a simple list, not a map: who is in your group, how far away they are, an arrow pointing toward them, and how fresh each position is.

HOW IT WORKS
- Start a group and show the QR code, or send the invite link. Friends join in one tap.
- Each phone shares its position with the group whenever any data gets through.
- Friends nearby swap positions directly over Bluetooth, even when the network is down.
- Find uses ultra-wideband on supported iPhones to guide you the last few meters.
- Tap "I'm lost" and everyone in your group gets an alert.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no email, no phone number.
- Positions are encrypted on your phone before they leave it. The server only holds sealed data and can never read it.
- Data expires on the server after 72 hours.
- Location is shared only with the people in your group, and only after you start the app. You can leave the group at any time.
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics.

BUILT FOR GLANCING
Dark, high-contrast, large text, made to read in a few seconds with the sun in your eyes or the lights low. Pick a color and an emoji so friends spot you quickly.

Hivebound is a convenience for meeting up. It is not a safety or emergency service: if someone needs help, contact event staff or emergency services.

Needs iPhone with iOS 17.6 or later. Find needs iPhone 11 or later.

name: Holiday Lights - House Map
description:
See every decorated house near you, mapped and ready to visit.

Holiday Lights shows Halloween and Christmas displays added by people in your own town. Browse the map, check photos before you go, and search by theme, like zombies or the Grinch, so your family finds exactly what they love.

Found a great display? Add it, rate it, and leave a comment so other families know what to expect. Browsing the map and photos is free for everyone.

- Map of every decorated house for Halloween and Christmas
- Add, rate, and comment on houses
- Photos of each display so you know what you'll see
- Search photos by theme, from spooky to classic
- Optional route planning so you see more houses in less driving

Halloween season runs through early November. Christmas season starts right after Thanksgiving and runs into the new year. Open the app and start finding houses near you.

name: Holtix
description: Holtix is an offline notebook for one exposure setup. Square the f-number, multiply by the shutter denominator, and take log base 2. ISO 100 is zero, and a higher ISO subtracts its stop count from that light value. Compare two apertures, two shutters, or two ISO values. If the aperture closes by a whole number of stops, divide the shutter denominator by 2 to that power so the exposure stays the same.

name: Holy Pages: Scroll the Bible
description:
Read the Bible one verse at a time. Holy Pages helps you build a daily Scripture reading habit, discover illustrated Bible stories, and pick up right where you left off.

• Read the entire Bible. Browse all 66 books of the Old and New Testaments, from Genesis to Revelation. Choose a translation, including the King James Version (KJV), and read at your own pace in a verse-by-verse feed.
• Open your Verse of the Day. Unseal a daily Bible verse and take a moment to reflect. Share a verse as an image with friends or family.
• Find Scripture for what you’re feeling. Explore collections of Bible verses for moments of anxiety, gratitude, and more, or discover illustrated stories like Creation and the parting of the Red Sea.
• Make daily reading a habit. Set a reading goal, follow your streak, and see your progress across verses, chapters, and books.
• Keep meaningful verses close. Bookmark passages to revisit, add notes as you study, and resume reading from your saved place.

Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://amber-pixie-75a.notion.site/Holy-Pages-Privacy-Policy-418d7c6987ca804d9af0e402c4a50b80

name: HoniShow
description:
HoniShow turns the photos already on your device into a short comic, and keeps the whole thing on the device.

Start from Photos, or from pictures you have set aside in the bin. A series can hold several episodes. Each episode is a sequence of panels, with a caption and a speaker on every frame. Play it back one panel at a time, then make a cut and share it when you want to. You choose where it goes.

Write the lines first if you prefer. A script is a board of frames. When the lines are ready, open an episode with photos from your library, from the bin, or with the built-in pictures. People you name in the cast can speak the lines. Originals in the bin stay there after a series is made.

Slice one photo into panels, side by side, stacked, or in a grid, and save that as an episode. Make a cover for the series. Reorder panels, change a caption, and set how long each frame holds.

There is no account. HoniShow does not collect data. Import and playback settings stay on this device, and the series you make stay with it.

name: HORIZON SPI
description:
Built with a focus on clarity and thoughtful design, this app brings training records into a clean, easy-to-read interface so reviewing your work feels simple and unhurried.

We believe useful tools should make the numbers easier to see. That is why it is designed to help you keep a private log of practice, watch how load and time change, and manage daily mass and intake with greater confidence.

With a commitment to reliability and records that stay on this phone, it offers a quieter, more organized way to understand your training data over time.

name: HotelNative: Hotel Manager
description:
HotelNative is the phone app for the people who run small hotels, villas and guesthouses.

EVERY CHANNEL, ONE CALENDAR
Bookings from Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia and your own website appear in one calendar. Change a price, set a minimum stay or close a night and HotelNative sends it to every channel through Channex.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
Who arrives, who leaves, who is in the house, the money on the books by channel and the latest activity, the moment you open the app.

BOOKINGS AND REQUESTS
Every reservation with its guest, dates, amount and messages. Confirm or decline a direct request, take a reservation on the phone, change dates or cancel.

CHECK-IN
Check guests in and out and photograph their passports. ID photos are encrypted, shown only to your team, and deleted 90 days after the stay.

YOUR TEAM
Add the people who run the front desk and housekeeping. Each signs in with their own account and sees only your hotel.

GETTING STARTED
Create your account in the app with your email, name your hotel, and connect your channels when you are ready (we help with the first Channex connection). HotelNative is free while in early access; nothing is sold inside the app.

HotelNative is made by Almaorb, LLC in Miami, Florida.
Privacy: https://hotelnative.com/privacy
Terms: https://hotelnative.com/terms
Support: https://hotelnative.com/support

name: huch — Карго хяналт
description:
huch — track your cargo from China to Mongolia in one place.

If you shop on Taobao, 1688 or Pinduoduo and ship through a cargo company, huch follows your parcel from the moment it reaches the cargo company's warehouse in China (Guangzhou, Shanghai, Yiwu, Beijing, Hohhot, Erlian…) until it is in your hands.

• Copy your cargo address in one tap — your personal China warehouse address with your customer code, ready to paste into any shop; pick the city if the company has several warehouses.
• Add a tracking number or scan its barcode — when the parcel arrives it is linked to your order with weight and price.
• Route tracking — China warehouse → Erlian–Zamyn-Üüd border → Sainshand → Ulaanbaatar, with a map and a dated step for every stage.
• Choose your cargo company — compare rates, exchange rates, experience and licences of the companies on the platform.
• Pay from your phone — top up your wallet with QPay and pay for orders instantly; your transaction history is kept.
• Home delivery — pick up at a branch or request delivery to your door.
• Notifications — when the parcel arrives at the warehouse, crosses the border and reaches Ulaanbaatar.
• AI assistant — answers questions about your orders and payments and hands over to a human operator when needed.

Sign up with just your phone number. huch.mn

huch — БНХАУ-аас Монгол руу ирэх ачаагаа нэг дороос хянах апп.

Taobao, 1688, Pinduoduo зэрэг Хятадын онлайн дэлгүүрээс захиалсан бараагаа карго компаниар оруулж ирдэг бол huch таны ачааг карго компанийн БНХАУ дахь агуулахад (Гуанжоу, Шанхай, Ивү, Бээжин, Хөх хот, Эрээн…) орсноос эхлээд гарт тань очих хүртэл хянана.

• Карго хаягаа нэг товчоор хуулна
Таны кодтой БНХАУ дахь агуулахын хаягийг онлайн дэлгүүрийнхээ хүргэлтийн хаягт шууд буулгана. Компани хэд хэдэн хотод агуулахтай бол аль ойрыг нь сонгоно.

• Аялалын дугаараа нэмээд л хянана
Хятадын хүргэлтийн компанийн дугаарыг бичих эсвэл баркодыг камераар уншуулна. Бараа агуулахад ирмэгц таны захиалгад холбогдож, жин, төлбөр нь харагдана.

• Замын хяналт
БНХАУ дахь агуулах → Эрээн – Замын-Үүд хил → Сайншанд → Улаанбаатар: ачаа тань хаана явааг газрын зураг, алхам бүрийн огноотой харна.

• Карго компаниа өөрөө сонго
Платформд нэгдсэн карго компаниудын үнэ, ханш, туршлага, тусгай зөвшөөрлийг харьцуулж сонгоно.

• Төлбөрөө утаснаасаа
Хэтэвчээ QPay-ээр цэнэглээд захиалгынхаа төлбөрийг шууд төлнө. Гүйлгээний түүх тань хадгалагдана.

• Гэртээ хүргүүлэх
Ирсэн бараагаа салбараас авах эсвэл хүргэлтийн компаниар гэртээ хүргүүлэх хүсэлтээ аппаас өгнө.

• Мэдэгдэл
Бараа агуулахад ирэх, хилээр гарах, Улаанбаатарт ирэх үед мэдэгдэл авна.

• AI туслах
«Миний захиалга хаана явж байна?», «Төлөх төлбөр хэд вэ?» гэх мэт асуултад шууд хариулна; шаардлагатай бол оператор руу шилжүүлнэ.

Бүртгүүлэхэд утасны дугаар хангалттай. huch.mn

name: Hue Haul
description:
The dock is three bays away. The gate in front of you is shut. Do you take the long way around, or can you make the next scan on the way?

Hue Haul is a parcel-routing puzzle set in a depot after dark. Tap lit bays to move your parcel across an enamel sorting board. Work around striped gates, visit any scan stops in order, and deliver to the bay that matches the destination label.

NIGHT SHIFT
Every delivery brings a new board. As your shift gets longer, the clock gets tighter and some parcels need a scan before they can go to the dock. See how many deliveries you can finish in one run.

ROUTE BOOK
Take on multiple handcrafted routes with a move limit and no countdown. Later routes open up to 4 by 4 boards and ask you to plan several stops in sequence. Each route shows the move target for a Perfect mark. Beat a route once to unlock the next, then come back to trim your detours.

Bay letters help you read the board alongside color. Play solo without signing in. Your best shift, route progress, and Perfect marks are saved on your device.

name: Ideal Market Hyannis
description:
Ideal Butchery & Market is Cape Cod's Brazilian market, now in your pocket.

Browse the whole store — over 10,000 products — straight from our shelves: Brazilian butcher cuts, bakery, deli & cheese, produce, groceries and drinks. Prices and photos come right from the store's system and update on their own.

• Butcher cuts by the pound: pick an approximate weight; the final price is confirmed on the store's scale.
• Fast search in English or Portuguese (picanha, pão de queijo, guaraná…).
• Cart and card checkout, then pick up at the store.
• Thanksgiving pre-orders.
• English and Portuguese.

Visit us: 213 W Main St, Hyannis, MA 02601 · (508) 737-1116
Mon–Sat 6 AM–9 PM · Sun 7 AM–7 PM

name: Idle Genesis: Origin of Life
description:
Start in a primordial ocean and guide life all the way to the first civilizations.

Idle Genesis is a calm incremental game about evolution. Your creatures keep producing DNA while you are away; check in, upgrade, unlock the next species, and move one era forward. Offline progress is settled when you return.

17 ERAS, 115 CREATURES
From the Precambrian to the Copper Age, 115 species and 88 technologies trace the long chain of evolution. Each era brings its own deep-sea palette and animated scenery, and every creature moves with skeletal animation, sounds and voice clips.

EVOLVE, BREED, COLLECT
Level up species, breed variants and fill the handbook. A technology tree keeps output flowing, while neurons upgraded with culture fluid multiply every tech gain.

REBIRTH, THEN GO FURTHER
When progress peaks, start a new run. The helper robot, bio-pods, life tree and crystals carry permanent boosts, so every cycle reaches farther than the last.

A LITTLE EVERY DAY
Daily sign-in, online rewards, timed boosts, offline earnings, quests and treasure boxes. Progress saves automatically - play for a minute or stay a while.

A glowing deep-sea interface that changes color with each era, built for one-handed play. No twitch reflexes, just one long line of life moving forward.

name: IETCS Chat
description:
IETCS Chat — manage your company's WhatsApp business conversations in one place.

UNIFIED INBOX
• All your official WhatsApp numbers in a single inbox.
• Send text, photos, videos, files, and voice messages with a built-in player.
• Approved WhatsApp templates, quick replies, and emoji.
• Internal notes that customers never see.

TEAM ORGANIZATION
• Auto-assign conversations to the first responder, or reassign manually.
• Automatic assignment log in internal notes.
• Team directory with roles and availability.

DASHBOARD & TOOLS
• Company stats: conversations, messages, unread, and today's activity.
• Message traffic charts and per-account distribution.
• Tools: campaigns, tickets, contacts, channels, templates, quick replies.

REAL-TIME NOTIFICATIONS
• Instant push alerts with customizable sounds (7 tones).
• Background operation to receive messages anywhere.

PRIVACY & SECURITY
• Unlock with Face ID / Touch ID.
• Encrypted credential storage, TLS everywhere.
• Delete your account from within the app.

Support: support@ietcs.ai
Privacy Policy: https://ietcs.ai/privacy

name: Iglesia Bautista Ciudad Caucel
description:
This app will help you stay connected with the day-to-day life of our church. With this app, you can watch or listen to past messages, stay updated with push notifications, read the Bible, and view our calendar.

Mobile app version: 6.24.7

name: Insert Life
description:
Insert Life is the card file for one insert, one grade, and one work material.

Run the edge at three cutting speeds beside the machine. Time the cut, count the parts, and log flank wear VB. The app fits the Taylor line V·T^n = C and marks the lowest-cost speed and the speed that makes the most parts per hour.

A photo of the edge can be marked on the inscribed circle so VB is read from the wear land. Each card sits in a turret pocket. A shift plan pulls nearby tool changes into one stop and reminds you before that stop.

Two grades on the same material compare at one speed. The records stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. A photo reading is an estimate. Insert Life does not connect to the machine and does not read G-code.

name: ITS Löwen-Kick
description:
ITS Löwen-Kick ist das Fußballspiel der Iserlohner Turnerschaft 1895 – für Kinder, Eltern und alle Löwen-Fans.

• 5 gegen 5 in 3D: laufen, passen, schießen, grätschen – mit dem Löwenschuss als Spezialität
• Spiele mit deiner echten ITS-Mannschaft – von der G-Jugend bis zu Damen, Herren und Ü32
• Gestalte deine eigene Spielfigur
• Löwen-Pokal, Vereinstabelle und ewige Torjägerliste
• Training mit Maskottchen MorITS: Torwand, Slalom und Liegestütze im Takt
• 20 Abzeichen zum Sammeln
• Tor der Woche: das schönste Tor als Wiederholung ansehen und teilen
• Duell: zwei Handys gegeneinander
• Flutlicht, Sonne, Regen und Schnee

Kostenlos, ohne Werbung, ohne Käufe und ohne Anmeldung.

name: JamRadio by CannonCodeConnect
description:
JamRadio gives you 20 new songs every morning.

Pick three artists you love and we build your first 20 from Apple Music right away. Each song comes with a short reason it's on your list.

Like a song or mark it "Not for me". Your votes shape tomorrow's 20.

In the app:
- Your daily 20, ready each morning in your time zone
- A player with a queue, a sleep timer and AirPlay
- Connect Apple Music to hear whole songs; without a subscription, 30-second previews play
- Save today's 20 as a "JamRadio" playlist in your Apple Music library
- An optional morning notification when today's songs are ready
- Light and dark appearance

Sign in with your email and a 6-digit code. No password to remember. You can delete your account any time in Settings.

JamRadio is free and has no ads. We never sell your information.

Built by CannonCodeConnect. Questions or ideas: help@cannoncodeconnect.com

name: Japanese Compound Verbs
description:
Learn Japanese compound verbs (複合動詞, fukugō dōshi) — the verbs formed from two verbs, like 取り組む, 見込む or 振り返る — with a dictionary, flashcards, spaced repetition and quizzes. Everything works offline.

2,874 VERBS RANKED BY IMPORTANCE
Every verb has its own rank (#1 is the most important), so you can start with the Top 100 or Top 500 and move on at your own pace. Each entry shows the kanji, the hiragana reading, all meanings, and example sentences with highlighted verb forms.

14,168 EXAMPLE SENTENCES
Every meaning comes with real Japanese examples and translations in English and Russian. Tap the speaker icon to hear any verb or sentence read aloud with the Japanese voice on your device.

FLASHCARDS
Swipe through cards in order of importance or at random. Filter the deck by Top 100, Top 500 or your favorites. Flip a card to see meanings and examples.

SPACED REPETITION (SRS)
Study with the SM-2 algorithm: rate each card Again, Hard, Good or Easy and see when it will come back. You choose when to study and how many cards per session. There are no daily goals, no streaks and no reminders — learn at the pace that suits you.

QUIZZES
• Guess the Meaning: choose the right translation from 4 options.
• Fill in the Blank: pick the compound verb that fits a real Japanese sentence.
Practice with all verbs, only your favorites, or only the verbs you are studying.

SEARCH
Find verbs by kanji, hiragana or translation. Filter by favorites or by verbs in your study list and sort by importance or reading.

OFFLINE, PRIVATE, CALM
• Works without an internet connection.
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no in-app purchases.
• Light and dark themes.
• Interface in English and Russian.

name: Jar Journal
description:
Jar Journal is a journal for your concentrate jars, for adults 21 and over where cannabis is legal.

• Photo, strain, producer and type for every jar
• Log your dabs: torch and glass or e-rig, with temp and a quick rating
• Cost per dab and per gram for every jar
• Flavor notes and your own 0 to 10 rating
• GLOBAL: see how everyone rates a jar, with top flavors and photos
• Search GLOBAL by strain, brand, type or flavor
• Shared jar photos from other users, checked before they show
• Report or hide any photo, and block anyone you don't want to see
• Graveyard for finished jars, ratings and all

No account needed to keep a journal. Sign in with Apple to share your ratings and photos. Your dab log, notes and prices stay on your phone.

Jar Journal does not sell, deliver or link to any cannabis product.

name: Jarvis – Maggiordomo AI
description:
Jarvis è il suo maggiordomo personale con intelligenza artificiale: elegante, rapido e sempre a disposizione. Gli parla come a una persona e lui risponde a voce, con calma e un'ironia garbata, dandole del lei.

PARLI E BASTA
Tocchi il microfono, usi il tasto Azione oppure dica «Ehi Siri, chiedi a Jarvis». La conversazione continua anche a schermo bloccato, così può parlargli mentre cammina, guida o cucina.

SEMPRE IN VISTA
Mentre Jarvis ascolta, ragiona o risponde, lo vede nella Dynamic Island e sulla schermata di blocco, con una sfera animata che reagisce alla sua voce.

FA LE COSE PER LEI
• Legge e crea impegni nel calendario, anche Google se l'account è sull'iPhone
• Crea promemoria con data e ora
• Chiama i suoi contatti, sempre dopo la sua conferma
• Prepara SMS, WhatsApp ed email: lei li invia con un tocco
• Meteo della sua città e dei prossimi giorni
• Navigazione con Mappe o Google Maps
• Apre Google, YouTube, Gmail, Spotify e i suoi Comandi Rapidi
• Cerca sul web notizie e informazioni aggiornate

DUE CERVELLI, LEI DECIDE
Se ha l'app Jarvis per Mac, l'iPhone usa il cervello del Mac. In alternativa Jarvis usa Claude Haiku 5.5 di Anthropic con la sua chiave API personale: un contatore mostra quanto spende e un limite mensile, che sceglie lei, blocca ogni richiesta che lo supererebbe.

SICURO PER SCELTA
Chiamate, messaggi ed email non partono mai senza il suo consenso. Le chiavi restano protette nel Portachiavi dell'iPhone.

PRIVACY
Lo sviluppatore non raccoglie i suoi dati e non ha server propri. Le domande vengono inviate a Claude solo dopo il suo consenso esplicito.

Jarvis: il maggiordomo che ha sempre desiderato, in tasca.

name: JE Delivery
description:
Jumble Eats Delivery Partner is the app for riders who deliver food and grocery orders for Jumble Eats restaurants and stores. Go online, accept orders near you, follow the live route and track every rupee you earn, all from one simple screen.

GET ORDERS FAST
• Go online with one tap and start receiving orders from your restaurants
• New orders arrive with a sound, a pop-up and a notification, even when the app is in the background
• First come, first served: each order is offered to you for 15 seconds before it moves to the next partner
• See the restaurant, distance, items and your earning before you accept

DELIVER WITH CONFIDENCE
• Live map with turn-by-turn directions to the restaurant and the customer
• Natural voice guidance so you can keep your eyes on the road
• Pick up several ready orders on the same route and deliver them in one run
• Call the restaurant or customer straight from the order

SAFE HANDOVER
• Show your ID photo: the customer sees who is delivering their order
• Confirm the customer's 4-digit delivery PIN before you complete the order
• See the exact amount to collect and record cash, UPI or card payments, including split payments

EARN MORE
• Clear pay for every order: streak pay plus a distance amount
• Deliver orders in a row to fill your streak and unlock surprise gift rewards
• See today's and this week's earnings, kilometres and orders at a glance

GET PAID EVERY MONDAY
• Your balance is paid out automatically every Monday
• Add your UPI ID or bank details once and you're ready
• Day-by-day breakdown and a list of your recent deliveries

YOUR HISTORY AND RECORD
• Delivered and rejected orders for any date you pick
• Daily totals split by cash in hand, UPI/online and card
• My record: check any warnings and stay in good standing

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with your Jumble Eats partner account
2. Tap Online to start receiving orders
3. Accept an order, pick it up and follow the map
4. Confirm the PIN, collect payment and get paid every Monday

This app is for registered Jumble Eats delivery partners. You need a partner account to sign in.

Location: the app uses your location while you are online, including in the background, to show nearby orders, guide your route and share live tracking with customers. Continued use of GPS in the background can reduce battery life.

name: Jerusalem Church OH
description:
This app will help you stay connected with the day-to-day life of Jerusalem Church, located in New Philadelphia, Ohio. With this app, you can watch or listen to past sermons, stay updated with push notifications, read the Bible from anywhere, view our calendar of upcoming events, give securely, and more.

Mobile app version: 6.24.7

name: JMJ Construction
description:
JMJ Construction is the crew app for JMJ Construction of Saint Marys, Kansas. It's for JMJ's owners and crew: you need a login from JMJ to use it.

- Clock in and out, take breaks and see your hours
- See your schedule for today and tomorrow, with the job's address and a map link
- Find any tool or material, see where it's kept and who has a tool out
- Scan an item's QR label to open it, and print labels on a Brother P-touch
- Keep the shopping list and plan jobs
- Talk to the crew with messages, voice messages and a push-to-talk crew radio
- Get notifications for schedule changes, messages and alerts
- Keep working on weak signal: the app opens from its saved copy

During a phone call the crew radio goes quiet by itself.

name: Journalink: Diary & Journal
description:
Write today. Shelve it forever.

Journalink is a diary drawn in black and white manga style. Every day is a chapter. Every month becomes a volume. Over a year, your days fill a bookshelf.

WRITE YOUR CHAPTER
• A ruled page for a few lines or a few paragraphs
• Pick how the day felt: Excited, Calm, Nervous, Annoyed or Gloomy
• Each mood marks the page edge with its manga symbol: sparkles, waves, a sweat drop, an anger vein or gloom lines
• Add one photo a day, turned into a black and white screentone panel

READ IT BACK
• Recent chapters appear on your home page as manga panels
• Finished months stand on your shelf as volume spines
• Open any volume to see that month's chapters and a tally of its moods
• Rewrite any day whenever you like

AND MORE
• An optional daily reminder at the time you choose
• Lock your journal with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
• Export every entry as a plain text file
• Night mode swaps paper and ink for writing after dark
• Built for iPhone and iPad, with support for larger text and Reduce Motion

Questions or ideas? Write to support@hootbits.app

name: Joy Work OS
description:
Joy is the legal workspace for law firms and lawyers anywhere in the world: court-ready filings and exhibit booklets, e-signatures, cases and clients, calendar and deadlines, invoices — and Joy's assistant, which does the work instead of just advising. Available in English, Hebrew, Arabic, Portuguese and Spanish.

In the app:
• Scan documents with the camera into one PDF — for a booklet, a signature or the chat with Joy
• Every file you produce is saved on the phone (Files app) and can be shared at once
• "Open in Joy" and "Share to Joy" from Mail, Files and WhatsApp
• Face ID lock
• Notifications for hearings, deadlines and reminders
• Legal library: laws in full text, with amendment dates and whether the text is current
• Due diligence with findings graded by severity, document and page
• Marketplace of legal documents and templates

Your account and subscription are managed in your firm's account. Data is encrypted in transit, and you can delete your account inside the app.

name: JS Farm - Farm Management Tool
description:
JS Farm — Simple Farm Ledger

Keep track of your fields, seasons, and fieldwork in one simple app.

• Add fields and record each season's crop, dates, and revenue
• Log fieldwork like sowing, fertilizing, and harvesting, with date and cost
• See revenue, expenses, and net profit automatically
• Export your records as CSV

Easy to use, clear to read, and made for real farms.

name: JSONPier
description:
Make structured data easier to understand. JSONPier helps you validate JSON, browse nested objects and arrays, compare two versions and create useful files from your own documents.

• Create a document or choose a UTF-8 JSON file from Files.
• See clear validation errors and inspect every node with its full JSON pointer.
• Keep large integers, decimal digits and exponent tokens intact when formatting.
• Choose two-space, four-space or compact JSON without overwriting your source.
• Compare object keys, array positions and scalar values. Filter added, removed and changed entries.
• Save real JSON files and complete text reports. Reopen and share independent snapshots after editing the source.

JSONPier supports JSON files up to 2 MiB, 128 container levels and 100,000 nodes. Duplicate object keys are rejected. Number tokens compare exactly: 1 and 1.0 are different. Comparison results have an 8 MiB resource budget and generated files a 16 MiB limit. Documents and files are stored on your device, with no app account required.

name: Just Three: Habits & Focus
description:
Three habits. No more.

Just Three is for you if you want to keep a few real habits, and sometimes sink into one task for 25 minutes. No system to build first.

FIRST START
A few quick taps: what matters to you, when, and how much time you have. You get three suggested habits, and you can rename any of them. Or skip it and write your own. Your answers are not saved.

TODAY
Write your three habits in your own words. Not sure what to write? Tap a suggestion, like Drink water or Walk. Each habit gets an icon suggested from its name, and you can pick another one.

Tap to tick off what you did today. The ring fills with each habit done. A soft sound plays, and a fuller one when all three are done. The silent switch mutes it.

Next to each habit you see how many days in a row you have kept it. If you have not ticked it yet today, you will not wake up to a zero: you have the whole day.

Missed a day? Your streak waits for you. Tick the habit the next day, and it carries on. This works once in any 7 days. The missed day does not add to the count, and two missed days in a row start it over. When a streak depends on today, the row tells you.

At 8 pm, if a habit is still open today, you get one reminder. If all three are done, it stays silent.

Changed your mind? Press and hold to rename a habit. Its streak stays.

FOCUS
One 25-minute timer, nothing to set up. Start, pause, resume. To stop, press and hold, so you never stop it by accident.

If you leave the app, a local notification tells you when the 25 minutes are up. It is marked time-sensitive, so Do Not Disturb can let it through. If you turn notifications off, the timer still works.

Want quiet while you work? The Focus tab shows you how to turn on Do Not Disturb. In the Shortcuts app you find the Start Focus action, so one shortcut can start Do Not Disturb and your 25 minutes together. With Siri, too.

WHAT IT DOES NOT HAVE, ON PURPOSE
• No account and no sign-in.
• No cloud and no sync. Your data stays on your phone.
• No ads. Free, with no in-app purchases and no subscription.
• No tracking and no analytics.
• No fourth habit, no stats page and no settings menu. The 25 minutes and the 8 pm reminder are fixed.

Few buttons, few decisions. More time for what matters.

In English and Hungarian, following your phone's language.

name: Jynora
description: Jynora is an offline notebook for two shadows measured at the same moment on level ground. The object height is the stick times the object shadow, divided by the stick shadow. The scale is the stick divided by its shadow. The sun altitude is the arctangent of that ratio. A height divided by the tangent of an altitude is the shadow it would cast. A shadow can also be counted in paces.

name: Karpeles Manuscript Library
description:
Explore original historical manuscripts from the Karpeles Manuscript Library Museum, wherever you are.

The museum cares for more than one million historical documents and opens its doors free of charge. This app brings the collection to your phone and turns a visit into a guided tour.

AT THE MUSEUM
Scan the QR code next to a manuscript, or tap an NFC tag, to open it in the app. Listen to its recorded narration, read the story behind it, and keep going to the next one. Narration keeps playing with your screen locked.

TALK TO THE GUIDE
Curious about what you are looking at? Ask a question by typing, hold a button and speak, or start a live spoken conversation with the museum's AI guide. The guide answers questions about the manuscript and the museum, and it will say so when it is not sure. Answers come from the AI service OpenAI and can be wrong, so please check anything important. The app asks for your agreement before the first question.

BROWSE THE COLLECTION
Search the collection, explore the timeline, and see a new Manuscript of the Day. Tell Find Your History what interests you and it suggests manuscripts that fit.

PLAN YOUR VISIT
See hours, addresses, directions, and accessibility notes for each museum location, including St. Augustine, Florida and Duluth, Minnesota.

SAVE WHAT YOU LOVE
Bookmark manuscripts to find them again.

No account. No ads. No tracking.

name: Kbwsup
seller_name: GIA HUNG SERVICE TRADING COMPANY LIMITED
description:
Thanks for being with us! We are constantly iterating and improving—please feel free to leave your suggestions at any time.

Kbwsup is an outfit diary for the clothes you already own. Catalogue your wardrobe, log what you wear each day, and finally see which pieces earn their place on the rail — and which are quietly gathering dust.

A WARDROBE YOU CAN ACTUALLY SEE
Hang every piece in a clean, editorial catalogue: name, category, a colour swatch, season, the price you paid and the day you bought it. Filter by laundry state or category and sort by newest, most worn, best value or longest idle.

LOG TODAY'S LOOK IN SECONDS
Tap the pieces you put on, or re-wear a saved outfit with one tap. Add where you wore it and a short note. Your Monday uniform, your wedding-guest look, your easy Saturday — save them as outfits and they are always one tap away.

NEVER REPEAT A LOOK TO THE SAME CROWD
Tag each look with an event — Office, Book club, Priya's wedding. If you pick most of the same pieces for an event you have worn them to before, Kbwsup tells you when. Every event keeps its own ledger of what that crowd has already seen.

COST PER WEAR, WORKED OUT FOR YOU
Each outing lowers a piece's cost per wear. See which pieces are earning their keep, how many times you have worn something, and when it last left the house.

GATHERING DUST
Anything not worn in 60 days (or 30, 90 or 180 — your choice) is flagged on Today and in the wardrobe, so forgotten favourites get another outing.

THE LAUNDRY BASKET
Every piece is clean, worn or in the wash. Logging a look marks those pieces as worn; send everything worn into the wash, then back to clean, with one tap each.

A DIARY OF WHAT YOU WORE
A month calendar shows each logged day as a row of colour swatches. Tap any day to see or edit the look, or log a day you forgot.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email — or tap "Try without an account" and decide later. Guests can keep their wardrobe at any time from the Dressing Room, and everything they logged comes along. Your wardrobe syncs securely and keeps working offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your data is stored in Google Firebase under your own account and is never sold or shared. Delete your account and every piece, outfit and diary day from inside the app, in the Dressing Room.

Kbwsup is free to use, with no subscriptions and nothing locked away.

name: Kesora
description: Kesora is an offline notebook for a simple pendulum. The length in meters is 9.80665 times the square of a period you type, divided by 2π. Inches divide that full length by 0.0254. Beats each minute are 120 divided by the period. Swings each minute are 60 divided by the period. A length you type can be turned back into a period.

name: Key of the Door Solo
description:
Make 21. Take the Key.

Key of the Door is a game for three by David Parlett, the card-game historian and inventor. Four keys lie on the table, one for each suit, each headed by a face card. Everyone plays numbered cards to them, and whoever brings a key to exactly 21 wins it.

- The face card counts one card twice: a Queen with a 6 and a 4 reads 16 or 14.
- Win a key, and the next face card of its suit starts another: Jack, then Queen, then King.
- Later keys score more: a key scores its cards times its face card, up to three times for a King or a Joker.
- Steal a bent key: if a key can never reach 21 with the cards still out, claim it before you play.
- Mind what you leave: a key at 15 hands the next player any 6.

In the app:

- Every key shows what it reads, and the app checks every steal for you.
- New opponents every game, at three levels: Normal, Hard and Elite.
- A Practice Round: watch a deal with a guide, then play one with a hint on every turn.
- Quick Rules and a searchable Glossary, any time, even mid-game.
- Stats for each level, kept on your device.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no data collected. Plays offline.

Key of the Door is David Parlett's game, made with his kind permission. His rules and many more of his games are at parlettgames.uk.

name: Keyspoken
description:
Say it. It's typed.

Keyspoken turns what you say into text, in any app, without replacing your keyboard. Touch and hold the globe key, choose Keyspoken, tap Dictate and talk. When you pause, your words are typed where your cursor is.

NO KEYBOARD TO LEARN
Keyspoken has no letter keys. It is one strip with one large button. Typing stays on the keyboard you already know, and the globe key takes you back to it.

TAP, TALK, DONE
It stops when you pause and types what you said, with Undo if you change your mind. The strip stays ready for your next sentence. It never starts listening by itself.

PRIVATE BY CONSTRUCTION
The speech model runs on your iPhone. There is no account, no analytics and no cloud transcription. The only download is the speech model itself.

WORKS OFFLINE
Once the model is downloaded, dictation works in airplane mode and uses no mobile data.

THREE OPEN VOICE MODELS
English is the default. Multilingual and Ultra cover 25 European languages. All three run on the device, and the app shows their published error rates side by side.

WRITTEN YOUR WAY
- Choose standard, casual or lowercase writing, right on the strip
- Custom vocabulary for the names and terms it mishears
- Snippets: say a short phrase, get the text you saved
- Removes filler words (English)
- History of what you dictated, kept on your iPhone only

FROM THE LOCK SCREEN TOO
Start a dictation from the Lock Screen or Control Center. With no text field open, your words are held on your iPhone and copied, ready to paste.

Free. No subscription, no word limit.

Requires an iPhone 12 or later.

Speech recognition: Parakeet TDT 0.6B by NVIDIA and Parakeet Ultra by moondream, CC BY 4.0. Runs with FluidAudio, Apache 2.0.

name: KeyTray Vision
description:
KeyTray Vision is the phone app of the KeyTray Vision video-wall system for security cameras (CCTV). It is the client and the administration app for companies that run their own KeyTray Vision server.

HOW IT WORKS
• Your company installs KeyTray Vision Server on a Windows PC at the site. That server connects to your IP cameras (or imports them from Luxriot) and builds the camera walls.
• The app signs in to the KeyTray Vision cloud (vision.keytray.com) to find your company, its servers and walls.
• Video goes from your own server to your phone: directly on the local network when you are on site, or through an encrypted relay when you are away. The cloud does not store your video.

WATCH
• Your company's camera walls, live.
• Pinch to zoom into any camera; each camera is shown at the best quality available.
• Your own layouts: pick cameras and a grid, save them and open them with one tap.
• Recordings: browse a camera's day on a timeline, play back what your server recorded and export a clip as MP4 to share.

APPROVE TVs
• Sign a TV (Fire TV) in to your account: the TV shows a QR code, you scan it (or type its code) and approve it from the phone.

ADMINISTER (owners and administrators)
• Link servers with the code the server shows.
• Add, edit and discover cameras; import cameras from Luxriot.
• Create and edit walls (layouts) and recording settings.
• Manage the company's servers.

ACCOUNTS
• You can create an account in the app: your company gets its own account and you are its owner. You can also sign in with a linked KeyTray account.
• Users have roles: owner, administrator or view only.
• Delete your account at any time from Settings > Delete account, or at vision.keytray.com/delete-account.

REQUIREMENTS
KeyTray Vision needs a KeyTray Vision server running at your site with your cameras. Without a server the app has no video to show.

No ads. No tracking.
Privacy: https://vision.keytray.com/privacy
Support: info@softcontrolusa.com

name: Kiln Load
description:
Kiln Load shows how a shelf of pots sits before you fire.

Open a firing, or add the shelf you are about to load. Each piece is a circle. Drag it. Its weight goes to the nearest of the four corner posts.

A red circle is touching another piece, or it hangs past the edge. A red post is over the limit you set. The load on a post is the sum of the pieces nearest to it.

Tap a circle to set its name, radius, and weight. Posts and Touching list the same result in inches and pounds.

Firings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Knitso: Cozy Knitting Game
description:
Unwind. Stitch by stitch.

A quiet room. A crackling fire. Something taking shape in your hands.

Knitso is a cozy knitting game for grown-ups. Trace a figure-eight with each thumb and the needles follow. Move together to make a stitch. Slow down when you want a quiet moment, or find a quicker rhythm and work through a row.

BOTH THUMBS, ONE STITCH
Follow the two tracks and feel the yarn move with you. A short, hands-on guide helps you find the motion. Perfect stitches bring a small haptic reward.

MAKE A LITTLE. KEEP A LITTLE.
Watch your scarf take shape as you work. Your progress is saved automatically, so you can leave mid-row and pick up where you left off.

SMALL CHALLENGES, YOUR OWN PACE
Build a run of perfect stitches, find an even rhythm and collect stitch markers along the way. There is no countdown, no lives to lose and no rush to finish.

FIVE COZY PROJECTS
Start with a scarf, then unlock a beanie, mittens, a cushion cover and a blanket. One piece at a time. One stitch at a time.

JUST YOU AND THE FIRE
Knit beside a warm fireplace, with optional crackling sound and haptic feedback. Adjust the sound, haptics and evening reminder in Profile.

FREE TO PLAY
Knitso has no in-app purchases or subscriptions. Play without an account, even offline. Sign in with Apple, Google or a one-time email code when you want to save your work across devices. Sign out or delete your account from Profile.

Privacy: https://knitso-prod.web.app/privacy
Terms: https://knitso-prod.web.app/terms
Support: https://knitso-prod.web.app/support

name: Konta
description:
O Konta é o software de gestão para gabinetes de contabilidade em Portugal. Com a app tem o dia a dia do gabinete no iPhone:

• Alertas: prazos e obrigações em atraso (IVA, SAF-T, declarações, recibos de renda), emails novos e documentos em falta
• Mensagens: emails e WhatsApp dos clientes num só sítio, com resposta rápida
• Enviar: fotografe ou escolha um documento e envie-o ao cliente em segundos
• Clientes: contactos, NIF, obrigações do mês e últimos documentos de cada cliente
• Notificações quando chega uma mensagem, um documento ou há prazos a terminar

A app é para gabinetes e contabilistas que já usam o Konta (konta.pt). Entra com o mesmo email e palavra-passe do computador.

name: KPSS Ortaöğretim Ritmi
description:
KPSS Ortaöğretim Ritmi, sınava sakin ve sürdürülebilir bir tempoyla hazırlanmak isteyen adaylar için hazırlandı. Kısa oturumlar, düzenli tekrar ve şeffaf bir ilerleme takibi tek uygulamada.

NELER VAR?
• 1020 özgün pratik sorusu — Türkçe, Matematik, Tarih, Coğrafya, Vatandaşlık ve Güncel Bilgiler.
• Tam deneme — 120 soru, 130 dakika; soru haritası ve soru soru çözüm incelemesi.
• Mini testler — ders, zorluk ve kaynak seç: karışık, çözmediklerim, yanlışlarım ya da favorilerim.
• 509 bilgi kartı — 12'lik setler hâlinde; bildiğin kartlar aralıklı tekrarla doğru zamanda yeniden karşına çıkar.
• Yanlışlarım ve Favorilerim — hatalarına odaklan, önemli soruları sakla.
• İstatistik — son 7 gün, başarı gelişimi ve derslere göre durum.
• Karanlık tema ve ayarlanabilir yazı boyutu.
• İnternetsiz çalışır, hesap açmak gerekmez.

Uygulama ücretsizdir ve reklam içerir.

Önemli: Sorular ÖSYM'nin resmî soruları değildir; sınava hazırlık pratiği amacıyla özgün olarak hazırlanmıştır. Uygulama ÖSYM ya da MEB ile bağlantılı değildir.

name: Krible – Things to Do
description:
What shall we do? Krible has 240 ideas.

Your child looks through drawings of Krible the crab and chooses. A grown-up reads out the description, you find what you need, and then you put the screen away and get going.

YOUR CHILD CHOOSES
No reading needed. Every activity is a drawing of Krible doing it, and the buttons are big enough for small fingers.

YOU DO IT TOGETHER
• The grown-up reads the description aloud. Krible does not read aloud, and that is on purpose: you look at the drawings together and agree.
• ‘You need’ shows the things, and most of them are already at home.
• In Finding out, Krible shows every step, and ‘Why does it happen?’ explains briefly and correctly what is going on.
• In Little chef there is a recipe. It is a suggestion; use your family’s own if you like.

240 THINGS TO DO
Twelve categories with twenty in each: Out in nature, On the move, Finding out, Making things, Little chef, Indoor play, Let’s pretend, Music and dance, Cosy and calm, Games without toys, Helping out and Days out. Something for rainy days and something for the woods. Some take five minutes, some take all afternoon.

A HEART FOR THE ONES YOU LIKE
Tap the heart, and the activity is waiting under Favourites next time. Each child has their own list.

FOR GROWN-UPS
• The grown-up part is behind a sum.
• Add as many children as you like.
• Made for children of about three to seven, together with a grown-up.
• English, Norwegian, Swedish, Danish and German. The app follows the language of the device.

WHAT KRIBLE DOES NOT DO
• No adverts
• No in-app purchases
• No account or sign-in
• No tracking. Favourites stay on the device.
• No notifications
• No stars, points or streaks
• Works offline

All 240 activities are included from the start, and no purchases will come later. Krible is part of Sandkassa, our small family of apps from Norway. Its sibling Mumse is for tasting new food.

Made at home by us at Sandkassa. Shared with you.

name: Kūki
description:
Kūki (空気, “air”) shows how fresh the air is in the room where your sensor sits — quietly.

It works with air-quality sensors in Apple Home, such as the IKEA ALPSTUGA: carbon dioxide (CO₂), temperature, humidity and fine particles (PM2.5).

HOW IT RECORDS
Apple Home gives an iPhone or iPad app new readings only while it is open, so on its own your iPhone records while Kūki is open. For around-the-clock data, run Kūki on a Mac, where it lives in the menu bar, or leave a spare iPhone or iPad in Station Mode. Your iPhone's widgets, Lock Screen and alerts then follow along through iCloud.

CO₂ IN A BRUSH STROKE
An ensō — the Zen brush circle — grows with CO₂, with plain advice: clear air, fine, getting stale, stuffy. Temperature, humidity and PM2.5 sit beneath.

ROOM BY ROOM
Carry the sensor from the bedroom to the study to the kitchen. Kūki keeps a history per place and compares them: averages, peaks, and how much of the time each room was over your limit. Minutes while the sensor settles into a new room are left out, so comparisons stay fair.

A WIND CHIME, NOT AN ALARM
When CO₂ crosses your limit (1000 ppm by default), a soft synthesised fūrin rings once and a notification tells you to open a window: while Kūki is open, and usually also while it is closed when a Mac or Station device is recording. It stays quiet until the air has recovered.

WIDGETS AND LIVE ACTIVITY
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, StandBy, and a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island show the latest reading. They stay current while a Mac or Station device records, and fade honestly when the reading is old.

ON YOUR MAC, AROUND THE CLOCK
The Mac app lives in your menu bar — CO₂, temperature, humidity or PM2.5 next to the clock — and keeps recording all day, even with its window closed.

SYNCED THROUGH YOUR iCLOUD
History, places and where the sensor is follow you between Mac and iPhone through your private iCloud. Turn it off any time.

ASK CLAUDE OR CHATGPT
Export a CSV for spreadsheets, or an AI-ready summary to paste into Claude or ChatGPT and ask what to change.

STATION MODE
A dim, always-awake display for a device left on a charger — on iPhone it keeps Kūki in front so it keeps recording.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your readings stay on your devices and in your own iCloud. Kūki shares only usage statistics (which features are used, on what device, in which country) to improve the app; turn this off in Settings › Privacy.

A Thread border router (e.g. HomePod mini, Apple TV, or a compatible hub) is needed for Matter-over-Thread sensors. Kūki is an independent app, not affiliated with IKEA.

name: Kuutassu
description:
Kuutassu on käsinkirjoitettu seikkailu- ja roolipeli, joka sijoittuu Kuutamon kylään ja sitä ympäröivään metsään, kaikuvaan luolaan sekä Hohdekuun huipulle. Peli rakentuu vapaaseen kartoittamiseen: liikut itse kartalla, pysähdy kyläläisten luo ja ratkaise tehtävät omalla tavallasi.

Alueet avautuvat yksi kerrallaan edeltävän osuuden selvittyä, joten eteenpäin kulkeminen avaa kartalle uusia reittejä, kauppiaita, tiedonkantoja ja vastuita. Kolme päätehtävää muodostavat tarinan, ja kyläläisten sivutehtävät jatkavat sitä sivusuunnassa.

Karttaa ohjataan osoittavalla tavalla, ja jokainen paikka on piirretty käsin. Kerää yrttejä ja kuukiviä, avaa luolan syvyyksiä ja nouse huipulle kohtaamaan susikuningas. Jokainen kyläläinen on oma hahmonsa omalla puheellaan.

Taistelut käydään vuorotellen. Seuraa kolmea hahmoa, joilla on omat vahvuutensa, ja avaa heidän taitonsa edistyessäsi. Viisi elementtiä, fyysinen, tuli, jää, valo ja pimeys, tuovat erilaisia vaikutuksia: vahinkoa, parannusta, suojaa, myrkkyä, mykytystä ja puhdistusta. Osaat voidaan valita vapaasti ja kokeilla eri kokoonpanoja.

Takomuksessa valmistat omia varusteita. Vasaran taso nousee neljään vaiheeseen, ja valmiista esineestä voi löytyä yllättävä lisäominaisuus, joka muuttaa esineen käyttöä.

Pelissä on kolme tallennuspaikkaa ja automaattinen tallennus, joten edistymsesi säilyy vaikka sulkit sovelluksen kesken matkan. Pelaa omalla tempolla ja palaa silloin kun sinulle sopii.

name: KvarosFix
description:
KvarosFix is a tech shop and repair service in Podgorica, Montenegro. Browse the offer, place an order and follow your orders and repairs in the app.

SHOP
• Laptops, computers, consoles, games, smartwatches and accessories – new and tested used
• Warranty and payment in installments
• Deals, filters, product comparison and wishlist
• Cart and order with delivery or pickup in the store; you pay on delivery or pickup

REPAIR
• Repair price list for phones and other devices, searchable by model and service
• Repair status in your account

BUYBACK
• Selling a laptop, computer, console or phone? Send the device details and we will reply with an offer and an inspection appointment.

NOTIFICATIONS
• New arrivals, price drops on your wishlist and order or repair status changes. You can turn notifications off at any time.

ACCOUNT
• Shopping works without an account. You can delete your account in the app (Profile → Delete account).

The app is available in Montenegrin, English, Russian and Turkish.

Store: Pete Proleterske brigade 36, Podgorica
Phone: +382 63 494 531
Email: info@kvarosfix.me
Website: kvarosfix.me

name: La Mecha
description:
La Mecha es la app anónima de los estudiantes de la Universidad de los Andes. Lo que pasa en el campus, contado por gente verificada y sin nombres: preguntas, confesiones, planes, crushes y el hot take que no te atreves a decir en el salón.

SOLO ESTUDIANTES, SOLO CON INVITACIÓN
Entras con tu correo institucional, que usamos únicamente para confirmar que estudias en la U. Tu nombre nunca aparece en la app. Y nadie entra sin un fósforo: cada persona que llega recibe tres códigos para sus amigos, así la comunidad crece de amigo en amigo, no de bot en bot.

ANÓNIMO DE VERDAD
Nadie elige un nombre: todo sale como «Anónimo», con una «A» azul. Nadie puede ver tu historial de publicaciones ni de comentarios, ni siquiera desde tu perfil. Tu identidad queda cifrada y separada de todo lo que publicas.

PRENDER Y APAGAR
Nada de likes ni seguidores. Una mecha que vale la pena se prende; la que no, se apaga. Las que más arden se notan en el feed, y cada prendido que recibes suma karma en tu carnet.

ETIQUETAS CON SABOR
#chisme, #crush, #pregunta, #evento, #perdido, #confesión, #hottake, #aviso, #greenflag, #redflag y más, para encontrar lo tuyo de una.

ENCUESTAS Y FOTOS
¿Bobo o biblioteca? Pregúntale al campus y mira la respuesta en segundos. Publica fotos: les quitamos la ubicación y los metadatos antes de que nadie las vea.

ANÓNIMO NO ES SIN REGLAS
Reporta cualquier publicación en dos toques: con tres reportes de personas distintas se oculta sola hasta que la revisemos, y revisamos todo en menos de 24 horas. Bloquea a quien quieras. Acoso, odio, doxxing o contenido sexual implican expulsión definitiva. La Mecha es solo para mayores de edad (18 años o más).

HECHA EN BOGOTÁ
Nace en Los Andes y abre universidad por universidad. ¿Quieres que la siguiente sea la tuya? Escríbenos a hola@lamecha.app.

La Mecha es un producto de L.O.S. SAS y no está afiliada a la Universidad de los Andes ni a ninguna otra institución.

name: LabelFold
description:
Guarda etiquetes d'aliments i consulta ingredients, informació nutricional i al·lèrgens amb LabelFold. L'aplicació utilitza registres de productes d'Open Food Facts i està disponible en anglès per a iPhone i iPad.

Cerca productes per nom, marca o codi de barres, o tria un dels sis registres inclosos disponibles sense connexió. També pots escanejar codis de barres en dispositius compatibles. Les imatges dels productes poden requerir connexió a internet.

A la col·lecció pots filtrar les etiquetes, marcar preferits i afegir notes personals. Cada etiqueta mostra les dades disponibles del producte, inclosos els ingredients, els valors nutricionals per 100 g o 100 ml i el Nutri-Score, quan consta al registre.

Selecciona les categories d'al·lèrgens que vols tenir presents i consulta les coincidències amb els al·lèrgens declarats i les possibles traces. Compara dos productes desats per veure'n els valors nutricionals i els resums d'al·lèrgens. Si un producte es mesura per pes i l'altre per volum, pots consultar les etiquetes per separat.

El widget mostra un resum dels preferits i obre la col·lecció amb el filtre de preferits seleccionat.

Open Food Facts és una base de dades mantinguda per la comunitat i les etiquetes poden ser incompletes. Comprova sempre l'envàs actual del producte.

name: LamplightCasebook
description:
Astu Sumusatamaan Lamplightina, tweed-liiviin ja pehmeään ruskeaan hattuun pukeutuneena pesukarhudekkarina.

Kadonneet kellokoneiston osat ovat vaientaneet sataman kellot. Lämmin lyhdynvalo paljastaa asiat, jotka olet jo saanut selville, kun taas sininen sumu kätkee alleen kaiken, mikä ei vielä tunnu täsmäävän. Tutki hiljaisia tapahtumapaikkoja messinkisellä suurennuslasilla, vertaile jälkiä, säädä toisiinsa liittyviä rattaita ja kokoa tapahtumien kulku hajallaan olevista vihjeistä.

Kun todistajien kertomukset alkavat horjua, siirry vuoropohjaiseen väittelyyn, jossa keskittyminen kohtaa epäilykset. Tarkkaile, esitä todisteita, puolusta päättelyäsi ja pyydä apua pöllö-, saukko- ja kettuliittolaisiltasi. Kehity kykyjen kehityspuiden ja työpajalla valmistettavien varusteiden avulla, kun tutkit 24 päätapausta ja kuutta sivutarinaa, jotka johdattavat sinut aina satamatornin kelloon asti.

Jokainen tapaus päättyy selkeään raporttiin ja valintaan siitä, millaisena kaupunki muistaa tapahtumat. Palaa toimistollesi, kiinnitä uudet tiedot muistikirjaasi ja pidä satama toiminnassa – yksi varmistettu totuus kerrallaan.

name: LapinDry
description:
LapinDry auttaa suunnittelemaan perinteisen Lapin poron kuivaliha -prosessin. Sovellus yhdistää sään, raaka-aineen määrän ja kuivaustelineet yhdeksi selkeäksi suunnitelmaksi.

Tuotantoikkuna
Arvioi sopiva aloitusjakso lämpötilan, pakkasen, tuulen ja auringonpaisteen perusteella. Näet mitkä päivät sopivat kuivatuksen aloitukseen.

Raaka-aine ja tila
Syötä lihan paino, leikkauspaksuus ja kappalemäärä. LapinDry laskee tarvittavan kuivatustilan ja auttaa mitoittamaan erän.

Kuivaustelineet
Suunnittele telineiden määrä, tasot ja kapasiteetti. Vertaa tilaa raaka-aineeseen ennen kuivatuksen aloitusta.

Kuivatusjakso
Arvioi prosessin kesto ja poisottopäivä sään mukaan. Perinteinen kuivatus kestää tyypillisesti 3–6 viikkoa.

Saanto ja ennuste
Kirjaa aiempien erien raaka-aine- ja valmistepainer. Saat saanto-%-arvion, hävikkiarvion sekä yksityiskohtaisen saantoraportin ja parannusvinkit.

Kenelle
Poronlihan kuivattajille, pientuottajille ja perinteisen kuivaliha-prosessin suunnittelijoille – erityisesti helmi–huhtikuun tuotantokauteen.

LapinDry – selkeämpi kuivatus alusta loppuun.

name: Last Active: Chat Stories
description:
Last Active looks like the messenger on your phone. Someone writes to you, you write back, and what you say decides how the story ends.

YOUR REPLIES MATTER
People remember how you spoke to them. Be kind, be honest, push, or say nothing at all. Each story tracks how much a character trusts you, how close you are and how tense things have become, and every ending follows from it.

THEY WRITE BACK LATER
Characters go quiet and message you again in their own time, the way people do. Choose Live pacing and the story unfolds over hours, with a notification when someone writes back. Choose Steady for short pauses, or Binge to read straight through.

TYPE IT YOURSELF
Pick what to say, then tap the keys to type it out and hit send. Some moments give you only so long to answer, and staying silent is an answer too.

STORIES WITH MORE THAN ONE ENDING
Every story has several endings: the usual one, a worse one, a partial one and a good one, and sometimes a secret. Some are easy to change; some are very hard. Rewind to any episode and try again.

MANY KINDS OF STORY
Mysteries, thrillers, horror, romance, family, friendship, workplace and drama. A stranger texting a friend at midnight. A father planning a Sunday visit. A group chat that splits into sides. New stories arrive in the app without an update.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your name and progress stay on your phone. Free, with nothing to buy.

ALL STORIES ARE FICTION
Characters and events are invented. Some stories deal with stalking, controlling relationships, grief and loss, and are written for players aged 16 and over. If a story reminds you of something in your own life, the app can point you to a helpline directory.

name: LastFrame
description:
胶片留下画面，LastFrame 留下拍摄时的时间与地点。

为你的胶片相机装入一卷胶卷。每拍下一张，在 LastFrame 里轻拨一次过片扳手，便能按帧记下拍摄时间，并在获得定位权限和有效位置时保存地点。从第一帧到最后一帧，让每一卷都有迹可循。

【一台相机，一张卡片】
添加相机和镜头，选择胶卷型号、画幅与预计张数。可以添加多台相机，可上下切换。

【让记录也有过片的手感】
拨动过片扳手，记录下一帧；翻到卡片背面，回看这一卷的时间与地点。

【不必反复打开 App】
使用小组件或开启「锁屏过片」，通过实时活动快捷记录。Apple Watch 可作为遥控器，在手腕上切换相机、记录帧数并查看结果。

【每一帧都可以整理】
查看和调整拍摄时间，在地图上选择或补充地点。

【从拍摄记录，到扫描照片】
导出整卷 CSV，可在电脑端通过 NextFrame 批量应用EXIF信息。

使用说明
• LastFrame 是拍摄记录工具，不会自动识别实体相机的快门；每拍一张，需要手动记帧。
• 地点记录需要定位授权与有效定位。没有定位时仍可记帧，并可稍后补充地点。
• Apple Watch 记帧需要与配对的 iPhone 保持可用连接；具体表现受设备与系统状态影响。
• CSV 的照片匹配和 EXIF 写入在电脑端 NextFrame 中完成。

隐私政策网址
https://docs.qq.com/doc/DWkNFZWVjakZMRG92#

EULA
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Leiria Lovers
description:
Leiria Lovers is the events calendar and city guide for Leiria, Portugal, in your pocket: what to do, where to eat, what's happening in town and how to make the most of it.

Please note: the app and its content are in Portuguese (Portugal).

Save
Tap the heart on any event, restaurant, place, news story, shop, accommodation or park to save it. Everything stays on your iPhone, and your plan is still there without a connection.

My plan
Your saved events, organised by day, with time and place. If two events overlap, we let you know. Past events are tucked away on their own.

Reminders
Choose when to be reminded: the evening before, two hours before or when it starts. Reminders are scheduled on your iPhone itself — no account, no servers.

Add to Calendar
Send an event to your iPhone Calendar, already filled in with date, time and place, in one tap. The app never reads your calendar.

EVERYTHING HAPPENING IN LEIRIA

Events
Concerts, theatre, exhibitions, parties, sport, things to do with kids and much more. See what's on right now, jump to any day and find out what to do this weekend.

Where to eat
Leiria restaurants with photos, opening hours, contacts and directions.

Local shops
The city's shops and businesses, organised by category.

News
What's changing in Leiria, told by the Leiria Lovers team.

Tourism
Points of interest, accommodation and parks for visitors — and for locals who want to know the city better.

Search
Find events, restaurants, shops and places in one search field.

NO ACCOUNT, NO DATA COLLECTION
No sign-up needed. Your saved items, your plan and your reminders stay on your iPhone only.

All content is published by the Leiria Lovers team at leirialovers.pt. Got a suggestion, a correction or an event to share? Get in touch at leirialovers.pt/contactos.

name: LeoCRM
seller_name: Souq E Kamil Trading and Solutions WLL
description:
LeoCRM Mobile is the companion app for LeoCRM. Sign in with the account your company's
administrator gave you and work with the same customers, deals and tickets you use on the
web, with the same roles and permissions.

KNOW YOUR CUSTOMERS
• Customer list sorted by health, with at-risk and expanding filters
• Customer 360: health score, ARR, renewal date, NPS, contacts, deals, activity and tickets
• Call, WhatsApp or email a contact in one tap

WORK THE PIPELINE
• Swipe through pipeline stages and move deals forward
• Deal details with value, probability, close date, owner and tags
• Log calls, meetings and notes against any customer or deal

SERVICE AND TASKS
• Service tickets with priority and time left before the SLA is breached
• Tasks for you or the whole team
• Notifications for what needs you today

LEO, YOUR CRM ASSISTANT
• Daily brief and suggested next steps worked out from your company's own records
• Account summaries before you call a customer

BUILT FOR WORK
• Revenue against target, open pipeline and win rate on the home screen
• 12 themes, light and dark mode, three density settings
• Role-based access: people only see what their role allows

REQUIREMENTS
LeoCRM Mobile requires a LeoCRM company account. Accounts are created by your company's
LeoCRM administrator.

name: Lexigrove: English Vocabulary
description:
Lexigrove helps you learn the English words that matter most, a few at a time, and keep them for good.

3,000 WORDS, A1 TO C2
Words are grouped by CEFR level, from A1 beginner to C2 proficient. Every word comes with a plain-English meaning, US pronunciation, part of speech, an example sentence and, for many words, a usage tip.

LEARNED MEANS LEARNED
A word only counts as learned after you answer a question about it correctly. Tapping "I know it" just moves the quiz up.

FIVE KINDS OF QUESTIONS
• Pick the meaning
• Pick the word for a meaning
• Listen and choose the spelling
• Fill the gap in a sentence
• Type the word from memory
Questions get harder as a word grows stronger.

SPACED REVIEWS
Words come back after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days. Miss one and it steps back so you can catch it again. After the last review a word is mastered.

SAY IT OUT LOUD
Hear a word, say it, and get a pronunciation score. On supported iPhones speech is recognized on the device.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Daily goal ring and streak, with a streak saver earned every week
• Words learned per day over the last 30 days
• Skills report for meaning, listening, usage, spelling and pronunciation
• An estimate of when you'll finish your current level

BUILT FOR DAILY HABITS
• Daily goal of 10, 20 or 30 new words
• A gentle daily reminder at the time you choose
• Browse and search every word by level and topic, and keep favourites
• Progress syncs across your devices with iCloud
• Works offline

Lexigrove is completely free. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no account and no tracking.

name: Lịch Mới - Lịch Cúp Điện
description:
Lịch Mới giúp bạn xem lịch tạm ngừng cung cấp điện (lịch cúp điện) theo từng xã/phường trên cả nước, nhanh và dễ đọc.

ĐÁNH DẤU NƠI BẠN Ở
Đánh dấu xã/phường nơi bạn sống, làm việc hay nhà người thân. Mở ứng dụng là thấy ngay lịch cúp điện sắp tới của những nơi đó, không cần tìm lại.

TRA CỨU THEO TỈNH VÀ XÃ/PHƯỜNG
Chọn tỉnh/thành phố rồi chọn xã/phường, hoặc gõ tên để tìm nhanh, không cần gõ dấu.

THÔNG TIN ĐẦY ĐỦ, DỄ ĐỌC
Mỗi lịch hiển thị rõ ngày, khung giờ, đơn vị điện lực, khu vực bị ảnh hưởng và lý do. Lịch bị hoãn có nhãn riêng. Trong từng tỉnh có thể lọc theo điện lực.

LỊCH CÚP ĐIỆN HÔM NAY TOÀN QUỐC
Xem nhanh các tỉnh có lịch cúp điện trong ngày.

TÓM TẮT MỖI TUẦN
Mỗi tối thứ Sáu, nhận một thông báo gọn về lịch cúp điện tuần tới của những nơi bạn đã đánh dấu. Ít thông báo, không làm phiền.

LỊCH ÂM DƯƠNG VÀ NHẮC SỰ KIỆN
Xem lịch tháng, lịch năm có ngày âm, can chi, giờ hoàng đạo, ngày tốt xấu và các ngày lễ. Đếm ngày tới các dịp quan trọng ở mục Sắp tới. Tự thêm sự kiện dương lịch hoặc âm lịch với màu riêng, lặp lại hàng ngày, hàng tuần, hàng tháng, hàng năm và thông báo đúng giờ. Sự kiện chỉ lưu trên máy của bạn.

NHẸ VÀ XEM ĐƯỢC KHI MẤT MẠNG
Dữ liệu được lưu trên máy, mở ứng dụng nhanh và vẫn xem được lịch đã tải khi không có kết nối. Có chế độ tối, dùng được trên iPhone và iPad.

KHÔNG CẦN TÀI KHOẢN
Không đăng ký, không đăng nhập, không thu thập thông tin cá nhân.

LƯU Ý
Lịch Mới không phải ứng dụng chính thức của công ty điện lực nào. Dữ liệu được tổng hợp từ lịch tạm ngừng cung cấp điện do các công ty điện lực công bố. Lịch có thể thay đổi; vui lòng theo dõi thêm thông báo của điện lực địa phương.

name: Light Listener
description:
Light Listener transforms optical light, color temperature, LED strobe modulation, and pulsed light beacons into live soundwaves and real-time laboratory telemetry.

Inspired by Alexander Graham Bell's 1880 Photophone and modern optical spectroscopy, Light Listener samples either your live camera reticle or an interactive 8-preset Optical Calibration Bench at up to 60 frames per second:

- Real-Time Optical-to-Audio Sonification: Map relative luminance, RGB balance, and dominant visible wavelength (380-700 nm) into quantized 12-TET musical scales (Pentatonic, Major, Dorian, Chromatic), continuous Photophone pitch modulation, RGB Spectral Triad chords, or Photon Geiger clicks.
- LED / PWM Flicker Frequency Analyzer (FFT): Inspect time-domain RGB + luminance waveforms alongside a windowed Fourier spectrum analyzer to measure low-frequency modulation depth (Flicker %) and dominant strobe frequency (Hz) within the camera's Nyquist frame rate.
- Adaptive Optical Morse & Pulse Decoder: Built-in Schmitt-trigger hysteresis thresholding automatically tracks ambient brightness changes to decode optical Morse beacons (... --- ... or custom pulsed messages) into text in real time, paired with a custom Optical Beacon Transmitter.
- Sound Listener Toggle (Sub-20 Hz Infrasound Up-Converter): Flip the top-bar toggle switch to Sound Listener mode to capture low-frequency and sub-audible (under 20 Hz infrasound) pressure fluctuations - up-converting inaudible waves (0.2-20 Hz, including microbaroms, structural resonance, Schumann modes, and sub-bass) via x16/x32/x64/x128 octave pitch-shifting or +220 Hz heterodyne modulation into human hearing alongside a 0.25 Hz resolution spectrum analyzer.
- Spoken Color & Light Readout: One-tap voice readout announces detected color name, relative luminance, dominant wavelength, and musical pitch - helpful for hands-free lab work and accessible light exploration.
- 100% On-Device Privacy: Zero accounts, zero cloud uploads, and zero tracking. Camera and microphone streams are analyzed strictly in volatile memory on your device and never recorded or transmitted.

Disclaimer: Light Listener is an educational and audiovisual physics utility. Relative lux, CCT, and low-frequency acoustic levels are uncalibrated device-sensor proxies and are not intended for certified industrial or medical metrology.

name: Lighthouse Church San Angelo
description:
This app is where you can:

 - Watch or listen to Lighthouse Church messages
 - Stay up-to-date and sign-up for upcoming events
 - Download messages for offline listening
 - Make a secure gift

Mobile app version: 6.24.7

name: LightPath Intranet
description:
LightPath Intranet is the mobile companion to LightPath, a SharePoint Online intranet product from Privion. It is for employees of organizations that run LightPath, and it signs in with your Microsoft 365 work account.

What you get:

- Home: the news, events, links, teams and other content your intranet home page shows, laid out for a phone.
- Navigation: the same menu as your intranet, with every page opening inside the app.
- Me: your meetings, mail, tasks and recent files from Microsoft 365.
- People: the company directory with photos, titles and one-tap call, email and Teams chat.
- Ask: answers to questions about your intranet's content, with the sources they came from.
- Search: your intranet's search scopes.

Requirements: a Microsoft 365 work account on an organization that has deployed LightPath Intranet. Organizations license LightPath through the Microsoft commercial marketplace; there is nothing to buy in the app.

name: Likya Spor Rezervasyon
description:
Likya Spor Rezervasyon, Likya Spor Kulübü (Fethiye) havuzunun üye randevu uygulamasıdır.

Neler yapabilirsiniz?
• Özel ders, düet ders ve kulvar kiralama için boş saatleri görüp randevu alın

Likya Spor Kulübü havuzunda ders alan üyeler ve veliler, kulvar kiralayanlar ve kendi öğrencileriyle havuzu kullanan eğitmenler.

Giriş

name: Lilaro
description:
Lilaro, ce sont des listes d’envies que tu partages en couple, en famille et entre amis. Fini les cadeaux en double et les « tu voulais quoi, déjà ? ».

AJOUTER UNE ENVIE EN DEUX GESTES
Dans Safari ou l’app d’une boutique, touche Partager, puis Lilaro. Le nom, la photo et le prix arrivent seuls. Tu peux aussi coller un lien, ou noter une idée sans lien avec ta propre photo.

LE CADEAU RESTE UNE SURPRISE
Quand quelqu’un touche « Je l’offre », les autres le voient ; la personne à qui il est destiné, non. Tu peux aussi glisser des idées cachées pour un proche.

LE SECRET SANTA, CARTE À DÉCHIRER
Crée le groupe, fixe le budget et les exclusions, lance le tirage. Chacun déchire sa carte dans l’app et découvre à qui il offre, avec ses envies.

PRÉVENU QUAND LE PRIX BAISSE
Lilaro relève le prix de tes envies et te prévient quand il baisse, ou quand il passe sous le prix que tu as choisi.

ET AUSSI
• J’hésite : deux ou trois produits côte à côte, tes proches votent en un geste.
• Participation : pour un cadeau cher, chacun donne sa part.
• Listes d’achats à deux : Lilaro tient les comptes, qui a payé, qui doit quoi.
• Anniversaires : tes proches sont prévenus 14 et 3 jours avant.
• Sans l’app : un lien ouvre la liste dans le navigateur, sans compte.
• Assistants : ajoute Lilaro à Claude ou à ChatGPT et dicte tes envies.

Gratuit et sans publicité. Certains liens vers les boutiques sont des liens affiliés, marqués « Lien affilié » : la boutique verse une petite commission à Lilaro, ton prix ne change pas.

name: LinguaFlow: Hikâyeli İngilizce
description:
İngilizceyi ezberleyerek değil, çocukların öğrendiği gibi öğren: önce bol bol dinle ve anla, sonra taklit et, en sonunda kendi cümlelerini kur.

LinguaFlow, A1'den B2'ye uzanan sesli bir hikâye dizisi üzerine kurulu. Her bölüm aynı yolu izler: hikâyeyi dinle, yeni kelimeleri bağlamında gör, cümleleri gölgeleyerek tekrar et, sonra konuş ve yaz.

HİKÂYEYLE ÖĞREN
• A1, A2, B1 ve B2 seviyelerinde 104 sesli bölüm
• Her sezon sonunda seviyeni ölçen yeterlilik kapıları
• Doğal hızda, profesyonel seslendirme

DİNLE, TAKLİT ET, KONUŞ
• Gölgeleme: cümleyi dinle, aynı ritimle tekrar et, telaffuzun anında puanlansın
• Dikte ve cümle kurma alıştırmaları
• Rol oyunu ve serbest sohbet: hikâyedeki karakterlerle İngilizce konuş

KELİMELER SEKMESİ
• A1'den C2'ye yaklaşık 9.700 kelime, Türkçe karşılıkları ve örnek cümleleriyle
• Fiillerin geçmiş halleri (V1 · V2 · V3), düzensiz fiiller ayrı listede
• Sözlük gibi ara: İngilizce ya da Türkçe yaz, anında bul
• Günde 10 kelimelik çalışma turları, aralıklı tekrar

OKU
• A1–B2 seviyelerinde 18 sesli okuma kitabı: klasiklerin sade uyarlamaları
• Cümleye uzun bas, Türkçesini gör
• Kütüphanede seviyene göre işaretlenmiş ek okumalar

KİLİT EKRANI WİDGET'LARI
• Kelime: gün boyu değişen bir kelime, Türkçesi ve geçmiş halleri
• Kalıp: her gün yeni bir kalıp cümle ve Türkçesi

YAPAY ZEKÂ (İSTEĞE BAĞLI)
Konuşma, yazma değerlendirmesi ve sohbet özellikleri kendi API anahtarınla çalışır (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ya da Google Gemini). Anahtar telefonundaki güvenli depoda saklanır; yazdıkların doğrudan seçtiğin sağlayıcıya gider. Hikâyeler, dinleme, gölgeleme, kelimeler ve okuma kitapları anahtar olmadan da çalışır.

GİZLİLİK
Hesap yok, reklam yok, takip yok. İlerlemen yalnızca telefonunda durur; istersen yedeğini dışa aktarabilirsin.

name: Listly: Shopping List
description:
Listly is a fast, beautiful shopping list that thinks like a shopper. Type what you need, and it lands in the right aisle. Check things off as you go, and the list keeps what’s left right in front of you.

ADD A WHOLE LIST IN SECONDS
• Type straight into the bar at the bottom — Return adds the item and keeps the keyboard up for the next one.
• Separate with commas: “milk, bread, eggs” adds three items at once.
• Smart suggestions appear as you type, from nearly 200 everyday products and everything you’ve bought before.
• Add something that’s already on the list? Listly tells you instead of creating a duplicate.

SORTED THE WAY YOU WALK THE STORE
• Items go to the right category automatically: Fruits & Vegetables, Dairy & Eggs, Meat & Fish, Bakery, Frozen, Pantry, Snacks & Sweets, Drinks, Household, Personal Care and more.
• Drag categories into the order of your store, rename them, or create your own.
• Each category has its own color, so you can find your place at a glance.

MADE FOR THE STORE AISLE
• Tap to check an item off, with a satisfying haptic.
• When a whole category is done, it folds into a tidy “Bought” section at the bottom — what you still need stays on top.
• Clear purchased items, or the whole list, in one tap — with Undo if you change your mind.

REMEMBERS WHAT YOU BUY
• “Frequently Bought” puts your regulars one tap away.
• Clearing the list keeps your history, so suggestions get better over time.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Listly collects no data at all.
• Your list syncs between your own devices through your private iCloud.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE
• Modern look with light and dark mode.
• Supports larger text sizes and VoiceOver.
• Available in English and Russian.

Make your next shopping trip faster. Download Listly.

name: Little Atlas - Child Manual
description:
Little Atlas is a journal for parents to record and revisit a child's present and growth over time.

Save favorites, interests, relationships, challenges, memorable words, and recent changes with dates and notes. You can also keep height and weight records, wish lists, belongings and purchases, and events in one place.

Add multiple children and keep each child's records separate. Review a current overview, revisit the timeline by period or category, and find entries with keyword search. Records can be edited or deleted later.

Data is stored on the device and can be exported or imported as JSON from Settings. The app includes Japanese and English, light, dark, and system themes, a tutorial, and help.

This is a personal journal for noticing everyday changes—not an app for comparing, rating, or monitoring children.

name: Live Angle
description:
Measure angles by folding your iPhone Duo.

Live Angle displays your hinge angle in real time, from 0° to 180°, in a clean, easy-to-read interface.

• View readings on the inner or outer display.
• Hold a reading while you reposition your device.
• Copy the angle with a tap.
• Automatically match your system’s light or dark appearance.

No account, or internet connection required.

Requires an iPhone Duo with hinge-angle support. Readings depend on the device’s hinge sensor.

name: Livostyle: Women's Clothing
description:
Livostyle is a US-based women's clothing store with more than 3,400 styles: dresses, tops, matching sets, outerwear, plus size, shoes and accessories. New arrivals land every week, and you can shop outfits by occasion, by price or only in your size.
