WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Shop looks for date night, wedding guest, holiday party, vacation, office, brunch, night out or a gift for her. The occasions on the home screen change with the season
• Turn on "Only show my size" and everything that won't fit disappears
• Filter by size, 12 colors, occasion, price and what's in stock
• Browse the same Shop menu as livostyle.com, plus New in your size and an Under $50 edit
• See every piece in photos and video, with a size guide and shipping details for your country
• Save your size once and product pages pick it for you
• Real stock counts: "Only 2 left" means two are left
• Sold out in your size? Tap "Get notified" and we'll tell you when it's back
• Complete the look with pieces that go together, or scroll through similar items
• Watch: a vertical video feed of real pieces. See something you like? Choose your size right in the feed
• Keep favorites in Saved

SHIPPING, DISCOUNTS AND CHECKOUT
• We ship to 40+ countries. Prices show in your currency, and the app sets your country and language on its own (English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Polish or Brazilian Portuguese)
• Bundle discount, applied automatically: 10% off 2 items, 15% off 3 or more. No code needed
• Free shipping on US orders over $97. Other countries have their own threshold, shown in the app in your currency, and the bag shows how close you are
• Orders ship from our overseas suppliers after 1–3 days of processing. Shipping details for your country are on every product page
• Pay in Shopify's secure checkout with Shop Pay, Apple Pay or a card
• Check out as a guest, or create an account to keep orders, addresses and sizes in one place
• US orders can be returned within 7 days. Returns are handled by email

NOTIFICATIONS YOU CONTROL
Order updates, bag reminders, back-in-stock alerts, price drops on saved items and new arrivals. Each type has its own switch, so keep the ones you like and turn off the rest. You can also delete your account in the app.

QUESTIONS?
Email info@arcada.store. Livostyle is run by Arcada LLC d/b/a Livostyle in Albuquerque, New Mexico, USA.

name: LogMyDailyTask
description:
LogMyDailyTask helps you keep a running record of what you worked on.

• Check in with an activity, add a note, and choose or create a category.
• See today's entries from newest to oldest. Tap a marked day in the monthly calendar to see its details.
• Choose your workdays, working hours, and reminder interval. Tap a scheduled notification to open Check-In.
• Add a start time, end time, and time zone when you need to track a work session.
• Choose a date range and export a CSV from the iOS share sheet.

Your check-ins are stored on your device and are available without signing in.

name: Loop Player - Phone, NAS & TV
description:
Loop Player plays your videos from your phone and NAS, and sends them to your TV.
Simple and easy, with fast, smooth playback. Videos on your phone or your NAS open right away, matching subtitle files are found for you, and casting to your TV takes one tap.

■ Your phone's videos, as they are
· Play videos from Photos and from folders in the Files app.
· Plays many formats as-is: mp4, mkv, avi, mov and more.

■ Subtitle files, found for you
· Automatically loads the subtitle file with the same name as the video (srt, smi, ass, vtt and more).
· Language-tagged files like "movie.en.srt" are chosen in your preferred language order.
· Finds subtitles for the same episode even when names differ a little.
· Adjust subtitle size, position, style (shadow, background, outline) and color.

■ Cast to your TV in one tap
· Google TV (Chromecast) and AirPlay — your subtitles go along too.
· Your phone becomes the remote: double-tap to skip, hold for 2x, control from the lock screen.

■ Play straight from your NAS or PC
· SMB (NAS, Windows shares), WebDAV, SFTP, FTP and DLNA.
· Stream without downloading.

■ Save for offline, move freely
· Download videos from your NAS and watch them without internet.
· Copy or move phone → NAS, NAS → phone, NAS → another NAS.
· Matching subtitles and resume positions come along.

■ Comfortable viewing
· Thumbnail list and grid, watch progress, resume playback
· Double-tap to skip (5/10/15/30 s), press and hold for 2x, swipe for brightness and volume
· Volume boost up to 300%, even out quiet sounds
· Picture in Picture, keep audio playing with the screen off
· Like your favorites, Dislike the ones to clean up later

■ Privacy
No sign-up, no data collected. Server passwords are stored only in your device Keychain.

Contact: cozyfieldworks@gmail.com

name: Looping: Tiny Habit Reminders
description:
Looping reminds you of small habits that take just seconds or minutes, at the times you choose, so you never forget them.

Turn small but frequent tasks like resting your eyes, fixing your posture, standing up to stretch, or drinking water into habits. When it's time, you'll get a reminder, and you can complete it right from the notification or a widget.

■ Reminders on your schedule
• At regular intervals, like every 20 minutes or every hour
• At set times, like 9:00, 13:00, and 18:00
• Choose the days and the hours you want reminders
• Add a time limit so only on-time check-ins count

■ Complete without opening the app
• Touch and hold a notification to complete or skip
• Complete what's due right from Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Complete habits that arrive together all at once, or one at a time

■ Take a break when you need it
• Pause for 30 minutes, an hour, or until 9:00 tomorrow
• Pause until a date and time you choose
• Pause all habits at once

■ Your last 7 days
• See what you did and missed each day
• Completion rate by habit and a daily chart

■ Start fast with presets
Pick common habits like Eye Rest, Stand Up, Stretch, Check Priorities, and Review Vocabulary to get started right away.

■ No data collection
All habits and history stay on your device. No sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

Available in English, Korean, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese, with Dark Mode support.

name: Losing It
description:
Every pound deserves a moment.

Losing It is a gentle weight loss journal that turns your progress into something you can see and celebrate. Tell it where you started and where you are headed, and it lays out one bubble for every pound in between. Every time a weigh-in takes you past another pound, its bubble pops with a small burst and a soft haptic tap. And when you want to, log your food and calories too.

It is a calm, kind place to keep track, dressed in linen, sage and clay with classic serif type. No shouting numbers, no guilt. Just you, showing up.

POUND BUBBLES
- One bubble for every pound between your starting weight and your goal
- Popped bubbles fill with an earthy ombre and remember the day they popped
- A star marks every fifth pound, and a crown waits at your goal
- Pounds you have reached before stay softly marked, so an up day never erases how far you have come

WEIGH-INS THAT FEEL GOOD
- A scale-style ruler that ticks under your thumb, or tap the number to type it
- Add a mood, a date and a note if you like
- After every weigh-in, a short celebration with the bubbles you just popped, new badges and an affirmation
- When the scale goes up, the words stay kind
- Edit or delete any entry from your full history

FOOD & CALORIES
- A simple food log for breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks
- Scan a barcode with your camera, type the numbers in, or add any food by hand with a name and calories
- Product names and calories come from Open Food Facts, an open food database. Adjust anything to match your package.
- Count by the label's serving or by grams
- Recent foods, logged again with one tap
- An optional daily calorie target that you choose, with a ring for what's left. Or keep it off.
- A day over your target gets kind words, never a warning
- Look back at earlier days, and edit or delete any food

PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
- A weight chart for the last week, month, 3 months, 6 months or all time, with your goal line
- Weekly changes, pounds lost and to go, lowest weight, streaks and best week
- An estimated goal date based on your recent trend
- A milestone for every 5 pounds

PROGRESS PHOTOS
- Add photos from your library or take one with the camera
- Each photo shows the weight from a nearby weigh-in
- Compare any two with a before-and-after slider or side by side

YOUR GLOW RECAPS
- Story-style recaps for this week, last week, your recent months and your whole journey
- Pounds lost, a consistency calendar, personal bests, your photos and a summary card to share
- A trophy case of 21 badges

DAILY AFFIRMATIONS
- A new affirmation every day. Shuffle it, or tap the heart on the ones you love.
- Optional daily weigh-in reminders

GLOW COACH, ON DEVICE
On iPhones with Apple Intelligence and iOS 26 or later, the optional Glow Coach writes short pep talks for your day, your weigh-ins and your recaps. It runs entirely on your iPhone and is designed to cheer you on, not to give diet, food or exercise advice.

WIDGETS
- Pound Bubbles for the Home Screen (small, medium, large), with your next bubbles to pop on the medium and large sizes
- Daily Affirmation for the Home Screen
- Glow Progress for the Lock Screen

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no ads and no tracking
- Your journal and food log sync through your own private iCloud. Without iCloud, they stay on this iPhone.
- A barcode lookup sends only the barcode number to Open Food Facts, nothing about you
- Erase everything at any time from Settings

GOOD TO KNOW
- Weights are in pounds and food in calories (kcal).
- Barcode lookups need an internet connection.
- Glow Coach requires an iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence.
- Losing It is a personal journal for motivation and reflection. It is not a medical device and does not give medical, diet or nutrition advice. Please talk with a healthcare professional before starting any weight loss plan or choosing a calorie target.

name: Lots
description:
Lots planerar hela resan genom Åbolands skärgård – bil och färja i samma plan.

Välj start och mål, eller låt appen utgå från var du är. Lots visar nästa avgångar med Finferries riktiga tidtabell (via Fintraffic FINAP), körningen till och från färjeläget och en sammanhängande restid dörr till dörr.

• Riktiga färjetider för Pargas, Nagu, Korpo, Houtskär och Iniö
• Hela resan: körning, väntan och färja i en plan
• Larm före avfärd
• Karta över rutten och färjorna
• Fungerar offline med den senast hämtade tidtabellen
• Inget konto och ingen spårning
• Svenska, finska och engelska

Tidtabellen hämtas från Finferries via Fintraffic FINAP. Körtider och anslutningar är uppskattningar – kontrollera alltid den officiella tidtabellen före resan. Lots är en oberoende tjänst och är inte ansluten till Finferries eller Fintraffic.

Annonsplatser är alltid tydligt märkta.

Lots drivs av Nordiso Oy, Pargas. Frågor: info@nordiso.com.

name: Lumora Property Care
description:
Lumora Property Care is a team management application designed to streamline cleaning operations, property scheduling, and daily task coordination for authorized Lumora Property Care employees.

Key Features

• Property Management — Organize property information, addresses, access details, and management company associations.

• Cleaning Schedules — View scheduled properties, check-in requirements, and upcoming cleaning assignments.

• Task Management — Assign cleaning tasks, track progress, and record completed work.

• Team Coordination — Manage cleaning assignments for individual employees or teams.

• Cleaning Checklists — Follow task-specific checklists to maintain consistent cleaning standards.

• Financial Reporting — Authorized administrators can review cleaner payouts and operational financial reports.

• Bilingual Support — English and Spanish language options for team members.

Lumora Property Care helps administrators and cleaning professionals stay organized, improve communication, and manage daily operations more efficiently.

Access is restricted to authorized Lumora Property Care team members. A valid employee account is required to use the application.

name: Lunara Orbit & Align Phases
description:
Lunara Orbit is a calm night-sky puzzle: moon-phase shards float on a celestial disc. Rotate the disc and swap shards until every phase sits in the correct lunar order, guided by starlight on each true seat.

How to play
• Drag around the disc or tap Rotate to shift all shards.
• Tap one shard, then another, to swap them.
• North Star marks the start of the cycle. Correct seats twinkle.
• Restore twelve orbits, from short arcs to the full eight-phase moon.

Also included
• Phase Almanac — browse all eight moon faces with short notes.
• Clear Progress — wipe local save from the Crossing screen.
• Privacy — opens in the in-app browser.

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases. Progress saves on device. Offline play supported.

name: Lutanu: Flick Quest
description:
Discover trending movies and TV shows, search any title, watch official trailers, and play a poster color-palette game, all in one app for your next favorite watch.

DISCOVER TRENDING MOVIES & TV SHOWS
Looking for something great to watch tonight? Browse trending, popular, and now-playing movies updated daily. Explore top-rated picks and genre-based lists, and get recommendations based on what you're viewing.

DETAILS FOR EVERY MOVIE & TV SHOW
See runtime, release date, genres, and overview at a glance. Browse posters and backdrop art for every title, and explore TV shows season by season with episode counts included.

WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILERS
Watch official trailers right inside the app and decide what to watch before you commit.

SEARCH & FILTER
Search across movies and TV shows by title, and filter by genre to find what fits your mood. See what's trending the moment you open search.

BUILD YOUR OWN LIBRARY
Save your favorites with one tap and keep them all in one place. Your library is stored on your device, and no account is required.

PLAY WITH POSTERS
Test your movie knowledge by guessing the poster from its color palette in a fun mini game. Beat your best score, win rounds to collect color palettes from movie posters, and challenge yourself again and again.

MADE FOR IPHONE & IPAD
Available in English, Spanish, and French, and optimized for both iPhone and iPad.

Download now and find your next favorite movie tonight.

name: Maark Editor
description:
Maark Editor is a Markdown viewer first, and an editor too. READMEs, docs, notes and the Markdown that AI assistants write open as polished, rendered pages. When something needs changing, you edit it in the same window.

It works on your own plain files, where you keep them. No account, no library to import into, and free.

READ

• Clean, readable pages instead of raw Markdown syntax: GitHub-flavoured Markdown with tables, task lists, footnotes, code blocks with a copy button, inline HTML and YAML front matter. Ideal for the long Markdown answers AI assistants give.

• Mermaid with 20 diagram kinds, drawn on the device and offline: flowcharts, sequence, class, state and ER diagrams, Gantt, pie, mind maps, timelines, Git graphs and more. Decision-tree blocks turn a plain-language list into a tree.

• Pictures from your folder or from the web, shown in the preview. Web pictures load only once you allow it.

• Browse whole folders in a sidebar: a project's docs, a folder of notes, an Obsidian vault. Subfolders, new, rename, duplicate, move and delete.

• Several documents at once: tabs and windows on the Mac, several windows side by side on iPad.

• A history like a browser's: follow a link to another .md file, then step Back and Forward through the pages you visited.

• Control the display: Edit, Preview or Split side by side with both halves scrolling together; a table of contents; wide tables at natural width or fitted to the page; text size; Hide UI for the document alone; on the Mac a see-through window.

• Print or export as PDF, with clean page breaks and repeated table headers.

WRITE

• Table editor: edit a Markdown table in a grid. Add and remove rows and columns, and the table is written back neatly aligned. Pasted CSV becomes a table.

• Smart links: paste a web address over selected text and it becomes a link; ⌘K makes a link from the clipboard.

• Syntax highlighting that keeps the source easy to scan, including code in fenced blocks. Links fold to their title until you edit them.

• A formatting bar for headings, lists, quotes and inline styles. Return continues lists, Tab indents, and every action is one Undo step.

• Find and replace, with regular expressions and capture groups. Matches are marked in the editor and the preview.

LOOK

• 22 themes, each in light and dark: 44 looks, from GitHub and Solarized to Nord, Gruvbox, Monokai and Tokyo Night.

• Theme editor: change every colour, the editor font, the preview font and the preview layout. Changes to a built-in theme are marked and can be reset; themes import and export as JSON.

• One setting turns editor, preview and window light or dark, or follows the system.

FILES

• Plain .md files, read and written in place, with autosave. When another app changes an open file, it reloads and keeps your place.

PRIVATE

Maark Editor collects no data: no account, no analytics, no advertising.

Free on Mac, iPhone and iPad. In English and German.

name: MacchinAI
description:
MacchinAI dans votre poche : l'application des équipes qui travaillent avec MacchinAI, l'outil de gestion et d'agents IA de leur entreprise.

Réservée aux administrateurs et aux employés d'une entreprise équipée de MacchinAI : il faut un compte sur l'installation MacchinAI de votre entreprise pour l'utiliser. Aucun achat dans l'application.

DICTEZ, C'EST CRÉÉ
Touchez le micro et dites la tâche comme à un collègue : « Rappeler Claire jeudi pour le devis, projet site vitrine, c'est urgent ». L'IA choisit le projet ou le client, la personne, l'échéance et la priorité ; vous vérifiez, la tâche est créée. Demandez-lui de faire faire le travail et elle confie la tâche au bon agent IA.

VOS TÂCHES DU JOUR
En retard, aujourd'hui, dans les sept jours : tout ce qui vous est attribué, rangé par échéance. Un geste pour terminer une tâche, un autre pour changer son statut, son échéance ou la personne qui s'en occupe. Commentez à l'écrit ou à la voix, joignez une photo prise sur le terrain, un fichier ou une note vocale.

VOS PROJETS
Filtrez d'un doigt par état et par catégorie, retrouvez les tâches ouvertes de chaque projet, ses discussions avec les agents, et dictez une nouvelle tâche directement dans le projet.

VOS AGENTS IA
Confiez une tâche à un agent IA et suivez son travail. Parlez-lui à la voix, répondez à ses demandes d'autorisation sur place. Ce que les agents ont préparé et qui attend votre accord se valide depuis l'onglet Plus.

TRI RAPIDE DES E-MAILS
Vos e-mails un par un, comme une pile de cartes : glissez à gauche pour supprimer, à droite pour ranger dans le bon dossier, ou faites-en une tâche en un geste. Pour répondre, dites à l'IA quoi écrire, relisez et envoyez.

CONTACTS ET MODULES
Retrouvez un contact pour l'appeler, lui envoyer un SMS ou un e-mail. Les modules de votre installation s'ouvrent directement, déjà connectés.

NOTIFICATIONS
Une tâche qu'on vous attribue, la réponse d'un agent, une demande d'autorisation : vous êtes prévenu, et un toucher ouvre le bon écran.

PLUSIEURS COMPTES
Reliez votre iPhone en scannant un QR code depuis votre ordinateur, sans mot de passe. Un même iPhone peut être relié à plusieurs installations MacchinAI, et l'application se verrouille par Face ID.

Vos données restent sur l'installation MacchinAI de votre entreprise. Aucune publicité, aucun traceur.

name: Mafia Flow
description:
MafiaFlow — a convenient tool for Mafia game hosts.

Organize the game, manage players, and keep track of every stage of the game, all from your iPad.

App Features:

• Player Management — Add players and track their status throughout the game.
• Roles — Assign roles and keep track of team compositions.
• Game Phases — Easily switch between night and day phases.
• Voting — Conduct votes and record the results.
• Game Control — Monitor the progress of the game and player actions.
• Intuitive Interface — All the essential tools for the host are conveniently gathered in one place.

MafiaFlow is designed to help hosts spend less time dealing with organizational tasks and more time focusing on the game itself.

Host your Mafia game with confidence, ease, and without unnecessary distractions.

name: Magneettipulma
description:
Astu Polaris Labiin, magneettiseen logiikkapeliin, jossa jokainen siirto muuttaa magneettikenttää.

Valitse kuutio, vaihda sen napaisuutta ja liu'uta sitä pelilaudalla. Samanmerkkiset navat hylkivät toisiaan, kun taas vastakkaiset navat vetävät toisiaan puoleensa. Suunnittele jokainen siirto niin, että vetovoima ja hylkimisvoima muodostavat ketjureaktioita, jotka ohjaavat kuutiot oikeille paikoilleen.

Ohjaa jokainen kuutio omalle merkitylle alustalleen ja varmista, että sen varaus vastaa vaatimuksia. Seinät ja eristeet katkaisevat magneettikentän. Liukukiskot ja portaalit muuttavat kulkureittejäsi. Ansaitse tähtiä suorittamalla tasot tiukkojen siirtorajojen puitteissa. Huolella suunnitellut peliluvut opettavat ensin perusteet, kasvattavat sitten haastetta ja tarjoavat lopulta yllättäviä pulmia.

Käytä rajatonta peruutustoimintoa, tarkastele magneettikentän vaikutusaluetta ennen siirtoa ja tutki ratkaisujen uusintoja, kun kaipaat uusia näkökulmia. Esteettömyysasetuksiin kuuluvat värinä, vähennetyt animaatiot, korkea kontrasti sekä vasen- tai oikeakätisille sopivat ohjausasettelut.

Ajattele kuin fyysikko. Pelaa kuin strategi. Ota magneettinen pelilauta haltuun.

name: MailPrediction Pro
description:
MailPrediction Pro es una herramienta para magos y mentalistas que quieren preparar y ejecutar rutinas de predicción durante sus actuaciones.

Con Dibujo puedes capturar en tiempo real los trazos de un PAD Bluetooth compatible, organizarlos en hasta cuatro lienzos y consultar cada captura por separado. Las rutinas compatibles también permiten enviar predicciones por correo electrónico a los destinatarios que selecciones.

TheWatch, la app complementaria para Apple Watch, permite consultar capturas y controlar rutinas compatibles desde la muñeca. Algunas funciones requieren un iPhone enlazado o un accesorio compatible, como PAD MINI, Key Prediction Pro o TheBox.

La descarga es gratuita. Para acceder a las funciones de la app necesitas una cuenta habilitada por invitación.

name: Manga-Verse: Ink
description:
Manga-Verse: Ink is an inking app for iPad and Apple Pencil, made for one job: pen and brush lines that feel right to a working manga artist.

Draw on a white landscape page in pure black ink. Pressure changes the width of the line, lines taper to a point where you lift the Pencil, and the strokes are drawn live with Metal for a direct, low-latency feel.

PENS AND BRUSHES
• Thirteen tools in a tray: dip pens (G-pen, Kabura pen, Maru pen), brush pens (Fude pen, Hair-tip pen, Fine fude pen, Pocket brush pen), fude brushes (Choryu, Menso-fude, Kasure brush) and markers (fineliner in six tip sizes, a gray marker in five grays, a fill marker)
• The G-pen and the Fude pen are tuned by hand, and the rest of the set is being refined with artists' feedback
• Tune a pen's width, pressure response and the length of its tapered end, saved for each pen

SIMPLE AND FOCUSED
• Undo and redo, clear the page, and share your page as a PNG
• A plain About screen with the privacy summary
• Your page saves itself and is there when you come back
• English and Japanese
• Left- and right-handed layouts
• No account, no ads, no tracking. The app makes no network requests

Manga-Verse: Ink is an independent app and is not affiliated with any manga publisher, studio or pen maker.

name: Manipülasyon Oyunları
description:
İlişkinde bir şey seni rahatsız ediyor ama adını koyamıyor musun? "Abartıyor muyum?" diye düşünüp susuyor musun?

Manipülasyon Oyunları, ilişkine dair sorunu takma adla sorabileceğin, benzer şeyleri yaşamış insanların sana sakin ve destekleyici yanıtlar yazdığı bir topluluk.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR
Sorunu yaz, takma adınla paylaş. Gerçek adın, telefonun, hiçbir kişisel bilgin istenmez.
Soru, yayımlanmadan önce bir moderatör tarafından okunur.
Topluluk yorum yazar, dilediğin bir ankete oy verirsin.
"Efendi'nin Yorumu" bölümünde seçilmiş sorulara editöryal bir bakış eklenir.

NEDEN GÜVENLİ
Her soru ve her yorum yayımlanmadan önce incelenir.
Metnin içinde telefon numarası, e-posta gibi seni tanıtabilecek bilgi varsa uygulama sen yazarken uyarır.
Rahatsız eden içeriği tek dokunuşla bildirebilir, bir kullanıcıyı engelleyebilirsin.
Özel mesajlaşma yoktur; kimse sana doğrudan yazamaz.
Fotoğraf veya video yüklenmez.
Hesabını ve tüm paylaşımlarını istediğin an uygulama içinden kalıcı olarak silebilirsin.

NE DEĞİLDİR
Bu uygulama terapi, teşhis ya da hukuki danışmanlık aracı değildir. Kimseye "narsist", "psikopat" gibi etiketler konmaz; yaşanan davranış konuşulur. Acil bir durumda 112'yi ara.

KİTAPLIK
Konularla ilgili basılı kitap önerileri yer alır. Satın alma işlemi uygulama dışında, ilgili mağazada yapılır.

YAŞ SINIRI
Uygulama yalnızca 18 yaşından büyükler içindir.

name: Marble Masquerade
description:
Marble Masquerade is a route-building puzzle, not a card battle or deck-builder. Every playing card becomes a piece of a working glass rail: its rank sets length and momentum, while its suit changes the shape of the journey. Spades run straight, clubs open forks, hearts curl into loops and diamonds launch the marble over bouncing crests.

Read the mask gate before placing a card. The marble must pass in the exact suit order shown, then reach the bell bridge with ranks that rise, fall or stay within four. Wind, entry angle, grade and Safety Rail choices all affect stability, so a route that looks tidy can still lose speed or drift at the wrong moment. Preview the risk line, try a reduced-reward test run, or lock the finished route for the full score.

Masquerade Tour offers 40 routes across five glass pavilions. Daily Run builds a shared offline layout from the calendar date. Blueprint Puzzles present 24 fixed hands with one exact solution. Endless Loop adds maintenance pressure after every successful run. Rail Atelier earns cosmetic marbles, masks and rail details through play, while Glass Atlas records pavilions, mechanisms, parade honours and achievements.

Every gate, fork, loop, lift and brake follows the same Suite Rail language. There are no ads, accounts, stamina limits, real-money rewards, loot boxes or in-app purchases. The full game is offline, portrait-only and built for both iPhone and iPad.

name: Mark Roll
description:
Mark Roll rolls a spool until the match mark sits on the nearest bolt hole. Holes are spaced evenly around the circle. The sentence tells you to roll back, roll clockwise, or set the bolts.

Drag the mark on the hex dial. The mark follows your finger. The shortest bar is the nearest hole. Tap a hole to read its gap. The gap does not move the mark.

Spool 6 has 8 holes, a 20 degree mark, and a 5 degree band. The nearest hole is at 0 degrees, so the sentence says roll back. Elbow 4 has 6 holes and a 70 degree mark. Change the hole count, the band, or the starting mark. An odd count stays off this spool. Swipe a clamp dog to remove it.

The spool and the dogs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This sketch is not a substitute for the bolt-up procedure.

name: Market Monolith Operator
description:
Market Monolith Operator is the companion field app for independent contractors earning guaranteed batch pay across local neighborhood routes.

Choose when and where you work across door-to-door product introductions, die-cut 4.25x11 QR door hangers, street team activations, live hot-lead video handoffs to merchants, and commercial 24x18 sign installations.

BUILT FOR FIELD OPERATORS
• Neighborhood Radar & Open Batches: Preview nearby corridor demand, stop counts, estimated walking duration, and guaranteed batch pay before you claim an assignment.
• Live Hot-Lead Video Deals & Commissions: Connect eager homeowners at the door directly to the merchant on live video to close a deal and earn per-conversion bonuses alongside guaranteed route pay.
• Turn-by-Turn Walking Routes & Live Activity: Follow multi-stop neighborhood routes with Lock Screen and Dynamic Island Live Activity updates while your assignment is active.
• Native Field Kit Proof Capture: Snap daylight photo verification for QR door hangers and 24x18 corner signs with automatic timestamp and stop check-in — even when cellular coverage dips.
• Free Shipped Field Kits: Receive branded apparel, product sample kits, die-cut door hangers, and sign hardware shipped at $0 cost to you.
• Transparent Stripe Express Payouts: Track settled batch earnings, per-conversion bonuses, and instant payout transfers in real time.
• Privacy-First Location Controls: Location is requested progressively only after clear disclosure — active route tracking runs strictly during leased missions and shuts off immediately when you pause, finish a route, or sign out.

name: MAS SAS
description:
MAS SAS adalah aplikasi internal PT Mas Automobil Sejahtera untuk mengelola dokumen penjualan unit truk: Surat Pesanan Kendaraan (SPK), Sales Approval Sheet (SAS), dan pengajuan Insentif penjualan.

KHUSUS KARYAWAN
Aplikasi ini hanya untuk karyawan / staff PT Mas Automobil Sejahtera. Login hanya dapat dilakukan dengan akun perusahaan, dan akun hanya dapat dibuat oleh Administrator perusahaan. Tidak ada pendaftaran akun mandiri di aplikasi.

FITUR UTAMA
- Buat SPK, SAS, dan Insentif langsung dari HP, lengkap dengan tanda tangan digital
- Alur persetujuan berjenjang oleh Sales, Branch, atau Area Manager dan Direktur
- Setujui atau tolak dokumen dengan tanda tangan dan catatan penolakan
- Notifikasi saat dokumen diajukan, disetujui, atau ditolak
- Riwayat pengajuan dan revisi setiap dokumen
- Statistik penjualan: grafik pembelian, peringkat sales, dan pembeli terbesar
- Data master customer dan region
- Cetak dan bagikan dokumen sebagai PDF

Belum punya akun atau lupa password? Hubungi Administrator Sistem di perusahaan Anda.

name: MAS Transport
description:
MAS Transport adalah aplikasi resmi manajemen internal PT. Mitra Angkutan Sejati (MAS Group) untuk mendukung pemantauan operasional, persetujuan dokumen, dan akses laporan perusahaan melalui perangkat seluler.

Fitur utama:
• Persetujuan dokumen secara cepat, seperti penawaran, uang jalan, dan biaya job.
• Pemantauan armada, proyek, dan pekerjaan pengiriman.
• Ringkasan operasional dan laporan perusahaan.
• Galeri foto unit dengan cap waktu dan lokasi.
• Login aman dengan Face ID.

Aplikasi ini khusus untuk karyawan internal perusahaan. Login hanya dapat dilakukan dengan akun yang dibuat oleh administrator perusahaan; tidak ada pendaftaran akun dari aplikasi. Untuk permohonan akun, silakan menghubungi administrator sistem PT. Mitra Angkutan Sejati.

name: MAS Transport : Driver
description:
MAS Transport : Driver adalah aplikasi resmi untuk driver PT. Mitra Angkutan Sejati (MAS Group) dalam menjalankan pekerjaan pengiriman alat berat dan muatan.

Fitur utama:
• Menerima job pengiriman beserta rute, jadwal, dan informasi unit.
• Memperbarui status perjalanan: diterima, muat, dalam perjalanan, bongkar.
• Foto bukti tugas (kendaraan, muatan, surat jalan, nota) dengan cap waktu dan lokasi.
• Serah terima dokumen dan tanda terima pengiriman.
• Pengajuan dan riwayat uang jalan.
• Notifikasi job baru dan pencairan uang jalan.

Aplikasi ini khusus untuk driver dan staf internal perusahaan. Semua akun dibuat oleh bagian administrasi kantor; tidak ada pendaftaran akun dari aplikasi. Login menggunakan nomor HP dan PIN yang diberikan kantor.

name: MECUM: Never Forget a Thing
description:
Ever closed the door behind you, only to realise your keys are still inside? MECUM is the friendly reminder at your door.

MECUM notices the moment you leave and shows what to take with you: keys, wallet, medicine, charger or whatever matters to you. Tap what you have, or swipe once: all packed. Done.

KNOWS WHEN YOU’RE LEAVING
• Through your location, an NFC sticker by the door or your usual departure time
• A list for every place: home, work, your partner’s, the gym
• A nudge right at the door, not around the corner

SMART LISTS
• Your list adapts to your day: the gym bag on Tuesdays, the umbrella when rain is forecast
• Checks your calendar: a flight? Your passport is added
• Return-trip rule: what you brought somewhere comes back home with you

FOR EVERYONE
• Simple mode with big buttons and large text
• Read-aloud and clear vibration patterns, usable without sound
• High contrast and reduced motion
• Great for young and old, and for anyone who forgets things now and then

TOGETHER
• Share lists with your family, a co-parent or your carer
• Kids tick things off on their own simple screen
• A carer only sees whether it worked, never where someone is

PRIVACY FIRST
• Everything stays on your own phone
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• One-time purchase, no subscription

MECUM is Latin for “with me”. Made by Walraven Labs.

name: MedyaFobi
description:
MedyaFobi'nin resmî iPhone uygulaması.

• Medya Kaza Raporu: medyada yaşanan iletişim kazaları ve krizlerden dersler
• Eğitimler: Medya, Kriz İletişimi, Konuşma, VIP Koçluk
• Hikâyemiz ve referanslarımız
• Yazıları uygulama içinde rahatça okuyun; paylaşın ya da sitede açın
• İnternet yokken son indirilen yazılar okunabilir
• Açık ve koyu tema

Reklam yok, üyelik yok. Uygulamanın içeriği Türkçedir.

name: Meeting Timer · Tech Mallorca
description:
Meeting Timer es el temporizador de turnos para reuniones de networking, presentaciones por rondas y cualquier encuentro en el que cada persona tiene un tiempo para hablar.

Prepara la agenda, pulsa «Iniciar turno» y deja que la app lleve el reloj: todo el mundo ve cuánto le queda, suena la campana al terminar y nadie se pasa de tiempo sin darse cuenta.

EMPIEZA EN UN MINUTO
• Sin cuenta ni registro: crea tu propia reunión y añade participantes.
• Para cada persona: nombre, empresa, profesión, tipo de intervención y tiempo.
• Cambia el orden, añade intervenciones especiales y guarda la agenda para la próxima vez.
• ¿Solo quieres verla funcionar? Prueba con la agenda de ejemplo.

UN RELOJ QUE SE VE DESDE EL FONDO DE LA SALA
• Cuenta atrás grande y clara, con el nombre y la empresa de quien habla.
• Aviso en dorado en los últimos segundos y en rojo cuando se acaba el tiempo.
• Campana y sonidos de aviso que suenan aunque el iPhone esté en silencio.
• La pantalla no se apaga mientras corre un turno.

CONTROL TOTAL DEL TURNO
• Iniciar, pausar, sumar o restar 10 segundos y reiniciar.
• Pasa al siguiente o vuelve al anterior cuando tú decidas: el siguiente turno nunca arranca solo.
• Deshacer, bloquear los botones y finalizar la reunión con un resumen de tiempos que puedes exportar.
• Si la app se cierra a mitad de un turno, recupera la reunión donde estaba.

PROYECTOR Y VARIOS DISPOSITIVOS
• Conecta el iPhone o el iPad al proyector por cable o AirPlay: la sala ve el reloj a pantalla completa y tú sigues con los controles.
• Usa un iPhone como mando y otro iPhone, iPad o Mac como pantalla, conectados por wifi o Bluetooth, sin necesidad de internet.
• En iPad, atajos de teclado para manejarlo todo sin tocar la pantalla.

TUS DATOS SON TUYOS
• Sin anuncios, sin analítica y sin rastreo.
• Tu reunión se guarda en el dispositivo y en tu propio iCloud.

¿Tu grupo ya usa Meeting Timer con una clave de acceso? Introdúcela en la pantalla de inicio para cargar la agenda del grupo y sincronizar el mando con la pantalla de la sala.

name: Memorn
description:
Memorn は、Mac・iPhone・iPad で使える、オフラインのメモアプリです。

■ 仕上がりの見た目で書く
「# 」で見出し、「- 」で箇条書き、「[] 」でチェックボックス。記号はすぐに隠れて、整った見た目のまま書き進められます。「/」で書式のメニューも出せます。

■ プロジェクトとページの階層
メモをプロジェクトにまとめ、ページの中に子ページを作れます。ほかのページへのリンクも張れます。

■ Mac で広く使う
タブ、上下左右の分割、複数のウィンドウ、豊富なキーボードショートカットで、広い画面を生かせます。

■ リンクはカードで
URL を貼ると、ページの名前・説明・画像のカードになります。中身は1度だけ取得して端末に保存するので、オフラインでも表示できます。

■ 自分好みに
外観（ライト・ダーク）、アクセント色、書体（ゴシック・丸ゴシック・明朝・等幅）、文字の大きさ、行間を選べます。

■ プライバシー
メモは端末の中だけに保存します。アカウントの登録はいりません。データを集めたり、追跡したりしません。

name: Memory Dive: Photo Years
description:
Every year you've photographed, all around you.

Memory Dive arranges the photo library already on your Apple Vision Pro as prints in the space around you, so you can look back through your years and show them to the people who were there. There is nothing to import and no account to make. Your most recent 12 months are free, and one purchase opens every year

YOUR YEARS
Your library becomes a corridor of prints through time, your earliest years nearest you and every year after them ahead. Pinch and drag to move through the years, and pinch a year to go straight to it. Pinch a print to bring it close.

PLACES
A globe lit only where you have taken photos. Pinch a place and its photos fan out around you. Pinch with both hands to zoom the globe.

ONE PHOTO, ITS WHOLE DAY
Open a photo onto its day: when and where it was taken, and the photos taken around it. Pinch any of them to follow the trip.

YOU DECIDE WHAT SHOWS
Screenshots are left out, and your Hidden album is never read. When Memory Dive picks photos on its own, it skips ones that look private, such as bedroom, bathroom or swimwear shots. Hide any photo from Memory Dive with one pinch, and bring hidden photos back from the gallery menu.

COMFORT
See your years in your room, or turn the Digital Crown to bring them further around you. Calm motion keeps movement gentle. Every scene has a control bar to leave, restart or recenter at any time.

PRIVACY
Memory Dive never uploads or collects your photos. To name places, approximate photo locations are sent to Apple Maps. Photos stored in iCloud download from Apple to show at full size. No accounts, ads, analytics or tracking.

PRICE
Free to download. Your most recent 12 months of photos are always free. Every Year is a single in-app purchase that opens every year of your library. Paid once, Family Sharing included, no subscription.
Not ready to share your library? A built-in sample library, painted on the device with no real photos or people, lets you try every scene first, without giving Photos access.

name: Mentarium
description:
Mentarium hält ungeordnete Gedanken fest und macht Zusammenhänge sichtbar. Schreib einfach los – ordnen kannst du später.

ZETTEL OHNE PFLICHTFELDER
• Doppelt tippen oder „+ Zettel“ – der Text hat sofort den Fokus
• Text mit Formatierung, Bilder und Skizzen frei auf einem Zettel kombinieren
• Acht ruhige Farben, Größe und Lage frei wählbar

ZUSAMMENHÄNGE SICHTBAR MACHEN
• Benannte Gruppen als Rahmen um zusammengehörige Zettel
• Verbindungen mit Beschriftung, mit oder ohne Richtung – umkehrbar
• Mehrere Zettel gemeinsam verschieben, die Abstände bleiben

ÜBERBLICK BEHALTEN
• Zoomen und verschieben, „Alles anzeigen“ und eine Übersichtskarte
• Suche hebt passende Zettel hervor – auch über Gruppennamen und Bildbeschreibungen
• Liste aller Zettel, Gruppen und Verbindungen als Text (auch für VoiceOver)

SICHER AUFGEHOBEN
• Speichert jede Änderung sofort – „Lokal gespeichert“ erst, wenn es wirklich auf dem Gerät liegt
• Rückgängig, frühere Fassungen und Papierkorb (30 Tage)
• Vollständige Sicherung als Archiv; Ausgabe als SVG, PNG, PDF oder JSON mit Bildern

PRIVAT
• Kein Konto, keine Cloud, keine Werbung, kein Tracking – deine Gedanken bleiben auf deinem Gerät
• Mehrere Pinnwände, hell und dunkel, mit Tastatur bedienbar

Sprache: Deutsch.

name: Meshenger W3DS
description:
Meshenger is a messenger built on W3DS, where the data belongs to the person, not to the app.

The text of your messages is not stored in our database. It is written to your own sovereign data store — an eVault — and kept on your device so that chats open instantly. Our servers hold pointers only: who, to whom, when, and what kind of message.

That eVault is not ours either. It is held for you by a provider you choose — any of the eID and eVault providers of the W3DS architecture — so your identity and your data can move with you between applications, including away from this one.

• Private and group chats, with replies, reactions, forwarding and search
• Voice and video calls, with recording and transcripts
• Voice messages and round videos
• Files, photos, and places — with a live map when you share where you are
• Channels for sharing with many at once
• Calendar, reminders and daily summaries
• Twenty-two interface languages, and translation of incoming messages

Meshenger is not end-to-end encrypted today. We say so plainly rather than imply a guarantee we do not make — what we do promise is that your messages live on your own vault and not in our database.

name: Mijn Cortec
description:
Mijn Cortec is het gratis, persoonlijke onderhoudsboekje van Cortec B.V. in Vlijmen. Alles over uw auto op één plek, altijd op uw telefoon.

Wat kunt u in de app?
• Onderhoudsboekje: alle werkzaamheden aan uw auto, netjes op datum, met kilometerstand
• Facturen: elke factuur van Cortec staat automatisch in uw boekje, ook later nog te bekijken en te downloaden
• APK: de vervaldatum van uw APK en de APK-geschiedenis uit de RDW-gegevens
• Kilometerstand: vul zelf uw kilometerstand in, dan blijft uw boekje compleet
• Afspraak maken: kies een tijd voor onderhoud, APK of reparatie
• Status van uw auto: zie wanneer uw auto klaar is
• Boekje delen: download het onderhoudsboekje van uw auto als PDF, bijvoorbeeld voor een koper
• Meerdere auto's en zakelijk gebruik: meerdere voertuigen en collega's in één account

Privé en veilig
Alleen u ziet uw eigen gegevens. Een auto verschijnt pas in uw boekje nadat Cortec heeft bevestigd dat hij van u is. U kunt uw account en gegevens op elk moment zelf laten verwijderen via Profiel > Account verwijderen.

Hoe krijgt u toegang?
Log in met uw e-mailadres of met een koppelcode die u van Cortec krijgt (per e-mail, WhatsApp of aan de balie). Nog geen klant? Maak via de app of de website een afspraak.

Cortec B.V. is uw garage voor onderhoud, APK, reparatie en banden in Vlijmen en omgeving.

name: Mirror Notch
description:
Mirror Notch puts your Mac's notch on your iPhone. What's playing on your Mac, its battery and whatever you drop on the notch show up in the Dynamic Island, with controls that reach back to your Mac.

MUSIC IN THE ISLAND
Whatever plays on your Mac, from a music app to a video in the browser, appears in the Dynamic Island with its artwork. Play, pause and skip from the island, and set your Mac's volume from your iPhone. When your iPhone is locked, the same view shows on the Lock Screen.

SWING TO PASTE
Copy something on your iPhone, open Mirror Notch and flick the top edge away from you: your Mac pastes it right where you're typing. Send several things at once and one flick pastes them all. Swipe an item on the shelf to paste that one instead.

DROP IT ON THE NOTCH
Drag a file, an image or some text onto your Mac's notch and pick it up on your iPhone. Send things the other way from the share sheet, the Paste button or by dragging them into the app. New Mac screenshots can land on the shelf too. The shelf keeps your last 20 items: drag a box around several in the notch to take them out together.

FOCUS TIMER
Start a focus timer on your Mac from the notch or your iPhone. It counts down in the island, and you can stop it there.

WIDGET, NOTIFICATIONS AND SHORTCUTS
A Home Screen widget shows the newest item from your Mac. Something your Mac sends while Mirror Notch is closed arrives as a notification: touch and hold it to copy it. Send to Mac, Send Text to Mac and Get Latest from Mac work in Shortcuts.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your iPhone and Mac talk directly over your Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. No account, no tracking, and nothing you send between them goes to a server. You pair them once by comparing a code on both screens, and from then on everything between them is encrypted.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A Mac with macOS 14 or later and the free Mirror Notch app for Mac: mirrornotch.github.io
• iPhone and Mac on the same Wi-Fi network, with Bluetooth on
• The Dynamic Island needs iPhone 14 Pro or later, except iPhone 16e and iPhone 17e. On other iPhones, Mirror Notch shows on the Lock Screen.
• Swing to paste needs Accessibility for Mirror Notch on the Mac, so it can paste where you type.

name: MiseEnFold
description:
One upfront purchase. No subscriptions, no accounts, no ads, and zero network calls.

MiseEnFold turns the foldable iPhone Duo — as well as standard iPhone and iPad — into a calm, spill-safe, splatter-free kitchen sous-chef:

• COUNTERTOP L-FOLD STAND (TABLETOP)
Fold iPhone Duo gently into an L-shape beside the stove. Huge, high-contrast cooking steps (readable from a meter away) and parallel colored heat-bar timers stay elevated and clean above the crease. Extra-large (56+ pt) Prev, Timer, Voice, and Next controls plus live scaled ingredients sit safely below for floury fingers.

• SCALE BY WHAT YOU HAVE
Only have 250 g of Arborio rice left instead of 300 g? Tap any ingredient amount and watch every stock volume, butter gram, and serving yield rescale instantly without mental math — with one-tap Metric and Imperial conversion.

• CLICKABLE PARALLEL POT TIMERS + LIVE ACTIVITIES
Every time mention inside any recipe step ("18 min", "45 sec") becomes a tappable amber chip. Launch up to six simultaneous color-coded pot heat bars, backed by Lock Screen and Dynamic Island Live Activities plus synthesized copper-chime alerts.

• CLOSED COVER GROCERY & TIMER MODE
Fold iPhone Duo shut in the supermarket to see an aisle-sorted shopping list with giant 56+ pt check-off targets. While pots are simmering on the stove, closing the lid automatically focuses the countdown with tactile Pause and +1m controls on the 5.4-inch outer display.

• OFFLINE BLOG STRIPPER & COOKBOOK OCR + HANDS-FREE VOICE
Paste messy recipe text from food blogs or scan a cookbook photo — long stories and ad lines are stripped locally on your device, turning ingredients and cook times into structured cards. Optionally enable strictly on-device voice commands ("Next step", "Previous step", "Start timer", "Pause timer") in English, Turkish, or German.

• 1,800+ OFFLINE TRILINGUAL RECIPES + STANDARD IPHONE & IPAD COMPLETE
Includes 1,800 built-in trilingual recipes (English, Turkish, German) across 9 culinary chapters — Mains, Quick Suppers, Soups & Stews, Pasta & Grains, Seafood, Plant-Forward, Baking & Brunch, Sauces & Sides, and Desserts — with instant ingredient search, Favorites, Quick-25m filter, "Surprise Me" picker, and adaptive layouts for Tabletop L-fold, Book split view, Flat 180° workbench, compact iPhone portrait, and iPad Split View.

name: Mix Split
description:
Mix Split divides a volume in litres by the cement, sand, and gravel parts you type, then turns the cement into kilograms and whole bags.

Save a recipe as parts, including a mortar with no gravel. Set how many kilograms one litre of cement counts as. That density is the number you enter. Save a bag by its weight in kilograms. Bag count is cement kilograms divided by that weight, rounded up. A partial bag still counts as one bag to buy. Sand and gravel stay in litres.

On the bench, pick a recipe and a bag, type the litres, and read the split before you save it. A saved batch keeps the cement, sand, gravel, kilograms, and bags from the moment you saved it. Recipes, bags, and batches stay in a file on this phone.

Mix Split does not choose a ratio for a slab, a wall, or a foundation. The parts are only the parts you typed.

name: Moba TD: Lane Wars
description:
You steer no hero: you build, and your armies march by themselves

Raise buildings on the stone rings of your base and along the three lanes. Most buildings send out a wave every 30 seconds (Elites every 60, Titans every 90), and each wave marches down its lane to meet enemy towers, bastions and armies

Spend Spark with care: build, upgrade and repair, protect your Throne with armor plates, a dome and drones, and set Condensers on the forest farms for steady income. Towers and other defensive structures take the same pads as your army, so every defense costs you a building that would have sent out fighters

Break the enemy Throne and guard your own. Overheat starts at 12:00 and makes fighters hit harder every minute, and at 25:00 the Throne with the higher health percentage wins

Play online: ranked Duel or Team 3 vs 3, alone or with up to two friends in a party. Create private, unranked Duel or Team rooms for friends with a six-character code or a link. The host can add practice bots. Practice offers offline matches against bots, and How to play works offline

Six factions of fantasy fighters and machines clash in an ancient forest grown over a vanished machine civilization: Rusted, Overgrowth, Myrmidons, Etalons, Fangs and Isotopes. Each fields ten named fighters, from swarms to a towering Titan, and every building has three levels

Plays in landscape on iPhone and iPad. No sign-in, ads, purchases or analytics. Settings stay on your device

Available in ten languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Arabic, French, Bengali, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Indonesian

name: Mobile SLAM
description:
Connect a Livox Mid-360 LiDAR to your iPhone with a wired Ethernet adapter and build 3D maps on the spot while you walk. No PC or ROS needed.

FEATURES
• Live view: receive the LiDAR point cloud and IMU data and view them in 3D
• Mapping (SLAM): build a 3D map as you walk, using LiDAR-inertial odometry
• Save and view PCD: save maps as PCD files and view them in 3D in the app; export them from the Files app or the share sheet
• Localization: estimate your position against a saved map. Tap the map to give a starting pose, or let the app search for it
• Raw recording: save the received packets as they are
• Demo mode: try every step with simulated data, no hardware needed

REQUIREMENTS
• Livox Mid-360 and a 9–27 V power supply
• A wired Ethernet adapter for iPhone (USB-C, or via the Lightning to USB 3 Camera Adapter)
• In the iPhone's Ethernet settings, set the IP address manually to 192.168.1.50

PRIVACY
The app collects and sends no data. Maps and recordings stay on your iPhone.

Livox and Mid-360 are trademarks of their respective owners. This app is independent and not affiliated with Livox.

name: Modorama
description:
Midnight at the fairground. The carousel is lit, the guests are waiting, and you run the levers.

Every guest holds a ticket with a seat number. Pull a lever and the carousel turns by exactly that many seats. When a guest's seat stops at the gate, they climb on by themselves. Seat the whole queue, in order, in as few pulls as you can.

It sounds simple until the numbers go round. After seat 11 comes seat 0. A step of +4 on a 12-seater only ever stops at every fourth seat. And a broken seat must never stop at the gate, though it can roll right past.

Four acts, one new idea in each:

• The Loop: seat numbers wrap around like a clock, forwards and backwards
• Shared Factors: levers that share a factor with the seats reach only some of them, so you have to mix them
• Token Booth: tickets become sums like "the seat 17 steps after seat 9", then every pull costs tokens and the quick way is often too dear
• Times Table: a new lever multiplies the seat number, and seat 0 is a trap

Every lever tells you where it will stop before you pull it, and warns you if that would jam the ride. The first ride takes seconds to learn. The last one asks for twelve exact pulls on a budget, and the thinking is all yours.

• 20 handcrafted rides, each with one clear idea to find
• Every ride is proved by a computer solver that knows the fewest pulls. Match it for 3 stars
• Turn-based and relaxed: no reflexes needed. UNDO any pull
• Score points for stars, speed and streaks of 3-star rides, and climb the rank board on your iPhone
• Stuck? You have 5 skips per run. When they are gone, start a fresh run and beat your best score
• A real 3D carousel with galloping horses under a starry sky, marquee boards with chasing bulbs, ticket-stub levers, and fireworks over the carousel when the last guest sits down
• Play offline. No ads, no accounts, no tracking

name: MOOve PA
description:
MOOve PA is a personal voice assistant, built first for the disabled community.

You talk to it, and it answers out loud. Ask it to remember things that matter to you — a name, a routine, a note — and it can bring them back in later conversations.

It is designed to be easy to use if typing, reading a screen, or handling a phone is hard:

• Voice-first: speak your question, rather than typing
• Spoken replies, so you can listen instead of reading
• Large, high-contrast text when you do look at the screen
• Hands-free use, including with a headset, so you can speak and listen with less need to handle the phone

Your memories, on your iPhone

Memories and recent chats stay on your iPhone. You can look at them, delete one, or clear them in Settings.

Privacy

Nothing is sent off your iPhone until you agree on the consent screen. After you agree, when you ask a question the app sends your question, saved memories and recent chat to our server and to OpenAI, only to create that reply. The server does not keep a copy.

Turning your speech into text uses Apple's speech recognition. Apple may process your voice to produce the text. We do not receive the recording.

You can withdraw consent in Settings at any time. That stops the app sending data. It does not delete memories already stored on your iPhone.

Read the full privacy policy at https://moovemap.com/pa/privacy

Questions: pa@moovemap.com

MOOve PA is part of the MOOve family, from the maker of MOOve Map. It is for iPhone and needs iOS 17 or later. It is intended for people aged 13 and over.

MOOve PA is a general assistant. It does not give medical advice, and it is not a medical device.

name: Motion VMS
description:
Motion VMS is the resident app for estates and complexes that use Motion VMS visitor management and gate access by Motion Kulca.

Your estate must be on Motion VMS. Sign in with the mobile number or username your estate has on record. If your estate has not set you up yet, ask your estate office.

INVITE VISITORS IN SECONDS
• Create a pass for a visitor, contractor, delivery, service provider or group
• Each pass has a QR code and a PIN, with the dates and times it is valid
• Send the pass to your visitor's phone, or share it yourself
• The guard scans or keys it in at the gate. No phone calls, no waiting at the boom

SEE WHO IS COMING AND WHO IS ON SITE
• Upcoming, on-site and past visits in one list
• Get a notice when your visitor arrives and leaves
• Approve or turn away a walk-in visitor from your phone
• Save regular visitors such as domestic staff, gardeners and carers

PARCELS
• Know when a parcel or letter arrives at the gatehouse
• Collect it with a one-time code

YOUR ESTATE
• Estate notices and polls
• Book facilities such as the clubhouse
• Log and follow up support tickets
• Estate documents in one place

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Hold the SOS button to send a security, medical or fire alert to your estate's security team, with your unit and, if you allow it, your location
• The SOS button does not replace emergency services. In a life-threatening emergency call 10111 or 112.

YOUR HOUSEHOLD AND VEHICLES
• Add household members and register your vehicles
• See your own entries and exits

PRIVACY FIRST
• Privacy centre: see what your estate holds about you, download it, or ask for it to be corrected or deleted
• Built for South Africa's POPIA. No advertising and no tracking
• Privacy policy: https://motionkulca.co.za/motion-vms/privacy/

Motion VMS is made in South Africa by Motion Kulca (Pty) Ltd. Help: info@motionkulca.co.za or 087 711 0020.

name: Motorsports Marketplace
description:
SAFE. SIMPLE. SECURE. The marketplace built for people who build.

Motorsports Marketplace matches performance parts to your exact vehicle, from shops and sellers who passed an ID check. Every part is listed under the year, make and model it actually fits, so you stop guessing and start building.

FIND PARTS THAT FIT
• Scan your VIN with your camera, or pick year, make and model
• Cars, trucks, SUVs, motorcycles, UTVs, powersports and race cars
• Buy from real shops and verified members in one place

BUY WITH BUYER PROTECTION
• Pay by card or bank
• On most orders your payment is held until your part arrives
• Report a problem right in the app

YOUR GARAGE AND WISHMODS
• Save every vehicle you own, or dream about
• Track the mods you've done and the ones you want
• Share your build, or keep it private

MORE FOR THE CAR LIFE
• Find a Shop by specialty and location
• Swap Meet for used and NOS parts between members
• Vehicles For Sale from ID-checked sellers
• Every race track near you, with upcoming events
• Car meets, Cars and Coffee and cruises near you
• A vehicle wiki with specs, maintenance and how-tos for each generation
• Phone alerts for messages, orders and new parts for your vehicle

FOR SHOPS
List parts for free and pay only a small fee when you sell. No monthly plans, no listing limits.

Motorsports Marketplace LLC, Arizona. Questions? info@motorsportsmarketplace.com

name: Movement: Watchmaker
description:
Sit down at a watchmaker's bench and build a mechanical watch movement by hand.

A master watchmaker teaches you as you go. Find the right part, set it on its jewel, turn it until it drops in. Run each screw down and tighten it by feel. Guide the pivots into the bridge. Test your work with a puff of air before you go on, the way a real watchmaker does. Then wind it, and watch it come to life.

TWENTY-FOUR MOVEMENTS
• A first movement: a barrel, four wheels and an escapement
• A properly bridged hand-wound movement
• An automatic, wound by tilting your phone
• The dial side: hands that show the real time
• A date that jumps at midnight
• A chronometer, regulated on the timing machine
• A moon phase set to tonight's moon
• A world-time watch
• A verge fusee pocket watch from the 1700s
• A marine chronometer
• An alarm
• A column-wheel chronograph
• A flyback and split-seconds chronograph
• A perpetual calendar
• The equation of time
• A tourbillon, and a flying tourbillon with constant force
• A minute repeater that strikes the real time
• A grande sonnerie playing the Westminster quarters
• A grand complication, built without help
• Then work for customers: jumping hours, a cheap pin-lever, hand finishing, and a watch to repair

A WATCH BOX OF YOUR OWN
Case every movement you finish with a dial and strap you have earned. Your watches sit in the box showing the real time, and you can wear any of them full screen.

REAL WATCHMAKING
Every gear ratio is real. Every part is where it would be. Skip a check and something breaks, as it would at a real bench.

No ads. No accounts. No data collected. Nothing more to buy: one price, all twenty-four movements.

name: MovingCenter Slagharen
description:
PLEASE NOTE: YOU NEED A MovingCenter ACCOUNT TO ACCESS THIS APP. IF YOU'RE A MEMBER GET IT FOR FREE AT YOUR GYM!
 
Begin your journey to a healthier lifestyle and let MovingCenter help you along the way. Introducing  MovingCenter, most comprehensive fitness platform with:

• Check class schedules and opening hours
• Track your daily fitness activities
• Track your weight and other body metrics
• Over 2000+ exercises and activities
• Clear 3D exercise demonstrations
• Preset workouts and the option to create your own
• Over 150 badges to earn

Select workouts online and synchronize them with your app to workout at home or in the gym while keeping track of your progress. From strength to weight lifting, this app acts as your own personal trainer guiding and giving you the motivation you need.

You can sync this app with Apple Health App. If you enable this connection, any workout in the Health app with automatically be added to your Activity Calendar.

name: MoyMenu Business
description:
MoyMenu Business is the app for owners and managers of restaurants and cafés that use MoyMenu, the QR menu and ordering service (moymenu.com). It shows how the day is going and lets you deal with what cannot wait, from your phone.

You need a MoyMenu restaurant account: sign in with the e-mail and password of your MoyMenu account. There is no sign-up in the app.

TODAY
• Net sales for today, yesterday, the last 7 or 30 days, compared with the period before
• A chart by hour (or by day), the number of orders, the average bill and tips
• Top dishes, how guests paid (cash or card), voids and refunds
• "Needs you": bills waiting, guests calling a waiter, pre-orders to confirm and other things to act on; each one opens the place where you fix it
• The Z-report for the day: cash in the drawer, who took it, and a CSV file to share

FLOOR
• Every hall and table with its state: free, seated, cooking, ready, bill asked for, paid
• Open a table to see its orders, dishes, notes and bill
• Void an order, or put it on the house, with a reason
• Stop all table orders with one switch when the kitchen needs a break, and start them again

MENU
• Tap a price, type the new one on the number pad, save
• A sold-out switch on every dish, and a "Sold out now" list to bring dishes back
• Edit a dish: its name in Azerbaijani, Russian and English, description, category, price and photo (camera or gallery)
• Add dishes and categories, or remove a dish from the menu
• Select several dishes to mark them sold out, move them to another category or change their prices by a percentage

TEAM
• Everyone on the staff with their role (waiter, kitchen, cashier, host, manager) and whether their phone is set up
• Add a person and show them a set-up code: a QR code, valid for 24 hours, that they scan with the MoyMenu Team app. You can also send it as a link.
• Change a role, or turn someone's access off and on again (the app asks for your password first)

ALSO
• Azerbaijani, Russian and English; light and dark appearance
• Optional Face ID or fingerprint lock
• Switch between restaurants if your account has more than one
• Help from MoyMenu support on WhatsApp

Some parts (table ordering, the kitchen and sales reports) depend on your restaurant's MoyMenu plan. The app says so plainly when something is not in your plan.

name: murder.games
description:
Everyone has a target. No one is safe.

murder.games is a social game played together in real life. Every player receives a secret target — and is someone else’s target. Wait for the right moment, keep an eye on your friends, and try to be the last player standing.

Create a game, share the code with your friends, and start when everyone is ready. The app assigns targets and keeps track of the game. When a player is murdered and confirms it in the app, their killer takes over the next target.

• Create and join private games with a code.
• See your own secret target.
• Get push notifications for new targets and game results.
• Follow your current game and view past results.
• Sign in with an email link — no password or phone number needed.

You need at least three players, together in person. Murder your target by drawing your finger across their throat without anyone else seeing it. You can also agree to make the gesture in front of their throat without touching. If someone sees you murdering your target, you are the one who is murdered. Your target survives, and you must report yourself murdered in the app. The murdered player confirms in the app, and the game continues until only one player remains. Do not tell the other players that you have been murdered, so they do not know how many players remain.

Questions? Contact info@murder.games.

name: Mushimon
description:
You get one bug. It fights other bugs by itself, and every win makes it stronger.

• Watch quick ranged battles, or speed them up and skip.
• Spend gold to upgrade. You see the new AP and HP before you upgrade.
• Transform into a random new bug. There are 22, each with its own special ability.
• Four tiers: Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary. The odds are shown on screen.
• Beat a boss every fifth round for a guaranteed Rare or better.
• Clear the final boss to open the next world, with a new legendary waiting at the end.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. Works offline.

name: MV African American Heritage
description:
Walk the island's Black history where it happened.

The African American Heritage Trail of Martha's Vineyard marks 41 places, in every town on the island, where people of African descent lived, worked, worshipped, built businesses and changed history. This free app is the trail's companion. It puts every marker on an Apple map, tells each story, and helps you see more of it with the people who researched it.

FIND THE MARKERS
• All 41 trail markers on the map, from Oak Bluffs to Aquinnah
• See where you are and how far each marker is, then get walking directions
• Filter by town to plan a morning or a whole day

READ THE STORIES
• The history behind each site, with photos from the trail
• People, places and businesses, from Shearer Cottage and Dorothy West to Senator Edward Brooke
• Historic cottage businesses, and Black-owned businesses you can visit today

COLLECT YOUR PASSPORT
• Stand beside a marker and the app notices you've arrived
• Add it to your passport and watch your trip fill in, day by day
• See which towns you've explored and what's left to find
• Your passport stays on your phone. No account, nothing uploaded.

TAKE A GUIDED TOUR
The trail's guided tours are the best way to hear the full story, and they fund the trail's research, school programs and new markers. Browse every tour, see when it usually runs, how long it takes, where it meets and the current price, then book on the trail's website.
• Highlands walking tour
• Oak Bluffs tour
• Oak Bluffs and Edgartown tour
• All-island tour
• Black-owned businesses tour
• Custom walks and groups

SUPPORT THE TRAIL
Buy "Lighting the Trail," the trail's book, donate, suggest a new site, or bring the trail to your classroom.

Built for summer visitors and island residents alike. Works on iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode.

PRIVACY
Location is used only while the app is open, and it never leaves your device. The app has no ads, no tracking and no accounts.

The African American Heritage Trail of Martha's Vineyard was founded by Elaine Cawley Weintraub and Carrie Camillo Tankard. Their plan for four markers became 41.

name: MX Maintenance
description:
MX Maintenance keeps track of the hour meter on every motocross bike you own, what's been done to it and what's due next. Log a ride, and next time at that track you'll see what worked.

THE HOUR METER RUNS IT ALL
• Type in the hours after riding. A reminder after practice, on the days you ride, makes sure you don't forget.
• A typo like 1146 for 114.6 is caught before it's saved, and any reading can be corrected later.

A SERVICE LOG YOU CAN TRUST
• Log a service in seconds: the likely jobs first, everything else a tap away, or add your own.
• Backdate work that was done before you started using MX Maintenance.
• The whole history in one place, and every entry can be edited. Export it as a PDF for a buyer, a mechanic or yourself.
• Selling the bike? Hand its whole history to the new owner with a one-time code.

UP NEXT
• Choose which jobs to keep an eye on and how often: oil, air filter, top end, fork service and more.
• Up next shows what's due, counted in hours from the last time each job was done.

RIDES AND TRACKS
• Note where you rode, the conditions, the setup and how it felt.
• Back at the same track, MX Maintenance shows how your last ride there went and the setup you used.
• Keep your own notes for each track: lines, gate picks, when it's watered.

SETUP
• Clickers, fork height, air pressure, sag and tyre pressures, saved per track and conditions.
• A sag calculator, and a premix calculator for two-strokes.

EVERY BIKE IN THE GARAGE
• All the major brands, each shown in its own colours.
• Switch bikes with a tap. Each one keeps its own hours, history and plan.

YOURS
• Sign in with Apple, Google or your email, and your garage follows you to a new iPhone.
• Works at the track without signal, and syncs when you're back online.
• No ads, no tracking. Delete your account and everything in it whenever you want, right in the app.
• In English and Swedish, following your iPhone's language.

name: My Daily Thing
description:
Your calendar handles what's urgent. My Daily Thing handles everything else.

The drawer you've avoided for two years. The stretches. The thing you keep meaning to sell. None of it has a deadline, and that's why it never gets done.

My Daily Thing keeps those things in themed lists, picks the next one for you, and rings a real alarm when it's time. You don't plan. You don't pick. You just start.

HOW IT WORKS

• Make a Daily Thing: a list with a theme, like Organize & Clean, Stretch & Strength or Fix.
• Say how many you want done (at least one a day, at most two) and when you can be interrupted (weekdays, 10 to 8, an hour apart).
• When it's time, a real alarm rings with the next thing. Start it, and a timer runs for as long as you gave it. Ten minutes is plenty.
• Done? It goes to the back of the list. Tomorrow it's the next one's turn.

NOTHING IS EVER OVERDUE

There's no deadline and no pile of late tasks. There's only what's next. Busy right now? Skip it, and the same thing comes back at the next alarm. The first Skip of the day is free.

A FRIEND WHO DOESN'T LET IT GO

The app talks like a sarcastic friend: "It won't do itself. I checked." It gets bolder every time you skip the same thing.

MADE TO KEEP YOU GOING

• Rings that close when you hit your daily goal, and keep going when you do extra.
• A streak for the days you did what you set out to do, and spares that cover a bad day.
• A history of every day since the first.

THE DETAILS

• Rotations: several lists take turns, each with its own days, hours and pace.
• Sets: a group of things done in a row, like a stretching routine, each with its own timer.
• A photo, a video or a YouTube clip on any thing, to show you how it's done.
• Places: things that only make sense at home (or at the gym) wait until you're there.
• A countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island before each alarm, with Start and Skip right there.
• A Home Screen and Lock Screen widget with your next thing.
• "I'm out": pause everything for an hour, two, or until tomorrow.

YOURS, ON YOUR PHONE

No account. No sign-up. Your lists, your history and your places stay on your iPhone.

Requires iOS 26.1 or later.

name: My Event: Invites & Pledges
description:
My Event is the all-in-one companion app for hosts of weddings, send-offs, birthdays, graduations and conferences.

Your guests
• Build your guest list, import from Excel and group guests with tags
• Send invitation cards by WhatsApp and SMS and see who received and read them
• Track RSVPs and expected headcount in real time
• Publish an animated web invitation your guests can open on any phone
• Reply to guests' WhatsApp messages from one inbox

Your pledges (michango)
• Record pledges and payments and see progress at a glance
• Send pledge requests and reminders by SMS
• Export reports to PDF and Excel

Your event day
• Check guests in at the door by scanning their QR code or typing their 6-digit code
• Works offline at the door and syncs when you are back online
• Invite collaborators to help with the guest list or the door

Also: budget tracking, ticket sales for public events, event photos and videos (Moments), quick SMS messages and a vendor marketplace.

My Event works together with your account at myevent.africa. Sign in with Google, Apple or your phone number.

name: My LE BLEU
description:
MY LE BLEU est l'application officielle de Le Bleu, l'eau de santé ultra-pure de Côte d'Ivoire : une eau intracellulaire de grade pharmaceutique.

Commandez facilement vos packs et cartons d'eau, faites-vous livrer chez vous ou au bureau, et suivez votre livreur en temps réel.

Ce que vous pouvez faire :
• Commander en quelques gestes et choisir votre date de livraison
• Payer à la livraison ou par mobile money
• Suivre votre commande et votre livreur en direct
• Cumuler des points fidélité et profiter d'offres exclusives
• Retrouver l'historique de vos commandes
• Lire des conseils santé et hydratation dans la communauté Le Bleu
• Recevoir des rappels pour ne jamais manquer d'eau

Particuliers, entreprises et revendeurs : Le Bleu vous accompagne au quotidien.

name: My UNIK
description:
Unik runs the IskraLabs control boxes on your yacht from your iPhone. It talks to the boxes directly over Bluetooth, so the controls work on board with no internet.

Unik works only with IskraLabs control boxes fitted on the yacht. Depending on how your yacht is fitted, it runs gangways and passerelles, tender lifts and garages, stairs, anchors, doors, cranes, shades, and lights with dimmers and colours.

On board
- Each box's controls appear as tiles on your yacht, and you see which ones are in range.
- Gangways, lifts and stairs move only while you hold their key, and stop when you lift your finger.
- Switch lights on and off, set a dimmer, or pick a colour from the wheel or a preset.

Your yachts
- Yachts you own and yachts shared with you are in one list, on every iPhone you sign in on.
- To add your boxes, scan the installer's QR code on board. Unik adds a box only when your iPhone finds it nearby, and a box belongs to one yacht at a time.
- Rename the controls and put them in the order you use them. Changes you make offline sync when you're back online.

Sharing
- Invite crew, family or guests by email, or show a QR code that they scan with their phone. Each code works once and for 10 minutes.
- Choose how long their access lasts: no end date, a day, a week, a month or a date you pick. When it ends, the yacht leaves their phone by itself.
- Extend someone's access, remove the end date or end it now. Unik lets them know with a notification.
- People you share with use the controls. Only the owner adds boxes, renames controls, invites people and changes access.
- Selling the boat? Make another member the owner.

Sign in with a one-time code that Unik sends to your email address. There's no password.

Unik operates moving equipment. Use it only when you can see the equipment and nobody is in its way.

Unik is in English, Slovenian, Croatian, Italian and German. Questions: support@iskralabs.app

name: My Words: Toddler Flashcards
description:
My Words makes toddler flashcards from your own photos, in your own voice. Snap your child's cup, the dog, grandma's garden or the family car, type the word, and record yourself saying it. Each card shows one big real photo and plays your voice.

Small decks, five calm minutes a day
Every deck holds up to 20 cards, because small decks are easier for little ones. Today picks the cards for a short daily session, brings words back around, and always includes the cards you made today.

Hand it over
Your child sees only the cards: no ads, no pop-ups, no prompts. To leave, a grown-up answers a quick question. If the app is closed mid-session, it reopens to the cards, not your settings.

Works on silent
Card voices play even when your iPhone is set to silent, and music or a podcast quietly ducks underneath.

What you get:
- Cards from your own photos, with your recorded voice or a built-in US English voice
- Decks of up to 20 cards, with deck ideas like Family, Body parts, Bath time and Bedtime
- Ready-made Animals and Food decks with real photos, not cartoons
- Say it with me: the word, a pause for your child's turn, then the word again
- A daily Today session of 3, 5 or 10 minutes
- Mark the words your child knows, after a session or on any card
- Record in any language your family speaks

Works offline. No account. No ads. No data collected. Photos and recordings stay on your iPhone and are included in your iPhone backup.

name: MyDM by Discount Moulding
description:
MyDM is Discount Moulding's in-house app for our own employees. It is not for the public: it only works with a MyDM account, which the company gives each employee.

MyDM is where our staff do their daily work: expenses and reimbursements, training, store tools and more. The iPhone app adds what only a phone can do:

- Scan receipt: scan a paper receipt with the iPhone's document camera, straight into an expense or a reimbursement. Several pages become one PDF.
- Notifications: MyDM sends work alerts to the phone, like a reimbursement that needs attention or an order that changed. Each person chooses which ones they get.
- Face ID: people who can pay vendors have MyDM locked behind Face ID (or the phone's passcode), every time it opens.

name: MyGTDriver
description: MyGTDriver is the everyday toolkit for fuel delivery drivers.

name: MyHabits: Habit & Task Planner
description:
MyHabits brings habits and tasks together — and it's kind to you when life gets in the way. One missed day doesn't wipe out your streak: habit strength drops a little and recovers, the way real habits do.

HABITS
• Daily, specific weekdays, N times a week or month, every few days, several times a day
• Yes/no, counts (8 glasses of water), minutes, and "quit" habits for things you want to stop
• Honest streaks: a skip is allowed, flexible goals count by week or month
• Habit strength, a heat map of the year and a weekly review that shows what to change

ROUTINES
• Stack habits into a morning or evening routine and run through it step by step

TASKS
• Inbox, Today, Next, Scheduled, Waiting and Someday — a GTD-style system that stays simple
• Projects (including step-by-step ones), subtasks, checklists, tags, priorities and repeats
• Type "call mom tomorrow at 6 pm" — the date and time are understood
• Eisenhower matrix, kanban board, week view and a day timeline
• Voice input and an optional AI assistant that drafts tasks and habits for you to approve

FOCUS
• Pomodoro and stopwatch; minutes go straight into a timed habit

REMINDERS
• Scheduled on your iPhone itself: they arrive when the app is closed and even offline
• Quiet hours, a morning plan and an evening review; anything missed waits under "Overdue"

YOUR DATA
• Works fully without an account — everything stays on your phone
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email to sync with Android and the web
• Share chosen habits with a partner in a shared space
• No ads, no tracking, free

Works with other ReedVerse apps: finishing a workout in MyFitness or reading in Littera can check off a linked habit automatically.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://myhabits.reedverse.com/privacy.html

name: Mym:Détente en soirée
description:
Offrez à votre visage une routine simple, apaisante et guidée, pensée pour détendre les zones de tension et instaurer de vrais moments de soin au quotidien. Avec Mym:Détente en soirée, créez un rituel personnalisé en quelques minutes seulement, matin ou soir, selon votre rythme et vos besoins.

Grâce à des exercices courts, des massages doux et des suivis visuels, vous développez une routine facile à intégrer dans votre journée sans procédures compliquées. Chaque séance vous aide à mieux observer vos mimiques, à relâcher les zones souvent sollicitées et à rester constant dans votre démarche bien-être.

Fonctionnalités principales
