- Carte du visage interactive - choisissez les zones qui vous intéressent comme le front, les yeux, les joues, les pommettes, la mâchoire, le cou ou les lèvres.
- Yoga du visage guidé - suivez des exercices simples avec étapes claires, minuteries et animations pour mieux comprendre chaque mouvement.
- Rituels de massage - profitez de programmes ciblés pour détendre les traits et accompagner votre routine de soin.
- Contrôle de l’expression - remarquez plus facilement les tensions habituelles du front, de la mâchoire et du contour des yeux.
- Routine du matin et du soir - choisissez un moment adapté avec des séances courtes, douces et faciles à répéter.
- Calendrier beauté - recevez des rappels et suivez votre régularité au fil des jours.
- Journal de progression - conservez vos photos, vos notes et l’historique de vos séances au même endroit.

Idéal pour
- Les personnes qui veulent une routine visage rapide et structurée à la maison.
- Celles et ceux qui souhaitent intégrer des gestes de détente dans leur routine beauté.
- Les utilisateurs qui aiment suivre leurs habitudes et voir leur progression dans le temps.
- Les moments de fin de journée où l’on cherche à relâcher la fatigue et la tension.

Pourquoi choisir Mym:Détente en soirée
Notre approche met l’accent sur la simplicité, la régularité et l’expérience guidée. L’application combine carte du visage, exercices ciblés, suivi personnel et rappels pour vous aider à garder une routine cohérente et motivante. L’interface est conçue pour rester claire, agréable et centrée sur vos rituels quotidiens, avec des visuels adaptés à chaque section et un menu au style burger pour une navigation fluide.

Commencez votre rituel dès aujourd’hui et créez une routine visage qui s’intègre naturellement à votre quotidien.

name: myQRZ
description:
myQRZ is the directory of radio amateurs and CB operators worldwide, in your pocket.

LOOK UP A STATION
Type an amateur radio callsign or a CB handle: the station's profile opens like a QSL card, with country, photo, grid locator and town.

THE FULL PROFILE, FOR MEMBERS
With a free account you see everything: full-screen shack photos, gear, introduction, latest QSOs, UTC time and the sun at the station, and the antenna heading (short path and long path) from your locator.

YOUR LOGBOOK IN YOUR POCKET
Log a QSO in seconds: callsign, band and mode in one tap (or channel 1 to 40 and AM, FM, USB, LSB for CB), prefilled reports, automatic UTC time. "Save and log the next one" chains your contacts. When the other station logs the same QSO, it confirms itself. Countries and flags are added automatically.

YOUR OWN QSL CARD
Profile photo, shack photos from the camera or your library, gear, introduction, LoTW, eQSL, paper card. You choose who sees your name, address, exact locator and logbook: everyone, members or nobody.

THE LIVE WORLD MAP
Day and night move in real time, the grey line takes shape and links light up between continents.

RESPECTFUL
Free, no ads, no trackers. Data hosted in Switzerland. Your account and all your data can be deleted from the app.

The same account works on myqrz.com, where you can also import your logbook as ADIF.
The app is available in English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.

name: NearbyLink
description:
NearbyLink 让身边的人不靠互联网也能聊天、传文件和通话。数据只在你们的设备之间传输，不经过任何服务器，也不需要注册账号。

两种连接方式
• 蓝牙双人：两台靠近的设备直接相连，不需要 Wi-Fi，也不需要移动网络。
• 局域网房间：连接同一个 Wi-Fi 的设备可以创建或加入房间，最多 5 人。

可以做什么
• 文字聊天
• 语音消息：无损录制，最长 3 分钟
• 照片和文件：按原始内容发送，不压缩、不转码，收完后自动校验完整性
• 双人实时语音通话
• 断线后 3 分钟内自动重连，没传完的文件接着传

每次连接都要当面确认
连接建立后，双方需要面对面核对 6 位安全码，或扫描对方出示的二维码，确认连上的就是眼前这台设备，之后才能开始聊天。

加密方式
• 蓝牙双人连接、以及房间里只有两个人时：点到点加密，只有两台设备可以解密。
• 多人房间：消息由房主的设备接收后转发，每位成员与房主之间分别加密，房主的设备可以读到房间里的全部内容。请只加入你信任的人创建的房间。
• 使用系统提供的公开标准算法。App 没有经过独立的安全审计。

聊天记录只在本机
• 聊天记录、照片和文件只保存在你的设备上，可以搜索，也可以随时删除。
• 应用锁：重新打开 App 或一段时间没有操作后，需要面容 ID、触控 ID 或设备密码才能进入。
• 可以屏蔽不想再连接的设备，也可以举报不当内容。

同时支持 iPhone 和 iPad
• 宽屏上并排显示聊天列表和聊天内容，并为 iPhone Duo 的折叠屏做了适配。
• 提供简体中文和英文界面。

请先了解这些限制
• 双方都需要安装并打开 NearbyLink，而且彼此靠近，或连接同一个局域网。
• App 进入后台后，能否继续收到消息和来电由系统决定，无法保证；局域网连接在后台通常很快中断。
• 实时语音通话只支持两个人。
• 请不要把它当作紧急通信工具。

隐私
NearbyLink 不收集任何数据：没有账号、没有服务器、没有广告，也没有统计分析。

name: Neon Pitlane
description:
Neon Pitlane is a pocket arcade with three distinct driving games under one neon skyline.

Neon Courier is a self-driving route runner. Your car follows the glowing road and your only job is the steering wheel inside the chevron zone before each corner. Call every turn left or right, hold boost on straights to beat the par time, grab parcels on the way, miss a call and you kiss the barrier. Thirty-six routes across three night cities.

Torque Drop flips the camera. Hold gas to drive your pickup forward, brake to stop, keep holding to reverse. A sky-drop rains parts on you lane by lane. Catch bolts, gears and golden pistons in the truck bed, dodge tyres and oil drums, fill the turbo meter for double score and a parts magnet. Three hits and the truck is wrecked.

Bolt Cascade is a drag-and-release puzzle. Aim a spare tyre at a dense bolt board, pull further from the launcher for more power, release to send the tyre bouncing through the lattice. Knock out every orange bolt before you run out of rubber. Land in the moving pit tray on the way down to get the tyre back. Thirty boards across four bolt families.

Between runs the Workshop ties everything together. Spend tokens in the Spray Booth on paint jobs for your courier car, pin patches on the Patch Wall, read the Ride Log of every drive you've finished, and check the Telemetry panel for stars and best times per circuit.

name: Neon Reels
description:
Line up the symbols in Neon Reels, an offline, single-player logic puzzle for iPhone and iPad.

Explore three rooms with 40 levels each. Every level is available from the start and has a target row and a move limit. Move the three reels one symbol at a time, then check your center row against the target.

Each room has its own rule: reels move independently in Cherry Club, while Electric Night and Diamond Room link neighboring reels. Find a shortest route to earn three stars, or solve within the limit to earn one or two stars. Your lowest move count is saved as your best result.

Undo refunds a move, and hints show the next step on a shortest path without affecting your rating. Restart an attempt whenever you want.

Visit Daily for a puzzle selected by the UTC date and replay completed dates from local history. Collect five symbol cards in the Album as you complete different standard levels. Home Screen widgets show progress and open your current standard-level puzzle.

Neon Reels requires iOS 17 or later. The app interface is in English (UK).

name: Nevi - Gestão de Marcações
description:
O Nevi é a agenda do seu salão, barbearia, clínica de estética ou espaço de unhas, agora no iPhone.

Com a app consegue:
• Ver e gerir a agenda do dia, de 3 dias, da semana ou do mês, por profissional
• Criar, mover e cancelar marcações em segundos
• Consultar a ficha de cada cliente, com o histórico de visitas e notas
• Gerir serviços, equipa, horários e folgas
• Acompanhar os pedidos de marcação online da sua página
• Tirar fotografias para o portefólio e para as fichas com a câmara do iPhone
• Partilhar o link de marcações do seu espaço

As clientes marcam online na página do seu espaço e recebem confirmações e lembretes automáticos.

A app é para quem já tem conta no Nevi (nevi.pt). Também pode criar a conta do seu espaço diretamente na app.

name: NFClite
description:
NFCLite is the NFC app for lighting fixtures.

Main functions:
1. Read fixture info, settings, version data, current status and configuration via NFC
2. Write and update common control parameters（Parameters：Address,Channelmode,Signal,Fanmode,IP,RDMUID,Pan reverse,Tilt reverse,Pan position） via NFC
3. Batch write address, IP and RDM UID for multiple lighting units with Auto-Increment Write Auto; automatically proceed to the next unit after each write
4. Support offline NFC operation; pre-configure in advance under a network-connected environment

Operation Guide：
Preparation in advance:
1. NFC-enabled mobile phone, confirm the exact NFC location on the back of the phone
2. Download NFCLite APP in advance
3. When operating Pan reverse and Pan position functions, keep fingers and mobile phone away from lighting arm to avoid injury or phone falling.
【Tap to read】Write params(Address,Channelmode,Signal,Fanmode,IP,RDMUID,Pan reverse,Tilt reverse,Pan position) via NFC.
Read the parameters of the lighting (Address, Channelmode, Signal, Fanmode, IP, RDMUID, Pan reverse, Tilt reverse, Pan position). If you want to know the version of the lighting fixture, you can return to (top left corner).
【Write Light】Modify parameters of the lighting (Address, Channelmode, Signal, Fanmode, IP, RDMUID, Pan reverse, Tilt reverse, Pan position).Warning: When operating "Pan reverse" and "Pan position" functions, keep fingers and mobile phone away from lighting arm to avoid injury or phone falling.Note: The Address limit is 512. IP and RDMUID are generally unique for each lighting.
【Auto-Increment Write】
To write the Address, IP and RDM UID for multiple lighting units in batch, use the Auto-Increment Write Auto function. After writing data to one lighting unit, the system will automatically proceed to the next lighting unit.
Tap 【Auto-Increment Write】to open its panel, select items for auto-write: Address, IP, RDMUID. Notes: 1. Address follows Channelmode; 2. Max Address: 512; 3. IP & RDMUID increment by 1. Tap Continue after selection. The first Continue writes the 1st fixture with Count 1 shown on top-right.

name: Nimbly Solo
description:
Two Games of Taking Cards.

Nimbly Solo brings two games by David Parlett, the card-game historian and inventor, to one app. In both, the cards lie face up in overlapping rows, and you take one, two or three from the open ends.

Nimbly, for three players:
- Three rows of nine, 36 cards from Ace down to 6.
- Take from any row's open end, until everyone holds nine.
- Score flush × run × sets: your longest suit, your longest run and your threes and fours of a kind, multiplied.

Abstrac, for two players:
- One row of 24 cards, Ace down to 9.
- Take the open card, or the open two or three in order.
- Sets and runs score, multiplied by the number of cards your opponent took. Take few, but good ones.
- No combination at all? You score your opponent's points, and they score nothing.

In the app:

- New opponents every game, at three levels: Normal, Hard and Elite.
- A Practice Round for each game: watch a deal with a guide, then play one with hints.
- Quick Rules and a searchable Glossary, any time, even mid-game.
- A score card after every deal: tap any score to see how it adds up.
- Stats for each game and level, kept on your device.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no data collected. Plays offline.

Nimbly and Abstrac are David Parlett's games, made with his kind permission. His rules and many more of his games are at parlettgames.uk.

name: NIMVARO
description:
Find services for your home, car and pets with NIMVARO. Connect with independent providers and keep your service details in one place.

FIND A PROVIDER
Explore available home cleaning, car washing and detailing, and pet grooming providers. View profiles and reviews, and save your favorites.

REQUEST AND REVIEW QUOTES
Send a service request, review quotes and check the agreed details before moving forward.

STAY IN TOUCH
Message your provider about the service. Enable notifications to receive updates about requests, messages, quotes and service status.

FOLLOW YOUR JOBS
Check your jobs, review available completion photos and confirm the result. Access available service invoices from the app.

FOR PROVIDERS
Providers with an approved account can manage their jobs, communicate with customers and submit completion photos.

NIMVARO connects customers with independent providers. Providers perform the work independently, and customers pay them directly. Services and availability depend on the area and participating providers.

Available in English and Spanish.
Support: nimvaro.service@gmail.com

name: Nocasso: Draw & Paint
description:
Nocasso is a calm drawing and painting studio. Pick up your pencil and start – no account, no ads, nothing to buy.

BRUSHES
• 70+ brushes: pencils, inks, markers, crayons and pastels, gouache and oil, watercolour, airbrush, textures, blenders, lettering and cute stamps
• Pressure and tilt change size, opacity and shading as you draw
• Design your own brushes and keep your favourites close

LAYERS AND TOOLS
• Layers with blend modes, opacity, alpha lock and clipping
• Selections, transform, adjustments, guides and symmetry
• Smudge, erase, eyedropper, quick shapes and text
• Colour picker, harmonies, history and your own palettes

MADE FOR THE PENCIL
• Your hand can rest on the screen while you draw (iPad: Apple Pencil)
• Two-finger tap to undo, three-finger tap to redo, pinch to zoom and rotate

NOCASSO COACH
• Tap the coach for kind, concrete tips on your own drawing: light and shadow, colours, lines and proportions
• The coach never draws for you – you do all the drawing and get better step by step
• Learn to draw our own cat family from memory, with pencil-grip help and stretch breaks
• Only the picture you choose is sent for feedback, and nothing is saved. A grown-up can turn it off behind a parent lock

YOURS, AND ONLY YOURS
• Your drawings are saved on your device
• Drawing works offline
• Import PNG, JPG, HEIC and layered PSD files
• Export PNG, JPG, PDF, layers or a time-lapse video of your drawing
• Back up the whole gallery to a file and restore it on another device

Suitable for every age: no chat, no account and no ads.

name: Nookberry: Cozy 3D Room Design
description:
Make a little room for your imagination.

Nookberry is a cozy 3D room decorating game where you arrange miniature furniture, add small details, and create a space that feels like yours. Take your time, enjoy the soft colors and warm lights, and decorate at your own pace.

17 ROOMS TO EXPLORE
Start with a pastel bedroom or a quiet reading room. Try a sunlit bakery, a beach bungalow, a home library, a wizard observatory, a medieval tavern, or a space station. Each theme has its own room and matching catalog.

642 FURNITURE AND DECOR PIECES
Browse beds, chairs, shelves, plants, lamps, rugs, wall art, and themed objects. Press and hold an item in the catalog, then drag it into your room. Place little objects on suitable furniture surfaces and hang decorations on the walls.

ARRANGE THE DETAILS
Move furniture, rotate supported pieces in 45-degree steps, or remove an item and try another idea. Pan and pinch to zoom, or use the zoom controls to look more closely at your design.

A QUIET CREATIVE BREAK
Enjoy gentle background music with a mute option. There are no timers, scores, ads, or in-app purchases. Play offline without creating an account.

Made for landscape play on iPhone and iPad, with interface and item names available in 20 languages.

Each visit is a fresh decorating session: room layouts reset when you leave and reopen a room.

name: Notizen – eigener Server
description:
Notizen ist eine schlichte Notizen-App für iPhone, iPad und Mac. Deine Notizen liegen nicht in einer fremden Cloud, sondern auf deinem eigenen Server – zum Beispiel einem Raspberry Pi zu Hause – und werden zwischen all deinen Geräten in Sekunden abgeglichen.

FUNKTIONEN
• Ordner, angepinnte Notizen und schnelle Suche
• Die erste Zeile wird automatisch zum Titel
• „Zuletzt gelöscht“: gelöschte Notizen bleiben 30 Tage wiederherstellbar
• Funktioniert auch ohne Verbindung – Änderungen werden nachgereicht
• Änderungen erscheinen auf deinen anderen Geräten nach wenigen Sekunden
• Eine App für iPhone, iPad und Mac

DEINE DATEN GEHÖREN DIR
Es gibt kein Konto, keine Werbung und kein Tracking. Die App spricht ausschließlich mit dem Server, den du selbst einträgst.

WAS DU BRAUCHST
Einen eigenen Notizen-Server. Er besteht aus einem einzigen Python-Skript und läuft auf einem Raspberry Pi, einem Heimserver oder einem gemieteten Server. Anleitung und Download: notizen.minipliy.net/support

name: Nurab: Jamaat & Prayer Times
description:
Never miss jamaat again. Nurab shows the jamaat (iqamah) times of mosques near you, so you know exactly when to leave and where to pray.

FIND JAMAAT NEAR YOU
• Over 260,000 mosques worldwide, sorted by distance
• See the next jamaat at each mosque at a glance
• Directions to the mosque in one tap

A COUNTDOWN THAT GETS YOU THERE
• A live countdown to the next jamaat at your mosque
• In the last 10 minutes it turns gold: "Time to go"
• Jamaat reminders for My mosque, on by default

TIMINGS FROM THE COMMUNITY
• Timings are added and kept up to date by people who pray there
• Snap a photo of the mosque's timings board and Nurab reads it for you
• Mosque committees can claim their mosque and manage its timings

MORE FOR YOUR DAY
• Prayer start times for your location
• Qibla compass
• Tasbih counter, dhikr and duas, with the reason for each dua
• Scan a dua from a picture to save it
• Light and dark themes
• English, Urdu, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali, Indonesian and Malay

Nurab is free. You can browse without an account; sign in with WhatsApp only when you want to add or edit timings.

Questions or a mosque missing? Write to nurab.app@gmail.com.

name: NutriTrak: Meal & Diet Lab
description:
NutriTrak is an adaptive, on-device precision nutrition, 7-day meal planning, supermarket shopping companion, and microbiome plant-diversity application.

• Diet Goal Wizard: Choose Weight Loss, Strength Training, Endurance & Cardio, Maintain & Balance, or Healthy Weight Gain—NutriTrak calculates personalized daily calorie and macro targets using Mifflin-St Jeor / NIDDK energy balance equations.
• Structured 7-Day High-Protein Meal Plans: Daily Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, and Snack plans with exact ingredient portions, calories, and protein targets—plus scientific explanations for every meal.
• Supermarket Companion & Grocery Bag Scanner: View or listen aloud to today's meal plan and shopping list at the store, then scan your grocery bag via camera, barcode/UPC, or quick-tap checklist to verify meal readiness.
• Off-Menu / Cheat Meal Scanner (Live Calorie Subtraction): Ate something off-plan? Scan or tap an off-menu meal (e.g., a 600 kcal Big Mac on an 1,800 kcal budget -> 1,800 - 600 = 1,200 kcal remaining) and let NutriTrak automatically rebalance your remaining meals for the day.
• Hydration & 30-Plant Microbiome Tracker: Log water/electrolytes and weekly unique whole plants (fruits, vegetables, legumes, grains, nuts/seeds, herbs/spices, fermented foods).
• 100% Private & Local-First: No mandatory cloud account—your biometrics, grocery checks, and food logs stay on your device.

Disclaimer: NutriTrak is a self-directed nutritional planning, grocery organization, and wellness journaling tool—not a medical device, clinical diagnostic instrument, or substitute for professional medical or dietetic advice.

name: Offline Messenger: Hollerwave
description:
Hollerwave lets you talk to people near you when there is no internet: on a plane, at a festival, on a mountain trail, at a campsite or on a school trip.

iPhones connect directly over Bluetooth. No Wi-Fi, no mobile data, no account, no phone number, no servers.

■ See who is within reach
The home screen is a living radar: friends and room members appear as they come into range, grouped as Close, Medium or Far by signal strength. You always know whether a message can get through right now.

■ Chat, voice and photos
• Text messages with sending, passed along, delivered and read states
• Hold-to-talk voice messages
• Photos (resized and with location data removed before sending)
• If someone drifts out of range, your messages wait and are delivered automatically when you meet again

■ Add a friend
Both people open Add friend, tap each other's name and check that both screens show the same 4-digit number.

■ Walkie-talkie rooms
Create a room and read the 8-character code out loud. Everyone who types it joins. Hold the big button to talk; new voice messages play automatically, like a walkie-talkie.

■ Passes messages along
Messages can hop through up to 3 iPhones of your friends or room members to reach someone a little farther away. iPhones that pass messages along cannot read them.

■ Private by design
• End-to-end encryption with standard, widely reviewed algorithms (X25519, Ed25519, AES-256-GCM)
• Safety numbers to check a friend in person
• Strangers can't see your name: you appear only to friends and people who know your room code, and your nearby ID changes every day
• Disappearing messages (5 minutes to 7 days)
• Block and report. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no account

■ On a plane
Turn on airplane mode, then switch Bluetooth back on. Please use it only when the crew says Bluetooth is allowed.

■ Good to know
• Works best while Hollerwave is open on screen. In the background your iPhone keeps talking to people already connected, but new people may not find you until you open the app again.
• Range is usually tens of meters in open space, less through walls and crowds.
• Photos travel slower than text over Bluetooth.
• Both people need Hollerwave.
• Room codes are shared secrets: anyone you give the code to can read the room.

Questions: support@tanzsoft.com

name: OGZ CLUB
description:
REAL OGZ RECOGNIZE REAL OGZ.

OGZ CLUB is the OGZ streetwear shop in your pocket: hoodies, crewnecks, a crop top and tees with the OGZ logo, in an oversized fit.

IN THE APP
• The OGZ Club collection with a photo for every color, a size guide and favorites.
• Cart and secure Shopify checkout, with one-tap promo codes.
• Shop in French, English or Spanish, with prices in your currency.

YOUR OGZ MEMBER CARD

• Your nickname and photo on your card.
• 4 levels: NEW OGZ, REAL OGZ, OGZ LEGEND, OGZ ICON. The more you order, the higher you climb.
• Perks at every level: free shipping, then -10% and -15% forever.

EARLY-ACCESS DROPS
• Members get new drops before everyone else.
• Promo codes reserved for members.
• Notifications so you never miss one.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR DATA
• Secure sign-in by email, no password to remember.
• Track your orders in the app.
• Delete your account anytime from the app.

Join the club.

name: Okaya AI Battery

name: One Percent Better
description:
1% better turns one small question a day into a clearer head.

Answer one honest question. See how people your age and in your life stage answered the same thing. Then join a live session every week with Dr Sunny Garg and go deeper on what came up.

WHAT YOU GET

- A question a day. Ten seconds, one tap, no writing.
- Real results from real people, not opinions from strangers.
- Insights across six areas: clarity, awareness, emotions, thinking, connection and direction.
- A live session every week, with recordings to watch later.
- Your own answer history, so you can see what has changed.

WHY PEOPLE COME BACK

Most self improvement apps hand you homework. This one does not. You answer, you see where you stand, and you learn something about yourself in under a minute. No streak to protect, no guilt.

MEMBERSHIP

The daily question and your results are free. Live sessions and the deeper insights are for members. Membership is available on onepercentbetter.io, and you sign in here with the same phone number.

Made in India by Nebulyn Consulting Private Limited.

Questions or help: contact@onepercentbetter.io

name: Open in AR
description:
Open in AR shows augmented reality experiences in the space around you. Scan a code or tap a link, and the experience appears in front of you, placed in the room by Apple's ARKit.

Most people never need to install the app. When you scan an Open in AR code with the Camera, iOS shows a card. Tap Open, and the App Clip runs the experience.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Place 3D content on the floor or a table, walk around it and look at it from any side.
• Point the phone at a printed page made for AR and watch it come to life.
• Tap to place it and to interact with it.

THE FULL APP
The App Clip is all you need for a single code. The full app adds:
• A code scanner, for Open in AR codes on print, packaging and screens.
• A link field, for an experience link you were sent.

WHAT IT NEEDS
• An iPhone with iOS 17 or later.
• An internet connection. Experiences load from the web.
• The camera. It is used to place the experience in your space and, in the full app, to scan codes.

This version opens experiences published by its developer, Shivoo Studios. A code or link that leads anywhere else is offered to Safari, and never opened by itself.

PRIVACY
The app has no accounts and no ads. Camera pictures stay on your phone. They are never recorded, stored or given to the web pages the app shows. Those pages receive only where the phone is and the surfaces and printed pages it finds, so they can draw the experience in the right place.

Questions or problems: info@shivoostudios.com

name: OTTOLET Technician
description:
OTTOLET Technician is the field service app for authorized OTTOLET technicians.

View assigned service calls, access customer and job details, scan OTTOLET device QR codes, and record installation and delivery work. Capture job photos and customer confirmation from your iPhone, and review your service history.

An authorized technician account provided by your OTTOLET service organization is required.

name: Overboard Solo
description:
Make the Last Move.

Overboard is a two-player game by David Parlett, the card-game historian and inventor: a card version of his board game Quarterboard. 16 cards lie face up in a 4 by 4 grid, and you and your opponent take turns moving one shared Tracker across them.

- The suit decides the move: hearts along the row or column, diamonds diagonally, spades one step, clubs a knight's jump.
- Every card you leave turns face down, and nothing can land on it or slide over it.
- Make the last move: when nobody can move, whoever moved last scores the card the Tracker is on.
- Round after round: the grid refills from the pack until it runs out. The higher total wins.

In the app:

- A new opponent every game, at three levels: Normal, Hard and Elite. Elite works out every round to the end.
- The places you can move to light up, and the line says how the Tracker moves.
- A Practice Round: watch a round with a guide, then play one with a hint on every move.
- Quick Rules and a searchable Glossary, any time, even mid-game.
- Stats for each level, kept on your device.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no data collected. Plays offline.

Overboard is David Parlett's game, made with his kind permission. His rules and many more of his games are at parlettgames.uk.

name: Packet Gauge
description:
Only have 45 minutes? Packet Gauge shows which tasks fit once you account for the time it takes to get your tools ready.

Give each task an estimated duration, a tool, and a location. Group tasks that use the same tool at the same location so you only count setup once. Set your time budget and see how many minutes you have left or how far over you are before you start.
- Build a batch. Filter tasks by location and see how much setup time you can save by grouping them.
- Work through it. Focus on one task at a time. Log how long it took or skip it and record why.
- Review and reuse. Compare estimated and actual durations, then save recurring task combinations as reusable recipes.
Use it for home repairs, errands, or editing jobs that share the same equipment. Your tasks and history are stored on your device for offline use.

name: PadelHolics
description:
PadelHolics keeps your regular padel group organised: the sign-up list, the courts, the draw and your group's own rules, without scrolling back through the group chat.

FOR PLAYERS
- See the next sessions with live places: who is in, who is on standby and which court still needs players.
- Join or drop out in one tap. Before the cut-off, the first player on standby moves up automatically and gets a notification.
- After the cut-off, offer your place to standby players or the whole group instead of paying a no-show fee.
- Check in when you arrive at the club. Your arrival time is recorded, so late fees follow your group's rules exactly.
- Add a profile photo or pick an avatar, so everyone recognises who is on their court.
- See your history, your reliability score and what you owe, with the full working for every split.

GAME DAY
- Reminders and an optional alarm so you never sleep through an early slot.
- A leave-on-time estimate, directions to the club and the court you are playing on.
- Club guides from your group admin: the entrance pin, arrival notes and a court map.
- Optional Trip mode tells you if you are heading away from the club. It stops when you arrive.

FOR ORGANISERS AND ADMINS
- Start a group, invite players with a link and set your group's rules from a template.
- Create sessions, set the cut-off and request courts from connected clubs.
- For clubs that book by message, get the booking text ready to copy and send.
- Balanced court draws by level, with a reshuffle after set two.
- Fee splits are calculated for you: late tiers and no-shows cover the court cost first, and the rest is shared equally to the fils.
- Mark fees as settled privately or waive them. Every change is logged.

FOR CLUBS
- A tablet workspace for court availability, group rates and recurring blocks.
- Confirm, suggest another time or decline group requests.
- A desk list to check players in and tick who paid.

PadelHolics never takes or moves money. Payments stay at the club desk or between players.

Times are shown in 24-hour Gulf Standard Time.

name: Page Watcher for Safari
description:
Page Watcher is a Safari extension that refreshes a page for you and tells you when the part you care about changes.

Waiting for something to come back in stock, for an appointment slot, for exam results, for a price to drop or a job to be posted? Open the page in Safari, tap the part you are waiting on, and get on with your day.

WATCH EXACTLY WHAT MATTERS
• Tap any part of a page (a price, a status line, a list) or watch the whole page
• Check as often as every 10 seconds or as rarely as once a day
• Watch several pages at once, each in its own tab

ALERTS YOU CAN TRUST
• On any change, when a word appears, when a word disappears, or when a number goes below or above a value
• A notification with a sound, a badge in Safari, and a highlight on the page
• Ignore numbers and times so clocks and counters don't trigger false alerts
• Error pages and "are you a robot" checks are reported as problems, not as changes

A HISTORY OF EVERY CHANGE
• The app keeps the old and new value of each change, with date and time
• A chart for watched numbers such as prices
• Search, filter, and export to CSV

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no server, no analytics, no ads
• Everything stays on your device
• Safari asks for your permission site by site; Page Watcher has no access to any website until you start a watch there
• Because it works in your own Safari tab, it can watch pages you are signed in to

GOOD TO KNOW
• Page Watcher works inside Safari. The tab you are watching has to stay open.
• Watches run while Safari is on screen. iOS stops them when you switch apps or lock the device, and they pick up again when you return. To leave a device watching a page, choose "In the background" under More options and tap the page once: the screen then stays on for pages that don't build their content with scripts.
• Please choose an interval that is fair to the website.
• Apple's own websites can't be watched.

One purchase covers iPhone and iPad. No subscription.

name: Pagebench
description:
Open your PDF on one pane and a notebook appears on the other. That is the whole idea: read on one side, write on the other, and the two stay in step.

Every note page is bound to a document page. Flip ahead and the matching note page is already waiting. Need to compare pages? Turn paired flipping off - a small badge keeps track of where your note lives, and one tap brings it back to the page you are on.

The ink side behaves like paper. Strokes respond to Apple Pencil pressure. Four inks, three widths, a stroke eraser, unlimited-feeling undo. Ruled, dotted, or blank sheets. Palm down on the page draws nothing by default - only the pencil does.

Everything else you would expect is here: bookmarks, last-read position for every document, ruled paper that exports well. The share button hands you the page and its notes as one full-resolution PNG.

Documents up to 50 MB and 2,000 pages import from the Files app and stay on your device. There is no account, no subscription, no advertising, and no network permission - your library never leaves the phone.

name: Palm Wells: Water the Desert
description:
Tap a well, carry its water around the ring and land the last drop on water to keep the chain going. Grow every palm before your moves run out.

Palm Wells is a desert puzzle about a camel caravan and twelve wells. Each level sets a goal: grow a number of palm trees within a set number of moves. A sapling well becomes a palm tree as soon as it holds four drops, so every tap is a small plan.

HOW A MOVE WORKS
● Tap a well with water. The caravan picks up all of its drops.
● It walks clockwise and leaves one drop in each well it passes.
● If the last drop lands on a well that already has water, the caravan picks that water up too and walks on. One tap can set off a long chain.
● If the last drop lands in an empty well, the move ends.

SIX KINDS OF WELL, ONE AT A TIME
New wells join the ring as you travel, each with its own card:
● Cracked well: drops that fall in the crack are lost.
● Rest tent: the caravan stops here and empties its water.
● Thirsty camel: it drinks three drops, then gives you +2 moves.
● Thorny well: the chain stops when the last drop lands on thorns.
● Reverse arrow: water from an arrow well walks back the other way.
● Sealed jar: you can't tap it. Only a last drop opens it, and the chain goes on.
Later levels mix them together.

50 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
● Every level was set up by hand, from a three-palm warm-up to six-palm puzzles that mix several kinds of well.
● A hand shows the way in the first levels and whenever a new well arrives.
● After level 50, levels 11 to 50 come back, rotated around the ring.

NO TIMER, NO LUCK
● Take as long as you like on every move.
● The same tap always gives the same result.
● Out of moves? Take +3 moves once per try, or try the level again.

NOTHING IN YOUR WAY
● No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.
● Plays in English or Turkish, following your device language.
● Sound and vibration can each be turned off.

name: Pandafile
description:
Pandafile is the simple way to send big files.

SEND ANYTHING
Files, photos, videos and whole folders – share them with a link or send them by email. If your connection drops, the upload carries on where it left off.

RECEIVE IN ONE TAP
Open a Pandafile link and download a single file or everything at once.

SIGN PDFS
Draw or type your signature, add the date and save a signed copy with an audit page. Your PDF stays on your device.

STAY IN CONTROL
See your transfers, how often they were downloaded and when they expire.

For iPhone, iPad and Mac – in 32 languages, light and dark.

name: Panelkeep: Breaker Panel Map
description:
When a breaker trips or you need to switch off a circuit, the scribbled labels on most panel doors don't help much. "Kitchen", "Lights", "Bed 2". Which one is the fridge on? Panelkeep turns your electrical panel into an accurate, searchable map, and gives you a clean legend to tape inside the door.

BUILD A COPY OF YOUR PANEL
- Set the number of spaces, the numbering (odd left and even right, or column by column) and the main breaker
- Single and double-pole breakers, amp ratings, and AFCI, GFCI or dual-function types
- Several panels per home: link a subpanel to the breaker that feeds it
- Add a photo of the open panel if you like

MAPPING MODE: FLIP ONE, WALK, TICK
Panelkeep picks the next breaker to test. Switch it off, walk room to room and tick every outlet, light, switch and appliance that went dead. Found something you hadn't listed? Add it right there. Save, switch the breaker back on, and move to the next one. Panelkeep keeps track of which breakers you have tested, what is still unmapped, and which breakers seemed to feed nothing.

FIND IT IN SECONDS
Type "fridge", "bathroom outlet" or "porch light" and see the panel and slot number straight away.

PRINT THE DOOR LEGEND
A PDF laid out like the panel itself, with slot numbers down the middle, ratings, breaker types and what each one feeds. Choose half letter, letter, A5 or A4, add the panel photo as a second page, then print it or share it from the app.

A LOAD SANITY CHECK
Enter appliance wattages from their rating labels and Panelkeep adds them up for each breaker and compares the total with 80% of the breaker's rating, a common rule of thumb. It is an estimate, clearly labelled as one, and not electrical advice. It can't see wiring or real current draw. A breaker that trips, feels warm, buzzes or smells of burning needs a licensed electrician.

SAFETY FIRST
Panelkeep only asks you to move breaker handles. Never remove the panel cover, warn the household before switching anything off, and call a licensed electrician for anything that worries you.

PRIVATE
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics, and no internet connection needed.

name: PantryTurn: Stock & Shopping
description:
Keep track of what is actually in your pantry. Organize products and separate lots, record the dates printed on their labels, and see exact quantities after partial use, discard or a stock count.

Use Next puts your recorded dates in order. Replenishment targets turn low stock into shopping suggestions you can review. Shopping keeps needed, purchased and stocked items separate: buying does not change inventory until you explicitly receive the actual purchase as a new lot.

Activity keeps the original history with reversible events when the stock balance permits. Create useful PDF and CSV snapshots, or export and restore a complete JSON library backup. Your records work offline, without an app account. Dates are user-entered label reminders; PantryTurn does not determine whether food is safe to eat.

name: Papermark Cards
description:
Papermark Cards turns an NFC card into the fastest way to share a pitch deck.

Hold a Papermark card to the top of an iPhone and the deck linked to it opens straight away. The person you are meeting does not need to install anything, scan a code, or type a link.

SET UP A CARD IN A MINUTE
Tap a new card and sign in to Papermark. Pick a deck or data room you already share, or upload a new PDF, and the card is yours. From then on, everyone who taps it sees your deck.

SEE THE DECK BEFORE YOU OPEN IT
A tapped card shows a preview of the first slide, the name of the deck, and how many pages it has.

KEEP THE CARDS YOU COLLECT
Every card you open is saved to a list in the app, so you can find a deck again after the meeting.

SCAN FROM INSIDE THE APP
Use the Scan button to read a card whenever you like.

Papermark is the open-source way to share documents and pitch decks. Learn more at papermark.com.

name: Party Beacon: Find the Party
description:
Party Beacon is the live map for your night out in Kansas City. Find the party. Follow the beacon.

Flip your beacon on and the friends you pick see where you are, right now. Everyone else sees nothing. When the night's over, flip it off and you disappear.

YOUR CREW, ON ONE MAP
• See your friends' beacons on a live, neon map of KC
• Group chats with the map right behind them: slide the chat up and down
• Make a group for every crew, with its own color and icon
• Tell your people you're out with one tap

PLAN THE NIGHT WITH MOLLY
• Molly is your personal party concierge
• Tell her what you're into (tacos, live music, comedy, dancing) and she builds the night from what's actually on in KC this week
• She shows her picks on the map and helps you start a group

WHAT'S ON IN KC
• Live music, comedy, sports and nightlife around the metro
• See tonight, any day, or the whole week, and sort by time, distance or type
• Tap Interested and you're in a chat with everyone else going

SAFETY FIRST
• Heading home? Pick who watches, and your people see you get closer until you tap Home safe
• Every 15 minutes we check in. If you stop near home and don't check in, your people get a heads-up
• Check on me reminders if you're not home by the time you choose
• Nudge a friend who's gone quiet

YOUR SPOTS
• Pin your favorite places with icons (tacos, rooftops, live music, brunch)
• Your top 5, shared only with the people you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your beacon is off until you turn it on
• Only the people you pick can see you
• Block and report anyone, anytime
• Delete your account and everything in it from Settings

Made in Kansas City for girls' night, and everyone who's part of it.

name: Peak Print
description:
Peak Print keeps the photo that is still in your hand after a climb. For each mountain you write the name, the elevation in meters, what the mountain is like, what stands out, what to watch for, whether people were quiet, some, or crowded, whether the facilities were sparse, enough, or solid, and the day you climbed.

This iPhone compares the elevation with the mountain you kept before, tells you whether this one is the highest you have kept, and counts how many mountains were crowded or had sparse facilities. The newest print is the one you see first. Earlier prints stay on a shelf on this iPhone, in the order you climbed them.

There is no account and no network. Nothing is shared, and nothing is uploaded. The words and the numbers are yours. The record stays on this iPhone and does not move to another phone.

name: Pekva Krd
description:
Pekva Krd lets you watch a video together with one friend, in sync, wherever you are.

Create a room, pick a video from your gallery and share the 6-digit code. When your friend joins, play, pause and seek happen on both phones, and you can chat underneath the video.

- Private rooms for two people, joined only by code
- Playback stays in sync
- Chat with quick reactions
- Kurdish (Badini) and English, right-to-left ready
- No sign-up: no email, phone number or password
- Rooms, messages and videos are deleted automatically

Safety is built in: touch and hold a message to report or block, and use the flag in a room to report or block the other person.

Questions: iamshvan@gmail.com

name: pennyfox
description:
pennyfox brings your card offers together so you can find cashback and savings without digging through separate apps.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See offers from major card issuers in one list
• Filter by online or in store
• Browse by category: Food & Drinks, Travel, Entertainment, Shopping and Services
• Choose which card issuers you care about, so you see relevant offers first
• Get a notification when you're near a merchant with an offer (optional)

HOW IT WORKS
Pick your issuers, browse the offers, and turn on location alerts if you want a heads-up when a deal is nearby. Location alerts use "Always" location access so they can work in the background, and you can turn them off any time in the app or in iOS Settings.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account and no sign-in. pennyfox doesn't ask for your card numbers or card logins, and it doesn't track you across other companies' apps or websites.

pennyfox is an independent app from Nova Pioneers LLC. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any card issuer or merchant. Offers are set by issuers and merchants and can change or expire. Check the offer terms with your issuer before you buy. You must be 16 or older to use pennyfox.

name: Perla: Skyline Logic Puzzles
description:
Perla is a quiet logic puzzle about skylines. Each board is a small city: every row and every column uses each height exactly once, and the numbers along the edges tell you how many towers you can see from that side. Work out where every building stands and watch the skyline settle into place.

A calm, complete set of puzzles
· 144 main puzzles across six districts, growing from 4×4 to 5×5 and 6×6 boards
· 84 practice puzzles that always resume the board you left
· a daily skyline chosen from the puzzles in the app by the date on your iPhone, with a streak to keep
· every included puzzle verified to have exactly one solution

Tools that explain, not just answer
· pencil notes and automatic candidate notes
· undo, redo and erase
· Check marks the towers that are already wrong
· Hint explains the next logical step, and only counts once you apply it
· sightline preview shows what the towers look like from the edge you tap

A city you build over time
· 8 achievements, star ratings and best times
· 6 districts to preview, and 3 building colour palettes to unlock as you solve
· personal insights: your last seven days and your results by board size
· four short interactive lessons in the solving techniques

Field notes and postcards
· keep a private notebook with a thought, a photo of a real skyline or a sketch, and a voice note of up to 60 seconds
· draw any finished skyline as a postcard and save it to Photos

Made to stay on your phone
· no account, no sign-in and no cloud sync
· no advertising, no analytics and no third-party SDKs
· camera, microphone and Photos access are optional and requested only when you use that feature
· works fully offline, and saves as you play

Perla is a game for quiet moments: one skyline at a time, one perspective at a time.

name: PetRespondi
description:
O PetRespondi junta, num app só, o dia a dia da clínica veterinária, do petshop e do banho e tosa, e o cuidado do pet pelo tutor.

PARA CLÍNICAS, PETSHOPS E BANHO E TOSA
• Conversas do WhatsApp da clínica no celular: responda, envie fotos, áudios e documentos, transfira para a equipe e use os modelos aprovados pela Meta.
• IA que atende os clientes em nome da clínica, com as regras que vocês definem. A equipe pode assumir qualquer conversa.
• Agenda do dia, check-in e check-out, com recado e fotos para o tutor.
• Contatos e fichas dos pets, com alertas de alergias e cuidados especiais.
• Prontuário com IA: grave a consulta, revise o rascunho, assine e compartilhe receitas e orientações com o tutor.
• Volante: agenda, conversas e assistente para quem atende em domicílio.
• Lembretes automáticos, relatórios e avisos no celular.

PARA TUTORES
• Cadastre seus pets com foto, raça, peso e cuidados especiais.
• Rotina, remédios, vacinas e preventivos, com lembretes.
• Consultas, documentos e fotos que a clínica compartilha com você, numa linha do tempo.
• Converse com a clínica e peça horário pelo app.
• RG do pet com QR Code para a coleira: quem encontrar o pet consegue falar com a família.
• Divida o cuidado com a família e o passeador, escolhendo o que cada um vê.
• Bob, o assistente que tira dúvidas sobre a rotina e o uso do app.
• Memórias, datas especiais e conquistas.

Você escolhe o que compartilha com cada lugar e pode desconectar quando quiser. O Bob não faz diagnóstico e não substitui o veterinário.

A área da clínica usa a conta criada em petrespondi.com. A área do tutor tem cadastro direto no app, com e-mail e senha.

name: Phase Balance
description:
Phase Balance lays a panel out as two columns of breakers, splits each load across its phases, and shows the imbalance.

PANEL
Odd slots are the left column and even slots the right. The same row is the same phase. Drag a breaker onto another to swap them, or onto an empty span to move it. A locked breaker stays put.

BALANCE
A treemap shows each phase, then each load inside it. A suggested move names the slots and the imbalance before and after. Apply it, or undo.

DEMAND
Connected load, then receptacle and kitchen factors, continuous loads, and the largest motor. The last column is what the main has to carry, with the spare at 80 percent.

READINGS
Clamp each phase and log it. A high neutral is called out. The directory card lists every slot for the panel door.

Panels, photos, and the CSV you import stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This is not a design review.

name: Phase Belt
description:
Phase Belt is for a stator that already has some coil groups tucked. It shows where the next group can start, and it will not let you finish while a slot is over the fill limit or the phases are not about 120° apart.

The end view is this stator. Red slot numbers are copper that does not fit. A pale arc is a group you have not tucked. Drag that arc to another slot. Slot fill and the phase places move with it. A group you already tucked stays put.

Where to tuck names a start slot that clears the tight window. On the 24-slot example, slot 7 is tight. Moving group B1 to slot 17 clears the red numbers and puts the phases about 120° apart. Mark B1 tucked, then finish the rewind. Last rewind keeps the earlier slot areas and cannot be edited.

The stator stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Phone Guardrail
description:
Phone Guardrail is a private vault for the photos, videos, documents and notes you don't want sitting in your camera roll. You open it by drawing a pattern, and everything inside is encrypted on your device before it is stored.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a 4×4, 5×5 or 6×6 pattern pad and draw your pattern twice. A strength meter tells you when it is long enough to be hard to guess.
• Tap + to add photos and videos, documents and files, or write a note. Each file is encrypted with AES-256-GCM as it is added.
• Your pattern never encrypts files directly. It unlocks a random 256-bit key using PBKDF2-SHA-256 with 600,000 rounds.

ORGANISE
• Folders and sub-folders, with your own order
• Filter by Photos, Videos, Docs or Notes, and search inside a folder
• Built-in viewer for photos, videos, PDFs and text; swipe through a folder
• Select several items to move, rename, export or delete them

PROTECTION FOR AWKWARD MOMENTS
• Decoy vaults: a different pattern opens a different vault. The app never lists how many vaults exist.
• Duress mode: you can mark one vault so that opening it quietly erases the other vaults on this device.
• Locks when you leave the app and after a few minutes of inactivity (you choose)
• A short lockout after repeated wrong patterns

BACKUP AND SHARING
• Encrypted backup file of the open vault, which you keep wherever you like. It is useless without your pattern.
• Restore a backup on a new phone
• Share selected files as a package locked with a passphrase, and import packages sent to you

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up
• No ads
• Files and keys stay on your device. They are never sent to a server.
• Light, dark or match-device theme

PLEASE NOTE
There is no "forgot pattern" option. Nobody, including the developer, can open a vault without its pattern, so keep an encrypted backup. Adding a photo makes an encrypted copy; delete the original from your Photos app yourself if you want it hidden.

name: Photo Transfer Guru
description:
Transfer photos between your iPhone and computer over your local Wi-Fi network. Open the address shown in PhotoSpace in any browser—no cable, account, or extra app required.

Browse authorized albums and photos on a Mac, PC, phone, or tablet. Download photos to your computer or upload them from your computer to your iPhone. Transfers stay on your local network; PhotoSpace does not upload your photos to a cloud server.

With PhotoSpace installed on both devices, you can also connect them over local Wi-Fi to browse albums, preview photos, and select multiple photos to transfer in the app.

Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi, start sharing in PhotoSpace, and open the displayed address in your browser.

name: Pico Courier
description:
Pico Courier is the official delivery app for couriers working at Pico Pizza branches. Accounts are created by the branch; only authorised couriers can sign in.

PICK UP
• Scan the delivery QR code on the order receipt to take the order.
• See your active orders and delivery history in one place.

DELIVER
• Start directions to the customer's address with one tap (Apple Maps).
• Get back to your branch quickly with "Directions to restaurant".
• See the payment method, the amount to collect at the door and the order note in advance.
• Call the customer with one tap.

COMPLETE
• Confirm the delivery; order and payment status are updated instantly.

LOCATION SHARING
• Your location is shared with your branch and the waiting customer only while you are online.
• Location sharing stops as soon as you go offline.
• Battery friendly: infrequent updates when idle, frequent updates during a delivery.

Available in Turkish, English and German.

name: PinaCode
description:
PinaCode connects your iPhone or iPad to the coding agents running on your computer. Start a task at your desk, then open the same conversation on your phone to see how it is going.

Choose a project, read the conversation, inspect file changes, and send a follow-up when the agent needs direction. Your computer runs the tools and keeps the project files.

To get started, run PinaCode on your computer and pair the mobile app using a pairing link. Keep the computer running and reachable while you work. Coding providers are configured separately on the host.

name: ping4u
description:
ping4u 是连接你与自己电脑上开发工作区的 iPhone 客户端。

• 按项目管理和切换 Agent 会话，查看任务输出并继续对话。
• 使用远程终端，在手机上输入命令、查看输出和切换会话。
• 查看 Host 连接与设备状态，通过配对和电脑端确认授权连接。
• 与自己的电脑加密通信，Agent 和终端任务在电脑端执行。

使用前，请在 Mac 或 Windows 电脑上安装并运行 ping4u Host，再在 iPhone 上输入配对码，并在电脑上批准设备连接。

Agent、模型及第三方服务需在电脑端安装或配置，并使用你已有的账号、订阅或 API 服务。本 App 不包含第三方模型额度或订阅。

name: Pinpote
description: Pinpote est une carte privée pour partager tes bonnes adresses entre amis. Épingle les lieux que tu veux recommander, ajoute un avis et retrouve les découvertes de tes potes sur la carte ou dans le fil.

name: PinweKnow
description:
PinweKnow is an offline workspace for what you learn. Put the recording, paper handouts, PDFs, links and your own notes from a class, a conference or a meeting into one session. When you search, organize or ask AI later, every piece leads back to its source.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
• No sign-up, no sign-in, works without internet
• Recordings, photos, documents, notes and the search index stay on this device. The app collects no data, shows no ads and does not track you.
• Make a password-encrypted backup whenever you like and keep it where you choose. Not included in iCloud device backups unless you turn it on.

FIVE WAYS TO CAPTURE
• Scan: paper, slides or a whiteboard, several pages at once
• Record: write time-stamped notes, mark moments and take photos while recording; photos are linked to the moment in the recording
• Import files: PDFs, photos, audio, video, text files, and SRT or VTT transcripts with timecodes
• Link / text: paste a web address or a piece of text
• Note: write your own thoughts, mark them as key points or keep them private

TRANSCRIBED ON YOUR DEVICE
• When a recording ends, or when you import audio or video, it is turned into a transcript on the device, with no internet needed
• Tap a line of the transcript to jump to that second; transcripts are searchable too
• Uses the speech recognition built into iOS (iOS 26 or later on iPhone 12 or newer; iOS downloads each language the first time you use it)

FIND IT, AND GO BACK TO IT
• Text in photos and scans is recognized on the device (OCR); text in PDFs is extracted automatically
• One search box covers notes, transcripts, PDFs, recognized text and AI results
• Tap a result to jump to that second of the recording or that page of the PDF
• Notes can point to a time or page; if you delete the material, the note stays and shows "Source deleted"

ONE FULL RECORD
• Each session has one full record: transcripts, text from photos and scans, PDF text, notes and AI results in time order (reading sessions follow the order you set)
• Every passage starts with a source code, such as the time in the recording or the page of the PDF; tap it to go back to the source
• Export as PDF or Markdown, print or copy; your materials are never changed
• Private notes stay out unless you include them

PDF ANNOTATIONS AND PAGE TOOLS
• Highlighter, underline, pen and sticky notes
• Rotate, reorder, delete and extract pages, merge files, or turn a scan into a PDF
• Annotations are kept separately and can be saved as a new PDF; the original file is never changed

ASK AI, IN YOUR OWN AI APP
• PinweKnow runs no AI and never goes online; you choose which AI app to use
• Pick "Summary and key points", "Meeting minutes", "Study notes", "Translate" or write your own instruction. PinweKnow opens your AI app with the instruction and the full record already copied: paste them and tap Send
• When the AI answers, tap Copy, come back and tap "Paste reply". The answer is saved as an AI result in the session, searchable and part of the full record
• Source codes in the reply are checked against what you sent: matching ones take you back to the source, others are marked "Unverified"
• Email addresses, phone numbers, ID numbers and card numbers are hidden before sending by default; private notes are left out
• On supported iPhones (iOS 26 or later), translate on the device with the built-in translation; nothing leaves the device

ORGANIZE YOUR WAY
• Topics (with subtopics), projects, tags and contexts; long-press sessions to categorize several at once
• Two-column layout on iPad
• Available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean

Before recording or filming, follow local laws and the rules of the venue or meeting, and respect the wishes of other participants.

Privacy Policy: https://pinwelife.com/privacy/

name: Pixel Riddles: Nonogram Logic
description:
Fill in cells using the number clues and uncover the pixel art hidden in the grid.
The numbers beside each row and above each column tell you the runs of filled cells in that line. Reason it out cell by cell until the whole picture appears in full color.

102 ORIGINAL PIXEL PICTURES
• Six chapters: Little Bites, Critters, Kitchen, Everyday Things, Wild Animals and Grand Gallery
• From tiny 5×5 snacks to 20×20 lighthouses, castles and parrots
• Every picture is hand-made and original: mushrooms, sushi rolls, teapots, guitars, pandas, hot-air balloons and more

PURE LOGIC, NO GUESSING
• Every puzzle is checked by a solver: one unique answer, reachable step by step
• Difficulty from 1 to 5 stars, based on how deep the reasoning goes, and each chapter ramps up gently

EASY, PRECISE CONTROLS
• Tap to fill, long-press to cross, drag to fill a whole line in one stroke
• Undo any stroke
• Matched clues turn grey automatically so you can see what's left
• Pinch to zoom and move big boards. Cells stay easy to tap even on a small iPhone
• Optional mistake checker turns wrong cells red right away

A COLORFUL REVEAL
• Fill the last cell and the grid ripples into a full-color pixel picture

DAILY PUZZLE
• A new pixel emblem every day, from 8×8 on Mondays to 15×15 on weekends
• Keep your daily streak going

STUCK?
• Reveal fills in one correct cell for you
• Check marks the cells you got wrong

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Fully offline
• No account needed
• No tracking, no data collected. Your progress stays on your device

ALSO
• Dark mode, iPhone and iPad
• English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese

name: PizzaYolo - le jeu de cartes
description:
Pizza Yolo, c'est le jeu de cartes où l'on se dispute les meilleures parts !

Chaque carte est une part de pizza garnie de 0 à 5 aliments : olive, tomate, poivron vert, chèvre et basilic. Plus une part est garnie, plus elle rapporte de points.

À ton tour, choisis une carte sur la table, puis décide : la garder dans ton stock pour marquer des points, ou la poser dans la pizza commune. Mais attention à la règle de pose : une part doit toujours avoir au moins un aliment en commun avec ses voisines !

Quand la pizza commune est complète, la manche s'arrête et chacun compte les points de son stock. Le premier à atteindre 50 points gagne la partie.

- Joue contre l'IA, en 3 niveaux : facile, moyen ou difficile
- Défie un ami en ligne : envoie-lui un lien, et c'est parti
- Active l'aide à la pose pour voir les emplacements possibles, ou désactive-la pour réfléchir par toi-même
- Règles illustrées et vidéo explicative intégrées
- Gratuit, sans publicité, sans achat intégré, sans compte

Un jeu imaginé et dessiné par Benjamin Roucayrol.

name: PlacePocket
description:
Remember exactly where you put things. Build a directory of rooms, cabinets and containers, then add named items with aliases, tags and notes. Unfiled items stay visible until you choose a place for them.

Find searches item names, aliases, notes and current location paths. Move one item, up to 100 selected items, or a whole container with its nested places. The app checks the complete hierarchy before saving, so a container cannot become its own ancestor.

Movement history preserves the old and new paths even after places are renamed or items are removed. Print a useful PDF location index, share CSV, and export or restore your whole JSON library. PlacePocket works offline and does not require an app account.

name: Plan Gapwise
description:
Plan around the time you actually have. Whether you have 15 minutes before lunch or an hour after work, Plan Gapwise helps you find tasks that fit your available time, setting, and energy.
- Add the times you’re free and choose a setting and energy level for each opening.
- Give each to-do a time estimate, deadline, and requirements. See which tasks fit an opening and why others need a different slot.
- Preview a proposed schedule that prioritizes upcoming deadlines. See where tasks would go and what’s still unscheduled, then apply the schedule when you’re ready.
- Log how long completed tasks actually took. Compare actual time with your estimates and move unfinished work to a future opening.
Plan Gapwise works fully offline and supports English and Chinese, with no account or calendar access required.

name: Planer – Aufgaben & Kalender
description:
Planer ist deine Aufgaben- und Kalender-App für iPhone, iPad und Mac – mit einem entscheidenden Unterschied: Deine Daten liegen auf einem Server, den du selbst betreibst, zum Beispiel auf einem Raspberry Pi zu Hause. Kein Konto beim Entwickler, keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

ALLES IM BLICK
• Heute, Morgen und Nächste 7 Tage zeigen dir sofort, was ansteht
• Eingang und eigene farbige Listen für Arbeit, Privates oder Einkäufe
• Überfällige Aufgaben werden hervorgehoben
• Erledigte Aufgaben klappst du einfach ein

KALENDER
• Monats- und Wochenansicht mit allen Aufgaben des Tages
• Wiederkehrende Termine erscheinen direkt im Kalender

SCHNELL ERFASST
• Aufgaben in Sekunden mit dem Plus-Knopf hinzufügen
• Datumserkennung: „morgen 15 Uhr #arbeit !hoch“ setzt Termin, Schlagwort und Priorität automatisch

TERMINE, ERINNERUNGEN, WIEDERHOLUNGEN
• Datum, Uhrzeit oder Dauer festlegen
• Mehrere Erinnerungen pro Aufgabe
• Täglich, wöchentlich, monatlich, jährlich, werktags – oder ganz eigene Regeln, etwa „alle 2 Wochen am Mo und Do“ oder „nach Erledigung“

ORGANISIERT
• Prioritäten, Teilaufgaben, Schlagwörter und Notizen
• Suche über alle Aufgaben
• Heller und dunkler Modus

DEIN EIGENER SERVER
Planer gleicht alle Geräte über einen kleinen, offenen Sync-Server ab, den du selbst betreibst. Die Einrichtung ist auf planer.minipliy.net beschrieben. Die App funktioniert auch offline und ganz ohne Server – dann bleiben die Daten nur auf dem jeweiligen Gerät.

name: PlanSpan
description:
Turn a clear floor plan, drawing or PDF page into a measured reference you can keep and share.

Import a source from Files, choose a known distance and set its length. Place points directly on the drawing to save lengths, polylines and angles. Zoom and pan for precise placement, then hold and drag a point to adjust it.

• Import images or a selected PDF page
• Calibrate in millimeters, centimeters, meters, inches or feet
• Save named measurements and notes with your plans
• Review lengths, individual segments and angles across your plans
• Export a marked PNG and a paginated PDF report
• Keep report snapshots unchanged when you edit or delete the source
• Manage your local library and share chosen files through the system share sheet

PlanSpan works with uniformly scaled two-dimensional sources. Its results depend on the drawing and the calibration you supply.

name: PlateCalc — Barbell Plates
description:
PlateCalc tells you exactly which plates to load — no more mid-workout math.

Enter the total weight you want to lift, and PlateCalc instantly shows the plates for each side of the bar as a clear, to-scale diagram, with the count for every plate. If your plates can't make the exact total, PlateCalc loads the closest possible weight and always shows you the real total — nothing is silently rounded.

BUILT FOR THE GYM FLOOR
• One value, zero fuss: type a weight, see the loading
• To-scale barbell diagram — heaviest plates inside, just like real loading
• Kilograms and pounds, switchable anytime
• Bars: 20 kg / 45 lb, 15 kg / 35 lb, 10 kg, or your own custom bar
• Optional collar weight per side

WARM-UP SETS, DONE
The Warm-up tab builds your ladder automatically — empty bar, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% — with the plates for every step. Percentages are yours to edit.

YOUR PLATES, YOUR RULES
Tell PlateCalc what your gym actually has: switch plates off, set counts per side, or add your own sizes. Separate inventories for kg and lb, remembered between sessions.

FAVORITES
Save the lifts you load every week — weight and exercise name — and recall them in one tap.

No accounts. No ads. No tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone, and the app works fully offline.

name: PlayPOS
description:
PlayPOS — касса и учёт для небольшого магазина. Продавайте с телефона или планшета, ведите склад и смотрите выручку — всё в одном приложении.

ДЛЯ ВЛАДЕЛЬЦА
• Выручка, валовая прибыль, количество продаж и средний чек за день, неделю и месяц
• Оплаты наличными, картой и в долг, возвраты
• Самые продаваемые товары

СКЛАД
• Остатки по каждой торговой точке, товары, которые заканчиваются или ушли в минус
• Приёмки, списания, перемещения между точками и ревизии
• Добавляйте товары в документ сканером: камера телефона читает штрихкод
• История движения по каждому товару
• Цена, себестоимость и минимальный остаток — правятся прямо в приложении

КАССА В ТЕЛЕФОНЕ
• Продажа по штрихкоду или поиску, весовой товар, быстрые товары
• Скидки, покупатели и продажа в долг
• Наличные, карта и смешанная оплата
• Смены, история чеков и возвраты
• Работает без интернета: продажи сохраняются на устройстве и отправляются, когда связь появится

ДОСТАВКА
• Вызов курьера или такси Playfood прямо из кассы, статус заказа в реальном времени

КАК НАЧАТЬ
Войдите с данными вашего магазина — теми же, что в веб-кабинете my.playpos.store. Кассу можно подключить по коду из кабинета, а сотрудники входят по PIN-коду.

Приложение работает вместе с кассой PlayPOS для Windows и веб-кабинетом: товары, цены и продажи синхронизируются между всеми устройствами магазина.

Удалить аккаунт можно в приложении: значок аккаунта → «Удалить аккаунт».

name: PLAYVOL
description:
PLAYVOL is the mobile companion to the PLAYVOL lead management platform, built for the sales reps of companies that work car-accident cases. It requires a PLAYVOL account created by your company.

HOME
See where your month stands at a glance: points toward your goal, leads that came in, open leads and the calls your intake team still has to make.

CREATE LEADS IN SECONDS
Capture the basics (client, phone, states, contact method) and send it. Mark it hot and the intake team is alerted right away. No signal? The lead waits safely on your phone and is sent by itself when you are back online.

YOUR LEADS
Search and filter your leads, open any of them to see its status, people involved, notes, tasks and medical visits, add comments and photos, and follow every change.

TASKS
Your calls and follow-ups in one list, with due times shown on the client's clock. Complete a task with a note, schedule the next one, or ask intake to call when a call is overdue.

NOTIFICATIONS
Push notifications when a lead comes in, a comment is added or a task is due, so nothing waits for you to open the app.

SECURE
Sign in with your company account, unlock with Face ID, and only see the leads your role allows.

PLAYVOL is a business tool: it has no ads and does not track you across other apps or websites.

name: Plumbra
description:
Plumbra brings surface leveling, slope calculations and tilt readings into a clear toolkit. Check a shelf, a tabletop or equipment alignment with a circular dial and separate X/Y readings.

- Surface level: lock or copy readings, set a target slope and adjust tolerance.
- Calibration: use quick calibration, a two-step 180-degree calibration, or reset saved calibration.
- Slope calculator: enter distance and slope to calculate rise, using degrees, percent, per mille or ratios.
- Slope references: explore drainage, wet-room and roof presets as calculation references.
- Camera guides: view angle alignment guides over a live camera preview.
- Vehicle tilt: see roll and pitch separately, with zeroing, peaks and adjustable thresholds.
- Magnetic field: observe field strength, deviation from a baseline, peaks and trends.
- Personalize: choose English or Simplified Chinese, and light, dark or system appearance.

Readings depend on device sensors, placement and calibration. The magnetic field tool requires a magnetometer and observes field changes; it cannot identify every metal or locate wiring reliably. Vehicle readings are intended for stationary checks. Verify slope presets against the requirements of your project. Plumbra is for everyday measurement assistance.

name: Plumi – Bedtime Stories
description:
Every night, a story made just for your child.

Plumi tells gentle, beautifully illustrated bedtime stories for children aged 3 to 6. The magic touch: your child's first name is written into the story. They are the hero, page after page, all the way to sleep.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Gentle bedtime stories of about 10 minutes
• Your child's first name in every story
• Big, colorful, full-screen illustrations
• Soft background music
• Listen mode: a warm storyteller voice reads the story and turns the pages (in this version the hero keeps the story's own name; your child's name appears when you read it together)
• Stories in English and in French
• Easy-to-read text, with adjustable size
• Night mode for a softer screen at bedtime

CALM AND WORRY-FREE
• No ads
• No account
• No data collected: your child's name stays on your phone
• Works offline
• Parent-only areas protected by a parental gate

Get cozy, dim the lights… and let the story begin.

name: PocketLabs – Device & Sensors
description:
PocketLabs brings device information and live readings together with detailed instruments and a dashboard you can reorder.

• Battery, storage, CPU, RAM, device and system information
• Wi-Fi, Ethernet adapter and cellular details
• Display, thermal system state and camera capabilities
• Bubble level, 3D orientation, compass, magnetic field, acceleration and gyroscope
• Speed, altitude and barometric pressure
• Live microphone level in dBFS; optional reference adjustment for estimated dB SPL
• Supported modules on Apple Watch, with iPhone or watch as the selected source
• Selected device information as Home Screen widgets
• Recordings with PDF export and deletion: speed and sea-level altitude can continue in the background; barometer and relative altitude use the active app
• German, English, French and Italian

• Driving cockpit with combined speed, altitude and g-force recording
• Optional local GPS routes with map playback; separately enabled background route, speed and GPS altitude
• Snapshot PDFs for RAM and Device & system
• Manually enter and manage locally stored phone numbers per SIM
• Charging animations with a liquid battery or floating energy glass sphere
• Speed correction in 0.5 steps, custom sensor order and three selectable overview lines

Availability and accuracy depend on hardware, system version and permissions. Widget updates are scheduled by the system. The app does not measure ambient temperature. Without reference adjustment, microphone readings are not sound pressure levels; adjusted readings remain unweighted estimates. Do not use for medical or safety-critical decisions.

No account, advertising or analytics SDKs. Optional public IP and provider lookups contact external services after consent; see the privacy policy.

name: Porchlight Solitaire: Klondike
description:
Porchlight redraws Klondike solitaire from scratch. Warm lamplight falls on the middle of the table and fades toward the corners, the card backs carry a small lamp, and the face cards are original emblems (a shield, a flower crown and a crown) with big, bold ranks instead of busy court portraits.
The rules are the ones you know: build all 52 cards up by suit from Ace to King.

EASY ON THE EYES, EASY TO PLAY
• Large print cards (on by default): big ranks and suits you can read even in a stack
• Tap a card and it jumps to the best spot, or drag it yourself
• Big buttons with labels, all within reach of your thumb
• Left-handed mode mirrors the deck and the buttons
• Optional four-color suits: blue diamonds and green clubs
• VoiceOver support: every card and pile has a spoken label

WINNABLE DEALS
• "Winnable deals only": every deal is solved by the computer first, so there's always a way to win
• Prefer pure luck? Switch to random deals

DAILY GAME
• A new deal every day, the same for everyone, always winnable
• Keep your daily streak going

WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
• Unlimited undo
• Hints outline the card to move in gold and the target in green, with an arrow in between
• Once every card is face up, finish with one tap

LITTLE LAMPLIT REWARDS
• Cards land with a gentle bounce and a little sparkle
• Build up combos: Nice! → Great! → Amazing! → Incredible!
• Four rotating win celebrations: card fountain, fireworks, star shower and suit burst
• Set a record or finish the daily game for an extra-special golden celebration
• Three tables: Forest, Walnut and Midnight
• Effects can be turned off, and Reduce Motion switches to a calm version automatically

RULES AND RECORDS
• Draw 1 or Draw 3
• Standard or Vegas scoring (with an optional running total)
• Statistics: win rate, current and best streak, best time, high score and fewest moves

QUIET AND OFFLINE
• Fully offline, no account needed
• No tracking, no data collected. Your progress stays on your device

DEVICES AND LANGUAGES
• Dark mode, iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
• English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese

name: Pour Ledger IC
description: Pour Ledger times each vessel in a wax sitting, logs pour jobs, and reviews bench pace. Offline studio journal with no account.

name: Precentor
description:
Precentor helps you sing the Psalms of David in Metre, the Scottish Psalter of 1650.

"Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord." (Ephesians 5:19)

In Scottish churches the precentor led the singing of the psalms, one line at a time. This app does the same.

• All 150 psalms, and the second versions of 13 psalms
• A choice of tunes for each psalm, in the same metre
• The player plays the tune in four parts
• Each syllable lights up when you must sing it
• The music for each tune
• Links to the notes of the Self-Interpreting Bible on each psalm

The psalms and the tunes are in the app, so it works with no connection. It plays when your iPhone is on silent.

Precentor is free. It has no account, no advertisements and no tracking. Its code is open source.

name: President Trou du Cul Original
description:
President, also known as Trou du Cul, Scum or Daifugō, is the card game everyone plays around the kitchen table. Now it's on your phone, in real time.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Play now: sit down with whoever is online. If nobody comes within about 20 seconds, bots fill the empty seats, so the game always starts. Players you don't know appear as animals, and there is no chat.
• Solo vs 3 bots: a quick game anytime, even without internet.
• With friends: open a room, and friends join by scanning the QR code, tapping the link you send them or typing the four-letter room code. Everyone plays on their own phone, and friends without the app can join from their phone's browser.

No account, no sign-up, no ads.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Be the first to get rid of your cards and become the President. The last one still holding cards is the Trou du Cul.
• Play one card, a pair or a triple, equal to or higher than the last play, or pass.
• Match the last card to skip the next player. The 2 is the highest card and closes the trick.
• From the second round, the Trou du Cul hands their best cards to the President.

YOUR HOUSE RULES
Every family plays it a little differently, so whoever opens a room chooses before dealing:
• Ready-made rule sets: French classic, American and Japanese Daifugō
• What a matching card does: skip the next player, "7 or nothing", or not allowed
• The 2 highest or lowest, revolutions on four of a kind, jokers, the 8 cuts
• The card swap, a pass that is final, no going out on a 2
• One deck or two, for 7 or 8 players

MADE FOR PLAYING TOGETHER
• 3 to 8 players in a room, friends and bots in any mix
• A bot plays for anyone whose connection drops, until they are back
• Emoji reactions (you can mute anyone's), sounds and vibrations for the big moments
• VoiceOver support, Reduce Motion and an optional four-colour deck
• In English, French, Hebrew, Spanish, German, Portuguese and Japanese

LEVEL UP
Earn XP every round, keep a daily streak, unlock achievements and new table colours, from Classic green to VIP.

Your progress stays on your phone. The game only needs the name you choose for the table.

name: Priente Hub
description:
Priente Hub brings your organization's communication and collaboration tools together in one secure app. All your data stays on your organization's own Priente Hub server.

EMAIL & CALENDAR
• Read, reply to and organize your work email with folders and rules
• Calendar, meeting invitations and reminders
• Company directory and contacts

CHAT & MEETINGS
• One-to-one and group chats with file and voice message sharing
• Video meetings, voice and video calls
• Make calls with your business phone line and listen to your voicemail

FILES & OFFICE
• Access your Drive files from anywhere
• View and edit documents, spreadsheets and presentations
• Keep track of your tasks with Notes and Planner

APPROVALS & SECURITY
• Complete approval and signature workflows from your phone
• Built-in authenticator for two-step verification
• App lock with Face ID
• End-to-end encrypted notification content

AI ASSISTANCE
• Summarization and writing help with the AI assistant, when enabled by your organization

To use Priente Hub, you need an account on your organization's Priente Hub server. Your account is created by your organization's administrator.

Available in English, Turkish, German and Arabic.

name: Prime Academy
description:
Prime Academy is the learning app for students of Prime Academy, an Economics coaching institute.

Log in with your student account to access your enrolled courses anywhere:

• Video lectures organised by course, subject and chapter
