• PDF notes and study material
• Quizzes and mock tests with scores
• Progress tracking, so you can see what you have completed
• Free preview lessons to sample the teaching style
• Announcements from your teachers
• Certificates of completion

Courses cover Economics for undergraduate and postgraduate students and for entrance and competitive exams.

Your account works on one registered device to keep course material secure. Need help? Message us on WhatsApp or email info@primeacademy.in.

Privacy policy: https://primeacademy.in/privacy-policy/

name: PrismFold: Light Crease
description:
PrismFold turns iPhone Duo’s foldable glass into an interactive optics board. One white beam enters across the left leaf; slowly bending the hinge deflects light across the central crease into crystal mirrors, refractive prisms, focal lenses and spectral gates.

THE CREASE IS A LENS
• Fold iPhone Duo calmly anywhere between 85° and 170° to steer beams around the dihedral crease
• Hold steady for 300 ms inside the target window to lock every crystal gate and chime a harmonic chord
• Zero speed traps: never requires slamming shut, rapid flapping or forcing the screen flat

SEEP ONTO THE COVER
• In Showcase Level 3 and Chapters IV–V, aim white light into the translucent seep portal along the crease
• Close iPhone Duo and turn the Cover Prism Ring on the 5.4-inch cover screen to split white light into calibrated Red, Green and Blue channels
• Reopen smoothly to route all three spectral beams into color-matched crystal gates

60 CRAFTED PUZZLES · 5 CHAPTERS
• I · Dihedral Mirrors: pure angular deflection and reflections
• II · Refractive Prisms: chromatic bends and multi-bounce routing
• III · Focal Lenses: tight apertures and multi-target alignment
• IV · Crease Seep: cover-screen RGB splitting across open and closed states
• V · Spectral Architecture: combined optic benches across every discipline

PLAYABLE ANYWHERE
• Seamless posture continuity across book, tabletop, flat and Split View
• Color-blind-safe R/G/B/W beam tokens paired with distinct target shapes
• Full support for standard iPhones and iPads via the on-screen glass slider, ±1° crystal steppers and optional device tilt

RESPECTS YOU
• One purchase. No subscription, no accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network calls
• Localized in English, Turkish and German
• Full VoiceOver labels and adjustable actions, Dynamic Type support and Reduce Motion fallbacks

Optimized for iPhone Duo. Great on every iPhone and iPad running iOS 27.1 or later.

name: PrismRatchet
description:
Guide a clockwork rabbit through a glass museum where amber and cyan beams decide where it can land. Turn prisms to light the next jump, collect every exhibit, and reach the exit with the wind you have.

One prism turn can open a path and leave another tile in shadow. Tinted glass needs light of the matching color, and landing on a gear tile turns all the gear-driven prisms at once. Plan a route that leaves the rabbit somewhere to go after each jump.

Solve 24 rooms, including four challenges that send you after two exhibits in a single run. Try a different route to beat your best jump count, then replay your shortest clear one move at a time to see how it came together.

name: Pro Fan Pulse
description:
Practice soccer predictions in a single-player training season with five fictional fixtures. Choose a home win, draw, or away win, and optionally add an exact score. Save or change your answers before kickoff.

Complete a training round to reveal simulated results. Earn three points for a correct outcome and two more for an exact score. Follow your points, accuracy, achievements, and previous seasons in your profile.

Create or join a friends’ league with a configured server to make predictions and compare standings. League fixtures and points are separate from your local season.

Optional match reminders and a Home Screen widget help you follow your local round. The app interface is in English; the local season does not use a live sports feed.

name: ProjCo
description:
ProjCo is the professional network built for the event industry. Technicians, producers, stage managers, designers, crew, suppliers and event companies use ProjCo to find each other, talk, and get work done — from a single show to a season-long tour.

FIND THE RIGHT PEOPLE
Search event professionals by role, skill, seniority, availability and location — anywhere in the world or near you. Every profile shows experience, skills, languages, portfolio, credentials and recommendations from people they have worked with.

FIND WORK
Browse live jobs, freelance gigs, contracts and event projects. Apply in a few taps, attach your CV, and follow every application from one place. Hiring? Post an opportunity and the right people come to you.

DISCOVER SUPPLIERS AND COMPANIES
Explore a growing worldwide directory of production companies, AV, lighting, staging, rigging, staffing and other event suppliers — with services, coverage areas and contact details.

MESSAGE AND CALL
Chat one-to-one or in groups, share files and photos, and start audio or video calls right inside the app. Calls run directly between participants and are never recorded.

SHOW WHEN YOU ARE AVAILABLE
Keep your availability calendar up to date so producers can see at a glance when you are free, booked or on hold.

NEVER MISS A MESSAGE
Get notified about new messages, incoming calls, applications, connection requests and reviews — even when the app is closed. You choose which notifications you receive.

BUILD YOUR REPUTATION
Collect recommendations and reviews, showcase past events in your portfolio, and grow a network of trusted colleagues across countries.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CONTROL
No advertising, no tracking, and we never sell your data. Your email and phone number stay private unless you choose to show them. You can download your data or delete your account at any time from Settings.

ProjCo works together with projco.net — sign in with the same account on your iPhone and on the web.

ProjCo is for professionals aged 18 and over.

Questions or feedback? Write to hello@projco.net

name: Proof Fold
description:
Proof Fold times each fold from the dough temperature.

Start a dough with its temperature and the flour weight. At 22°C the gap is 50 minutes. At 26°C it is 30. In between, the gap moves with the temperature.

Stamp a fold when you fold, not when a timer rings. A fold before 70% of the gap is early. A fold after 140% is late. The next window shows when the following fold belongs.

The loaf, the stamps, and the temperature stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Propability
description:
Propability är mäklarsystemet i fickan. Appen samlar arbetsdagen för fastighetsmäklare: objekt, kontakter, visningar, bud och dokument – uppdaterat i realtid med kontoret.

Det här kan du göra:
• Se dagens visningar, möten och uppgifter på startsidan och i veckovyn
• Söka objekt och öppna bilder, grunduppgifter och parter
• Ringa, skicka sms eller mejla kontakter direkt från kontaktkortet
• Se vem som ringer: byråns kontakter visas med namn vid inkommande samtal
• Registrera besökare på visningen och visa en QR-kod för självincheckning
• Registrera och granska bud och fatta budbeslut med tydlig kontroll
• Läsa och ladda upp dokument och följa signeringsstatus
• Arbeta i ringlistor med stöd för samtalsutfall och återkomster
• Ta emot notiser när något händer i dina affärer

Propability används av mäklare på byråer som har mäklarsystemet. Ditt konto skapas av byrån; logga in med byråns Microsoft-konto eller e-post.

Vill du se hur appen fungerar utan konto? Tryck på ”Utforska med exempeldata” på startskärmen.

name: Puanladım: Film ve Dizi Puanla
description:
Puanladım, film ve dizi puanlama topluluğu puanladim.com'un resmi uygulamasıdır.

İzlediğin her filme ve diziye 10 üzerinden puan ver, düşüncelerini inceleme olarak yaz, izleme listeni oluştur. Puanını yapımın afişiyle birlikte şık bir karta dönüştür; Instagram Hikâye'de, Snapchat'te ya da WhatsApp'ta paylaş. Hesabın, puanların ve listen puanladim.com'daki hesabınla aynıdır: telefonda yaptığın her şey sitede de görünür.

NELER YAPABİLİRSİN
• Puanla: 10 yıldızlı ölçekle puan ver, istersen inceleme ekle. Puanını dilediğin zaman değiştir ya da kaldır.
• Puan kartı: Puanını hikâye (9:16) ya da gönderi (4:5) boyutunda bir görsele çevir, tek dokunuşla paylaş veya galerine kaydet.
• Hızlı puanla: Popüler filmler ve diziler art arda gelir; izlediklerine tek dokunuşla puan ver, izlemediklerini geç.
• İstatistiklerin: Puan dağılımın, ortalaman, en yüksek puanların ve sitenin ortalamasına göre ne kadar cömert puanladığın. Özetini tek kartla paylaş.
• İzleme listesi: Sonra izlemek istediklerini tek dokunuşla kaydet; kararsız kaldığında listenden rastgele seç.
• Puanlarım: Tüm puanların tek yerde; film ya da dizi, en yüksek ya da en düşük puana göre sırala, ada göre ara.
• Ne İzlesem?: Film ya da dizi, tür, dönem ve en düşük puanı seç; sana rastgele öneriler gelsin.
• Keşfet ve ara: Vitrin ve listelere göz at; film, dizi ve oyuncu ara.
• Yapım sayfaları: Özet, oyuncular, yönetmen ve senarist, sezonlar, benzer yapımlar ve üye incelemeleri.
• Kişi sayfaları: Oyuncu ve yönetmenlerin filmleri ve dizileri.

GÜVENLİ TOPLULUK
• Uygunsuz incelemeleri bildirebilir, rahatsız eden üyeleri engelleyebilirsin.
• Hakaret ve küfür içeren incelemeler gönderilmeden önce süzülür.
• Hesabını ve ona bağlı tüm verileri uygulamadan kalıcı olarak silebilirsin.

Uygulamada reklam ve takip yoktur.

name: Puddle Paws
description:
Small dog. Big splash.

Welcome to Puddle Paws, a cheerful 3D garden game about delivering muddy hellos.

Tap an open patch to guide your little puppy. Splash in a puddle to load your paws, then trot to the neighbors' doormats and leave a lovely paw-print delivery. Once every porch is signed, bring the splash back to your kennel.

Every ramble visits three freshly generated gardens. Find your own route around planters, cross raised footbridges, and hold HOP to spring over washing spray. Rotating sprinklers and changing weather keep your paws thinking. A surprise rinse is just a reason for another splash.

Collect optional biscuits, build a porch chain, and earn twelve local keepsakes. Choose Gentle, Playful or Bouncy rambles, explore your receipt journal, and unlock more collar colors as your collection grows.

• Real 3D toy gardens with a turning perspective camera
• Simple tap-to-trot controls and a hold-and-release hop
• A playable Paw School with a skip option
• Seeded garden layouts, breezy afternoons and happy drizzle
• Original procedural characters, splashes and garden sounds
• Adjustable sound, ambience, haptics, motion and sniff hints
• Landscape play with compact, readable controls

A little mud makes a lovely hello.

name: Pulse / Tone
description:
Explore the space where rhythm becomes harmony.

Pulse / Tone is an instrument, composition laboratory and listening guide built around one continuous transformation: slow repetitions sound like pulses; accelerate them and they become a pitch. Combine different repetition ratios and hear polyrhythms turn into intervals and chords.

LAB — SHAPE THE TRANSFORMATION
• Control the repetition rate and hear the transition from pulse to tone.
• Build intervals and chords with tensions and open voicings.
• Edit voice ratios, levels and stereo positions with hands-on knobs.
• Follow the relationships in a circular pulse visualization.
• Add Room, Hall or Shimmer reverb.

COMPOSE — TURN EXPERIMENTS INTO MUSIC
• Arrange clips across up to eight tracks.
• Layer performances, shape rate changes and create fades between clips.
• Balance tracks with independent volume, pan, mute and solo controls.
• Edit on a timeline with a visible playhead and playback follow.
• Save projects and export audio or MIDI for further production.

LEARN — LISTEN, TRY AND UNDERSTAND
• Explore eight guided modules with 24 playable examples.
• Discover rhythmic ratios, intervals and the connection between repetition and pitch.
• Test what you hear and bring examples into your own experiments.

AUV3 — BRING IT INTO YOUR STUDIO
• Use Pulse / Tone as an Audio Unit instrument in a compatible host.
• Generate rhythmic MIDI or pitched notes with per-voice pitch bend.
• Monitor the internal sound while capturing MIDI in hosts that support AU-generated MIDI recording.
• Play recorded incoming MIDI through the instrument without changing output modes.
• Follow host tempo and transport for generated performances.

Designed for iPhone and iPad, with layouts that adapt to the available workspace. No account, advertising or subscription.

AUv3 MIDI capture and routing depend on the host. Live rhythmic MIDI supports up to 24 pulses per second per voice; pitched MIDI begins at 20 Hz and supports up to 16 simultaneous voices. External instruments must preserve MIDI channels and use a ±2-semitone pitch-bend range for microtonal playback.

name: PulseJuice
description:
PulseJuice brings your Apple Health data to your Mac’s menu bar.

• Steps – today’s count right in the menu bar, plus the last 7 days
• Resting heart rate – your daily trend
• Sleep – how long you slept, night by night
• Workouts – type, duration, distance and average heart rate

One purchase includes the iPhone and the Mac app. The iPhone app reads your data from Apple Health (HealthKit) with your permission; the Mac app shows it. Pair them once by scanning a QR code with your iPhone’s Camera – after that your iPhone syncs automatically in the background whenever it can.

Private by design: your data travels only over your local network, encrypted, directly from your iPhone to your Mac. No cloud, no account, no ads, no tracking. PulseJuice only reads your Health data and never changes it.

Requires iOS 17 and macOS 14 or later, with both devices on the same Wi‑Fi.
PulseJuice is not a medical device and does not give medical advice.

name: QC4U
description:
QC4U is the inspection app for fresh-produce quality-control organisations. Inspectors use it on site to inspect the lots of an order and send their findings straight back to the office.

• Your work: see the inspections planned for you today and this week, grouped by order.
• One checklist per lot: the questions your organisation set up for this product, customer and inspection type, with norms that show at once whether a value is good, moderate or poor.
• Every kind of answer: counts, weights with tare, sample sizes, ranges, scales, defect percentages, colours and remarks.
• Photos: take photos for an inspection or for one question, and mark the best ones for the report.
• Growers and pallets: record growers, GGN numbers, packhouses and pallet numbers found on site.
• Works offline: everything you capture is stored on the device and syncs when you are back online.
• Secure: sign in with your work account or email address; unlock with Face ID.

QC4U needs an account from an organisation that uses the QC4U platform. Accounts are created by your organisation's administrator; the app has no sign-up.

name: QGo Live by Radio.Cloud
description:
QGo Live by Radio.Cloud puts your radio studio in your pocket. Reporters, hosts and producers connect to their station in broadcast quality – from a press conference, a stadium or the car.

STUDIO LINK
- Call your station's studio with one tap, or let the studio call you.
- On iPhone, a studio call rings like a phone call, even when the app is closed.
- Clean, very low-delay audio made for live radio.
- Talkback: the studio talks to you off air, so you are ready when the mic opens.
- Play audio clips into the studio during the call: up to three of your Field Editor recordings.
- Text chat with the studio or remote during the call, for example “On air in 30 seconds”.
- The call reconnects by itself when you switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data.

FIELD EDITOR
- Record interviews, sound and voice reports on location.
- Cut and trim the recording right on your phone.
- Share the finished audio with your newsroom.

BUILT FOR STATIONS
- Your station admin manages people and studios.
- Sign in with your station account, with Apple or with Microsoft.
- Interview guests join from a simple web link. They need no app.

QGo Live by Radio.Cloud needs an account from your station. Ask your station admin for access.

name: Qihe: Sleep & HRV Insights
description:
Make more sense of your day with Qihe. Bring sleep, HRV-based body stress and daily activity into one clear view, using the records you choose to share from Apple Health.

SLEEP, WITH CONTEXT
Review sleep duration and stages. When enough comparable records are available, see how your sleep compares with your own recent patterns. Explore 7-day and 28-day views to spot changes over time.

A PERSONAL VIEW OF BODY STRESS
View an HRV-based reference for physical stress in the context of your own records. It is not a measurement of your emotions, a diagnosis or a medical assessment. Results depend on the available heart rate variability records; Qihe does not continuously measure HRV itself.

YOUR DAILY ACTIVITY
Review steps, active energy, exercise and recorded workouts alongside your other trends. See how your days compare without turning every number into a target.

A QUICK LOOK ON YOUR WRIST
Use Apple Watch to view a summary shared from your paired iPhone. The watch shows a snapshot of the latest information received, rather than a live medical monitor.

A SIMPLE, PERSONAL ROUTINE
Choose optional local reminders to support your routine. No account or developer-operated server is required. Qihe reads Apple Health records with your permission and does not write records to Apple Health.

Available insights depend on your permissions, devices and existing records. Qihe is for everyday wellbeing and personal reference, not diagnosis, treatment or emergency use.

name: QrMenum: QR Menü Oluştur
description:
QrMenum ile restoranınızın, kafenizin ya da otelinizin QR menüsünü telefonunuzdan oluşturun ve yönetin. Misafirleriniz masadaki QR kodu okutarak menünüzü görür; onların uygulama indirmesi gerekmez.

NELER YAPABİLİRSİNİZ

• Menünüzü fotoğraftan oluşturun: basılı menünüzün fotoğrafını çekin, yapay zeka ürünleri ve fiyatları okusun. Siz onaylamadan menünüze hiçbir şey eklenmez.
• Fiyatları anında güncelleyin: ürün, fiyat, kategori ve fotoğrafları değiştirin; değişiklik QR menünüze hemen yansır.
• Siparişi kaçırmayın: yeni paket siparişleri telefonunuza bildirim olarak gelir.
• Kolay giriş: telefon numaranızı bir kez SMS koduyla doğrulayın, sonra dilerseniz Face ID ile girin.
• Birden çok işletme: numaranıza bağlı tüm menüleriniz arasında tek dokunuşla geçin.
• Menü istatistikleri: menünüzün kaç kez açıldığını ve en çok bakılan ürünleri görün.
• Çok dilli menü: menünüzü farklı dillerde yayınlayın, alerjen ve kalori bilgisi ekleyin.

KİMLER İÇİN

Restoran, kafe, bar, pastane ve otel işletmecileri ile çalışanları için.

HESAP

Telefon numarası kayıtlı olmayan hesaplar e-posta ve şifreyle giriş yapabilir. Hesabınızı uygulama içinde Daha › Hesap ve bildirimler › Hesabımı sil adımından silebilirsiniz.

name: QRQuill
description:
Turn a message, web address or Wi-Fi setup into a clear QR code. QRQuill also reads QR codes from images you choose in Files, so you can inspect the complete content before copying or saving it.

MAKE AND KEEP
• Create Text, Web URL and Wi-Fi QR codes.
• Preview the exact encoded content and save it in your Library.
• Reopen, edit or duplicate saved content.
• Export crisp 512, 1024 or 2048-pixel PNG images, or printable A4 and Letter PDFs. PDF pages include the complete content.

READ AN IMAGE
• Choose an image in Files or try the built-in example.
• Read multiple QR codes and see their positions.
• Inspect complete text and recognized Wi-Fi fields. Network passwords have an explicit display control.
• Copy or name a reading to keep it. QRQuill does not execute decoded content.

FILES THAT KEEP THEIR CONTENT
Exported files are independent snapshots. Changing or deleting a Library record does not change an older export. Open, share or delete actual exported files from the file history.

The core QR tools work on your device without an app account. QR files include all encoded information, including any Wi-Fi password entered. Verify network details against your own network and choose recipients carefully. QRQuill supports image files up to 25 MiB within its image-dimension limits; creating content is limited to 1,500 UTF-8 bytes.

name: Quick Delivery IQ
description:
Quick يربط المتاجر والمطاعم بسائقي التوصيل في منطقتك، في تطبيق واحد بدورين: التاجر والسائق.

للتاجر
• طلب توصيل جديد في ثوانٍ: هاتف المستلم ومنطقته، وتظهر أجرة التوصيل فوراً قبل الإرسال.
• يصل الطلب إلى أقرب السائقين المتاحين تلقائياً. 
• تابع السائق على الخريطة من الاستلام حتى التسليم.
• إشعار عند كل مرحلة: قبول الطلب، والاستلام، والتسليم.
• سجل كامل لطلباتك مع البحث والتصفية، وعدّادات طلبات اليوم.

للسائق
• شغّل «متاح» لتصلك الطلبات القريبة منك.
• تفاصيل كل طلب قبل القبول: المتجر، والوجهة، والمسافة، والأجرة، وسعر البضاعة.
• اقبل الطلب أو ارفضه، وحدّث حالته بضغطة.
• تواصل مع المتجر والدعم عبر واتساب من داخل الطلب.
• محفظة واضحة بكل حركة: العمولات والإيداعات والرصيد.

لماذا Quick
• أجرة توصيل واضحة تظهر قبل إرسال الطلب.
• خريطة تعمل حتى مع ضعف الإنترنت.
• واجهة عربية بالكامل وسهلة.
• خصوصيتك محفوظة: موقع السائق يُستخدم أثناء تشغيل «متاح» فقط، ويمكنك حذف حسابك من التطبيق متى شئت.

الحسابات الجديدة تُفعَّل من إدارة Quick بعد المراجعة.

name: Quiz Crown Chase
description:
Welcome to the Kingdom of Veloria, where no royal decision may be made without knowledge and evidence. You have been appointed Royal Keeper of Judgement — and the court is waiting.

Quiz Crown Chase is not a tap-the-answer quiz. Every question is solved with your hands, inside a miniature palace of brass, velvet and wax.

CROWN TRIBUNAL — THE ROYAL KNOWLEDGE COURT
Three courtiers step up to their podiums and make claims about the stars, the oceans, history, mathematics or the natural world. Only one is telling the truth. Open each evidence drawer, compare measurements, dates and sources, watch out for hidden qualifiers and unit traps — then select your candidate, draw back the mechanical gavel, hold it until it glows and strike. The crown drifts toward the truth.

ROYAL WAX SEAL — THE DOCUMENT ATELIER
Each royal decree carries a question, and the correct answer is engraved on one of three stamps. Rotate the tray to read the engravings, lift the right stamp into the brass press, heat the wax until it melts (but not until it bubbles), pour a full pool, align the press and hold it for just the right moment. Correct knowledge certifies the document; careful craft earns the stars.

THRONE PERSPECTIVE — THE OBSERVATION GALLERY
Architectural models stand in a sunlit gallery, their details hidden by distance, columns and perspective. Slide the brass observation frame along its rail, pinch to magnify, adjust the viewing angle and let foreground pillars glide aside. Lock the evidence when the detail appears, then decide which statement it supports.

A COMPLETE ROYAL HOUSEHOLD
• 72 handcrafted challenges across eight knowledge categories — all free, all replayable, unlimited retries.
• Three playable tutorials led by Pip the Herald, Mira the Scribe and Orin the Curator.
• The Hall of Records: 32 illustrated knowledge entries to read, search and bookmark.
• The Crown Treasury: 22 gemstone achievements with real unlock conditions.
• The Royal Gallery: collect characters, crowns, seal patterns, architectural models and instruments.
• The Court Chronicle: your real statistics, charted like an illuminated ledger.
• Daily Court: a fresh trio of challenges every day and a streak to keep.

Every historical and scientific fact in the game is real and checked; the kingdom and its courtiers are fiction. Think wisely — and claim the crown.

name: Quốc Tịch
description:
Quốc Tịch giúp bạn tìm hiểu quốc tịch thứ hai, thường trú và định cư theo số liệu kiểm chứng được, trước khi gặp bất kỳ đơn vị tư vấn nào.

KIỂM TRA VISA
Chọn hộ chiếu đang có và nước muốn đến, xem ngay cần visa, được miễn hay làm visa điện tử.

BẢNG XẾP HẠNG HỘ CHIẾU
Số nước miễn visa của từng hộ chiếu, và ghép hai hộ chiếu với nhau thì đi được thêm những đâu.

SO SÁNH CHƯƠNG TRÌNH
Đặt các chương trình đầu tư quốc tịch và định cư cạnh nhau: mức đầu tư tối thiểu, thời gian xét duyệt, yêu cầu cư trú, người thân đi kèm.

TÍNH TRƯỚC CHI PHÍ
Nhập số người trong gia đình, app bóc tách từng khoản: đầu tư, phí chính phủ, thẩm định lý lịch, phí dịch vụ. Lưu lại thành bản PDF để xem sau.

GỢI Ý CHƯƠNG TRÌNH
Trả lời vài câu về mục tiêu và ngân sách, app gợi ý những chương trình đáng xem kỹ.

THEO DÕI HỒ SƠ
Khách hàng đã có hồ sơ xem danh mục giấy tờ cần nộp, các mốc tiến độ, gửi giấy tờ và nhắn tin với người phụ trách ngay trong app.

Thông tin trong app mang tính tham khảo; quyết định cuối cùng thuộc cơ quan di trú của từng nước. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong app, ở mục Tài khoản.

name: Radio Wave 108 FM
description:
Radio Wave 108 FM – Ndiq valën!

Muzika e mirë të ndjek kudo! Radio Wave 108 FM, radioja nga Tirana, tani edhe në telefonin tënd. Dëgjo muzikën që do, zbulo emisionet e preferuara dhe qëndro në ritmin e Radio Wave, kudo që të jesh.

RADIO WAVE, GJITHMONË ME TY!

Dëgjo radion drejtpërdrejt, në shtëpi, në makinë apo në lëvizje. Muzika vazhdon edhe kur përdor aplikacione të tjera ose kur ekrani i telefonit është i kyçur.

EMISIONET E TUA TË PREFERUARA

Nga Wave Breakfast Show te Pop Hits, Hip Hop, 90's Dance Hits, Shqip Hits dhe DJ Live Set, zbulo programin javor dhe merr njoftime për emisionet që nuk dëshiron të humbasësh.

MUZIKA JOTE, VOTA JOTE!

Ndiq Radio Wave Chart, zbulo këngët më të pëlqyera dhe voto çdo ditë për të preferuarën tënde.

MË SHUMË SE MUZIKË

Lajme, video dhe të rejat më interesante nga bota e muzikës, argëtimit, kulturës dhe stilit të jetesës, të gjitha në një vend.

NJIHU ME VALËN!

Ke një pyetje? Vala, asistentja jonë me inteligjencë artificiale, të ndihmon të zbulosh emisionet, muzikën dhe gjithçka tjetër që kërkon në aplikacion.

Pa regjistrim, pa pagesë dhe pa ndërlikime. Thjesht hap aplikacionin dhe shijo Radio Wave.

Radio Wave 108 FM. Ndiq valën!

name: Rankly
description:
O Rankly trata do marketing digital de pequenos negócios: SEO, artigos, redes sociais, email e avaliações no Google. Com a app tem o essencial no iPhone:

• Início: visitas vindas do Google, posições das palavras-chave e saúde do marketing do seu negócio
• Publicar: escreva ou tire uma fotografia e publique na página do Facebook do negócio
• Números: pesquisas no Google, posições das palavras-chave e visitas ao site
• Alertas: artigos novos, palavras-chave descobertas, auditorias e outros avisos
• Avaliações: veja e responda às avaliações do Google

A app é para quem já usa o Rankly (joinrankly.com). Entra com o mesmo email e password do computador.

name: RARE Air: Daily Trivia
seller_name: Sichuan Letu Zhixing Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
Take your knowledge above the clouds.

RARE Air is an open-answer trivia game about finding the less obvious answer. Each flight gives you five questions and 30 seconds per question. Type one correct answer and your hot-air balloon climbs. Rarer answers give you a bigger lift.

A FRESH DAILY FLIGHT
Everyone gets the same five prompts each day. Explore geography, science, books, films, history and everyday knowledge. A new challenge opens at midnight UTC.

FIND YOUR UPDRAFT
Correct answers earn 100, 250, 500 or 1,000 meters, based on fixed editorial rarity tiers. Aim for a 5,000-meter flight and review accepted answers after the final stage.

A SKY THAT RESPONDS
Drag your balloon to steer. Tap it to catch a gust. Rare answers bring cloud breakthroughs, wind rings and paper-plane companions. Turn on sound for extra atmosphere. Native haptics add feedback on supported devices, and reduced-motion settings simplify the flight.

KEEP EXPLORING
Practice online with fresh five-question sets, revisit past daily flights, or play from 400 bundled practice prompts offline. Completed daily and offline flight history stays on your device.

SHARE YOUR FLIGHT
Send a spoiler-free scorecard through your phone’s share sheet. Compare daily altitudes on the anonymous leaderboard.

Daily challenges, online practice, the archive and leaderboards require an internet connection. Offline practice works without a connection. Rarity tiers are curated editorial ratings. The game is free and has no in-app purchases.

name: RepairFlow Pro
description: Manage repair tickets and workflows offline.

name: RetroDict
description:
RetroDict turns your iPhone into the pocket electronic dictionary you remember: a soft green LCD on top, a chunky round-key keyboard below.

On iPhone Duo, fold the phone halfway and it becomes the real thing. The top half is the screen, the bottom half is the keyboard. Open it flat and RetroDict switches to a clean, modern word list.

THREE DICTIONARIES, FULLY OFFLINE
- English: 160,000+ entries with definitions and examples
- English-Spanish: 67,000+ entries
- English-French: 76,000+ entries
No account, no network, no ads. Every lookup happens on your device.

BUILT LIKE THE ORIGINAL
- Type and results appear instantly, letter by letter
- D-pad to move through results and scroll long entries
- Number keys 1-5 jump straight to a result
- Page keys flip to the previous or next word
- Key-press haptics

OPEN DATA
Dictionary content comes from Open English WordNet (CC BY 4.0) and WikDict / Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0). Full credits and license texts are inside the app under INFO.

name: ReturnFolio: Returns & Refunds
description:
Keep return deadlines, partial returns and real refund progress together with ReturnFolio.

Record a purchase, its item quantities and the deadline you were given. Enter a manual date or calculate a date from your own purchase/delivery anchor and day count. Create separate partial-return cases without reserving more items than you bought.

Build a preparation checklist and record actual Ready, Sent, Received and Closed events. Logistics and money stay separate: closing a shipment never invents a refund. Record each actual payment or store-credit refund and see unknown, awaiting, partial, matched or over-expected states. Resolve an outstanding or unknown amount with an explanation, and retain voided records when correcting a refund.

Generate useful PDF/CSV return packets, choose whether to include references and notes, and keep frozen snapshots that survive later edits. JSON backup and validated whole-library restore use Files. No App account is needed.

ReturnFolio uses your entered policy terms and monetary records. It does not determine merchant eligibility or legal rights, connect to retailers or banks, or perform currency conversion.

name: Risale-i Nur: Lügat ve Ses
description:
Bediüzzaman Said Nursî'nin Risale-i Nur Külliyatı'nı lügatı ve sesli okumasıyla birlikte okuyun.

KELİMEYE DOKUN, ANLAMINI GÖR
Anlamını bilmediğiniz kelimeye dokunun; o cümledeki anlamı, kökü ve Osmanlıca yazılışıyla birlikte açılır. Lügatı olmayan kelimeler için genel bir Osmanlıca–Türkçe lügat de içeride.

SESLİ OKUMA, KELİME KELİME TAKİP
Her bölümü dinleyebilirsiniz. Okunan kelime metinde vurgulanır, ekran okunan yeri takip eder. Hızı ayarlayın, bir paragrafa uzun basıp oradan dinlemeye başlayın. Ekran kilitliyken de çalmaya devam eder. İsterseniz bir kitabın sesini indirip internetsiz dinleyin.

KÜLLİYATIN TAMAMI
Sözler, Mektubat, Lem'alar, Şuâlar, Mesnevî-i Nuriye, İşârâtü'l-İ'câz, Asâ-yı Mûsâ, Lâhikalar, Sikke-i Tasdik-i Gaybî, Muhâkemat, Tarihçe-i Hayat, İman ve Küfür Muvazeneleri ve İlk Dönem Eserleri. Haşiyeler, ayet ve hadislerin mealleri, basılı nüshanın sayfa numaraları dahil.

RAHAT OKUMA
Sade ve ferah okuma ekranı, ayarlanabilir yazı boyutu, açık ve koyu tema. Hastalar, İhtiyarlar, Haşir, Tabiat, İhlas gibi bilinen risalelere tek dokunuşla ulaşın. Kaldığınız yeri ve her bölümdeki ilerlemenizi uygulama hatırlar.

ARAMA

name: Roomtail: Clap Reverb Meter
description:
Clap your hands in an empty room and the sound hangs in the air for a moment before it fades. How long it lingers, the reverberation time or RT60, is what makes one room sound clear and another sound like a stairwell. Roomtail measures it with your iPhone's microphone and three claps.

Choose what the room is for: a podcast or voice booth, a home studio, a home theater or a living room. Stand near the middle, clap once, and stay quiet while the room rings out. Do it twice more. Roomtail splits each clap into six octave bands, from the low boom at 125 Hz to the hiss at 4 kHz, and measures how fast each band dies away.

You get:
- the decay time for each band, plus the 500 Hz to 1 kHz figure most guides quote
- a plain verdict for the room's purpose, such as "a little lively" or "on target for a studio"
- warnings when the bass rings on far longer than the mids, or when bare hard surfaces make the room bright
- the decay curves themselves, if you want to see the slopes
- a short shopping list: how many rugs, curtains, 5 cm panels or corner bass traps would bring the room into range, with where to put them and an estimate of the result

Then add the rug, hang the curtains or put up the panels, measure again, and compare. Roomtail shows each band before and after, so you can see what the change really did and what it didn't (most soft furnishings barely touch the bass).

A balloon pop works even better than a clap if you want reliable low-frequency readings.

How the numbers are made: the microphone runs in measurement mode, with the iPhone's automatic gain and voice processing switched off. Each band is integrated backwards with Schroeder's method, the background noise is subtracted, and the slope from 5 to 35 dB down (T30), or 25 dB when the clap wasn't loud enough (T20), is extended to a 60 dB fall. Treatment estimates use Sabine's formula with your room's size. An iPhone microphone isn't a calibrated measurement microphone and a clap is an uneven sound source, so treat the results as a survey reading, ideal for before-and-after comparisons.

Audio is analysed on the iPhone as it arrives and is never saved or sent. Rooms and results stay on your device. There's no account, no ads, no in-app purchases and no analytics, and Roomtail works without an internet connection.

name: RTAP – Team Awareness Platform

name: Rung Card
description:
Rung Card is a first chart for a Cantonese syllable.

A syllable is one initial, one final, and one pitch rung. Set those three pieces. The card writes the Jyutping spelling with its tone number, such as si2 or sap1.

Six rungs cover the six tones. A final that ends in p, t, or k is a stop. A stop can sit only on rung 1, 3, or 6, and that pitch is short. The other rungs are refused, and nothing is kept.

When the chart has an everyday word for that syllable, the card shows the character and a short gloss. Cards stay on this device. The counts for cards kept, open mouths, stopped mouths, and rungs used are worked out from the cards you kept.

The chart, the tone rule, and the example words are in the app. There is no account and no network.

name: Sayloop 影读：英语跟读
description:
Sayloop 影读是一款离线英语跟读（Shadowing）练习应用：听示范、开口跟读、逐词打分，达到通过线才解锁下一句，一句一句把英语“读顺”。

【逐词打分，知道错在哪】
• 本机语音识别 + 逐词比对，给出总分、准确度、完整度、流利度
• 每个词按“标准 / 偏弱 / 错读 / 漏读”标色，点单词听示范、回放你自己读的那个词
• 达到通过线（默认 80 分）才进入下一句；连续 3 次未过可跳过并加入待复习

【场景库：36 篇原创对话与经典名篇】
• 出行、餐饮、购物、社交、职场、面试、就医、生活、校园、科技新生活等 12 类场景
• A1–C1 分级，每篇带中文译文、场景说明和关键表达
• 林肯《葛底斯堡演说》、《傲慢与偏见》等公版名篇
• 发音专项：th、l/r、v/w、长短元音，根据你常读错的词推荐

【角色扮演】
系统用另一个声音读对方台词，你说自己的那一方，只为你的台词打分；可换角色、开启“盲读”。

【听力循环】
逐词高亮朗读，整篇循环 / 单句循环、每句重复、句间停顿、0.6×–1.2× 变速、定时停止。锁屏后继续播放，支持耳机线控。

【开车模式：全程免触控】
播放 → “嘀”声 → 自动录音 → 打分 → 英文语音播报。没通过自动重播，第二次放慢；三次未过自动下一句并加入待复习。

【导入任意文本】
粘贴、导入 TXT / Markdown / PDF，或拍照识别书页，自动分句。

【隐私优先】
无需注册登录，不收集任何数据。录音、识别、打分、学习记录都只在你的手机上。

【统计】
练习时长、连续天数、得分分布、最常出错的词、待复习句子。

name: SeedWindow

LANGUAGES

CROSS-PLATFORM FILE TRANSFER
One file-sharing solution for multiple devices and platforms.

1. Android phones and tablets
2. iPhones and iPads
3. Android TV
4. Windows PCs and laptops
5. Linux computers
6. macOS and MacBook
7. Web browsers
8. Android XR headsets

LOCAL FILE SHARING & QUICK WIRELESS TRANSFER
Share files with nearby devices on the same local network. Transfer files wirelessly without cables or complicated setup.

Discover compatible devices and send files between connected phones, computers and other supported devices.
Share files locally or over the internet, between supported devices.

SIMPLE & SECURE DEVICE CONNECTION

LARGE FILE TRANSFER

description:
Selamat datang di Sentauri Academy — portal pembelajaran eksklusif dan aplikasi pendamping resmi bagi para murid terdaftar Sentauri Academy di seluruh Indonesia.

Sentauri Academy menghadirkan standar emas dalam pendidikan tata rias wajah (makeup artistry), memadukan estetika Quiet Luxury, teknik modern bridal internasional, dan kurikulum profesional yang disusun langsung oleh Sentauri.

FITUR UTAMA APLIKASI MURID SENTAURI ACADEMY:

Akses streaming video berkualitas ultra-jernih yang didukung jaringan global Bunny.net CDN, mencakup:

name: Sheila's Table
description:
Handcrafted charcuterie boards, individual boxes and grazing tables, made fresh for your event in Orange County, California.

Sheila's Table makes every board to order and themes it to your occasion: birthdays, showers, weddings, holidays, office parties and everything in between.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse the menu: grazing boards for 6 to 15+ guests, individual boxes in three sizes, and full grazing tables
• See a gallery of real boards and tables
• Send an order request in a minute: your date, guest count, board, pickup or delivery, and any dietary needs
• Get a reminder the day before, and add your event to your calendar
• See your past requests anytime

REWARDS
Every 5th order earns a free individual box platter ($50 value). There's no sign-up: just order with the same email each time and the app shows your progress.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tell us about your event.
2. Sheila replies within a day with availability and a quote.
3. Pick up your order, or have it delivered.

Serving Orange County, California only. Orders need at least 2 days' notice. Payment is arranged directly with Sheila. There's no payment in the app.

name: Shiftglance: Shift Calendar
description:
Shiftglance is a calendar made for shift work. Set up your rotation in a few taps, see what you work on any day, and let your iPhone show the next shift on the Home Screen and wake you before it starts.

SET UP IN A FEW TAPS
• Pick your rotation by name: 4 on 4 off, 2-2-3 (Pitman and Panama), DuPont schedule, 24/48, 48/96, Kelly, Continental, 9/80, Monday to Friday and more
• Tap where today falls in the cycle and check the preview against your real schedule
• No fixed pattern? Pick a shift and tap the days you work it
• When the days you tapped repeat, Shiftglance offers to carry the pattern on. You always see a preview first

REAL LIFE CHANGES
• Swap one day without touching the rotation
• Add a second shift, or mark a picked-up shift as an extra shift
• Vacation, sick days, unpaid leave, and "shift cancelled"
• A note on any day
• One tap puts the day back to the rotation

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN
• Today widget: what you work today and what is next
• Week and month widgets
• Lock Screen widget with your next shift
• Widgets change at midnight and at shift change by themselves

ALARMS THAT FOLLOW YOUR SHIFTS
• A real iPhone alarm before each shift, even when the phone is silenced or in a Focus
• Choose which shifts wake you and how long before they start
• Change the schedule and the alarms move with it

HOURS AND PAY
• Hours for each pay period: weekly, every two weeks or monthly
• Your own rates for overtime, nights, Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays
• Daily and weekly overtime, and extra shifts paid at a higher rate from the first hour
• Night shifts that cross midnight are split by the clock, and daylight saving nights are counted correctly
• Every rule is shown in plain words so you can check it against your pay stub

PUBLIC HOLIDAYS
• Built in for the United States, the United Kingdom and every Australian state and territory
• Add your own days, or switch off the ones you do not get

SHARE AND EXPORT
• Share a month as a picture
• Add your shifts to Apple Calendar
• Calendar file (.ics) for Google Calendar and Outlook
• A second schedule for another job, or for your partner's shifts

PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Works offline. Your shifts stay on your iPhone

For nurses, firefighters and paramedics, police, factory and warehouse crews, oil, gas and mine workers, retail and hospitality staff, and anyone whose week does not look like everyone else's.

Pay figures are estimates before tax and deductions.

name: Shoal Pact
description:
Steer a few fish and watch a whole school follow. In Shoal Pact, each move changes how the school spreads out, squeezes past coral, and comes together again.

Eight reef dives
Start with Amber and Mint. Drag a crowned leader toward a destination, or select a leader and tap the water. The little fish swim on their own, following their leader, staying close to their neighbors, and finding their way around rocks.

Send each school to its matching ring. Some rings are linked, so every school has to stay in place until the shared meter fills. In rescue dives, send any leader close to a stranded fry and it will join that school. Later dives add a third leader, Rosy, and combine these rules. Once the objectives are met, bring the whole crew to the pearl pool.

The campaign has no time limit. Pause to set destinations, resume to see your plan play out, and try a different route whenever you like. Finish a dive to unlock the next one. Replay earlier dives with fewer moves to earn up to three stars each.

Pearl Rush
You have 60 seconds to collect 15 drifting pearls across three waves. Guide the little fish through the pearls to pick them up. Alternate between schools to keep your chain going and earn up to 4x points. Clear all three waves to turn your remaining time into bonus points. Your personal best appears on the home screen.

Free Swim
Open Dive Map and choose Free Swim to experiment with all three leaders at your own pace. See what happens when you bring the groups together or send them around opposite sides of a reef.

Play offline. Campaign progress and Pearl Rush scores are saved on your device.

name: Shortlist: Photo Curation
seller_name: Renato Ferreira Lima e Correa Pereira
description:
Shortlist turns an album or a few days of photos into a short, personal selection, one swipe at a time.

Pick an album, a period or a hand-picked set of photos and give the curation a name. The photos appear as a stack, in the same order as the grid. Swipe right to keep, left to not keep, up to skip and down to go back. Prefer buttons? Every action is also below the photo, and Undo is always at hand.

ROUNDS UNTIL IT FEELS RIGHT
A first pass doesn't have to be final. Start a new round with only the photos you kept, go back to the ones you skipped, and change any decision later by touching and holding a photo in the grid.

REVIEW BEFORE ANYTHING CHANGES
Nothing in Photos changes while you sort. At the end, every decision appears as thumbnails: kept, not kept and pending. When you're ready, Apply in Photos lets you favorite the kept photos and delete the ones you didn't keep, as separate choices. You see every affected photo first, iOS asks for your confirmation before deleting, and deleted photos go to Recently Deleted.

YOUR FAVORITES STAY SAFE
You can leave photos that are already favorites out of the round, and Shortlist only offers to delete favorites you marked elsewhere if you explicitly allow it.

PHOTOS IN ICLOUD
If a photo is only in iCloud, Shortlist tells you, shows the download progress and lets you cancel or keep going with the photos already on your iPhone. A photo that can't load is never treated as rejected. On cellular, it asks before downloading.

SAVED ON YOUR IPHONE
Curations are saved on your device, so you can stop and pick up where you left off. Shortlist keeps references and decisions, not copies of your photos.

BUILT TO BE SIMPLE
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Works with full or limited photo access
- English and Portuguese
- VoiceOver and Dynamic Type support

REQUIREMENTS
iPhone with iOS 26 or later. Downloading originals from iCloud needs an internet connection.

name: ShotWeave Plan
description:
Every memorable frame starts with intent. ShotWeave Plan is your offline photography workspace for a considered shoot.

• Plan projects with a date, written location, creative brief and progress status.
• Build shot lists with lens choices, composition prompts, notes and captured/skipped states.
• Keep scouting observations, access notes and backup plans beside each project.
• Check equipment as you pack and export a readable project brief.
• Explore original thirds, leading-lines, negative-space and symmetry guides.
• Calculate equivalent shutter times across aperture and ISO changes.
• Estimate ND exposure duration from a base shutter and filter stops.
• Export a complete JSON backup or shot CSV, validate a backup before restoring, and erase your local workspace when you choose.

Free, with no account, ads, analytics or tracking. Your plans stay on this iPhone until you choose to export them. Optional editable examples help you explore; bundled help and policies work offline.

Exposure results are mathematical starting points, not metering or guarantees. Film may require reciprocity correction. No live weather, sunrise/sunset or location service is provided. Recheck access, permissions and conditions yourself.

name: ShowArc: TV Episode Ratings
description:
See every episode of a TV show rated in one colour grid. Spot where a series peaks, skip the weak seasons and decide in seconds what to watch tonight.

ShowArc turns a show's episode ratings into a heatmap: one column per season, one tile per episode, coloured from gold for the very best down to red for the weakest. One look tells you whether a show starts slow, gets better later or falls apart in its final season.

DECIDE FAST
• What to watch? suggests three great shows for the time you have (a meal, a weekend or a long haul) and the mood you're in
• Quick filters: under 30 minutes, finished shows, one season, weekend binges
• Today's pick: a fresh, well-rated show every day
• Binge time on every show: episode length and the hours it takes to finish
• Random great episode for sitcoms and other shows you can drop into anywhere

EVERY SHOW, EVERY EPISODE
• Episode ratings for more than 45,000 TV series and mini-series, updated daily
• Season averages and each show's best episodes
• Episode details: air date, length and summary

YOUR OWN RATINGS
• Rate episodes from 1 to 10 and see your own grid next to everyone's
• Rate a whole season in a minute with Next
• Give whole shows your own score

WATCHLIST
• Watching, Plan to Watch and Completed
• Sort by rating, your score or quickest to binge
• Synced between your iPhone and iPad with iCloud, no account needed

HOME SCREEN
• Tonight's Pick widget with a new show every day
• Continue Watching widget for the shows you're in the middle of
• Quick actions: touch and hold the icon to jump back into your show

SHARE
• Export the full episode grid of any show as an image, or your own ratings grid, for group chats and the eternal debate about which season was best

ShowArc is free, with no ads, no account and no tracking. Made for iPhone and iPad, and it runs on Apple silicon Macs too.

name: SideTube – Family Videos
description:
SideTube is a small, quiet video library for the family. Parents choose channels, videos and playlists, review them and approve them – only that selection is shown. No open search, no algorithm, no comments, no autoplay.

- Parent area behind a PIN: add channels, videos and playlists by link, rate them, approve or block
- Trust levels per channel: trusted source, trusted series, individually reviewed videos only
- Profiles per age group (3–5, 6–8, 9–11, 12+) with categories such as knowledge, nature, technology, stories, drawing manga
- Kid mode behind the parent PIN: Home with “Continue watching”, channels, recently watched; All videos; search only within approved content
- Wishes: suggest a topic or “more like this”, parents decide – optionally with a notification to the family's own Nextcloud server
- Sleep timer, daily limit and quiet hours with an early warning
- Remote control with a click wheel (haptic, works with VoiceOver)
- Links out of the player and recommendations only behind the parent PIN
- German, English, Spanish and Italian, following the system language
- Everything stays on the device: no accounts, no ads of its own, no tracking

Note: videos come from YouTube and play in the official YouTube player, which may show YouTube ads on some videos; on iPhone, videos from PeerTube are also possible. SideTube is not a YouTube or Google product. Playback is subject to the YouTube Terms of Service and the Google Privacy Policy.

name: Simetri: Alüminyum Doğrama
description:
Simetri, alüminyum ve PVC doğrama imalatçıları için proje, çizim ve teklif uygulamasıdır. Müşterinin yanında, internet olmadan ölçü alın, pencere ve kapıyı çizin, teklifi hemen PDF olarak paylaşın.

PROJE
• Müşteri, adres, iletişim ve iskonto bilgileriyle proje açın
• Teklif ve iş numarası otomatik verilir
• Üniteleri lotlara ayırın, projeleri arayın ve favorilere ekleyin

ÇİZİM
• Pencere, kapı ve cephe ünitelerini dış ölçüsüyle çizin
• Dikey ve yatay kayıtlarla alanlara bölün, bölmeleri iç içe kurun
• Kısmi ölçüleri elle ya da T/4-20 gibi formüllerle girin
• Sabit cam, iç/dış açılım, çift eksen, vasistas, sür-çek, pivot ve çift kanat seçin
• Yalıtımlı cam, panel ya da lambri dolgu seçin
• Profil silerek alanları birleştirin, topal (L ve kademeli) doğrama çizin

ÇIKTILAR (PDF)
• Teklif ve ölçü föyü
• Malzeme ve maliyet analizi
• Profil, cam/panel, aksesuar ve sarf malzeme siparişleri
• İmalat listesi, kesim listesi ve kesim optimizasyonu
• Firma logonuz ve bilgilerinizle; paylaşın ya da yazdırın

ÇEVRİMDIŞI VE GÜVENLİ
• Projeleriniz cihazınızda saklanır, internet gerekmez
• Projelerinizi yedekleyip geri yükleyebilirsiniz
• Hesabınızı uygulama içinden istediğiniz zaman silebilirsiniz

name: Simple Controller
description:
Arrange game controls around your reach. Simple Controller lets you create and customize buttons, sticks and touch controls on your iPhone.

Start with an editable Shooter, Racing, Sports, Open World or Palworld layout, or build your own. Move and resize controls, organize them into pages, and keep navigation controls within the same profile.

Explore the controls in offline Practice before connecting hardware. Optional features include tap-to-hold actions, sticks that stay where you leave them, Stick+ actions at different travel distances, slide-to-activate buttons, timed macros, touch aiming and floating controls. Release all clears active inputs.

REAL CONSOLE CONTROL REQUIRES ADDITIONAL HARDWARE.
The verified Xbox connection uses a Raspberry Pi Pico W running the project's compatible bridge firmware and an Xbox Adaptive Controller. The phone and Wi-Fi bridge must share a local network. The iPhone does not connect directly to the Xbox on its own. USB button mode sends full LT/RT presses; adjustable pressure requires a compatible additional hardware route. Keyboard/mouse and other outputs marked Practice-only are not available through every bridge mode.

Profiles and settings are stored locally. Export profiles to keep a backup or share a layout. No app account is required.

This is an independent controller utility. Game assignments vary with the game and its control settings. Starter layouts are examples that you can customize.

name: Simpro HVAC Calculator
description:
Simpro HVAC Calculator puts the everyday field calculations in your pocket: charge checks, duct sizing, airflow, psychrometrics, capacitor tests and filter sizing. Enter what your gauges and meters read and get a clear answer, with an in-range, high or low verdict where it matters.

Free forever with a free Simpro account. No ads, no subscription, no credit card.

CHARGE CHECK: SUPERHEAT AND SUBCOOL
• Superheat for piston (fixed orifice) systems, with the target worked out from indoor wet bulb and outdoor dry bulb
• Subcooling for TXV systems against the nameplate target
• Saturation temperature from suction or liquid line pressure (R-410A)

DUCT SIZER
• Round duct size from CFM and friction rate, or from a target velocity
• Rectangular equivalents with velocity and friction for each size

AIRFLOW CFM
• Required airflow from sensible capacity (BTU/h) and temperature split, plus CFM per ton

PSYCHROMETRICS
• Start from dry bulb with relative humidity, wet bulb or dew point
• Get dew point, wet bulb, RH, enthalpy, moisture (grains per pound), specific volume and vapor pressure, corrected for altitude

CAPACITOR CHECK
• Measured microfarads (µF) from start winding amps and voltage across the capacitor, compared with its rating

FILTER VELOCITY
• Face velocity in fpm for a filter size and airflow, with a suggested size when it's too high

BUILT FOR THE JOB SITE
• Works offline: in basements, attics and crawl spaces
• Large +/- steppers for quick adjustments
• Find tools by the shorthand you use: SH, SC, CFM, WB, µF
• Light and dark mode
• Imperial or metric units: °F, psig, CFM and inches, or °C, kPa, L/s and mm

Use three calculations as a guest, then create a free account with your name, company and work email to keep going.

Made by Simpro, field service management software for trade businesses.

Results are guidance. Always verify against the equipment manufacturer's data and charging charts.

name: Sit Less - Sedentary Reminder
description:
Sedentary Reminder helps you break up long sitting with gentle, on-time reminders — on iPhone and Apple Watch.

SITTING TIMER
A clear progress ring fills as you sit. When the ring is full, you get a reminder to stand up — with a vibration on your Apple Watch, and "I Stood Up" and "Snooze" actions right in the notification.

AUTOMATIC STAND DETECTION
Walking or running is detected automatically, so the timer resets when you really get up and move — no manual check-in needed. Riding in a car never counts.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
See today's stand-ups, standing time and steps (from Health, read-only), plus 7-day charts for stand-ups, standing time and sitting time, counted only within your reminder hours.

FLEXIBLE SETTINGS
Choose your interval (20–90 minutes), snooze length, reminder hours and active weekdays, and a reminder sound. Everything pauses automatically outside your hours.

No account. No ads. No tracking. Your data stays on your device.

name: Sleepy Forest: Logic Puzzles
description:
Tuck sleepy animals into a patchwork meadow so nobody wakes anybody. Every animal follows its own rule, and every puzzle has exactly one answer.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• Animals with their own rules. Hedgehogs sleep one to a row, column and patch, and never touch, not even at a corner. Owls follow that rule and also keep off each other's diagonals. Rabbits sleep in pairs. Each new animal changes how you think.
• One answer, no guessing. A solver checks every puzzle before it reaches you. If a board is in the app, it can be solved by logic alone.
• Hints that teach. A hint does not just fill a cell. It shows the next logical step and explains why it works, in plain words. A hint that only points at a wrong mark costs nothing.
• A daily puzzle. Three new boards every day, quick, classic and hard, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going, and one missed day a week is covered for you. Past days stay open in the calendar.
• The nook. As you play and build streaks, new residents move into the nook: a dormouse, a squirrel, a robin, a frog, a badger and more. Tap one to say hello.

HOW IT PLAYS
Tap a cell once to mark it empty, tap again to place an animal. Drag across cells to mark many at once. Mistakes are never punished: there are no lives and no mistake counter. Undo whenever you like.

IN THE FOREST
• 450 levels in three chapters: Hedgehog Meadow, Owl Wood and Rabbit Hill, from easy to hard. Every level is open from the start.
• Short guided boards teach each animal's rule the first time it appears.
• Acorns come from playing. Spend them on hints, on bringing back a streak, and on new board colours.
• Patterns on the patches, so boards can be read without telling colours apart.
• Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion are supported. Light and dark looks.
• Soft sounds and light haptics, both optional. Your music keeps playing.
• One gentle reminder a day, if you want it. Nothing else interrupts you.
• No account, no sign-up. It works without a network, and it collects no data about you.
• Plays in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Dutch, Turkish, Japanese and Korean.

Sleepy Forest is free to download. Every level and every daily puzzle is open from the first day. If you like star battle, two-not-touch and other grid logic puzzles, you will know the idea. The animals here add rules of their own.

name: SMF DashCam
description:
Turn your iPhone into a dash camera. Mount it, open DashCam and drive: recording starts by itself, and the clips that matter are kept safe.

HANDS-FREE RECORDING
• Starts recording automatically once the car is moving. You never need to touch the phone while driving.
• Records in short clips, so a crash or a flat battery never costs more than a few seconds of video.
• Loop recording: choose how much space DashCam may use, and the oldest clips are replaced once it's full.

CRASH DETECTION
• An impact or hard braking locks the clip being recorded, the one before it and the moments after.
• Tap the lock button to keep a clip yourself.
• Locked clips are never removed automatically.

EVERY FRAME TELLS THE STORY
• Date, time, speed, GPS position, heading and a live route map, burned into the video.
• A large speed readout, plus the speed limit for the road you're on, from OpenStreetMap.
• Take a geotagged photo without stopping the recording.

EVIDENCE PACK
• A PDF report for your insurer, the police or a solicitor.
• It includes the route map, a speed graph, stills from each event and a SHA-256 fingerprint of every clip. Anyone receiving the video can check it hasn't been altered.

TRIPS
• Every journey is listed with its route, distance, duration and events.
• Share a whole trip as one video, or export the route as a GPX track.
• Old clips you haven't locked are shrunk to 720p after a day, about a third of the size.
• Recordings are ordinary video files, also available in the Files app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no analytics and no advertising.
• Video, photos and trips are stored only on your iPhone, and leave it only when you share them.

Please drive safely. Mount your iPhone securely without blocking your view, and set DashCam up before you set off. Speed limits are a guide only, so always follow the road signs. Keep your iPhone on charge for long journeys.

name: Sổ Nhà: Chi tiêu gia đình
description:
Sổ Nhà là sổ chi tiêu DÙNG CHUNG cho gia đình và cặp đôi — nơi mọi người cùng ghi, cùng xem, cùng nắm được tiền nhà đang đi đâu.

Khác với các app quản lý chi tiêu chỉ dành cho một người, Sổ Nhà được thiết kế "gia đình chung" ngay từ đầu: mỗi khoản chi ghi rõ ai trả, cả nhà thấy cùng một bức tranh, và cuối tháng biết ai đang ứng nhiều hơn cho chi tiêu chung.

TÍNH NĂNG CHÍNH

• Ghi thu / chi nhanh, phân loại theo danh mục tuỳ chỉnh
• Nhiều thành viên: Chủ · Thành viên · Chỉ xem — mời nhau bằng email
• Hạn mức theo danh mục, tự kế thừa sang tháng sau, cảnh báo khi sắp vượt
• Tổng quan trực quan: chi/thu tháng, biểu đồ theo danh mục, giao dịch mới nhất
• Xem theo ngày / theo người / theo danh mục; lọc theo khoảng thời gian
• Cân đối đóng góp: ai ứng dư, ai còn thiếu cho chi tiêu chung — chia đều hoặc theo tỷ lệ
• Sổ mượn trả: ghi nhớ khoản cho mượn / đi mượn giữa người thân, bạn bè, trả từng đợt, nhắc hạn — tách riêng khỏi thu chi (thuần ghi chép)
• Hũ tiết kiệm: đặt mục tiêu chung cho cả nhà, ghi khoản gửi / rút, xem ai đã góp bao nhiêu
• Nhắc ghi chép cuối ngày
• Song ngữ Việt / Anh, giao diện Sáng / Tối
• Khoá ứng dụng bằng Face ID / mật mã thiết bị

RIÊNG TƯ & MINH BẠCH

• Ứng dụng ghi chép cá nhân: không giữ tiền, không thu lãi, không liên kết tài khoản ngân hàng
• KHÔNG quảng cáo — ở mọi màn hình
• KHÔNG bán hay chia sẻ dữ liệu cho bên thứ ba
• Không đọc tin nhắn, không đòi quyền không cần thiết
• Dữ liệu mã hoá khi truyền; bạn xoá được toàn bộ tài khoản và dữ liệu bất cứ lúc nào ngay trong ứng dụng

PHÙ HỢP VỚI

• Vợ chồng / cặp đôi mỗi người trả từ ví riêng cho chi tiêu chung
• Gia đình có bố mẹ, con cái cùng đóng góp
• Nhóm bạn ở chung, chia sinh hoạt phí

name: Social Ease: Talk Practice
description:
Some conversations are easier when you have tried them once before.

Social Ease is a quiet place to rehearse everyday moments: greeting a neighbour, turning down an invitation, giving a compliment, asking your manager for more time, ending a long phone call. Pick a scene, read what the other person says, and choose how you would answer.

HOW IT WORKS
• 50 written scenes in five areas: Everyday conversation, Saying no, Kind words, Workplace and Boundaries
• Each moment offers replies in different styles, such as gentle, direct or formal
• No reply is marked wrong. You get a short note on how it may come across, and sometimes a small tip
• Listen to the lines with recordings included in the app. If a recording is unavailable, playback uses your device's text-to-speech service under that provider's terms and privacy policy
• Save the replies you like and come back to them before the real conversation
• Repeat any scene as often as you want

YOUR OWN RHYTHM
• An optional 10-question reflection on your social preferences. It describes preferences, not abilities, and is neither a clinical assessment nor a diagnosis
• Note how you feel today and, if you like, set a gentle plan for social time. A plan is a guide, never a limit
• A weekly review based only on what you logged yourself

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• Conversation practice and local records work offline; opening web links requires an internet connection
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• The app stores your entries locally and does not send them to us. You can delete local entries in the app. Your device backup service may keep copies, depending on your settings

GOOD TO KNOW
• All scenes and feedback are written in advance. The app does not listen to you, does not use your microphone, and does not generate replies
• Available in English and Dutch
• Social Ease is a practice tool. It is not a medical product and does not replace professional help. If you are struggling, please contact a doctor or a local support service

name: Sow & Grow: Garden Planner
description:
Sow & Grow plans your vegetable and flower garden around where you live.

YOUR SEASON, WORKED OUT
Enter your town or postal code and Sow & Grow finds your hardiness zone and your average last and first frost dates from 30 years of local weather records. Know your own dates? Set them and everything follows.

A PLAN FOR EVERYTHING YOU GROW
Tick the crops you want this year and the app lays out every step, month by month: when to start seeds indoors, harden off, sow or transplant, thin, fertilize and expect a harvest. Cold-hardy crops are timed from your average last frost; tender crops wait for the later, safer date. Fall crops and repeat sowings for a steady harvest are planned too.

SNAP THE SEED PACKET
Photograph the back of a seed packet and the app reads the variety, days to maturity, depth and spacing for you, then schedules it. Or add your own variety by hand and save it for next year.

WATER WHEN IT MATTERS
Each day the app checks rain, heat and evaporation against your soil, your watering method and how far along your crops are. It tells you when to water and for how long, when rain has it covered, and when a dry spell calls for a deep soak. It also warns you when frost threatens tender plants.

WALK THE GARDEN
Walk from planting to planting and tap what you see: dry, weedy, pests, yellowing leaves, ready to harvest. When you finish, your to-do list is put together for you, with how-to notes for each job.

REMINDERS
Get a notification the evening before and the morning a garden job is due.

MORE
• Several gardens, each with its own soil, watering and dates
• About 50 vegetables, herbs and flowers built in, with a crop guide you can check
• Organic or conventional fertilizer advice with rates
• Works without signal in the garden; everything stays on your phone
• No account, no ads

name: Soz Tabu: Qazaqsha Crossword
description:
Сөз Табу: Қазақша Сөзжұмбақ — әріптерден сөз құрап, кроссворд шешетін қызықты қазақша сөз ойыны! Саусағыңызбен әріптер дөңгелегін жалғап, жасырын сөздерді табыңыз, сөздік қорыңызды байытыңыз және Қазақстанның әсем табиғаты мен мәдениетіне саяхат жасаңыз.

НЕГІЗГІ МҮМКІНДІКТЕРІ:
• 500 бірегей деңгей және 100 тақырыптық тарау: «Отбасы», «Тағам мен Ас», «Табиғат сыры», «Сарыарқа», «Өнер мен Күй», «Білім ордасы» және т.б.
• Сөз мағынасы, орысша аудармасы және дыбысталуы: ашылған кез келген сөзді басып, оның орыс тіліндегі аудармасын, латынша жазылуын, мысалын көріңіз және қазақша дыбысталуын тыңдаңыз.
• «Қоржын» бонустық сөздер сандығы: торда жоқ қосымша қазақша сөздерді тауып, тиындар мен сыйлық сандықтарын жинаңыз.
• «Күн сөзі» және мақал-мәтелдер: күн сайын жаңа сөз бен халық даналығын ашып, үздіксіз серияңызды сақтаңыз.
• «Сөз жинағы»: тапқан барлық сөздеріңіз жеке сөздігіңізде сақталады — оларды іздеп, таңдаулыға қосып, дыбысталуын тыңдаңыз.
• Ойыншы дәрежелері мен 32 марапат: тәжірибе (XP) жинап, «Сөз шебері» мен «Сөз зергері» атағына жетіңіз.
• Интернетсіз ойын: жолда, ұшақта немесе демалыста офлайн ойнай беріңіз.

---

СөзЖұмбақ (Сөз Табу) — увлекательная словесная головоломка и кроссворд на казахском языке в формате Word Connect («слова из букв»)! Соединяйте буквы на круговом диске, находите загаданные слова и легко запоминайте новую казахскую лексику прямо во время игры.

ПОЧЕМУ ВАМ ПОНРАВИТСЯ ИГРА:
• Идеально и для носителей языка, и для тех, кто хочет учить казахский язык с удовольствием: каждое отгаданное слово можно нажать (`Сөз мәні`), чтобы увидеть перевод на русский, транслитерацию на латинице, пример употребления и прослушать правильное произношение.
• 500 продуманных уровней в 100 тематических главах — от простых слов из 3 букв до сложных интеллектуальных головоломок.
• Ежедневное испытание «Күн сөзі» с казахскими пословицами, система рангов и 32 достижений (`Жетістіктер`), комбо-серии и умные подсказки (`Кеңес`, `Нысана`, `Араластыру`).
• Личная коллекция открытых слов (`Сөз жинағы`) с поиском, фильтрами и озвучкой (839 слов в базе).
• Работает полностью без интернета (офлайн).

name: Span Card
description:
Span Card is for the moment the tape is still on the wall and the shelf board has not been cut.

Write the clear span, the depth of the board, and the weight that will sit on it. Choose a thickness, a wood, and whether the board rests on the two ends or also on a support in the middle. The iPhone works out the sag at midspan and the span divided by 240, then says whether that thickness stays within the limit.

When the numbers are the ones you want, write a card on this iPhone. The card carries the cut length, the board, the load, the sag, the limit, your name, and a contact, so the person at the saw can read it. You can share that file with the system share sheet. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account.

Span Card is an estimate you make before you cut. It is not a structural certificate, and it does not replace a builder or an engineer. Units stay in inches and pounds.

name: SPCX Launch Pad
description:
SPCX Launch Pad helps you follow upcoming SpaceX missions, the $SPCX share price, space news, and merch from the SPCX Gear store, all in one simple iPhone app.

LAUNCHES
See the next planned SpaceX liftoff at the top of the app, with a live countdown. Scroll the upcoming list for the rocket, pad, and launch status. Open a launch for more detail, including the launch window, mission notes, and a webcast link when one is available.

Set optional alerts for 10 minutes or 1 hour before liftoff. You can get alerts for all upcoming SpaceX launches or for Starship only, and you can also set a one-time reminder on a launch’s page.

NEWS
Read recent articles about SpaceX from space news sites. Tap a story to open it in your browser.

$SPCX STOCK
Check the Nasdaq $SPCX share price, with charts for 1 day, 5 days, 1 month, and 1 year. Prices come from IEX through Marketstack and may be delayed. They are not investment advice. Add the shares you own (this stays on your iPhone) to see your position and gain or loss. You can also open the Nasdaq quote page.

Home screen widgets show the next launch countdown and the $SPCX price.

GEAR
Browse mugs, hats, shirts, and other items from the SPCX Gear store. Tap a product to open it on spcxgear.com in your browser, where you can buy it.

No account is required. SPCX Launch Pad does not collect your data. Your launch-alert choices and share count stay on your device.

This is an unofficial, independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with SpaceX or any related company. SpaceX and Starship are trademarks of their owners. Launch data is provided by The Space Devs (Launch Library 2). News is provided by the Spaceflight News API. Share prices are provided via IEX and Marketstack and may be delayed.

name: SpectroSynth: Atomic Light Lab
description:
SPECTROSYNTH — Chemical Audiovisual Synthesizer & Bluetooth Light Controller

Explore the physics of atomic emission lines through real-time sound synthesis, photonic strobe visualization, and microcontroller lighting telemetry.

Key Features:
• Periodic & Molecular Emission Matrix: Tap 16 pure elements (Hydrogen Balmer 656.3 nm, Sodium D-doublet 589.0 nm, Copper emerald 515.3 nm, Potassium lilac 404.4 nm, Strontium crimson 650.4 nm, Cesium sky-indigo 455.5 nm, and more) plus 8 molecular compounds (H2O, NaCl, CuSO4, Fe2O3, Sr(NO3)2, KCl, BaCl2, CO2) mapped to multi-spectral harmonic chords.
• Audio-Acoustic Resonator & Live Oscilloscope: Converts emission wavelengths and atomic properties into pentatonic/harmonic chords across Sine, Triangle, Sawtooth, and Square timbres with micro-interval doublet detuning and a live 60fps time-domain oscilloscope.
• Photonic Strobe Beacon & 8-Channel NeoPixel Simulator: Real-time central emission beacon, 380–750 nm visible spectrum line ruler, and 8-channel WS2812B LED array with 5 hardware lighting modes (Spectral Strobe, Multi-Line Alternating, Photon Wave Chase, Standing Orbital Nodes, and Plasma Breath Envelope).
• 8-Byte BLE Protocol Controller & Hardware Simulator: Generates live 8-byte hexadecimal frames (0xA5 sync, Species ID, RGB, Pattern/Waveform nibble, Strobe Hz×10, XOR CRC8) with native ESP32/Arduino C-packet export and full built-in hardware telemetry simulation when no external BLE receiver is paired.

name: Spectrum Photo Editor
description:
Spectrum is a photo editor that puts the tools of a desktop darkroom on your phone. Open a JPEG or a camera RAW file, shape the light and colour, and export a finished picture. Everything happens on your device.

LOOKS
• 80 built-in looks in 12 moods: film, cinematic, moody, warm, cool, soft, vintage, black and white, portrait, landscape, urban and food
• Set the strength of any look
• Import your own .cube LUT files
• Import presets made for Adobe Lightroom (.xmp and .lrtemplate files)
• Save your own edits as presets, and copy and paste edits between photos

LIGHT AND COLOUR
• Exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites and blacks
• Temperature, tint, vibrance and saturation
• Tone curves: a master curve plus separate red, green and blue curves
• Colour mixer: hue, saturation and luminance for eight colour ranges
• Colour grading for shadows, midtones and highlights
• Auto adjust as a starting point

DETAIL AND EFFECTS
• Clarity, texture, dehaze, sharpening and noise reduction
• Grain, fade, vignette and halation

LOCAL ADJUSTMENTS
• Up to three masks per photo: a gradient, a circle or a brightness range, each with its own sliders

CROP
• Free crop or fixed ratios, straighten, rotate and flip

WORKFLOW
• Develops camera RAW files, including DNG, CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, ORF and RW2
• Pinch to zoom, press and hold to compare with the original
• Undo and redo for every step; your original file is never changed
• Live histogram
• Export as JPEG, PNG or WebP, with quality and size options, one photo or a batch

PRIVACY
Spectrum needs no account and has no ads or analytics. Your photos are not uploaded anywhere.

name: Spellfill: English Word Game
description:
Spellfill is a word game that teaches you English while you play.

Every level hides a few letters of one real English word. Drag a tile into a blank, tap a tile and then a blank, or double tap a tile to send it to the first empty space. Get the word right and Spellfill shows you what it means, how it is used in a sentence, and how it sounds in both UK and US pronunciation.

A WORD BANK THAT GROWS WITH YOU
3,000 hand-written words across the six CEFR levels, from A1 to C2. Early runs stay on everyday words; the further you get, the rarer they become. Every entry has its part of speech, a plain-English definition, an example sentence and full IPA for both accents, all written by us rather than copied from a dictionary.

ONE RUN, FOUR LIVES
A run starts at level 1 with four lives. Each solved word moves you up a level, each wrong letter costs a life, and every five solved levels give one life back. Lose the last one and the run ends, unless you take the single revive a run allows.

PLAY ANYWHERE
The whole word bank ships inside the app, so Spellfill works with no signal at all. There is no account to create and nothing to sign in to.

EIGHT THEMES
Each word carries a theme, and the screen takes its colours and decorations. Calm background music and soft tile sounds come with it, and both can be switched off from the settings button on any screen.

REMOVE ADS
Spellfill is free and shows ads. One purchase removes them for good and makes the revive free.

name: Sperely
description:
سبيرلي هو سوق لقطع غيار السيارات. اعثر على القطعة المناسبة لسيارتك، واطلبها مباشرة من المتجر، وادفع نقدًا عند الاستلام.

كل مستخدم في Sperely يمكنه الشراء والبيع: اشترِ ما تحتاج إليه، وافتح متجرك الخاص لبيع قطع الغيار.

اعثر على القطعة المناسبة
• أضف سيارتك وحدّد الشركة المصنّعة والموديل وسنة الصنع، لتظهر لك فقط القطع المتوافقة معها.
• تصفّح الفئات أو ابحث باسم القطعة.
• اختر حالة القطعة: جديدة، أو حاوية (مستعملة مستوردة)، أو مستعملة.
• اطّلع على الصور والفيديو والسعر ورسوم التوصيل ومدة التوصيل قبل الطلب.

اشترِ بثقة
• ادفع نقدًا عند الاستلام، دون الحاجة إلى بطاقة مصرفية.
• سلة واحدة لعدة متاجر: يُقسَّم طلبك إلى طلب مستقل لكل متجر.
• استفد من أسعار الجملة للكميات الكبيرة، والخصومات، والتوصيل المجاني لبعض القطع.
• تتبّع طلبك من الموافقة عليه حتى التوصيل.
• قيّم المتجر بعد وصول طلبك، واقرأ تقييمات المشترين الآخرين.

تواصل مع البائع
• دردش مع البائع داخل التطبيق، واستفسر عن القطعة وأرسل الصور.
• تواصل مع الدعم من داخل التطبيق.

بِع قطع الغيار الخاصة بك
• افتح متجرك وأضف اسمه وشعاره ووصفه.
• أضف منتجاتك بالصور والفيديو، وحدّد السعر وسعر الجملة ورسوم التوصيل والسيارات التي تتوافق معها القطعة.
• استقبل الطلبات وأدِرها، وتابع مبيعاتك وإحصاءات متجرك.
• تُراجَع المنتجات الجديدة قبل نشرها، للحفاظ على جودة المعروض في السوق.

حمّل Sperely واعثر على القطعة المناسبة لسيارتك، أو ابدأ البيع اليوم.

name: Sportivement Sparring-partner
description:
Trouve ton partenaire de sparring près de chez toi, dans ton sport de combat.

Sportivement réunit les pratiquants de boxe, MMA, kickboxing, muay thaï, lutte, judo, jiu-jitsu, grappling, taekwondo et karaté. Repère les sportifs motivés autour de toi, échange avec eux et organisez ensemble votre prochaine séance.

• La carte : les pratiquants les plus proches de toi, par sport, avec l’itinéraire jusqu’au lieu de la séance.
• Les séances : crée une séance ou rejoins celle d’un autre membre, puis note les participants après l’entraînement.
• Les discussions : messages privés pour caler l’heure, le lieu et le niveau.
• L’actu : partage une photo, ta dernière séance ou un sondage avec toute la communauté.
• La pratique : techniques, exercices et conseils mentaux pour progresser dans ta discipline.
• La sécurité : signale un profil ou un message ; des modérateurs veillent sur chaque ville.

La carte, les messages et la sécurité restent gratuits pour tous. Avec Sportivement Plus, abonnement mensuel ou annuel, tu débloques tout le catalogue de techniques et d’exercices dans chaque discipline, et tous les membres de ta ville sont prévenus quand tu crées une séance. L’abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement et se résilie à tout moment depuis les réglages de ton compte.

Que tu prépares un combat ou que tu cherches simplement quelqu’un avec qui faire des rounds, Sportivement t’aide à ne plus t’entraîner seul.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://bloxks.app/apps/f1952666-sportivement-trouve-ton-sparring-partner/terms

name: Spotra - Link to Video Ad
seller_name: AHMED MOHAMED ADEL EZZAT EL SHAMY
description:
Spotra turns a product link from your store, or a story from your site, into a short vertical video ad ready for Reels, Stories and TikTok.

• Paste the link: we read the product name, description, price and photos for you.
• The script is written in Egyptian, Gulf or Modern Standard Arabic, with a look that suits your product (bold, clean, luxe or news).
• The voice is recorded in natural Arabic, and you can play every word on its own: change any word you don't like and record it again.
• No video is made until you approve the voice.
• Word-by-word captions light up with the voice, and a QR code at the end takes viewers to the product.
• Download the video and share it straight from your phone.

One point = one second of the final video; previews and reviews are free. Every new account gets gift points for its first video.

For WordPress and WooCommerce stores there is a plugin that adds a “Make video” button to every product.

name: Sprue Stack
description:
Sprue Stack là cuốn sổ quản lý dành cho người đam mê mô hình lắp ráp. Từ robot, xe hơi, máy bay đến tàu thuyền, hãy quản lý toàn bộ bộ sưu tập kit và theo dõi hành trình hoàn thiện từng mô hình.

QUẢN LÝ KHO KIT
- Thêm kit với tên, loại mô hình, tỷ lệ, giá mua và ngày mua.
- Theo dõi trạng thái: Chưa mở, Đang ráp hoặc Xong.
- Chỉnh sửa, xóa và lọc danh sách kit theo trạng thái.

GHI NHẬT KÝ LẮP RÁP
- Ghi lại từng buổi ráp cho mỗi kit.
- Phân loại thời gian theo công đoạn: Cắt, Ráp, Sơn, Decal và Phủ.
- Ghi số phút thực hiện và ghi chú cho từng buổi.
- Chỉnh sửa hoặc xóa nhật ký bất cứ lúc nào.

HỒ SƠ CHI TIẾT TỪNG KIT
- Xem tổng thời gian đã dành cho mỗi mô hình.
- Theo dõi tỷ lệ thời gian giữa các công đoạn.
- Tính chi phí cho mỗi giờ trải nghiệm lắp ráp dựa trên giá mua và tổng thời gian đã chơi.
- Đánh dấu hoàn thành khi mô hình được ráp xong.

DỰ BÁO ĐỐNG KIT CHƯA RÁP
- So sánh số kit mua mới và số kit hoàn thành trong 6 tháng gần nhất.
- Dự báo thời điểm có thể hoàn thành toàn bộ kho kit hiện tại.
- Nhận cảnh báo khi tốc độ mua kit vượt tốc độ hoàn thành.
- Hiểu rõ liệu đống kit đang giảm hay tiếp tục tăng.

THỐNG KÊ VÀ PHÂN TÍCH
- Biểu đồ thời gian ráp theo từng tuần trong 8 tuần gần nhất.
- Thống kê tỷ lệ thời gian dành cho từng công đoạn.
- So sánh chi phí mỗi giờ giữa các loại mô hình.
