- Khám phá loại kit mang lại nhiều giờ trải nghiệm nhất so với chi phí bỏ ra.

XUẤT VÀ QUẢN LÝ DỮ LIỆU
- Xuất danh sách kit và nhật ký lắp ráp thành tệp CSV.
- Chia sẻ dữ liệu qua bảng chia sẻ của thiết bị.
- Tùy chỉnh đơn vị tiền tệ và ngày bắt đầu tuần.
- Chọn giao diện sáng hoặc tối.
- Xóa toàn bộ dữ liệu sau khi xác nhận.

THIẾT KẾ CHO NGƯỜI CHƠI MÔ HÌNH
Sprue Stack tập trung vào trải nghiệm quản lý bộ sưu tập và ghi lại hành trình lắp ráp. Không cần tài khoản, không cần kết nối Internet và không phải đăng ký dịch vụ.

Toàn bộ dữ liệu được lưu trực tiếp trên thiết bị. Bạn có thể quản lý kho kit, ghi nhật ký và xem thống kê ngay cả khi ngoại tuyến.

Sprue Stack giúp mỗi hộp kit không chỉ là một món đồ trong tủ, mà còn là một hành trình sáng tạo được ghi lại.

name: Stampy Pro
description:
Stampy reúne en un solo lugar las tarjetas de sellos de tus lugares favoritos. Compra, suma sellos y gana premios: sin tarjetas de papel y sin perder nada.

CÓMO FUNCIONA
• Únete a un negocio con un toque.
• En la caja, muestra tu código QR o di tu celular. El negocio suma tus sellos.
• Cuando completas los sellos, tu premio queda listo para canjear.

DESCUBRE
• Restaurantes, cafés, postres, bebidas, barberías, belleza y lavado de autos.
• Ordena los negocios por cercanía con "Cerca de ti".
• Cupones activos de cada negocio.
• Guarda tus favoritos.

TU BILLETERA
• Todos tus tickets en un solo lugar, con tu progreso y tus premios listos.
• Avisos cuando sumas un sello, cuando tienes un premio y cuando tus lugares lanzan promociones.
• Invita a tus amigos y gana sellos extra.

Stampy es gratis para los clientes. Ingresas con tu correo, sin contraseñas.

¿Tienes un negocio? Agrégalo gratis en stampy.pro.

name: StockCount Pro
description: Count warehouse stock offline.

name: STRIPE FIVE
description:
STRIPE FIVE brings instructional grappling and martial arts video from real coaches into one place.

WATCH AND LEARN
• Instructionals from verified coaches and competitors: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, no-gi, wrestling, striking and strength & conditioning
• Free previews on every video, and your full library on any device
• Collections that group a coach's videos into a structured course

TRAIN WITH YOUR GYM
• Join your gym by scanning its QR code
• Your gym's shared library: everything your academy has unlocked for its members
• Gym owners can run their whole member list from the app

KEEP WHAT YOU LEARN
• Timestamped notes on any technique
• A wishlist of videos to come back to
• Notifications when the coaches you follow release something new

COACH'S CORNER
• Send your rolling or competition footage to a coach and get a personal video breakdown back

FOR COACHES
• Upload and manage your videos, follow your stats, and reply to Coach's Corner requests on the go

STAYING SAFE
• Report any post or comment, and block accounts you don't want to see

An account is needed to use STRIPE FIVE. You must be 18 or over.

name: Stronux
description:
Stronux is where your learning community lives. Join the conversation with the people in your courses, learn at your own pace and show up to live sessions — all with the account you already use on the web.

• Community: post, reply, mention people, like and share photos with the members of each course you belong to.
• Your courses: all the courses you joined in one place, with your progress, and the next lesson one tap away.
• Lessons made for your phone: video, slides, readings and tests, with your progress saved as you go.
• Live sessions: one calendar with the sessions of every community you belong to. Add them to your calendar and join when it's time.
• For creators: if you run a community, see the courses you manage right from your phone.
• Your account: edit your profile, change your password, see your purchases and delete your account from the app.

You join communities and courses on each creator's website. There's nothing to buy in the app.

Questions? Visit stronux.com/help or write to contact@stronux.com.

name: StructMetrics Mobile
description:
StructMetrics brings construction measurement and progress control to the jobsite—so field teams and the office work from the same source of truth.

Built for general contractors, developers, and project teams who need reliable field data, photographic evidence, and clear visibility into what was measured and when.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Record measurements on site with a clear, guided workflow
• Attach photo evidence from camera or library to support each measurement
• Review completed measurements by project, month, and inspection
• Monitor progress with project charts—general, monthly, inspection, client, and production views
• Stay productive in the field with sync designed for real jobsite conditions
• Access your enterprises and projects with your StructMetrics account

DESIGNED FOR THE WAY CONSTRUCTION WORKS

StructMetrics connects field execution to planning and control. Measurements, evidence, and progress views stay aligned with your organization’s projects—reducing rework, disputes, and “what was actually done on site?” uncertainty.

WHO IT’S FOR

• Field engineers and supervisors capturing progress on site
• Project managers tracking measurement status across inspections
• Construction companies standardizing how progress is recorded and evidenced

ACCESS

StructMetrics is an enterprise platform. Sign in with your company account credentials provided by your organization. New customers can learn more at structmetrics.com.

SUPPORT & PRIVACY

Support: https://structmetrics.com/support
Privacy: https://structmetrics.com/privacy
Account deletion: https://structmetrics.com/deletion

name: Sufro Waiter
description:
Sufro Waiter puts table ordering in your waiters' hands. Take the order at the table on a phone and it prints straight away on the kitchen printer, with no running back and forth to the counter.

Sufro Waiter works with Sufro POS, the restaurant's billing till, and Sufro Admin, the back office where the owner sets up menus, tables and staff.

AT THE TABLE
- See every table live: free, ordering, served or waiting for the bill
- Pick the guests, then add dishes from the outlet's own menu with search and categories
- Notes for the kitchen on any item ("less spicy", "no onion")
- Prices, offers, service charge and GST worked out as you go, the same way the till bills them

STRAIGHT TO THE KITCHEN
- Each round is sent as a kitchen ticket (KOT) to the right kitchen printer through the outlet's till
- Add more rounds to the same table, move a table, or ask the counter to print the bill
- Orders taken while the Wi-Fi drops are kept on the phone and sent when it is back, never twice

FOR THE TEAM
- Pair a phone in seconds by scanning the QR on the till
- Shared phones: each waiter signs in with a staff PIN, and is signed out after a quiet spell
- "My tables" shows only your own tables during a busy shift

Sufro Waiter needs a restaurant that uses Sufro. To try it, ask your Sufro administrator for a pairing code.

name: Sum Lattice
description:
A little room to think.

Sum Lattice is a quiet number puzzle about making every line balance. Place numbers from a limited pool into an intersecting grid of equations. A shared tile belongs to more than one equation, so every choice connects.

200 CLASSIC PUZZLES
Start with simple addition, then find your way through subtraction, multiplication, division and denser grids. Six chapters take you from Primer to Summit, with checkpoints along the route. There is no countdown in Classic: take the time you need.

10 MASTER TRIALS
Ready for a sharper challenge? Each trial gives you five minutes to balance the board. Trial I is available from the start; clearing each trial opens the next. Return for six puzzle variants per trial, transposed layouts in later cycles and occasional One Submit rules, where an incorrect submission resets your placements.

SMALL MOVES. SATISFYING LOGIC.
• Select a cell and a number in either order.
• Use each copy from the pool once; some puzzles include spare numbers.
• Follow shared cells across intersecting equations.
• Undo a move, clear a tile or enlarge the board when you need a closer look.
• Use one free hint per Classic puzzle; revealed tiles stay in place.
• Submit when you are ready, then follow the highlighted cells if a line needs another look.

MADE FOR QUIET MOMENTS
Warm paper textures, tactile tiles and gentle sound effects make room for concentration. Choose sound and haptic settings to suit you. Your progress and unfinished puzzles save on your device.

Play offline on iPhone and iPad. No account, advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Place a number. Find the balance.

name: Sumi: Calm Ink Painting
description:
Sumi is a quiet studio for Japanese ink painting on iPhone and iPad. You do not need to know how to paint. You only need to enjoy the process.

Dip the brush, touch the washi paper and watch the ink settle. Paint a single leaf, a circle in one breath, a moon over still water. Stay for two minutes or for an evening. Nothing is graded and nothing is counted.

• Begin in seconds: your first circle takes one slow stroke, and the painting is yours to keep.
• Four brushes, five shades of ink: a broad brush for leaves, a fine tip for stems, a dry brush that breaks into texture, and a wide wash for mist and mountains.
• Ink that behaves like ink: it pools, runs dry and settles into the paper after you lift the brush. Apple Pencil pressure and tilt are supported.
• Twelve guided paintings in four movements: first strokes, the Four Gentlemen of bamboo, orchid, plum and chrysanthemum, ma (the art of empty space), and mountains and water.
• Guidance that fades as you grow: faint ghost strokes, a quiet demonstration brush, soft hints about where things might go, and finally a master's reference to paint beside. Hide it whenever you like.
• Free painting on three kinds of paper whenever you want to wander.
• Finish with a seal: press a vermilion seal, name your painting, and it joins your journal.
• A journal, not a scoreboard: rename, annotate, continue, export and share your work.
• Gentle sound and touch: brush on paper, rain, a mountain stream or wind in the pines, each one optional.

There are no scores, streaks, timers or reminders, and nothing to win or lose. Sumi works fully offline, has no accounts or ads, and everything you paint stays on your device.

name: Sun Bolt Walk
description:
Lightning strikes the highest thing under the cloud. Make sure it isn't you.

A stick man in a yellow raincoat has to cross a meadow in the middle of a thunderstorm to reach his little hut. Dark clouds drift over the field on fixed paths, and every turn each cloud strikes the tallest thing in the 3x3 patch of shadow beneath it.

He is one step tall. A tree is two. An iron rod is three. Stand next to something taller and the bolt goes there instead. Stand alone in an open field and you are the lightning rod.

• Stones are safe shelter for good
• A tree takes one bolt, then it is a stump
• Plant your iron rod next to you, pull it back up later, but never under a cloud
• Strike a Leyden jar to charge it, and its iron gate sinks into the ground
• A bolt that lands in a puddle runs through all of it
• On a slope you are as tall as the hill beside you

Every turn shows you where the lightning would fall, and red rings warn you about the step that gets you zapped. The puzzle is in planning ahead: where will the clouds be when you get there?

• 20 handcrafted fields in 4 acts: Open Field, Iron Rods, Leyden Jars and Puddles
• Every field is checked by a computer solver that knows the fewest turns to the hut. Match it for 3 stars
• Turn-based and relaxed: no reflexes needed. UNDO any turn, even a zap
• Score points for stars, speed and streaks of 3-star fields, and climb the rank board on your iPhone
• Stuck? You have 5 skips per run. When they are gone, start a fresh run and beat your best score
• A glowing storm-station look, real 3D rain, flashes and thunder, and a shower of sparks when you make it home
• Play offline. No ads, no accounts, no tracking

name: Super Awesome Trip Planner
description:
Super Awesome Trip Planner keeps a whole trip in one place: flights, stays, drives, tours, restaurants and ideas, laid out day by day and drawn on a map.

PLAN IT DAY BY DAY
• Every flight, hotel, rental car, drive and booking on a day-by-day itinerary
• See the whole route on a map, with each day's stops
• Weather forecasts for the places you'll be
• "Next up" shows what's coming while you're on the road
• Confirmation numbers one tap from copying, and ticket files saved for when you're offline

ADD BOOKINGS FROM A PICTURE
Take a screenshot of a confirmation email, or choose a PDF, and the app reads it and fills in the details for you to check. The app asks first before any picture is sent to be read.

TRAVEL WITH FRIENDS
• Start a travel group and invite people with a link
• Each person keeps their own itinerary, and you see everyone's plans together, or just one person's
• Share the things you're doing together, like a cabin or a tour, once for everyone
• Post photos to the group, sorted by day and placed on the map
• Suggest ideas and mark them done

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your trips are seen only by the people you share them with. What a booking cost and your ticket files are visible to you alone. No ads, no tracking.

Sign in with Apple, Google or an email address. New accounts are approved by the person who runs the app.

name: Surface Volume
description:
**Two surfaces. One number. Every cell.**

Surface Volume Bench turns a grid of spot elevations into the map you needed before the takeoff: every cell coloured by its depth, amber for cut and teal for fill, with a white zero line where the design plane crosses the ground.

Drop the plane and the cells flip one by one. The net moves with them — until the balance curve crosses the current elevation.

It is not a takeoff and not machine control. It answers the question that comes first: **how high does this site grade before it stops exporting material?**

name: Surge Sigil
description:
Surge Sigil is an offline puzzle cabinet for the shore.
Coral, shell, and kelp fragments wait in the tray. Beds wake and sleep with the tide. Some pieces show only at high water; others move only in the gap between. Drag them onto the shelf, turn them around the pearl, and cover every dashed mark to seal the pattern.
There is no clock. Leave a chart half finished and it will still be there.
WHAT YOU DO
• Seat fragments while ebb, flood, and slack allow it
• Rise and Fall walk the tide forward or back
• Currents, rock, and ringed coves appear on later charts
• Seal a finished pattern and leave a field note
ON THE TABLE
• Twelve charts across Shallow Shelf, Channel Bend, and Outer Reef
• An almanac of tides, beds, and sea creatures
• A voyage log of seals and best marks
• Preferences for haptics and motion—all kept on this iPhone
Surge Sigil does not predict real tides and is not a navigation aid. No account, no network, no purchases, no ads.

name: Sweep Fit
description:
Sweep Fit checks a conduit bend you already have on the wall. Drag the corner on the plan. The circle through the three points is the sweep. The sentence says the sweep holds, to ease the bend, or that a leg is too short.

The minimum radius is the factor times the diameter. The factor starts at 6. A leg that cannot reach the setback has to be lengthened before the radius matters. Equal to the minimum still holds.

Rack 4 is 16 mm with factor 6. The sentence says to ease the bend. Drag the corner up and the sentence changes when the sweep holds. Home 2 is the gentler run. Change the diameter or the factor, add a run, or swipe one away.

Each run stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This sketch is not a substitute for the bending procedure.

name: Syrinquel
description:
Syrinquel is a pocket instrument for one finger. Two streets share every choice you make. Only one of them answers immediately.
You are the brass spark on the right. Tap either side of the screen to change lanes, as many times as you like before the beat lands. Motes are yours. Thorns take a life.
The pale ring on the left is the echo. It does not follow your finger yet. Three beats later it steps into the lane you chose. Embers score only for the echo. Snares take a life.
Rings above the echo show where it will go. The brightest ring is the choice you are making now. Set that ring on an ember, and keep the spark off the thorns. Embers in a row build a latch. Eight in a row give a life back.
The streets quicken. Three lives. No timer, no second hand. Sound and haptics can be switched off. Your best score and longest latch stay on the device.

name: Table of Strangers
description:
Take your seat at a table of strangers. Seven AI characters are waiting, and two of the eight players are secretly Mafia.

Table of Strangers brings the social deduction game of Mafia to a solo voice experience. Listen to the conversation, question a suspicious story, defend yourself, and decide whom to trust. Speak naturally and interrupt when you have something to say.

A SECRET ROLE, A DIFFERENT STRATEGY
Play as Mafia, Detective, Doctor or Villager. Keep your information private, make your night choices, and use the day’s discussion to build your case before the vote.

SEVEN CHARACTERS WITH THEIR OWN VOICES
Your opponents are AI characters with different personalities. They make accusations, defend their choices and respond to what you say. There is no matchmaking or chat with other human players.

FIVE TABLE LANGUAGES
Choose English, Italian, French, German or Spanish. Turn captions on or off to suit the way you play.

VOICE ON YOUR IPHONE, GAMEPLAY AI ONLINE
Speech recognition and character voices run on your iPhone. With your permission, your nickname, recognized words and game history are sent to our game server, OpenRouter and model providers to run the game. Read the details in Privacy & support before playing.

FREE WITH DAILY LIMITS
No subscription, ads or in-app purchases. Daily usage and service capacity limits apply. The allowance varies with the amount of dialogue; it is not a fixed number of games. Reaching a limit or losing the connection can end a game. Daily allowances reset at midnight UTC.

Requires a compatible iPhone with iOS 26.2 or later, microphone access and an internet connection. The first game requires a voice download of about 400 MB; size varies by language. Games cannot currently be resumed after an interruption.

All other characters are AI. Generated dialogue can be inaccurate or inappropriate. Fictional deception, accusations and elimination are part of the game.

name: Tack: Quick Capture
description:
Tack is a notes app for getting a thought down before it goes.

Open it and you are already typing. There is no list to get past and no title to fill in. When the note is ready, one tap sends it where it belongs: an email, a reminder, a calendar event, the end of a running note, or one of your own Shortcuts.

YOUR NOTES ARE FILES
Every note is a plain Markdown file in a folder you choose: Tack's folder in iCloud Drive, or any other folder in Files. They sync through your own iCloud, open in any other Markdown app, and stay yours if you ever stop using Tack. There is no account and no server.

A FAST EDITOR
• Markdown is styled as you type: headings, lists, links, code
• Lists continue on Return, and a tap ticks a task
• A toolbelt above the keyboard for the marks you use most; choose and reorder them
• Themes, with adjustable colors and text size
• Optional vim mode for hardware keyboards

ACTIONS
• Append to today's daily note, or to a flagged or pinned running note
• Send to Mail, Reminders or Calendar. Tack reads the day, time and place out of the note for calendar events
• Run a Shortcut with the note's text
• Archive, copy, share
• Make your own, and choose what happens to the note afterwards: keep, archive or delete
• For anything else, an action can run a short script you write yourself

FIND IT AGAIN
• Inbox, Flagged, Daily, Archive and Trash
• Tags and saved filters
• Full-text search across every note
• Version history kept on your device

CAPTURE FROM ANYWHERE
• Share text or a link from any app, as a new note or onto the end of an existing one
• Siri and Shortcuts: create a note, append to a note, find notes, run an action
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and Control Center controls
• Note templates with the date filled in and options to pick

ON-DEVICE INTELLIGENCE
On devices with Apple Intelligence, Tack can summarize, proofread, rewrite, pull out key points, suggest a title and suggest tags. It runs on the device. On other devices these tools are simply not shown, and everything else works the same.

PRIVATE
Tack collects nothing. No analytics, no tracking, no account. Location is used only if you add a location field to a template, and it stays in your note.

name: Tank '86 - Photo Fuel Log
description:
Take a photo at the pump. Add the receipt or a shot of the odometer if you have one. Tank ’86 reads them together and turns the readings into a fill-up draft, so you can spend less time typing at the station.

Use the camera or choose up to eight photos and screenshots from your library. On-device text recognition (OCR) can suggest mileage, fuel volume, price or total paid. Check the suggestions, correct any field and fill in what the photos couldn’t show. You can also log the whole fill by hand.

Build a fuel history for each car, with its own distance unit and fuel preferences. Record the station, fuel grade, currency, partial or missed fills and driving conditions. Switch between kilometers and miles and between liters and gallons. The original amount and currency stay with every entry. Reference exchange rates can show spending in your chosen currency.

See fuel economy between full tanks, price and spending trends, and side-by-side car comparisons. With enough history, explore how driving conditions relate to fuel use and estimate an upcoming fuel budget. The instrument-style dashboard puts the readings up front, with a searchable log for the details.

Your fuel log and photo recognition run on your device. No account is required. Share a PDF report or a CSV export, and make a backup file you can restore later.

name: Tarachat iOS
description:
TaraChat is where your community hangs out. Jump into always-on voice rooms, go live on camera, share your screen, message friends privately and celebrate together with gifts, music and games, all in one app.

ALWAYS-ON VOICE ROOMS
Open a room and you're in, no join buttons. Raise your hand to queue for the mic, and room owners keep the conversation flowing. Rooms keep playing in the background, so you can keep listening while you use other apps.

CAMERA & SCREEN SHARE
Go on cam or share your screen in any room, and pin the views you want to keep on top.

PRIVATE MESSAGES & CALLS
Direct messages with 1:1 voice and video calls, buzzes and read receipts. New messages pop up as a chat bubble so you never miss a conversation.

GIFTS THAT CELEBRATE
Send gifts to friends or to whoever's on the mic, with room-wide effects everyone can see.

MUSIC & KARAOKE
Listen together and sing along right inside your rooms.

ROOM GAMES
Kick off trivia and party games in the room, no extra apps needed.

MAKE IT YOURS
Rich text and custom fonts, nickname colors, badges, crowns and message highlights. Show off who you are.

SAFE & SECURE
Two-factor authentication, recovery codes, blocking, reporting and active moderation keep accounts and rooms safe.

TaraChat is for adults 18 and over.

Terms of Service: https://tara-ph.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tara-ph.com/privacy

name: Taste Menu
description:
Taste Menu puts the menus of every Taste Vietnam restaurant in Hoi An in your pocket: Morning Glory, Cargo Club, Vy's Market, Ancient Remedy and more.

BROWSE BEAUTIFULLY
• Pick a restaurant, choose a menu, then jump straight to a category
• Real photos of every dish, with descriptions and every size and price
• Grid or compact list view

YOUR LANGUAGE
• English, Tiếng Việt, 中文 and 한국어, switch any time
• The app remembers your choice

FIND THE RIGHT DISH
• Search by dish name in English or Vietnamese
• Dietary filters: vegetarian, vegan, gluten free, lactose free, shellfish free and spicy. Show only matching dishes, or hide them.
• Drink lists and full menus as zoomable pages

ALWAYS UP TO DATE
• Menus update live as our restaurants change dishes and prices

FOR OUR TEAM
• Staff mode: connect a phone to one restaurant with a QR code; the menu is downloaded with all photos and keeps working offline
• Manager mode: our editors update dishes, photos, prices and translations, mark dishes as sold out and publish to every device

name: TeamFA
description:
TeamFA keeps your two-factor authentication codes on your iPhone and Mac, and lets a team share the codes it needs together.

YOUR CODES, EVERYWHERE
• Codes sync automatically through your own iCloud account. There is no TeamFA account to create and no TeamFA server.
• Every code, issuer and account name is stored encrypted in iCloud.
• Your codes stay available offline.

BUILT FOR SPEED
• Tap a code to copy it. The copy stays on this device and clears itself after a minute.
• A countdown ring shows how long each code has left, and warns you in the last seconds.
• Each code shows its site's own icon, so the one you want is easy to spot.
• Search across all your codes.

SHARED WITH YOUR TEAM
• Switch between your personal codes and the teams you belong to.
• Team members see the same codes at the same time, with view-only or edit access.
• Create teams and invite people from TeamFA for Mac.

EASY TO MOVE IN AND OUT
• Add a code by scanning its QR code or typing the setup key.
• Import the export QR codes produced by Google Authenticator.
• Export one code or a selection as a QR code that other authenticator apps can scan. Export is protected by Face ID or your passcode.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• TeamFA collects no data and contains no tracking or analytics.
• Site icons are fetched from the site itself, never from a third-party icon service.

TeamFA requires an iCloud account. Also available for Mac.

name: Télézap – Télécommande TV
description:
Télézap transforme votre iPhone en télécommande pour votre TV connectée. Tout passe par le Wi‑Fi de la maison : pas de boîtier à acheter, pas de compte à créer.

UNE VRAIE TÉLÉCOMMANDE, EN MIEUX
• Un design graphite inspiré des télécommandes haut de gamme : touches en relief, pavé directionnel avec bouton OK central.
• Chaque touche s’illumine et vibre légèrement quand vous appuyez : vous savez que la commande est partie.
• Volume, sourdine, chaînes, retour, accueil, menu, lecture, pause, avance et retour rapides.

PAVÉ TACTILE RÉGLABLE
• Glissez pour naviguer, touchez pour valider. Un geste = un déplacement, sans saut involontaire.
• Sensibilité réglable dans les Réglages, de « Douce » à « Vive ».

ÉCRIRE ET OUVRIR VOS APPLIS
• Un vrai clavier pour chercher un film sans pianoter lettre par lettre.
• Des raccourcis pour ouvrir en un geste vos applis de streaming déjà installées sur la TV.
• Pavé numérique, touches de couleur, info et guide.

VOS TV, TROUVÉES TOUTES SEULES
Télézap repère les TV compatibles présentes sur votre réseau. Vous pouvez aussi ajouter une TV par son adresse IP. Vos TV sont mémorisées pour la fois suivante. Appairage sécurisé : code affiché sur la TV ou demande à accepter, selon le modèle.

COMPATIBILITÉ (via le Wi‑Fi)
• Android TV et Google TV, dont TCL, Sony, Philips, Hisense et Xiaomi
• Samsung Smart TV (Tizen, modèles récents)
• LG webOS
• Roku TV et lecteurs Roku, dont TCL Roku TV
• Fire TV (après activation du débogage ADB dans les options pour développeurs)
• Chromecast : volume, sourdine, lecture et pause
La TV et l’iPhone doivent être sur le même réseau Wi‑Fi. L’iPhone n’a pas d’émetteur infrarouge : les TV sans connexion réseau ne sont pas compatibles.

RESPECT DE VOTRE VIE PRIVÉE
Gratuit, sans publicité, sans traceur, sans compte, sans abonnement. Les échanges restent entre votre iPhone et votre TV, sur votre réseau local. Les codes d’appairage sont rangés dans le Trousseau de l’iPhone.

PAS DE TV SOUS LA MAIN ?
Le mode démo vous laisse essayer toute l’interface.

Télézap est une application indépendante, éditée par LES HUMAINS. Elle n’est ni affiliée, ni approuvée par les fabricants de TV ni par les services de streaming. Les noms cités le sont uniquement pour indiquer la compatibilité.

name: The Phonics Room by Hashifa
description:
The Phonics Room is the official learning app for Hashifa's phonics programmes.

Enrol in individual or group phonics courses, join live online classes, work through chapter-by-chapter lessons, attempt quizzes and assignments, and track your progress, attendance and certificates — all in one place.

Key features:
• Individual and Group Phonics Programmes
• Live online classes
• Structured curriculum with chapters and study materials
• Quizzes to test your learning
• Assignments with in-app submission and instructor feedback
• Attendance and learning-streak tracking
• Certificates on course completion
• Secure sign-in for enrolled learners

Designed for clear, step-by-step phonics learning, guided by your instructor. Whether you are starting your phonics journey or continuing an ongoing programme, The Phonics Room keeps your classes, lessons and progress together in one simple app.

name: The Sanctuary of the TriCities
seller_name: The Sanctuary Church Of The Tri-Cities Of Tennessee
description:
This app will help you stay connected with the day-to-day life of our church. With this app, you can watch or listen to past messages, stay updated with push notifications, read the Bible, and view our calendar.

Mobile app version: 6.24.7

name: Tick Done
description:
Tick Done is the home for everything you say "one day" to, and the easiest way to actually plan it with the people you love.

SAVE IT FOR ONE DAY • Keep a list of experiences: trips, restaurants, concerts, hikes, classes and more • Add a date, place, cost, link and priority • Find ideas near you, from parks and museums to places other Tick Done users love • Share an idea with a friend so they can save it too

PLAN IT TOGETHER • Create a group and invite people with one link • Pick a date: send a link, friends tick the days that work, no app or account needed • Vote on places and budgets with quick polls • Build a day-by-day itinerary and open the route in Maps • Share a checklist, assign to-dos and keep bookings in one place

INVITE YOUR PEOPLE • Plan birthdays, dinners, weddings, baby showers and weekends away • Design a beautiful invitation from templates, with your own photo • Send it on WhatsApp, text or email. Guests open it and RSVP in a tap, with no app or account needed • See who's coming, plus dietary needs and notes, as replies arrive

SETTLE UP • Log what everyone paid and see who owes whom across all your plans • Mark payments as paid or received, and send a friendly reminder • Add how people can pay you, so nobody has to ask

KEEP THE MEMORIES • Shared albums with photos and short video clips • Check in when you're there, so your group sees you made it • Seal a memory capsule for a future date and open it together later • See everything you've ticked off in one place • Share a "Year in experiences" story card to Instagram, WhatsApp or Facebook

MAKE IT HAPPEN • The Today screen shows what's on, what's waiting on you and what's coming up • Daily goals and group challenges with streaks • Countdowns, this weekend's weather and calendar sync • Alerts when friends vote, RSVP, comment, pay or invite you

Your lists are private unless you choose to share them. Tick Done is free, with no ads.

Plan it. Live it. Tick it done.

name: Tie Stagger
description:
Tie Stagger keeps a rebar mat you are tying. Tap the next crossing. If the cell beside it in the same row or the same column is already tied, that tap stays open. The sentence names the row, the column, or both, and the next open cell.

The shop ratio starts at 0.25. When that share is met and a two-by-two bay is still empty, the sentence names that bay. Wall 3 is staggered. Bay 5 meets the ratio and still names bay C1. Slab 2 has more crossings to tie.

Each mat stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This sketch is not a substitute for the tying procedure.

name: TigerVault: Private Vault
description:
TigerVault keeps your private photos, videos and files in an encrypted vault on your iPhone and iPad. Draw a pattern to open it. There is no account, no sign-up and no server of ours that ever sees your files.

DRAW TO OPEN
• Draw a shape on a 5×5 grid. Your pattern becomes the key that unlocks the vault.
• Each pattern opens its own vault. The lock screen never lists your vaults, so nobody can tell how many you have.
• Hide the pattern trail while you draw, so no one can follow it over your shoulder.

ENCRYPTED, NOT JUST HIDDEN
• Files, thumbnails, names and folders are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they are stored.
• Your pattern is stretched with Argon2id, so guessing it is slow and costly.
• The vault locks as soon as you leave the app, and its contents are hidden in the app switcher.

NINE WORDS TO GET BACK IN
• Every vault gets nine recovery words. If you forget your pattern, the words open the vault.

CAPTURE AND KEEP
• Take photos with the secure camera, so they never land in your photo library.
• Import photos, videos and any other file.
• Organise with folders, move and rename, and search by name.
• A built-in photo viewer, with previews for videos and documents.

ENCRYPTED iCLOUD BACKUP
• Vaults are backed up to your own private iCloud and kept in sync between your iPhone and iPad. Everything is encrypted on your device first, so iCloud stores only scrambled data.
• The same pattern opens the same vault on all your devices.

MIDNIGHT OR PORCELAIN
• A calm dark theme, a light theme, or follow your device.

TigerVault cannot recover a vault without its pattern or its nine words. Keep your words somewhere safe.

name: Tigo UPDT
description:
Tigo UPDT es la app de "Tigo: un poco de todo", la tienda de Pollença (Mallorca).

GANA PUNTOS EN CADA COMPRA
Enseña tu código QR en caja y suma 10 puntos por cada euro. Al crear tu cuenta te regalamos 100 puntos de bienvenida.

CANJEA VALES Y REGALOS
Cambia tus puntos por vales de descuento o por productos de la tienda, directamente desde la app.

NOVEDADES Y OFERTAS
Recibe avisos cuando lleguen productos nuevos u ofertas especiales, en tu idioma.

FÁCIL PARA TODOS
Entras solo con tu número de teléfono y un PIN de 6 números. Sin correos ni contraseñas largas.

EN 5 IDIOMAS
Español, català, English, Deutsch y 中文.

Tigo: un poco de todo
Carrer de Cecili Metel 6, 07460 Pollença (Mallorca)
Lunes a sábado 9:00–21:00 · Domingo 9:00–20:30

name: Toadi's World
description:
Welcome to Toadi’s World—a colourful pixel-art adventure packed with friendship, mischief and mushroom pizza!

Run, jump and blast your way through seven story levels, from neighbourhood streets and a futuristic robot camp to a carnival, the moon and Pizza Madness.

Collect mini pizza slices for points, grab full pizzas to restore health and unleash your special attack against the bosses.

• Unlock playable characters as you progress
• Ride the Doom Coaster through loops and broken-track jumps
• Enjoy story cutscenes between adventures
• Keep trying with unlimited retries
• Play with touch controls or a compatible Bluetooth controller

The adventure continues after the main story!

Visit Arcade Night to play Hill Driver, Sky Jumper, Toadi Racing and Toadi Runner. Complete the arcade challenges to unlock the Special Stage, where Sashton & Chippy team up for a piggyback escape through a fast-food restaurant.

Clear the Special Stage to unlock the duo for adventures across the other levels.

Created by LDM.

name: Tokay: Agent Inbox
description:
Tokay is a companion for Rex servers: it puts the coding agents running on your Macs in your pocket.

AGENTS
See every agent at a glance: which ones need you, which are working, and which have finished or failed. Answer a permission prompt right on its card, or open its terminal to see exactly what it's asking. Group them by status, by Mac, or by project.

PROJECTS AND TABS
Your Rex sessions are your projects. Open any tab, start a new one with the agent you want, or start a new project in a folder. Rename and close projects as you go.

LIVE TERMINALS
Full, live terminals with smooth native scrolling, direct keys, and a keyboard bar for the keys a phone lacks. Fit a terminal to your iPhone, or keep the size it has on your Mac.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Tokay connects straight to the Rex servers you run, over your own tailnet. There's no account, no backend, and no analytics.

Works with Rex on your own Mac, reached over your own private network: Rex's built-in Tailscale makes that work from anywhere. Not set up yet? Try the demo on the welcome screen: a pretend Mac with agents to answer and terminals to open. Tokay is an independent, open-source client and is not affiliated with Superlogical.

name: Tombolata: tombola e smorfia
description:
La tombola di casa, con il telefono al posto del paniere.

Uno tiene il tabellone ed estrae i numeri. Gli altri prendono le cartelle, ognuno sul suo telefono, e le segnano col dito. Si gioca nella stessa stanza, oppure a distanza durante una videochiamata fatta con l'app che usate di solito.

Senza pubblicità e senza registrazione
Nessuno spot fra un numero e l'altro, nessun account da creare, nessun tracciamento. Si gioca anche senza internet.

Chi tiene il tabellone
• Estrae i numeri a mano, oppure lascia fare all'app: un numero ogni 5, 8 o 12 secondi.
• La voce del telefono chiama il numero e il detto della smorfia napoletana.
• Il tabellone è diviso nelle sei cartelle della tradizione e, se vuoi, gioca anche lui.
• Ambo, terno, quaterna, cinquina e tombola: l'app tiene il conto dei premi e di chi li ha vinti.
• Un numero estratto per sbaglio si annulla.

Chi gioca con le cartelle
• Da una a sei cartelle per telefono.
• Tocchi il numero quando viene chiamato; lo tocchi di nuovo per togliere il segno.
• L'app ti avvisa quando ti manca un numero e quando hai fatto il premio.

Anche con le cartelle di carta
• Per chi gioca senza telefono stampi le cartelle: sei per foglio, ognuna con il suo codice.
• Oppure mandi il PDF a chi le stampa a casa sua.

La vincita si controlla
Ogni cartella ha un codice di sei caratteri, scritto e come QR. Chi tiene il tabellone lo inquadra con la fotocamera o lo scrive, e l'app dice subito se l'ambo, il terno o la tombola ci sono davvero.

La smorfia, come la vuoi
• Classica: i novanta detti della tradizione napoletana, parole forti comprese.
• Per famiglie: salta le cinque voci meno adatte ai bambini.
• Spenta: solo i numeri.

Se qualcosa non ti piace, dimmelo
• Dall'app mi scrivi cosa non va in due tocchi, anche senza scrivere niente.
• Il messaggio è anonimo; se vuoi una risposta lasci un'email o un telefono.
• Leggo ogni messaggio, ogni giorno.

In più
• La partita resta salvata se chiudi l'app.
• Lo schermo del tabellone resta acceso mentre si gioca.
• Numeri grandi e ben leggibili sulle cartelle.

I significati della smorfia vengono dalla voce «La smorfia» di Wikipedia in italiano (licenza CC BY-SA 4.0). È tradizione popolare: da zona a zona cambiano.

name: Tone Slip
description:
Tone Slip is for the moment a beginner takes one syllable from the pinyin chart and the slip on the desk is still blank.

Write the first, second, third, and fourth tones in that order. This iPhone places the tone mark on the vowel, shows the initial and the final, and adds the short spelling when that syllable uses one. When a tone has an everyday character, the slip shows that character and what it means.

Slips kept, tones written, and syllables still bare are counted on this iPhone. The finished slip stays here for you. There is no account, network, sample slip, audio, file, or payment. The chart is on this iPhone and is removed with the app.

name: Topology Bench
description: Topology Repair Bench is an offline iPhone app for inspecting and repairing small 2D GIS vector datasets. Import GeoPackage or GeoJSON to identify invalid geometries, polygon overlaps, coverage gaps, duplicate geometries, and endpoint near misses. Preview proposed repairs, review changes, and apply them as new revisions while preserving original data. Rerun checks to verify the results, then export repaired GeoPackage files, PDF reports, and delivery packages containing rules and supporting evidence for a traceable handoff.

name: Trailshift
description:
Broken stairs ahead. Rapids right after. In Trailshift, speed comes from choosing the right move for the terrain. Run on flat trails, jump over broken steps, swim past drifting logs and hold your grip on long rockfaces. Steer into a clear line, adjust your pace and boost when the trail opens up.

• Four-racer heats. Chase first place against three AI rivals. Flint is quick on flat ground, Brook excels in water, and Slate shines on stairs and rockfaces. Follow your position as the lead changes.
• A 15-course campaign. Learn the moves in the woods, then tackle broken stairs, logs, rapids and waterfalls. Go for gold times, first-place finishes and clean runs as separate goals.
• Expeditions and Daily Trials. Pick a side at each fork and compare your split times. Take on the day's course, chase a ghost of your best run, and use Run Lab to review a finish or practice a section.
• Signal Runs and Route Cards. Steer into marked lanes to collect enough beacons before the finish. Assemble a three-leg course from Route Cards and race the route you picked.
• Trail Workshop and Trail Passport. Build and test courses with terrain pieces, forks and beacons. Share a route code or import one to race. Earn badges across modes to unlock runners, workshop pieces and a bonus challenge.

name: Tramoia
description:
Quem daqui transformava uma ida ao supermercado numa aventura? A Tramoia põe a mesa a decidir.

Cria uma sala, mostra o QR e junta de três a oito pessoas. Lê o convite com a câmara dentro da app ou entra pelo código. Cada pessoa joga no seu telemóvel. As escolhas ficam em segredo até à revelação; depois chegam os pontos e a vontade de pedir desforra.

Entra com um nome e um avatar e mantém o perfil entre partidas. Descobre quem faria a maior trapalhada, adivinha preferências, inventa legendas, tira fotografias e desenha por cima delas. As fotografias são opcionais: as pessoas identificadas decidem se autorizam a utilização, a TV e a partilha.

Depois acelera: resolve contas rápidas, disputa os toques, mantém o equilíbrio e aparece nas tocas sem te deixares apanhar. No quiz, usa a energia da partida para preparar um bloqueio, uma bomba ou um escudo. As perguntas de atualidade mostram fonte e data; se não houver uma pergunta válida, entra um quiz editorial. A ronda final põe à prova a memória da mesa.

Escolhe uma partida curta, a mistura da casa ou os teus modos preferidos. São 12 tipos de desafio. Antes de cada ronda, todos veem as regras e confirmam que estão prontos. O equilíbrio pode ser jogado com toque ou inclinação. Todos precisam de internet, mas não da mesma rede Wi-Fi.

Queres um ecrã para todos? Lê o QR da Tramoia TV com o telemóvel e confirma no ecrã grande. Os telemóveis continuam a ser os comandos dos jogadores. A TV é opcional e mostra apenas o conteúdo autorizado.

Para 3–8 pessoas, com idade mínima de 16 anos no jogo. Podes passar desafios, denunciar conteúdo e eliminar o teu perfil. Não há apostas nem prémios monetários.

name: Tu Evento: invitación y álbum
description:
Abrí el link de tu invitación y Tu Evento se convierte en la app de esa fiesta, con el nombre, los colores y las fotos de quienes te invitaron. Desde ahí confirmás tu lugar, elegís tu menú, mirás el cronograma y subís tus fotos al álbum.

Sirve para casamientos, fiestas de 15, cumpleaños y otros eventos. Cada fiesta tiene su propio diseño, pero todas funcionan igual: encontrás cada cosa en el mismo lugar.

Si te invitaron, usarla no te cuesta nada. La arma Softweare para quienes organizan; vos sólo abrís tu link.

QUÉ HACÉS EN LA APP

- Tu invitación: la portada con los nombres, la fecha y la cuenta regresiva. Se abre con el link que te mandaron o con el código corto de tu grupo.
- Confirmás por persona: cada uno del grupo marca si va o no va y elige su menú (clásico, vegetariano, vegano, sin TACC o infantil). Si tenés una alergia o necesitás un plato especial, lo contás ahí. También podés dejar una canción y un mensaje para los anfitriones.
- El día: cronograma hora por hora, cómo llegar con Google Maps o Waze, dress code y cómo volver. Agregás la fecha a tu calendario con un toque.
- Álbum compartido: las fotos del fotógrafo y las de todos los invitados. Sacás una foto con la cámara o elegís una de tu galería y se suma al álbum de la fiesta. Las que te gustan, las guardás en tu teléfono.
- Regalos: el alias para transferir, que copiás con un toque, y el link a la lista de regalos si hay una. Tu Evento no cobra ni mueve dinero.
- Avisos: los anfitriones te escriben directo con una notificación («arrancó el vals», «el micro sale en 10 minutos») y los avisos quedan guardados en la app.

PENSADA PARA EL CELULAR

- Queda en tu pantalla de inicio y abre tu invitación al tocar el link, sin pasos de más.
- Te avisa con notificaciones cuando pasa algo en la fiesta. Son avisos del evento, no publicidad, y las podés apagar cuando quieras.
- Usa la cámara y la galería de tu teléfono para subir fotos.
- Si en el salón no hay señal, tu invitación igual se abre.

TUS DATOS

- Lo que contás de tu alimentación es opcional: el salón lo ve para preparar tu plato y se borra 30 días después del evento (hasta 7 días más en copias de seguridad cifradas).
- A las fotos que subís les sacamos la ubicación.
- Si una foto no tiene que estar, la sacás vos (si es tuya) o pedís que la saquen, y la revisamos.
- No hay cuentas ni publicidad. Los anfitriones ven si abriste tu link y cuándo; tu actividad no se comparte con otras apps ni con anunciantes.

¿TODAVÍA NO TENÉS TU LINK?

Tocá «Ver un ejemplo» y mirá cómo se arma una invitación. Si el evento lo organiza una agencia, vas a ver su nombre y su logo en la invitación y en el pie de la app.

Qué ves depende de lo que armaron los anfitriones: el álbum y los regalos aparecen si ese evento los tiene.

¿Una duda o algo no anda? Escribinos a hola@tu-evento.com.

name: Tử Vi Ánh Sáng: Lá số AI 2027
description:
Xem lá số Tử Vi dịp đầu năm, khi đón con hay trước ngày cưới là nét văn hóa quen thuộc của nhiều gia đình Việt. Tử Vi Đẩu Số là hệ thống cổ học phương Đông, dựa trên lịch pháp, âm dương và ngũ hành. Tử Vi Ánh Sáng giúp bạn đọc lá số của mình như một tấm gương để chiêm nghiệm điểm mạnh, xu hướng và nhịp vận của bản thân, rồi tự quyết định con đường của mình.

App lập lá số theo cách an sao dòng Việt, rồi để Thầy AI luận giải dựa trên chính lá số của bạn. Mỗi nhận định đều nêu căn cứ: sao nào, ở cung nào, chiếu từ đâu.

LẬP LÁ SỐ MIỄN PHÍ
• Nhập ngày giờ sinh âm hoặc dương lịch, app tự tính và an đủ 12 cung, chính tinh, phụ tinh, Tứ Hóa, Tuần, Triệt trong vài giây.
• Lịch âm Việt Nam tính theo giờ chuẩn UTC+7, giờ Tý tính từ 23 giờ, tháng nhuận chia theo ngày 15.
• Lá số và thông tin sinh chỉ lưu trên máy của bạn.

THẺ 95 SAO
• Chạm vào từng sao để xem bản chất sao, ý nghĩa sao ở cung đó, Tứ Hóa, sao đi cùng, Tuần và Triệt.

THẦY AI LUẬN GIẢI
• Bài trọn lá số: tổng quan cốt cách, 12 cung theo nghĩa gốc của từng cung, lời khuyên nên và kỵ.
• Đọc trước phần mở đầu miễn phí.
• Trong lúc chờ, xem Thầy an sao trên bàn 12 cung với các quan hệ thật của lá số.

VẬN HẠN
• Đại vận mười năm, vận năm 2027 Đinh Mùi, vận tháng, vận ngày.
• Mức thuận lợi theo tháng và theo ngày, kèm lý do.
• Xem ngày giờ: ngày giờ Hoàng đạo, Lục Diệu, ngày hợp hay xung tuổi, gợi ý giờ ký kết và xuất hành.

ĐỒNG XU
• Tặng 15 đồng xu khi đăng nhập lần đầu.
• Giá mỗi bài hiện rõ trước khi luận. Chỉ trừ xu khi bài luận xong; nếu lỗi, xu được hoàn tự động.
• Bài đã mở xem lại miễn phí.

RIÊNG TƯ
• Không có quảng cáo.
• Đăng nhập bằng Apple hoặc Google.
• App không gửi họ tên, ngày giờ sinh hay nơi sinh lên máy chủ. Thầy AI chỉ nhận cấu trúc lá số.
• Xóa tài khoản và toàn bộ dữ liệu ngay trong app.

Nội dung Tử Vi mang tính tham khảo và chiêm nghiệm văn hóa truyền thống, không phải lời tiên đoán chắc chắn. Bài luận không phải lời khuyên y tế, pháp lý hay tài chính. App không phán bệnh tật, tai nạn hay tuổi thọ, không bán dịch vụ cúng bái, giải hạn hay vật phẩm. Mỗi bài luận có nút để bạn chấm điểm và báo cáo nội dung chưa phù hợp.

Một sản phẩm của Công ty Cổ phần Einslight.
Hỗ trợ: hotro@einslight.com

name: Tuck & Trail
description:
Tuck & Trail is a bright sky-caravan packing adventure in which every standard playing card becomes a physical piece of travel gear. Each rank occupies a different shape, each suit belongs to a different storage zone, and every corner index stays visible as you rotate, tuck and weave supplies into a limited Trunk, Pack and Pannier.

Create Packweave links by placing neighboring ranks into continuous routes and gathering matching suits into supply groups. A tidy load is only the beginning: changing weather, urgent station orders and quick-access requests can make you rethink the journey before departure. Open slots are scarce, so practical placement and room to adapt matter as much as a clever shape.

Travel five original sky routes through cloud depots, kiteglass markets and ribbon-wind passes. Take on fixed packing scenarios, a fresh Daily Pack, the continuous Endless Road and a growing Trail Journal of supplies, stations and weather. Nook, the cloud sheep, watches over the luggage while you plan.

Tuck & Trail is fully offline and contains no ads, real-money purchases, energy timers, loot boxes or accounts.

name: TV Guide: What's On Tonight
description:
TV Guide shows what's on: now, tonight and all week, in a clean native app.

NOW
Every channel at a glance: what's on right now, how far in it is, and what's next. Tap any programme for details, or swipe to set a reminder.

TONIGHT, NOT THE NEWS
The Tonight view skips the evening bulletins and picks each channel's main event, whether it's the film, the match or the big series episode, so you can decide in seconds.

TIMELINE
Prefer a classic grid? Switch to the timeline and pinch to zoom from the whole evening down to the half hour.

FAVORITES AND REMINDERS
Star your channels and they get their own tab, even across countries. Reminders arrive as notifications a few minutes before a show starts.

YOUR OWN TABS
Build up to two custom tabs from simple filters: football matches, films on tonight, kids' shows on your favourite channels, first runs only.

13 COUNTRIES
Turkey, United Kingdom, United States, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Poland and Portugal. The guide follows your device's region, and you can switch country any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your favourites and reminders stay on your phone.

Listings are compiled from publicly available schedules and may change at short notice. TV Guide is not affiliated with any broadcaster.

name: TVCleanzer: чистка Android TV
description:
Is your TV slow, full of ads and installing apps on its own? TVCleanzer cleans it up from your phone — no root, no computer, nothing to install on the TV.

WHAT IT DOES
• One-tap clean-up: telemetry, ad services, store demo modes, fake "boosters" and other preinstalled bloat. The database is built from 463 tested lists of real TV models from dozens of brands.
• Safe by design: home screen, HDMI inputs, remote, keyboard, updates and system services are never touched. Your own apps are never pre-selected.
• Undo anything: every clean-up is kept in History and can be reverted in one tap.
• Boost: faster animations, more free memory, cleaner cache — with before/after numbers.
• Phone remote: D-pad, volume, Home, text input.
• Our own launcher: tiny (under 100 KB), with clock, favourites, HDMI inputs, skins, your own photo and a PIN-protected kids mode. Installed and set up from your phone, removed in one tap.
• Google TV pairing by code for TVs with Wireless debugging.
• Demo mode: try every feature without a TV.

WHAT YOU NEED
• An Android TV / Google TV set or box.
• Debugging turned on in the TV's Developer options — the app has a step-by-step guide for your brand.
• Phone and TV on the same Wi-Fi network.

Doesn't work with Tizen, webOS or VIDAA TVs — they are not Android.

Free. No ads. No data collection.

name: Two at the Table
description:
Made for iPhone Duo. Unfold it, lay it flat between you and the big inner screen becomes a real game table for two, with the fold running right along the middle line: your half, their half.

Two players, one iPhone Duo, face to face. No accounts, no internet, no waiting for strangers online. (Other iPhones can play in landscape, but every board is designed for the unfolded Duo screen.)

SIX GAMES IN ONE APP
- Air Hockey: both play at the same time, first to 7 goals
- Chess: full rules with castling, en passant and checkmate
- Backgammon: dice, hitting, the bar and bearing off
- Checkers: forced captures, multi-jumps and kings
- Four in a Row: drop your discs and connect four
- Dots & Boxes: the classic paper game, now with no pencil needed

BUILT FOR SITTING ACROSS FROM EACH OTHER
Every text, score and turn hint faces the player it belongs to. Red plays from the left edge, Blue from the right.

PLAY ANYWHERE
On the train, in a cafe, on holiday or at the kitchen table. Everything works offline and the app keeps your win count for every game.

name: TzoTzo
description:
Το TzoTzo είναι η εφαρμογή του χώρου προπόνησής σου — γυμναστηρίου, σχολής πολεμικών τεχνών, yoga ή pilates studio. Βλέπεις το πρόγραμμα, κλείνεις τη θέση σου και ξέρεις πάντα πού και πότε προπονείσαι.

ΒΡΕΣ ΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΣΟΥ
• Ψάξε στον κατάλογο χώρων ανά περιοχή και δες το πρόγραμμά τους.
• Μπες με τον κωδικό που σου έδωσαν ή στείλε αίτημα εγγραφής.
• Είσαι μέλος σε παραπάνω από έναν χώρο; Αλλάζεις χώρο μέσα από την εφαρμογή.

ΤΟ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑ ΣΟΥ
• Δες τα μαθήματα της εβδομάδας και πόσες θέσεις έχουν μείνει.
• Κλείσε θέση με ένα άγγιγμα, ακύρωσε όσο προλαβαίνεις.
• Γέμισε το μάθημα; Μπες στη λίστα αναμονής και περνάς αυτόματα μόλις ακυρώσει κάποιος — με ειδοποίηση στο κινητό σου.

ΟΙ ΚΡΑΤΗΣΕΙΣ ΣΟΥ
• Τα επόμενα μαθήματά σου, μαζί με το ιστορικό σου.
• Το πακέτο ή η συνδρομή σου, με τις επισκέψεις που απομένουν.

ΣΤΟ ΗΜΕΡΟΛΟΓΙΟ ΣΟΥ
• Σύνδεσε τα μαθήματά σου με το ημερολόγιο του κινητού ή του υπολογιστή σου.
• Ενημερώνεται μόνο του: αν ακυρώσεις κράτηση, φεύγει και από εκεί.
• Δουλεύει με iPhone, Google Calendar και Outlook.

ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ
• Στείλε μήνυμα στον προπονητή ή στη γραμματεία μέσα από την εφαρμογή.
• Ειδοποιήσεις για κρατήσεις, αλλαγές ώρας, θέση από τη λίστα αναμονής και ανακοινώσεις του χώρου σου.

ΓΙΑ ΠΡΟΠΟΝΗΤΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΙΔΙΟΚΤΗΤΕΣ
• Οι προπονητές βλέπουν τη μέρα τους, το πρόγραμμά τους και τις λίστες παρουσιών, και περνούν παρουσίες από το κινητό.
• Η γραμματεία και ο ιδιοκτήτης βλέπουν τα μέλη, εγκρίνουν αιτήματα εγγραφής, διαχειρίζονται πακέτα και απαντούν σε μηνύματα.

ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑ
• Κλείδωμα της εφαρμογής με Face ID ή δαχτυλικό αποτύπωμα.
• Σύνδεση με κωδικό ή με SMS.
• Μπορείς να διαγράψεις τον λογαριασμό σου μέσα από την εφαρμογή.

Χρειάζεσαι λογαριασμό σε χώρο που χρησιμοποιεί TzoTzo.

Απόρρητο: https://tzotzo.app/privacy
Όροι χρήσης: https://tzotzo.app/terms

name: Unfoldly
description:
Your iPhone Duo has a big, beautiful inner display. Unfoldly makes Safari use it.

Unfold your phone and Unfoldly switches Safari to Desktop Mode, so you get full desktop websites with every menu, sidebar and column. Fold it again, or share the screen with another app in Split View, and Safari goes back to the mobile site that fits. You never have to tap "Request Desktop Website" again.

HOW IT WORKS
• Unfolded and full screen: Desktop Mode.
• Folded: Mobile Mode.
• Split View or Slide Over: Mobile Mode, because a half-width window reads better as a phone layout.
Unfoldly looks at the width of Safari's window and whether it fills the screen, then picks the right mode as soon as the layout changes.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Width threshold: choose how wide Safari's window must be before desktop sites load (400 to 1,200 points, 650 by default).
• Per-site overrides: always load a site as Desktop or Mobile, whatever the fold state. Set them in the app or right from the Unfoldly menu in Safari.
• Pause anytime: one switch turns automatic switching off and on.
• Quick test: the app shows live what Safari would do in the current posture, and opens a test page that shows which mode Safari actually used.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Zero tracking. No analytics, no telemetry, no ads, no accounts.
• Nothing leaves your iPhone. Your settings live on your device, shared only between the Unfoldly app and its own Safari extension.
• Unfoldly never reads, stores or sends the content of the pages you visit or your browsing history.

LIGHT ON BATTERY
Unfoldly has no background process and does not poll. It responds only when Safari's window size changes, then gets out of the way.

GETTING STARTED
1. Open Settings › Apps › Safari › Extensions (Settings › Safari › Extensions on earlier iOS versions).
2. Turn on Unfoldly and allow it on All Websites.
3. Open Safari and unfold.

Questions? Visit unfoldly.app/support.html or write to support@unfoldly.app.

name: UnitBasket: Price Compare
description:
UnitBasket helps compare the quantities and prices you actually enter.

Create a board for mass, volume or item counts with one currency label. Add quantity per pack, packs per complete bundle and the actual total bundle price. See comparable unit prices, exact-ratio ranks and complete calculation terms. Change the display basis without changing the underlying comparison.

Need a particular quantity? Compare the whole bundles you must buy, the purchased amount, surplus and total cost for each offer. A cheaper unit price can still mean a higher checkout cost for your target.

Keep reusable offers in an independent Offer Library. Insert copies into compatible boards without linking later edits. Save immutable comparison snapshots, then generate real PDF and CSV reports with the terms used at that moment. History keeps your snapshots and output files separate from current boards.

Make a JSON backup or restore a validated whole-library backup through Files. Your comparisons work locally without an app account.

UnitBasket does not look up live prices, exchange currencies or combine different offers into an optimal basket. Entered prices are complete bundle totals; tax, shipping and coupon eligibility are not inferred.

name: UP Escape Mind
description:
Enter a world of mystery and puzzles in Up Escape Mind, an immersive escape-room adventure that challenges your observation, logic, and problem-solving skills.
Explore mysterious locations, discover hidden clues, collect useful items, and solve clever puzzles to unlock new rooms and uncover the story.

**Key Features:**
- Explore interactive escape rooms.
- Solve challenging puzzles and brain teasers.
- Find hidden objects and combine useful items.
- Discover clues and uncover mysterious stories.
- Use hints when you need help.
- Save your progress and continue anytime.
- Enjoy offline gameplay without an internet connection.

Can you solve every mystery and find your way out?
Download Up Escape Mind and begin your adventure!

name: URadical
description:
Sua próxima aventura começa aqui!

O URadical conecta você aos melhores instrutores de esportes radicais. Voe de parapente, voe de asa delta, sobrevoe lugares paradisíacos de paramotor ou encare trilhas, sempre com profissionais verificados.

ESCOLHA SUA AVENTURA
• Parapente
• Asa delta
• Paramotor
• Salto livre
• Voo acrobático
• Rapel
• Trilhas
• Vôo de Helicóptero
• Jet-Ski
• RopeJump
• Pêndulo
• Mergulho

ENCONTRE PERTO DE VOCÊ
• Busque por região, cidade ou bairro
• Use o "Perto de mim" e veja atividades em até 50 km da sua localização
• Filtre pela data que você quer ir
• Veja distância, dias disponíveis e preço por pessoa antes de decidir

INSTRUTORES VERIFICADOS
Todos os instrutores passam por verificação antes de entrar na plataforma. Você escolhe a experiência com mais tranquilidade e foca no que importa: curtir o momento.

AGENDAMENTO SIMPLES
Encontrou a atividade ideal? Fale direto com o instrutor pelo WhatsApp e combine tudo em poucos toques.

SALVE SUAS FAVORITAS
Marque as atividades que você curtiu e monte sua lista de próximas aventuras.

EM 3 IDIOMAS
App disponível em português, inglês e espanhol. Perfeito para quem mora no Rio e para quem está de passagem.

Das montanhas ao céu do Rio de Janeiro, a adrenalina está a um toque de distância. Baixe o URadical e marque sua primeira aventura.

name: Urbanguru Serviceman
description:
Urbanguru Serviceman is the companion app for service professionals working with Urbanguru.

When a customer books a service, the admin assigns it to you. Open the app to see your assigned jobs, view service and customer details, and update the job status as you work.

Key features:
- View all services assigned to you
- See service details, address and schedule
- Navigate to the customer location
- Mark services as complete once the job is done
- Get instant notifications for new assignments and updates

Note: This app is for registered Urbanguru service professionals. Jobs are assigned by the Urbanguru admin team.

name: UySofi
description:
UySofi is a rental marketplace for Uzbekistan where only property owners can post listings — no realtors or middlemen.

• Search homes on the map — apartments, houses, offices
• Whole home or a shared room with roommates
• Daily or monthly rent, prices in so'm or dollars
• Chat with the owner inside the app
• Every owner verifies their phone number by SMS
• Report suspicious listings with one tap

Post your own listing in a few minutes: add photos, mark the location on the map and set the price. Listings are reviewed before they appear.

Available in Uzbek, Russian and English.

name: V Notes - Vaidik Notes
description:
V Notes — a simple, beautiful and free notes app for everything you want to write down and keep.

Daily tasks, shopping lists, study plans, verses, ideas or a diary — all in one tidy place.

Write beautifully
• Headings, bold/italic, text colour and highlight
• Bulleted, numbered and lettered lists; checklists you can tick off
• Tables, dividers and text sizes

Add anything to a note
• Photos from the camera or gallery
• Document scan
• Record your voice or attach an audio file

Stay organised
• Folders, note colours, pins and favourites
• Grid or list view — your choice
• Search inside your notes, with matching words highlighted

Safe in your Google Drive
• Optionally sync with your Google account — change phones, keep your notes
• The same notes on Android, iPhone, iPad and the web
• Your notes live in your own Drive, not on our servers

And more
• App lock (fingerprint / Face ID)
• Share a note as text, PDF, Word or image
• Light or dark look
• Ten languages including English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi and Bengali

No ads. No charges.

name: ValPulse
description:
Your whole game account, beautifully organised and one tap away.

ValPulse is a fast, ad-free companion for your tactical shooter account. Sign in on Riot's own page and see your shop, battle pass, matches, collection and more, without loading the game.

A DAILY SHOP WORTH OPENING
• Mystery boxes: every daily offer starts face down, showing only its rarity. Tap to rattle, flip and reveal it, or reveal all at once.
• Live reset countdown, and the shop refreshes itself the moment it rotates.
• Accessories, featured bundles with savings, and your Night Market when it's live.
• Shop history: every shop you've seen, day by day, and how often each skin has appeared.

EVERY SKIN, IN DETAIL
• Every upgrade level and colour variant, with the picture that matches what you picked.
• Riot's in-game clips for each level and variant, in full screen.
• Wishlist any skin and get it flagged when it lands in your shop.

YOUR LOADOUT, YOUR WAY
• See every equipped gun with its buddy hanging off it.
• Swap buddies on any gun in a tap; it changes in the game too.
• Save your whole loadout as a preset and put it back on later.
• Change your banner from your player cards.

BATTLE PASS & MISSIONS
• Your level, XP to the next tier and the whole reward track, folded or full.
• Tap any reward to preview it.
• Weekly missions with progress and a reset timer.

MATCHES THAT TELL THE STORY
• Match history with results, K/D/A, score and RR won or lost.
• Full scoreboards with MVP, ace, clutch and top-frag medals, and party colours for players who queued together.
• A Progress tab with rank change and the XP each match gave you.
• Win rate, K/D and average combat score at a glance.

KNOW YOUR LOBBY
• From agent select on, see both teams with agents, ranks and levels.
• Tap a player for their recent matches and loadout.

RANK, LEADERBOARD & MORE
• Current and peak rank, plus a rank-up calculator that tells you how many matches you need.
• Your region's leaderboard with search.
• Premier team page and the pro VCT schedule and results.
• Agent pages with every ability, and which agents you still have to unlock.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• Light mode and a true-black dark mode for OLED screens.
• Liquid Glass controls, smooth animations and a choice of accent colours.
• Up to five accounts, each with its own sign-in, switched in one tap.
• English, Bahasa Indonesia, Español, Português (Brasil), 日本語 and ไทย.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• You sign in on Riot's official page. Your password never reaches ValPulse.
• No account, no tracking, no ads, no analytics. Your account data is only ever sent to Riot's own servers.

ValPulse is a free fan project. It isn't endorsed by Riot Games and doesn't reflect the views or opinions of Riot Games or anyone officially involved in producing or managing Riot Games properties. Riot Games and all associated properties are trademarks or registered trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.

name: VANTAGE: Caped Runner
description:
Ashgrave never stops raining. The Aviary owns its streets, its skies and its docks. You're Wren, the one runner they never caught.

Every run starts with a launch: the cannon on the roof of your hidden HQ fires you into the storm, and you're gliding over the city before your feet ever touch the street.

RUN, GLIDE, DIVE
- Swipe to switch lanes, jump and slide through traffic, barriers and rooftops.
- Hold to glide. Hold down to dive, let go to pull up and swoop back into the air.
- Tap targets to grapple across gaps.
- Every clean move feeds your chain. Keep it alive and the city moves to your rhythm.

TAKE THE CITY BACK
- Take down Aviary trucks to find out where their lieutenants hide.
- Bring down the gunship hunting you from the sky.
- Each recruit you free joins your team with a power of her own:
  EMBER - OVERDRIVE: a burst of pure speed that smashes everything in your lane.
  KESTREL - SKYWARD: hurled high over the roofs into a glide that won't drain.
  HERON - STRINGS: containers pulled over the street, box to box, on the beat.

SUIT UP
- Three suits for Wren: V1 Operative, Crimson and Ghost.
- Daily missions, a limited Night Watch event and career goals.

BUILT FOR YOUR PHONE
- Hand-drawn noir comic art, made for one-thumb play.
- No ads. No account. No data collected.
- Save your best moments as clips, right on your device.

Made by Mighty Mote Games, an independent studio.

name: Vau0
description:
Vau0 is the driver app for the VAU0 Portal. It puts everything a truck driver needs for the day in one place.

TODAY
See your current trip and the next stop first: facility, full address, appointment time with its time zone, reference numbers you can copy, dispatcher instructions and, for reefer loads, the temperature set on the load. Open your maps app, call your dispatcher, open the trip's documents or report a problem with one tap.

TRIPS
Active and delivered trips with search and filters. Each trip lists its stops in order, contacts, appointment and actual times side by side, truck and trailer, and documents. Mark Arrived, Loaded or Delivered; the time is saved when you press it.

DOCUMENTS
Photograph a proof of delivery, BOL, receipt or scale ticket, add several pages, rotate or retake them and send them as one document. Without a signal everything is saved on the phone and sent automatically later. A document shows "Sent" only after the server has confirmed it. See the status of your application documents and sign documents your carrier sends you.

PAY
Weekly pay statements with paid miles, rate, extras, deductions and net pay, the payment dates your carrier has set, and a PDF you can share. Questions about a pay period go straight to support with the period attached.

MESSAGES AND SUPPORT
Talk to your dispatcher and create support requests with the trip, document or pay period already filled in.

OPTIONAL TRIP TRACKING
If you choose, Vau0 can share your phone's precise location with your carrier during an active trip, including with the screen locked when you allow "Always" location access. It is off until you tap Start tracking, you can pause or stop at any time, and the status is always visible in the app. Locations are kept for 30 days, shown only to authorized people at your carrier, and never sold or used for advertising. Background location can drain the battery faster and stops if you force-quit the app.

Vau0 needs a VAU0 account connected to a carrier. Navigation opens your maps app and gives an ordinary car route, not a truck route.

name: Veralead CRM - Chats y Ventas
description:
¿Tus clientes escriben por WhatsApp, Instagram y Messenger y se te escapan ventas porque nadie contesta a tiempo? Veralead junta todos tus chats en una sola bandeja para que tu equipo responda rápido, venda más y no se pierda ningún cliente.

UN SOLO NÚMERO, TODO TU EQUIPO
Tus vendedores atienden el mismo WhatsApp de la empresa, cada uno desde su iPhone o su computadora. Se acabaron los chats en teléfonos personales y los clientes que se van con el vendedor.
• WhatsApp, Instagram y Messenger en una sola bandeja.
• Varias líneas y áreas: ventas, soporte, cobranzas.
• Reparto automático de chats, y cada cliente vuelve con su mismo asesor.
• Notas internas, etiquetas y respuestas rápidas.

ATIENDE AUNQUE NO ESTÉS
Pixibot responde al instante, de día y de noche: menús que llevan al cliente al área correcta y respuestas con inteligencia artificial (Gemini u OpenAI) que pasan a una persona cuando hace falta.

CIERRA MÁS VENTAS
• Embudo por etapas para ver en qué va cada cliente.
• Ventas ganadas y perdidas, con su motivo.
• Descubre qué anuncio de Facebook o Instagram te trae clientes.

CAMPAÑAS QUE SÍ SE LEEN
Envía promociones, recordatorios o novedades a tus contactos, con el nombre de cada cliente dentro del mensaje. Prográmalas para la hora que quieras.

MENOS CITAS PERDIDAS
Agenda citas, visitas o entregas, y deja que Veralead le recuerde al cliente por WhatsApp.

MIDE A TU EQUIPO
Cuánto tarda cada uno en responder, cuántos clientes atiende y cuántas ventas cierra.

CONEXIÓN OFICIAL CON META
Veralead es Tech Provider de WhatsApp aprobado por Meta: conecta tu número a la API oficial de WhatsApp Business.

TUS DATOS, SEGUROS
Las conversaciones son de tu empresa: viajan cifradas, cada empresa está aislada de las demás y nuestro equipo no lee tus chats.

Para entrar necesitas la cuenta de Veralead que te da tu empresa.

name: vervento Scanner
description:
Mit vervento Scanner verwalten Vereine den Einlass zu ihren Veranstaltungen. Die App ist für Vereine mit einem vervento-Konto und aktivem Ticketing.

ANMELDUNG
Melde dich mit dem Vereinskürzel, deiner Kennung und PIN an.

EINLASS
Wähle eine oder mehrere Veranstaltungen aus. Scanne Tickets beim Einlass mit der Kamera als QR-Code oder gib die Ticketnummer alternativ manuell ein. Bereits eingelassene Tickets werden als solche angezeigt.

ZÄHLER UND VERANSTALTUNGEN
Behalte den Überblick über eingelassene Tickets und die Gesamtzahl der Tickets. Die Kamera wird ausschließlich zum Scannen von QR-Codes verwendet.

Zahlungen finden in der App nicht statt.

name: Vibe Tapes
description:
Vibe Tapes is a four-track tape recorder for iPhone and iPad. It is one screen with no menus, built like a piece of hardware: every control does one thing and shows its own state.

USE IT TO
• Jam with a synth or drum machine. Plug it into the USB-C port and record it directly. When you stop, the tape plays back through the speaker, so there is nothing to unplug.
• Catch an idea before it goes. Open the app, press record, and sing or play into the microphone.
• Build a song in layers. Record a part, pick the next track, and play over what you already have.
• Practise a hard section. Mark it with cues, switch the loop on, and slow the tape down.

HOW IT WORKS
• Four tracks on a six-minute tape, each with level, pan, mute and solo.
• A reel you turn by hand to move through the tape, with a tick you can feel at every second.
• Tape speed from quarter to four times. Pitch follows speed, as it does on real tape.
• A click with tempo from 40 to 240 bpm.
• Cues and a loop that repeats the section you are in.
• Export mixes the four tracks into one audio file you can share or save.

IN THE BACKGROUND
Recording carries on when you leave the app or lock the screen. A Live Activity shows the take running on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

THREE FINISHES
Light, dark or green. On iPad the mixer sits beside the reel, with a full-length fader for each track.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. The app never connects to the internet. Your tapes stay on your device, and you can reach them in the Files app.

name: VideoVault
description:
Deine Videos. Dein privater Tresor.

VideoVault speichert deine eigenen MP4-Videos verschlüsselt in deinem persönlichen iCloud-Speicher. Verwalte deine Bibliothek auf iPhone, iPad und Apple-Silicon-Mac und schaue dort weiter, wo du aufgehört hast.

VERSCHLÜSSELUNG VOR DEM UPLOAD
Videos, Originalnamen, Vorschaubilder und Wiedergabestände werden auf deinem Gerät verschlüsselt, bevor sie an iCloud übertragen werden. Der Entwickler erhält deinen Tresorschlüssel nicht.

EIN PLAYER FÜR DEINE BIBLIOTHEK
Spule vor und zurück, passe das Wiedergabetempo an und verwende verfügbare Ton- und Untertitelspuren. VideoVault merkt sich deine Position und den Angesehen-Status.

AUF ABRUF ODER OFFLINE
Videos werden beim Abspielen in Blöcken geladen. Lade einzelne Videos vollständig für unterwegs herunter und entferne lokale Downloads, wenn du Platz brauchst.

DEIN ZUGANG BLEIBT PRIVAT
Schütze die App mit einem Code und optional mit Face ID oder Touch ID. Mit deinem Wiederherstellungsschlüssel verbindest du weitere Geräte mit demselben iCloud-Tresor.

DEIN SPEICHER IM BLICK
Sieh den geschätzten Videospeicher, ausstehende Übertragungen und die aktuelle Upload-Geschwindigkeit. Andere Videos kannst du auch während eines Uploads zum Löschen vormerken.

Wichtig:
• Ein angemeldeter iCloud-Account und ausreichend iCloud-Speicher sind erforderlich. Auf verbundenen Geräten muss derselbe Account verwendet werden.
• Die App ist kostenlos. Für zusätzlichen iCloud-Speicher können Kosten nach deinem Apple-Tarif entstehen.
• Sichere deinen Wiederherstellungsschlüssel. Ohne passenden Schlüssel oder entsperrbaren Zugang kann der Entwickler deine Inhalte nicht wiederherstellen.
• MP4-Dateien müssen einen vom Gerät unterstützten Codec verwenden. Ein Formatkonverter ist nicht enthalten.
• Uploads laufen bei geöffneter, entsperrter App; beim Verlassen wird die App gesperrt.
• Mac-Version für Apple Silicon ab macOS 14. iPhone und iPad ab iOS/iPadOS 17.

Support: apple@danmail.eu

name: Viewfinder: Film Framing
description:
Viewfinder helps you plan a 35 mm film photograph with the camera you already have in your pocket.

• Preview 28, 35, 40, 50 and 85 mm framing over a live rear-camera view. Turn the lever to switch focal lengths.
• Choose from three rangefinder-inspired frameline styles. Hold the view to see the whole scene, then release to return to your frame.
• Show the edges and perforations of 35 mm film. Save a reference photo of your composition to Photos.
• Tap Light meter to switch to a landscape view with a dual-needle exposure scale. Turn the aperture ring and separate shutter-speed and film-speed dials. The meter opens in manual mode, and can recommend a shutter speed or aperture for your chosen ISO.

Exposure readings are a reference for setting your film camera. Photos taken with the iPhone use its own automatic exposure.

Viewfinder works offline. There’s no account, advertising or tracking.

name: Vigifield: control de jornada
description:
Vigifield es el registro electrónico de jornada para empresas con personal en campo: obras, cuadrillas, mantenimiento, seguridad, servicios y ventas de ruta.

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta de tu empresa. Tu administrador te da de alta con tu correo.

CHECADAS QUE SÍ VALEN
• Checa entrada y salida solo en tu sitio de trabajo, con GPS o tag NFC.
• Si la ubicación está apagada o estás fuera del sitio, no hay checada.
• Cada teléfono queda ligado a su trabajador: nadie checa por otro desde su cuenta.
• ¿Olvidaste tu teléfono? Un compañero te checa con tu foto y tu supervisor la confirma.

TU JORNADA, CLARA
• Consulta tus horas, retardos y horas extra cuando quieras.
• Límite semanal y horas extra dobles y triples según la Ley Federal del Trabajo.
• Listo para la reforma de 40 horas y el registro electrónico obligatorio desde 2027.

CHOFERES Y REPARTO
• Tu ruta del día con sus paradas, en orden.
• Toca tu siguiente parada y navega con Apple Maps, Google Maps o Waze.
• Entrega con foto, firma y nombre de quien recibe; reporta incidencias.
• Reporte del vehículo: kilometraje, checklist, combustible y daños.
• Funciona sin señal: todo se guarda y sube al recuperar conexión.

PARA SUPERVISORES Y ADMINISTRADORES
• Quién está en sitio en tiempo real, desde qué hora y cómo checó.
• Choferes en el mapa en tiempo real durante su ruta.
• Exporta el registro, verifica que nadie lo alteró y revisa checadas con foto.
• Vendedores: visitas a clientes y formularios de reporte, también sin conexión.

PRIVACIDAD
• La ubicación solo se registra durante la jornada: con entrada abierta (trabajadores) o en horario laboral (vendedores).
• Solo los administradores de tu empresa ven tus datos. No hay publicidad ni venta de datos.
• Puedes eliminar tu cuenta desde la app.

Más información: https://vigifield.com

name: VisitorLog Pro
description: Log visitor check-ins offline.

name: VIVA Portal
description:
VIVA Portal là app làm việc nội bộ của Viva Living và các công ty cùng nhóm. Chỉ dành cho nhân viên đã được quản trị cấp tài khoản.

• Việc của tôi: việc được giao, hạn, việc trễ lên đầu. Báo xong, gửi file, ảnh ngay trên điện thoại.
• Trình ký: gửi đề xuất, thanh toán, tạm ứng; theo dõi ai đang duyệt.
• Lịch họp: lời mời, nhắc giờ, biên bản.
• Thông báo tức thì khi có việc mới, phiếu cần duyệt hay cuộc họp sắp tới. Bấm thông báo mở đúng việc đó.
• Dùng được trên iPhone và iPad, chữ to nhỏ tuỳ chỉnh.

name: Wagtone
description:
Wagtone puts your veterinary clinic's phone line on your phone. It is part of Woovet, the practice management software your clinic already uses, and works with your clinic's existing Woovet account.

Take and make clinic calls anywhere
- Calls to the clinic ring on your phone, even when the app is closed or the phone is locked.
